AI.result: 在Reacher、MountainCar和随机FourRooms环境中，即使理论假设被违反，智能体在少量奖励函数训练下仍能编码准确的动力学模型。基于Reacher智能体隐式世界模型训练的策略在速度目标的分布外任务上实现了准最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 证明了模型基与无模型强化学习之间存在深层联系，基于价值的智能体隐式编码世界模型，这提供了新的泛化能力视角，并为连接模型基、无模型和目标条件RL提供了新思路。

title: Evaluation of Small Language Models for Arabic Language Processing
summary: This paper evaluates the performance of twelve Small Language Models (SLMs) on Arabic natural language processing tasks. The study introduces a benchmark of 240 Arabic test items distributed across eight domains and ten language skills, covering both comprehension-oriented and generation-oriented tasks. All models were evaluated under a controlled zero-shot setting using a standardized Arabic-only prompt template. Model responses were assessed through a multi-model LLM-as-a-judge framework involving GPT-4.1 Mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, and DeepSeek-Chat, with scores aggregated across judges and analyzed by task, skill, and model family. The results show that Gemma 3 (12B) achieved the highest overall score (4.548/5), followed by Aya and C4AI Command Arabic. The observed results suggest that model size alone does not explain Arabic SLM performance. Models with stronger Arabic alignment and more reliable instruction-following behavior tended to perform better across tasks. Common failure patterns among lower-performing models include prompt leakage, hallucination, language drift, incomplete generation, and weak task adherence. Overall, the benchmark provides a structured reference for evaluating compact Arabic language models and supports future work on efficient, reliable, and culturally appropriate Arabic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了12种小语言模型在阿拉伯语NLP任务上的表现，建立了包含240个测试项目的基准，发现Gemma 3 (12B)表现最佳，且模型性能不单纯取决于参数量，而更依赖阿拉伯语对齐能力和指令遵循能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对小语言模型在阿拉伯语任务上的系统评估，需要建立一个结构化的基准来衡量紧凑型模型在阿拉伯语理解和生成任务上的表现。
AI.method: 构建包含240个测试项的阿拉伯语基准，覆盖8个领域和10项语言技能；在零样本设置下使用标准阿拉伯语提示模板评估12个SLM；采用多模型LLM-as-a-judge框架（GPT-4.1 Mini、Claude Haiku 4.5、DeepSeek-Chat）聚合评分进行分析。
AI.result: Gemma 3 (12B)以4.548/5获得最高分；模型大小并非决定性因素；阿拉伯语对齐和指令遵循能力更关键；低性能模型常见错误包括提示泄露、幻觉、语言漂移、生成不完整和任务遵循能力弱。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为评估紧凑型阿拉伯语模型提供了结构化参考，支持未来开发高效、可靠且文化适恰的阿拉伯语AI系统。

title: Study on Quantitative Dynamic Epistemic Logic for Belief Revision
summary: Belief revision is a process in which an agent begins to believe in something she previously did not. I begin the paper by presenting, based on (Gärdenfors, 1998; Hansson, 1999), postulates for belief revision that constitute the basis of the AGM theory. I will then briefly show the semantics of a modal logic introduced in (van Ditmarsch, 2005), which I call `$P$'. This logic formalizes static epistemic states and has greater expressive power than AGM in doing so because it captures the quantitative notion of "degrees of conviction". The third step is to introduce revision operators on $P$ and, mostly following (van Ditmarsch, 2005), obtain the Dynamic Epistemic Logic (DEL) I call `$P*$'. It models processes of belief revision in several ways. Original results are presented in the following two sections. The first one of these sections revolves around a formalization of AGM postulates within $P*$ by proving some theorems related to the satisfaction of those postulates by revisions defined in $P*$. The last section features an analysis of $P*$'s revisions that go beyond the mere satisfaction of postulates. I compare their formal behavior with respect to some philosophical criteria. At last, I conclude that the functions presented in (van Ditmarsch, 2005) are not good formalizations of the philosophical intuition behind AGM. Instead, it is captured by the function $*^0$ originally defined in this paper (but highly inspired by (van Benthem, 2007)). An implementation of this function is also provided.

AI.tldr: 本文在动态认知逻辑P*中形式化AGM信念修正公设，分析了van Ditmarsch(2005)提出的修正算子，发现其不符合AGM的哲学直觉，并提出了新的修正函数*⁰，该函数更好地捕捉了AGM的哲学内涵，并提供了实现。
AI.motivation: AGM信念修正理论在哲学上具有重要地位，但其与动态认知逻辑中的修正算子之间的对应关系尚未被充分检验。本文旨在考察van Ditmarsch(2005)的逻辑P中的修正算子是否真正符合AGM的哲学直觉。
AI.method: 首先介绍AGM信念修正公设和模态逻辑P（能够表达"确信程度"）；然后引入修正算子得到动态认知逻辑P*；接着在P*中形式化AGM公设并证明相关定理；最后对P*中的不同修正算子进行哲学标准分析。
AI.result: van Ditmarsch(2005)中的修正算子未能很好地形式化AGM的哲学直觉，而本文原创定义的函数*⁰（受van Benthem, 2007启发）更好地捕捉了这种直觉。
AI.conclusion: AGM的哲学内涵需要更精细的逻辑刻画，*⁰函数是一个更合适的候选，且已提供实现。

title: Rejections Based on Predictive Uncertainty Enable Reliable Routine Soil Spectroscopy
summary: Soil properties relevant to agricultural and environmental applications are conventionally measured using elaborate laboratory methods involving physical and chemical processing. While highly accurate, these conventional methods are costly and time-consuming. In contrast, optical spectroscopy paired with machine learning enables rapid and cost-effective predictions of multiple soil properties. However, spectroscopic modelling is often considered unreliable, as the predictive accuracy varies between soil properties and individual samples. To balance this trade-off between cost and reliability, we introduce reject-to-remeasure: an AI-based measurement framework that combines probabilistic modelling with uncertainty-guided rejection. In this framework, soil samples are first analysed using spectroscopy, after which predictions are rejected if their predictive uncertainty exceeds predefined quality constraints. Rejected samples are subsequently remeasured using conventional laboratory procedures. On a regional visible-near-infrared spectral soil library from Québec, we demonstrate that reject-to-remeasure with modern foundation models (TabPFNv2.5 and TabICLv2) can facilitate the integration of optical spectroscopy into routine laboratory workflows while meeting user-defined accuracy requirements and reducing measurement costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种“拒绝-重测”框架，将光谱预测与不确定性引导的拒绝机制结合，在满足精度要求的同时降低测量成本，并在魁北克土壤数据上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统土壤测量方法准确但昂贵耗时，光谱法快速廉价但预测精度不稳定。为了平衡成本与可靠性之间的矛盾，需要一种既能利用光谱法的高效性、又能保证结果可靠性的框架。
AI.method: 提出“拒绝-重测”（reject-to-remeasure）框架：先用光谱法配合概率模型进行预测，当预测不确定性超过设定阈值时拒绝该样本，转而采用传统实验室方法重新测量。使用了TabPFNv2.5和TabICLv2等现代基础模型进行不确定性建模。
AI.result: 在魁北克地区的可见-近红外光谱土壤数据集上，该框架在满足用户定义的精度要求的同时，显著降低了测量成本，验证了将光谱法整合到常规实验室工作流程中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: “拒绝-重测”框架能够有效平衡光谱法的成本优势和传统方法的可靠性，为光谱法在土壤检测中的实际应用提供了一条可行路径。

title: Economic Transformation and Cultural Change: Evidence from Two Centuries of French Drama
summary: How do large-scale economic transformations shape cultural production? We address this question by combining computational linguistics, econometrics, and formal modelling, using French drama as a well-documented empirical laboratory. Applying latent Dirichlet allocation to a corpus of 1,215 theatrical texts published between 1700 and 1900, we show that aristocratic discourse centred on sovereignty and political authority was gradually displaced by bourgeois and household economic themes as French capitalism developed. Bayesian vector autoregressive models with max-share shock identification suggest a temporal shift in the literary response to economic shocks: bourgeois everyday-life themes reacted to GDP shocks in the eighteenth century, whereas household-economic concerns became responsive only after 1820, amid accelerating industrialisation. A discrete-choice model shows that peer effects among authors and sensitivity to prevailing economic conditions can jointly account for these dynamics. Monte Carlo simulations reproduce the observed historical trajectory with reasonable fidelity. These findings offer a quantitative framework for understanding how economic transformations propagate into cultural production through identifiable social mechanisms, contributing to the study of cultural evolution and the long-run relationship between institutions and literary discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析1700-1900年间1215部法国戏剧文本，运用LDA主题建模、贝叶斯向量自回归和离散选择模型，揭示了资本主义发展如何推动戏剧主题从贵族政治话语向资产阶级家庭经济话语转变，并量化了经济冲击对文学主题的因果影响。
AI.motivation: 探究大规模经济转型如何塑造文化生产这一宏大学术问题，即经济发展与文学话语之间的长期关系。
AI.method: 结合计算语言学（LDA主题建模）、计量经济学（贝叶斯向量自回归）和形式建模（离散选择模型及蒙特卡洛模拟）的多学科方法。
AI.result: 贵族话语逐渐被资产阶级主题取代；经济冲击对不同主题的影响存在时间差异（18世纪影响日常生活主题，1820年后影响家庭经济主题）；作者间的同伴效应和经济条件共同驱动了主题演变。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一个量化框架来理解经济转型如何通过可识别的社会机制（如同伴效应）传播到文化生产中，为文化演化和制度与文学话语的长期关系研究做出贡献。

title: Process-Reward Tactic Evolution for Long-Horizon Bioinformatics Workflows
summary: LLM agents can write code and call tools, but reliable bioinformatics work requires long-horizon interaction with workflow software, typed data objects, provenance, and biological checks. We study this setting through Galaxy workflow execution. The agent must explore task data, construct or adapt an executable workflow DAG, bind inputs and dataset collections, monitor execution, debug failures, and validate biological outputs. We propose Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, a Galaxy-based training framework that turns verified workflow rollouts into reusable \tactics. During training, agents practice on curriculum-organized Galaxy tasks in Agent Gym; process verifiers score workflow construction, software interaction, execution, and biological correctness; successful and failed traces are distilled into a tactic library. At inference, the trained executor, Process-Reward Tactic Evolution, uses this library to execute held-out peer reviewed Galaxy workflow converted BioWorkflow Bench and BioAgent Bench tasks in isolated environments. The paper evaluates whether process-supervised tactic accumulation improves long-horizon bioinformatics workflow completion, biological correctness, and execution efficiency over no-memory and reflection-style baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Galaxy工作流平台的流程奖励策略进化（PRTE）训练框架，通过将验证过的工作流轨迹转化为可复用的策略库，提升LLM智能体在生物信息学长程工作流任务中的执行效率与生物学正确性。
AI.motivation: 生物信息学工作流需要长期交互、类型化数据对象、数据溯源和生物学验证，现有LLM智能体缺乏可靠完成此类复杂长程任务的能力。
AI.method: 提出Process-Reward Tactic Evolution框架：在Agent Gym中通过课程式组织任务进行训练，使用流程验证器对工作流构建、软件交互、执行和生物学正确性进行评分，将成功和失败的轨迹蒸馏为策略库；推理时利用该策略库在隔离环境中执行未见过的工作流任务。
AI.result: 在BioWorkflowBench和BioAgentBench的同行评审Galaxy工作流任务上评估，对比无记忆和反思式基线，验证了流程监督的策略积累能提升长程工作流完成率、生物学正确性和执行效率。
AI.conclusion: 流程监督的策略积累方法能有效提升LLM智能体在复杂生物信息学工作流中的可靠性和效率。

title: TF-SNO: Time-Frequency Gated Spectral Neural Operators for Learning Non-Stationary Partial Differential Equations
summary: Non-stationary partial differential equations (PDEs) arise throughout scientific computing, where the dominant frequency content and energy distribution can drift over time. While efficient in PDE solving, many spectral neural operators apply a shared spectral response across rollout stages, leading to mismatch with time-varying spectra in non-stationary systems. To address this issue, we propose Time-Frequency Gated Spectral Neural Operator (TF-SNO), a state-adaptive framework with learnable time-frequency gating inside spectral blocks. TF-SNO extracts compact frequency-domain and physical-space statistics from the current state to generate modulation coefficients, enabling the spectral response to evolve with the dynamics. TF-SNO learns temporal variation implicitly from the evolving state without introducing an explicit time dimension or time embedding, keeping the modeling complexity low. We further embed the adaptive operator blocks to accurately capture the multi-scale features, thereby improving long-horizon stability. Experiments on six non-stationary PDE benchmarks in 1D and 2D demonstrate that TF-SNO significantly reduces prediction errors and improves robustness compared to strong baselines, with particularly clear gains in long rollout, suggesting the effectiveness of state-dependent spectral adaptation in modeling non-stationary physical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出时间-频率门控谱神经算子(TF-SNO)，通过可学习的时频门控机制使谱响应随系统状态自适应演化，解决非平稳PDE求解中频谱漂移问题，在多个基准上显著提升长时域预测精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 非平稳PDE的频谱和能量分布随时间漂移，现有谱神经算子使用固定谱响应，无法匹配时变频谱特征，导致长时域预测误差累积。
AI.method: 在谱块中引入可学习的时频门控机制，从当前状态提取频域和物理空间的紧凑统计量生成调制系数，使谱响应随动力学演化自适应调整，无需显式时间嵌入。
AI.result: 在6个1D/2D非平稳PDE基准上，TF-SNO相比强基线方法显著降低预测误差，长时域滚动预测中提升尤为明显，鲁棒性更强。
AI.conclusion: 状态依赖的谱自适应机制能有效建模非平稳物理系统，在不增加时间维度复杂性的前提下提升长时域稳定性和精度。

title: Towards Pedagogically Aligned LLM Tutors for Math Mistake Remediation
summary: Large language models have strong potential for use in intelligent tutoring systems, but they often fail to follow effective pedagogical strategies, such as guiding students without revealing final answers. We study the application of a two-stage alignment pipeline for math mistake remediation, combining supervised fine-tuning on tutoring dialogs with Direct Preference Optimization on synthetic preference pairs. We construct a dataset that integrates existing tutoring corpora with synthetic data generated along pedagogical dimensions, such as scaffolding and factuality, and study different input configurations that incorporate solution correctness and gold answers. Experiments show that this approach improves both factual accuracy and pedagogical quality over base models and existing tutoring models. Human evaluation further indicates that our best model is competitive with a strong proprietary baseline, while providing additional benefits in terms of openness, transparency, and reproducibility. Our results highlight the effectiveness of preference-based pedagogical alignment, while also revealing challenges in reliably evaluating tutoring quality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两阶段对齐流水线（监督微调+直接偏好优化）提升大语言模型在数学纠错场景中的教学质量，使其既能提供正确引导又不直接透露答案，在事实准确性和教学品质上优于现有模型，并与强基线模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在智能辅导系统中潜力巨大，但常无法遵循有效教学策略（如引导学生但不直接给出答案），需要对其进行教学对齐。
AI.method: 两阶段对齐流水线：先在辅导对话数据上做监督微调，再通过合成偏好数据对进行直接偏好优化（DPO）。构建了融合现有辅导语料和按教学维度（如脚手架式引导、事实性）合成数据的数据集，并研究了不同输入配置（如正确性、标准答案）的影响。
AI.result: 该方法在事实准确性和教学质量上均优于基础模型及现有辅导模型。人工评估表明最佳模型可与强商业基线竞争，同时具备开源、透明、可复现的优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于偏好的教学对齐方法有效提升了模型的教学质量，同时也揭示了在可靠评估辅导质量方面仍存在挑战。

title: SignVLA: Real-Time Sign Language-Guided Robotic Manipulation via Attention LSTM and Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to execute manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions grounded in visual observations. However, existing VLA interfaces primarily rely on speech or text input, limiting accessibility for deaf, hard-of-hearing, and speech-impaired users. We present SignVLA, a real-time sign-language-guided VLA framework for accessible human-robot interaction. The system introduces a modular sign-to-text interface that converts visual sign gestures into semantic instructions compatible with downstream VLA policies. Given video streams, SignVLA extracts hand landmark features and employs an attention-enhanced Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal gesture dynamics for alphabet- and command-level sign recognition. A temporal stabilization module further improves prediction consistency in real-time interaction settings.The generated instruction sequence is then passed to a downstream VLA policy for sign-conditioned robotic manipulation. Experimental results demonstrate stable real-time sign recognition and successful execution of manipulation tasks driven by sign-language inputs. Our findings suggest that lightweight temporal sign recognition can serve as an effective and practical accessibility layer for multimodal embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: SignVLA提出了一个基于手语输入的实时VLA框架，通过手部关键点提取、注意力增强LSTM和时域稳定模块实现手势识别，并将识别结果转化为机器人操作指令，为听障和言语障碍用户提供了更可及的人机交互方式。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型主要依赖语音或文本输入，限制了聋哑、听障和言语障碍用户的使用，因此需要开发基于手语的交互接口来提升人机交互的可及性。
AI.method: 提出SignVLA框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 手部关键点特征提取；(2) 注意力增强的LSTM网络捕捉时间序列手势动态，支持字母级和命令级手语识别；(3) 时域稳定模块提升实时交互中的预测一致性。识别结果传递给下游VLA策略执行机器人操作。
AI.result: 实验证明了稳定的实时手语识别能力，并成功执行了基于手语输入的机器人操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级的时序手语识别可以作为多模态具身智能中有效且实用的可及性增强层。

title: DCD-PFN: A Decoupling-Aware Foundation Model for Causal Discovery
summary: Causal discovery is critical for understanding complex data-generating mechanisms, yet traditional algorithms often struggle with highly non-linear and noisy systems, or suffer from severe computational bottlenecks. Recent tabular foundation models based on Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot inference capabilities, but their potential for explicit structural causal discovery remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose DCD-PFN, a decoupling-aware foundation model for causal discovery. Instead of directly amortizing global graph reconstruction, DCD-PFN focuses on local causal discovery through a decoupling-based paradigm. Through pre-training on diverse synthetic Structural Causal Models (SCMs), the model learns sample-wise decoupling weights that enable Markov boundary (MB) identification. Furthermore, by leveraging parallelized local discovery, DCD-PFN efficiently reconstructs global causal graphs while remaining grounded in the theoretical foundations of decoupling-based causal discovery. Experiments demonstrate that our foundation model achieves robust zero-shot generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCD-PFN，一种基于解耦感知的因果发现基础模型，通过预训练学习样本级解耦权重来识别马尔可夫边界，并利用并行化局部发现高效重建全局因果图，在零样本泛化上表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 传统因果发现算法在处理高度非线性和噪声系统时存在困难，且计算瓶颈严重；已有的基于PFN的表格基础模型在零样本推理上表现出色，但其在显式结构因果发现方面的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 提出DCD-PFN模型，采用解耦感知范式，先通过预训练学习样本级解耦权重以识别马尔可夫边界，再通过并行化局部发现来重建全局因果图。
AI.result: 实验表明，该基础模型在零样本泛化方面表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: DCD-PFN为基于基础模型的结构因果发现提供了一种有效的新范式，兼顾了理论严谨性与计算效率。

title: MedHal-Loc: Are "Explainable-by-Architecture" Medical Hallucination Detectors Faithful Localizers? A Localization Benchmark
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Computers in Biology and Medicine
summary: Detecting hallucinations in clinical text is increasingly framed as an explainability problem: systems should not merely flag an unreliable response but point to the offending span. Architectures built around knowledge-graph (KG) triple decomposition are marketed for exactly this auditability, yet their localization ability is typically assumed rather than measured. We introduce MedHal-Loc, a benchmark and metric for localization faithfulness -- whether a detector's top-ranked error unit actually overlaps the erroneous span. The controlled subset comprises 300 PubMedQA-derived statements with single, span-level errors injected across four localizable types (entity substitution, relation error, mechanism misattribution, invention), yielding gold spans by construction; a complementary natural subset documents that real hallucinations are dominated by diffuse conclusion-flips that resist span localization (a human expert accepted 1/18 candidate spans). Evaluating four fine-grained paradigms, we find that NLI-per-clause, consistency-per-sentence, and the dedicated span detector FAVA all localize well above chance, whereas an elaborate KG-triple pipeline localizes no better than chance (+3.3pp, n.s.), bottlenecked by ~59% entity-extraction coverage -- despite competitive detection F1 (0.609). Detection competence does not imply faithful localization; architectural explainability must be validated, not presumed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedHal-Loc基准，发现基于知识图谱三元组的幻觉检测架构虽然检测性能不错，但在定位错误跨度方面仅比随机好3.3个百分点（不显著），远不如NLI等范式，表明检测能力不代表定位忠实性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于知识图谱三元组的幻觉检测系统声称具有可解释性和可审计性，但其错误定位能力通常被假设而非被实际测量，缺乏定量评估。
AI.method: 构建MedHal-Loc基准，包含受控子集（300条PubMedQA语句，注入4类可定位错误）和自然子集；评估四种范式：NLI-per-clause、consistency-per-sentence、FAVA（专用跨度检测器）和KG三元组流水线。
AI.result: NLI-per-clause、consistency-per-sentence和FAVA的定位效果显著优于随机；KG三元组流水线定位仅比随机高3.3个百分点（不显著），其瓶颈在于实体抽取覆盖率仅约59%，尽管检测F1达0.609。
AI.conclusion: 检测能力并不保证忠实定位；架构的可解释性必须经过实证验证，而非想当然。

title: When Do Intrinsic Rewards Work for Code Reasoning? A Comprehensive Study
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in large language model reasoning, but relies on ground-truth supervision that is costly or infeasible, especially in coding tasks. Recent work addresses this by deriving rewards from a model's own signals, such as majority voting or confidence-based scores, achieving notable success on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. However, code generation poses distinct challenges: programs are structurally complex, semantically equivalent solutions may differ syntactically, and verification typically requires execution. Whether these intrinsic reward methods transfer effectively to code remains unexplored. In this work, we present a systematic empirical study of intrinsic reward methods for code generation. We conduct extensive experiments on LiveCodeBench, systematically evaluating representative certainty-based Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) approaches under different training scenarios and hyperparameter settings. Our experiments reveal that certainty-based methods yield early gains but inevitably collapse: models progressively shorten outputs and lose reasoning capability, with collapse speed sensitive to sample size and temperature. When used to initialize RLVR training, RLIF pre-training offers no significant improvement over training from scratch. We also provide actionable recommendations for using intrinsic rewards for training code reasoning models. Our study shows both the promise and limitations of intrinsic reward methods for code, informing future work on code models and agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于内在奖励的强化学习方法在代码生成任务中的效果，发现确定性方法（如RLIF）虽能带来初期收益，但最终会导致模型输出缩短、推理能力下降，且作为RLVR初始化预训练并无显著优势。
AI.motivation: 代码生成任务中获取真实奖励信号（如执行验证）成本高昂或不可行，现有内在奖励方法在数学推理上表现良好，但在代码生成领域是否适用尚缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 在LiveCodeBench上对确定性内在奖励方法（RLIF）进行系统性实验，涵盖不同训练场景和超参数设置，评估其在代码生成任务中的效果。
AI.result: 确定性方法（RLIF）在训练初期有收益，但最终会导致模型输出缩短、推理能力崩溃，崩溃速度受样本量和温度影响；作为RLVR训练的初始化预训练，并不优于从头训练。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了内在奖励方法在代码生成中的潜力与局限性，并为使用内在奖励训练代码推理模型提供了可操作建议。

title: Sakana Fugu Technical Report
summary: The capabilities of frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to advance, with different providers increasingly specializing in distinct domains. This raises a natural next objective: how to combine the individual specializations of various LLMs into a collectively intelligent system. To this end, we report the development of Sakana Fugu, a family of orchestrator models that harness and amplify the capabilities of an LLM agent team. Fugu models are themselves language models trained to understand user queries and dynamically devise agentic scaffolds to solve them. Through these adaptive scaffolds, Fugu accesses performance beyond any individual LLM agent, achieving state-of-the-art results compared to other publicly accessible models across a range of challenging tasks, including SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal Bench, LiveCodeBench, GPQA-Diamond, Humanity's Last Exam, and CharXiv Reasoning. We release two models: Fugu, which balances performance with latency for everyday use, and Fugu-Ultra, which prioritizes answer quality on the hardest problems. We describe our training paradigm, which encompasses large-scale fine-tuning, evolutionary algorithms, and reinforcement learning approaches, along with the infrastructure and core design principles that turn these methods into a production system. We hope this report encourages further research into multi-agent systems and dynamic, query-adaptive agentic scaffolds as a path toward the next frontier of AI capabilities, accessed through collective intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Sakana Fugu系列模型——一种能够理解用户查询并动态编排多LLM智能体团队来解决问题的“编排器”模型，通过自适应智能体架构在多个高难度基准测试中达到SOTA性能，并开源了Fugu（平衡性能与延迟）和Fugu-Ultra（侧重最难题质量）两个版本。
AI.motivation: 不同前沿大语言模型在不同领域各有专长，如何将多个LLM的个体专长整合为一个集体智能系统成为自然的研究目标。
AI.method: 训练语言模型作为编排器，使其能够理解用户查询并动态生成自适应的agentic scaffolds（智能体架构）；采用大规模微调、进化算法和强化学习相结合的混合训练范式，并构建了相应的生产系统基础设施。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Pro、Terminal Bench、LiveCodeBench、GPQA-Diamond、Humanity's Last Exam和CharXiv Reasoning等多个挑战性基准上取得领先于同类公开模型的结果。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统和动态查询自适应智能体架构是通往下一代AI能力的前沿路径，集体智能有望突破单一模型的性能天花板。

title: Dissecting Agentic RAG: A Component Ablation for Multi-Hop QA with a Local 7B Model
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems combine iterative reasoning loops, query decomposition, and adaptive retrieval to tackle multi-hop question answering. However, the contribution of each component remains poorly understood, particularly under resource-constrained settings using only local language models. Many agentic designs add adaptive retrieval routing and deeper retrieval loops on the assumption that the added complexity helps. To test whether it does, we run a controlled ablation study of a full agentic RAG pipeline evaluated on 5,000 questions from the HotpotQA distractor development set using a local 7B parameter model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct). Our full pipeline achieves EM=53.2% and F1=61.6%, compared to a single-pass dense-retrieval baseline of EM=43.1% and F1=54.0%. Across eight ablation conditions, we find that: (1) fixed hybrid retrieval via reciprocal rank fusion consistently outperforms rule-based adaptive routing (+1.8 EM, +1.9 F1), as the routing heuristic over-routes to BM25 by firing on named entities present in nearly all multi-hop sub-questions; (2) two retrieval iterations over the decomposed sub-questions capture 95% of the gains of five, with no meaningful benefit from deeper loops; and (3) query decomposition and cross-encoder reranking each contribute statistically significant but smaller gains (p<0.01 and p<0.001 respectively). Taken together, on a fixed local-model budget, the simpler and fixed choices turn out to be competitive with or better than their adaptive versions: most of the gain comes from running a short retrieval loop, not from adaptive routing or from many iterations. We use no proprietary APIs or large-scale compute.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对本地7B模型上的Agentic RAG系统进行受控消融实验，发现：固定混合检索优于自适应路由，两次检索迭代即可捕获95%的收益，查询分解和交叉编码器重排序贡献较小但显著。结论是：在有限资源下，简单固定的设计比复杂的自适应版本更具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有Agentic RAG系统包含迭代推理、查询分解和自适应检索等多种组件，但各组件在资源受限条件下的具体贡献尚不明确，需要系统性的消融研究来厘清哪些设计真正有效。
AI.method: 在HotpotQA数据集5000个问题上，使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型，对完整的Agentic RAG流水线进行八种消融条件的受控实验，比较单次稠密检索基线（EM=43.1%, F1=54.0%）与完整流水线（EM=53.2%, F1=61.6%）的性能差异。
AI.result: (1) 固定混合检索（倒数秩融合）优于基于规则的自适应路由（+1.8 EM, +1.9 F1）；(2) 两次检索迭代即可获得五次迭代95%的收益，更深层循环无意义；(3) 查询分解和交叉编码器重排序贡献较小但统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 在固定本地模型预算下，简单固定的设计（短检索循环+固定混合检索）与复杂的自适应版本竞争相当或更优；大部分收益来自短检索循环，而非自适应路由或多轮迭代。

title: Neurosymbolic Clinical Trial Matching via LLM-Driven Abduction and Logical Verification
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising path to automate Clinical Trial Matching (CTM), but still struggle with the deterministic verification required for complex eligibility criteria. Conversely, purely symbolic methods provide formal rigour but break down when faced with incomplete patient records and noisy clinical evidence. To bridge this gap, we investigate a hybrid framework for CTM combining LLMs with logical verification. In particular, we introduce an abductive neurosymbolic CTM framework (αNeSy-CTM), which leverages the linguistic and world knowledge in LLMs to support reasoning over noisy and underspecified clinical text. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that αNeSy-CTM substantially outperforms standalone LLM baselines, achieving up to 30% relative improvement over zero-shot baselines. In addition, our analyses confirm the impact of abductive reasoning on CTM, with αNeSy-CTM exhibiting improved accuracy, specificity, and robustness over a non-abductive neurosymbolic setting. Furthermore, αNeSy-CTM and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning prove highly complementary, highlighting the potential for a hybrid routing policy. Ultimately, this paper demonstrates the impact of neurosymbolic methods for automating CTM, providing a path toward the next generation of auditable, LLM-driven clinical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型与逻辑推理的溯因神经符号框架αNeSy-CTM，用于自动化临床试验匹配，在准确性和鲁棒性上显著优于纯LLM基线方法。
AI.motivation: 纯LLM难以处理复杂入组标准所需的确定性验证，而纯符号方法在面对不完整患者记录和噪声临床证据时表现不佳，因此需要二者结合的混合方案。
AI.method: 提出αNeSy-CTM（abductive neurosymbolic CTM框架），利用LLM的语言与世界知识，结合溯因逻辑推理，对含噪声和未完全指定的临床文本进行推理。
AI.result: 相比零样本LLM基线，相对性能提升高达30%；与非溯因的神经符号方法相比，准确性、特异性和鲁棒性均有提升；与链式推理（CoT）表现出高度互补性。
AI.conclusion: 验证了神经符号方法在自动化临床试验匹配中的有效性，为下一代可审计、LLM驱动的临床应用提供了可行路径。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for Wound-Rotor Synchronous Motor Performance Prediction
comment: This paper was presented on April 19, 2026, at the 10th ISPEC International Congress on Modern Scientific Research
summary: Wound rotor synchronous motors have emerged as a strong alternative that eliminates dependence on REEs. However, WRSM design requires the simultaneous optimization of numerous geometric and electromagnetic parameters, and the high computational cost of conventional finite element analysis severely limits the rapid exploration of the large parameter space. Although there are machine-learning-based surrogate modeling studies in the literature, they generally compare only a limited number of models, exclude deep learning architectures, and do not provide a comprehensive benchmark specific to WRSM. In this study, the performance of a total of eight machine learning and deep learning models from four different algorithmic families was systematically compared for the prediction of WRSM torque and motor efficiency. On a dataset of 3351 samples generated using Latin Hypercube Sampling in the Motor-CAD simulation environment, each model was trained with 10 different random seed values and tuned via Optuna hyperparameter optimization. Different from the existing literature, this study jointly offers a broad model spectrum including recent deep learning architectures such as FT Transformer, a multi-seed reproducibility protocol, and a Pareto analysis of the computational cost-accuracy trade-off. The results revealed that neural-network-based models systematically outperform tree-based models. The FT-Transformer model achieved the highest single-model accuracy with R^2 = 0.9928, producing predictions in 0.33 milliseconds and thus obtaining several orders of magnitude speedup compared to FEA. Model performances were evaluated in a multidimensional manner using R^2, MAE, RMSE, and MAPE metrics.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较了8种机器学习与深度学习模型在预测绕线式同步电机转矩和效率方面的性能，发现FT-Transformer模型表现最优（R²=0.9928），相比传统有限元分析实现了数个数量级的加速。
AI.motivation: 绕线式同步电机设计需同时优化大量几何和电磁参数，传统有限元分析计算成本高昂，限制了参数空间的快速探索。现有基于机器学习的代理模型研究存在模型数量少、缺乏深度学习架构、且未针对WRSM进行综合基准测试等问题。
AI.method: 使用拉丁超立方采样在Motor-CAD仿真环境生成3351个样本，系统比较了来自四种算法家族的8种机器学习/深度学习模型。每个模型使用10个不同随机种子训练，并通过Optuna进行超参数优化，同时评估了计算成本与精度之间的权衡。
AI.result: 基于神经网络的模型系统性优于基于树的模型。FT-Transformer模型取得最高精度（R²=0.9928），预测仅需0.33毫秒，较FEA实现数个数量级加速。使用R²、MAE、RMSE和MAPE多维指标评估模型性能。
AI.conclusion: FT-Transformer可作为WRSM设计的高精度、高效率代理模型，本研究提供的多模型基准测试和复现性协议为电机的数据驱动优化设计提供了可靠参考。

title: PeerMathDial: A Middle School Dialogue Dataset for Student Collaborative Math Problem Solving
comment: 17 pages. Project website (dataset and source code): https://ziyu-yao-nlp-lab.github.io/MathVC-NSF.github.io/. Accepted to the 21st Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications (BEA) co-located at ACL 2026
summary: Collaborative Problem Solving (CPS) is a core skill in education, where the process of peer interaction is highly important. However, existing educational dialogue datasets mostly focus on classroom instruction or tutoring (i.e., teacher/tutor-student interaction), yet datasets centering small-group, student-student interaction are limited. This thus leaves research with limited resources for studying how students interact, coordinate, and solve problems together in real educational settings. To address this, we introduce PeerMathDial, the first dataset of peer CPS dialogues collected from authentic middle school math classrooms. It contains 55 dialogues from 27 students, totaling 6,406 turns. To facilitate research on CPS discourse analysis, we further build a corpus-grounded dialogue act taxonomy assisted by LLMs. Using the dataset and the dialogue act taxonomy, we demonstrate the practical applications of PeerMathDial across three use cases. First, we track how dialogues evolve over time and measure the impact of teacher interventions. Second, we align dialogue actions with student surveys to reveal the connection between students' traits (e.g., confidence, leadership) and their actual behaviors. Third, by evaluating LLMs on dialogue act prediction, we glimpse at the potential of LLMs for student simulation in educational applications. Our dataset and source code will be released to the community.

AI.tldr: PeerMathDial是首个来自真实中学数学课堂的同伴协作问题解决对话数据集，包含55段对话、6406轮次，并构建了对话行为分类体系，支持CPS话语分析、教师干预影响、学生特质-行为关联及LLM对话行为预测等应用。
AI.motivation: 现有教育对话数据集多聚焦于师生互动（课堂教学或辅导），缺乏以学生-学生互动为中心的小组协作问题解决数据集，限制了研究者在真实教育场景下研究学生互动、协作和共同解决问题的资源。
AI.method: 从真实的中学数学课堂收集55段同伴CPS对话（27名学生，6406轮次），并借助LLM辅助构建基于语料的对话行为分类体系。
AI.result: 构建了PeerMathDial数据集及对话行为分类体系，并在三个应用场景验证其实用性：对话演化追踪与教师干预影响分析、学生特质（如自信、领导力）与实际行为的关联、LLM在对话行为预测任务上的评估。
AI.conclusion: PeerMathDial为同伴协作问题解决研究提供了宝贵资源，展示了其在教育研究中的多重应用价值，数据集和代码将开源。

title: Root Cause Analysis with Latent Confounders using Partial Ancestral Graphs
summary: Finding the source of failures, known as Root Cause Analysis (RCA), is essential for identifying the root causes of anomalies and maintaining the reliability of complex systems. While causal theory has advanced data-driven RCA, existing frameworks assume causal sufficiency, failing to account for the unobserved latent variables prevalent in real-world environments. To address this gap, we propose PAG-RCA. This framework models system failures as parametric interventions over Partial Ancestral Graphs (PAGs) to perform RCA in the presence of latent variables. We use standard causal identification algorithms to find the source of failures by quantifying causal effects over the PAG. When an effect is identifiable, candidate root causes are ranked based on their exact intervention effects. When effects are structurally unidentifiable, our framework (for the first time in the RCA literature) integrates partial identification to evaluate and score candidates using analytical causal bounds. By integrating latent variables and partial identification at once our framework ensures robust RCA even under data scarcity and latent-variable scenarios where traditional methods degrade. Evaluations on synthetic data, microservice anomaly benchmarks and power-grid cascading failures demonstrate that PAG-RCA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art data-driven baselines. By improving data-driven RCA performance under data scarcity, this methodology advances reliable automated diagnostics in partially observable complex networks.

AI.tldr: 提出了PAG-RCA框架，利用部分祖先图（PAG）建模系统故障，在存在未观测隐变量和低数据场景下进行根因分析，通过因果识别和部分识别技术对候选根因进行排序，实验表明优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的根因分析方法假设因果充分性，忽略了真实环境中普遍存在的未观测隐变量，导致在部分可观测系统中性能下降。
AI.method: 将系统故障建模为针对部分祖先图（PAG）的参数干预；使用标准因果识别算法量化因果效应；效果可识别时基于精确干预效应排序；效果结构不可识别时首次引入部分识别方法，利用分析因果界限对候选根因进行评估和打分。
AI.result: 在合成数据、微服务异常基准测试和电力网络级联故障数据集上，PAG-RCA持续优于现有数据驱动基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时整合隐变量和部分识别方法，PAG-RCA在数据稀缺和存在隐变量的场景下实现了稳健的根因分析，提升了部分可观测复杂网络中自动化诊断的可靠性。

title: Does RoPE Prevent or Degrade Retrieval Heads? A Mechanistic Analysis Across Model Families
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 18 tables. Code, data, and a paired-seed reproducibility harness: https://github.com/CengizhanBayram/Does-RoPE-Prevent-or-Degrade-Retrieval-Heads-A-Mechanistic-Analysis-Across-Model-Families
summary: Retrieval heads, attention heads that copy information from earlier context to the current position, have been proposed as the mechanistic substrate for long-context recall. Rotary position embeddings (RoPE) rotate queries and keys by frequencies decaying with a base hyperparameter theta, and a natural hypothesis is that this rotation either prevents retrieval heads from forming or degrades their function. We test both across four open-weight 7-8B models spanning multi-head and grouped-query attention and a 100x range of theta, using paired-seed needle-in-a-haystack tests, layer-clustered permutation, and causal head-masking. (i) Retrieval heads are causally necessary: masking the 87 detected heads in OLMo-2 collapses recall from 1.00 to 0.00, while masking matched random heads has no effect; this replicates in Qwen. (ii) Higher theta does not reduce retrieval-head count (LLaMA-3.1 at theta=500K has 47 heads vs LLaMA-2 at theta=10K with 42), refuting the prevention hypothesis. (iii) The norm-utility relation is family-specific and significant in opposite directions (Qwen d=-0.49, OLMo d=+0.50, both significant; LLaMA null); since OLMo and LLaMA-3.1 share theta=500K yet differ, the effect is not theta-driven. (iv) Building on Chiang and Yogatama (2025), a controlled patch shows that zeroing the lowest-frequency RoPE dimensions of retrieval heads degrades recall dose-dependently (1.00 to 0.18 when 32 of 128 dimensions are zeroed, vs 0.98 for random dimensions); the effect is head-specific and task-specific. The causal variable is RoPE frequency, not norm-utility. The direction holds in all five models patched (OLMo-2, Qwen2.5-7B/14B, Gemma-2, Mistral) across four lineages and two scales. We do not claim cross-model magnitude. Code and a paired-seed harness are released.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了旋转位置编码(RoPE)对检索头（从早前上下文复制信息的注意力头）的影响，发现检索头是因果必要的，更高的θ不会减少检索头数量，且RoPE低频维度是影响检索功能的关键因果变量。
AI.motivation: 检验RoPE是否阻止或削弱检索头（注意力头中负责从早期上下文复制信息的机制）的形成与功能，验证"高频旋转破坏检索头"这一自然假设。
AI.method: 在四种开源7-8B模型（覆盖多头/分组查询注意力、θ范围100倍差异）上进行：配对种子针堆测试、分层聚类置换、因果头掩码、受控维度补丁实验（零化RoPE低频维度）。
AI.result: (1)掩码87个检索头使OLMo-2召回率从1.00降至0.00，随机掩码无影响；(2)更高θ不减少检索头数量（LLaMA-3.1 θ=500K有47个，LLaMA-2 θ=10K有42个）；(3)范数-效用关系因模型族而异，非θ驱动；(4)零化检索头最低频RoPE维度导致召回率剂量依赖性下降（1.00→0.18），随机维度无影响。
AI.conclusion: 因果变量是RoPE频率而非范数-效用关系；高频θ不破坏检索头，但RoPE低频维度对检索功能至关重要；该结论在5个模型、4个模型族、2个规模上一致成立。

title: Rubric-as-Experts: Case-Specific MQM Rubrics for Translation Quality Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in fine-grained translation quality evaluation (QE), yet existing MQM-based approaches typically rely on fixed rubric configurations shared across all translation samples. However, translation instances often differ substantially in error complexity, ambiguity, and required evaluation granularity, making static rubric allocation suboptimal for span-level error detection. We find that larger MQM subtype spaces improve error coverage but also introduce more false positives, while different translation instances prefer different rubric granularities, suggesting that evaluation spaces should be allocated dynamically for each case. Motivated by these observations, we propose a case-specific dynamic rubric framework that adaptively constructs MQM evaluation spaces for individual translation instances. Unlike fully free-form rubric generation methods, our framework remains grounded in the predefined MQM taxonomy while dynamically selecting suitable subtype spaces and evaluation granularity for different cases. Experiments on WMT span-level QE benchmarks across multiple model scales demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves MCC and produces cleaner span-level error localization compared with static rubric settings. Our results suggest that combining structured MQM rubrics with case-specific adaptive allocation is an effective strategy for fine-grained LLM-based translation evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种针对机器翻译质量评估的案例特定动态评价框架，根据每个翻译实例的特点自适应构建MQM评价空间，相比静态评价标准能更有效地检测细粒度错误。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MQM的翻译质量评估方法对所有样本使用固定相同的评价标准配置，但不同翻译实例在错误复杂度、歧义性和所需评价粒度上存在显著差异，静态分配评价空间会导致span级错误检测效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出案例特定动态评价框架，在预定义MQM分类体系基础上，为每个翻译实例自适应选择合适的子类型空间和评价粒度，既保持结构化又实现动态分配。
AI.result: 在多个模型尺度的WMT span级QE基准上，该框架相比静态评价标准持续提升了MCC指标，并产生更清晰的span级错误定位结果。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化MQM评价标准与案例特定的自适应分配相结合，是面向细粒度LLM翻译评估的有效策略。

title: Power Systems Agent Benchmark: Executable Evaluation of AI Agents in Electric Power Engineering
comment: 19 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/trashchenkov/power-systems-agent-benchmark ; archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20753046
summary:
Executable evaluation -- checking the consequences of an agent's actions with a program rather than grading its prose -- has become a prominent way to assess tool-using AI agents in software settings. Electric power engineering has not yet had an analogous benchmark: language-model use is still dominated by retrieval and text question answering, while agents acting on power-system artifacts remain mostly academic prototypes. We introduce the Power Systems Agent Benchmark, an executable benchmark for power-engineering agents. An agent receives a structured task and returns a structured solution; a deterministic evaluator recomputes the engineering quantities, checks operational constraints, and returns a feasibility flag, a normalized score, and explicit violations.
  The benchmark contains 41 task families across eight areas of power engineering, from power flow and protection to stability, microgrids, reliability, power quality, and forecasting. Each task is grounded in a citable source, standard, or documented engineering formulation. To resist contamination, held-out cases are synthesized on demand by per-family generators from private seeds: the construction is inspectable, but the instances remain private. In a reference evaluation with three command-line agents, the strongest score near the compact tier's ceiling, a smaller open model trails, and public and held-out performance are broadly consistent; a separate public-split grid with OpenCode and Aider probes harness effects. The reference evaluation doubles as quality control: unanimous failures flag candidate task or evaluator defects, and it exposed a latent evaluator bug missed by self-consistency checks. The evaluators are compact deterministic surrogates, but the task contract allows their internals to be upgraded to simulator-backed checks without changing how tasks are posed or solved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了电力系统智能体基准测试（Power Systems Agent Benchmark），这是一个可执行的电力工程智能体评估基准，包含41个任务族和8个电力工程领域，通过确定性评估器检查解的可行性与规范性。
AI.motivation: 电力工程领域缺乏可执行的语言模型智能体评估基准，现有应用仍以检索和文本问答为主，缺乏对智能体在电力系统工件上操作行为的标准化评估。
AI.method: 构建41个任务族（覆盖8个电力工程领域），每个任务基于可引用来源；采用按需生成和私有种子合成保留样本以防污染；使用确定性评估器计算工程量、检查约束并返回可行性标志、规范化分数和违规项。
AI.result: 参考评估中，最强调模型接近紧凑层上限，较小开源模型表现落后；公开与保留集的性能基本一致；评估还发现了人类自我一致性检查未能发现的潜在评估器缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 该基准填补了电力工程领域可执行智能体评估的空白，评估器设计支持未来升级为仿真器驱动检查，且具备质量控制自检能力。

title: Gradient-Free Warm-Start Library Recovery: an Amortized-Regret Separation
summary: Continual learning that is gradient-free, local, online, and append-only is attractive for edge and streaming deployment, but its value is usually argued informally. We give a provable account on recurring-regime streams. Given segmentation, a warm-start library learner attains amortized recovery cost $O\!\big(KD/\varepsilon^2+(R-K)\logK/Δ^2\big)$ versus a memoryless re-estimator's $Θ(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, an advantage $(R-K)\,Θ(D/\varepsilon^2)$ growing with dimension $D$ and recurrence density. The mechanism is a decoupling: recognizing which of $K$ seen regimes is active costs $O(\log K/Δ^2)$, independent of $D$, whereas estimating a regime costs $Θ(D/\varepsilon^2)$. We prove this is tight: matching lower bounds give recognition $Θ(\log K/Δ^2)$ and a memoryless-class bound $Ω(RD/\varepsilon^2)$, so each term is individually minimax-tight (the joint statement is conditional). The separation is born-immune (a memoryless learner's advantage is identically zero) and paradigm-level: it matches, and does not beat, a fair spawn-capable Bayesian baseline; the contribution is attaining this cost structure without end-to-end backprop and with zero forgetting by construction. A count-calibrated variant ties the baseline's leading constant up to a bounded, never-negative per-recurrence overshoot, hyperparameter-free and with no per-step transcendentals. We bound the scope: recognizable regimes are capped by simplex packing (walls $e^{Θ(D)}$); autonomous segmentation is impossible at the packing wall (no detector escapes the false-alarm/delay frontier as regimes overlap); the advantage vanishes under overlap. The dimension-dependent separation is corroborated on synthetic streams and real $k$-mer genome distributions (memoryless cost $\propto D^{1.04}$, recognition $D$-independent); the one real sequential stream sits in the $D{=}1$ near-null corner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无梯度、局部、在线且仅追加的持续学习方法，通过解耦“识别已知模式”和“估计新模式”两个子任务，在循环流数据上实现了显著优于无记忆重估计器的理论保证和实际效果。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法虽然被广泛认为适合边缘和流式部署，但其优势缺乏严谨的理论证明。本文旨在为循环模式流（recurring-regime streams）提供可证明的加速机制，并严格刻画其理论边界。
AI.method: 提出一种解耦机制：识别K个已见过模式中哪个被激活的成本为O(log K/Δ²)，与数据维度D无关；而估计一个模式的成本为Θ(D/ε²)。该方法基于“暖启动库学习器”（warm-start library learner），结合分割（segmentation）实现。
AI.result: 摊销恢复成本为O(KD/ε² + (R-K) log K/Δ²)，显著优于无记忆重估计器的Θ(RD/ε²)；优势(R-K)·Θ(D/ε²)随维度D和循环密度增长。每个子任务的界均是极小极大最优的，且分离是范式级别的。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在无端到端反向传播、无遗忘（零遗忘保证）的前提下达到了与公平贝叶斯基线相当的成本结构，在合成数据和真实k-mer基因组分布上验证了维度依赖的分离效果。

title: Per-Entity Bias Mapping for AI Visibility: Why Brand Mentions Require Entity-Specific Calibration
comment: 26 pages, 14 tables. Zenodo preprint: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20419277. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20308957
summary:
AI-mediated answer systems increasingly determine how brands and organizations are represented to users. Existing approaches reduce visibility to mention rate or citation frequency. This paper argues that aggregate metrics are insufficient because entities exhibit systematically different AI visibility error profiles.
  We introduce Per-Entity Bias Mapping (PEBM): a ten-dimensional framework distinguishing raw from verified mentions. Three failure modes are identified: (1) underrepresented entities suffer invisibility due to weak knowledge graph presence; (2) large entities suffer the Brand Hallucination Paradox -- model familiarity creates stronger surfaces for plausible but incorrect completions; (3) CEE entities face a structural infrastructure gap across knowledge graphs, NER, and entity linking. A fourth dimension, Parametric-Retrieval Lag Asymmetry, describes divergence between retrieval-augmented and parametric memory update cycles.
  A full-scale empirical study (n=100 Hungarian B2B entities, 1,400 probe runs, 2,062 sources) finds Tier 1 brands produce 52.69% fabricated citations versus 37.87% for Tier 3 entities (+14.82 pp; p=1.67e-11), supporting the Brand Hallucination Paradox. Regulatory-framed queries elevate fabrication to 56.77% versus 37.59% baseline (+19.2 pp). We identify rejection-induced confabulation escalation: agentic quality filters function as hallucination accelerators in compliance contexts. We introduce ghost cartography as a unifying mechanism: entities in sparse latent regions produce confident output interpolated from neighboring dense regions, yielding a two-dimensional confabulation space (fabricated presence vs. frozen representation).

AI.tldr: 提出PEBM框架，发现AI回答中品牌存在系统性偏差：大品牌更易被幻觉（52.69%虚构引用），监管查询加剧问题（56.77%），并揭示"幽灵地图"机制——稀疏区域实体被相邻密集区域插值输出。
AI.motivation: 现有AI可见性评估仅关注提及率或引用频次等聚合指标，无法捕捉不同实体在AI系统中的差异化偏差模式。
AI.method: 提出十维PEBM框架（区分原始提及与验证提及），通过n=100匈牙利B2B实体、1,400次探针运行、2,062个来源的全规模实证研究，识别三种失效模式及参量-检索滞后不对称性。
AI.result: 一级品牌虚构引用率52.69% vs 三级品牌37.87%（+14.82pp）；监管框架查询虚构率升至56.77%（+19.2pp）；发现拒绝诱导的虚构升级现象。
AI.conclusion: 引入"幽灵地图"统一机制：稀疏潜在区域实体被相邻密集区域插值输出，形成二维虚构空间（虚构存在vs冻结表征），揭示知识图谱基础设施差距的结构性问题。

title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government
summary: Trust in the application of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) relies on well-governed measurable evidence of performance and safety. In practice, however, evaluation data is often fragmented across systems, inconsistently structured and difficult to compare. We introduce the Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) as a lightweight open-source data model for centralising AI observability across popular vendors. Practical blueprints for code, architecture and statistical evaluation are shared as guidance about how to approach generative system assurance at the organisational level. Illustrative case study results are reported from Westminster City Council's AI catalogue with a focus on measuring human-model alignment including detecting systematic disagreement between evaluators. By framing evaluations as a data modelling problem, GRAIDES provides a practical pathway toward more consistent and reproducible benchmarking, tuning and assurance activities for generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAIDES，一个轻量级开源数据模型，用于集中化生成式AI的可观测性评估，解决评估数据碎片化、结构不一致和难以比较的问题，并通过威斯敏斯特市议会的案例展示了其在人机对齐测量和系统化保障中的应用。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的应用信任依赖于可衡量的性能和安全性证据，但实际中评估数据常分散于不同系统、结构不一致且难以比较，缺乏统一的数据模型来支持标准化评估与基准测试。
AI.method: 提出GRAIDES轻量级开源数据模型，提供代码、架构和统计评估的实践蓝图，并在威斯敏斯特市议会的AI目录中进行案例研究，重点测量人机对齐并检测评估者之间的系统性不一致。
AI.result: 通过将评估问题重新定义为数据建模问题，GRAIDES能够实现更一致和可复现的基准测试、调优和保证活动，案例研究结果展示了其在检测评估者间系统性不一致方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRAIDES为组织层面的生成式AI系统保证提供了一条实用路径，通过统一数据模型提升评估的一致性和可复现性，有助于建立对生成式AI的信任。

title: Intrinsic Flow Matching on Quantum Pure-State Manifolds with Phase-Aligned Transport
summary: Quantum pure-state ensembles live on complex projective space, making flat Euclidean generative modeling geometrically mismatched. We introduce Intrinsic Flow Matching (IFM), a deterministic transport framework on $\mathbb{CP}^{d-1}$ that learns tangent velocity fields using Pancharatnam phase-aligned conditional paths. IFM replaces local score teachers and reverse-time stochastic sampling with manifold probability flow, while horizontal parameterization removes redundant ambient directions. We show that the IFM objective recovers the induced marginal transport field, represents deterministic projective ensemble flows, and yields endpoint and stability guarantees. Empirically, IFM often improves over ambient Euclidean flow matching across higher-qubit, multimodal, spin-coherent, physics-inspired, and amplitude-encoded MNIST image-vector benchmarks, with strongest gains on high-dimensional and coherence-sensitive tasks but not uniformly across every metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在复射影空间上的确定性传输框架——内在流匹配（IFM），用于量子纯态系综的生成建模，通过学习切向速度场并利用Pancharatnam相位对齐条件路径，替代了传统欧几里得方法在该几何不匹配场景下的不足。
AI.motivation: 量子纯态系综生活在复射影空间上，而平坦的欧几里得生成模型在几何上与该空间不匹配，因此需要一种符合流形几何的生成建模方法。
AI.method: 提出了内在流匹配（IFM），一种在$\mathbb{CP}^{d-1}$上的确定性传输框架。学习切向速度场，使用Pancharatnam相位对齐的条件路径，采用水平参数化去除冗余的环境方向，并通过流形概率流替代局部分数教师和反向时间随机采样。
AI.result: 在多量子比特、多模态、自旋相干、物理启发及振幅编码的MNIST图像向量等基准测试中，IFM通常优于欧几里得流匹配方法，在高维和相干性敏感任务上提升最明显，但并非在所有指标上均一致胜出。
AI.conclusion: IFM目标恢复了诱导边际传输场，能够表示确定性的投影系综流，并提供了端点和稳定性保证，是量子生成建模中一种有效的几何对齐方法。

title: LLM and Human Modes of Representation
summary: Much work on the cognitive foundations of AI has focussed on comparisons between the ways in which Large Language Models (LLMs) and humans process information and represent it. One aspect of this comparison involves determining the extent to which LLMs can achieve or surpass human performance on a variety of cognitively interesting tasks. A second explores points of convergence and divergence between LLM and human systems for processing information. Here, I consider some recent research that has addressed both issues in two informational domains. The first is the representation of linguistic knowledge. The second is real world reasoning and planning. While LLMs frequently achieve impressive levels of performance and fluency on linguistic applications, they tend to handle linguistic content in ways that are distinct from human processing. They are also, for the most part, less efficient than humans in learning and generalisation for reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）与人类在语言知识表征和现实世界推理规划两个信息领域的认知差异。LLMs在语言任务上表现优异，但处理方式与人类不同；在推理任务上，其学习和泛化效率通常低于人类。
AI.motivation: 研究LLMs与人类在认知基础上的比较，特别是探索两者在信息处理上的趋同与分歧。
AI.method: 从语言知识表征和现实世界推理规划两个领域，综述近期关于LLMs与人类认知比较的研究。
AI.result: LLMs在语言应用上表现流畅，但处理方式与人类不同；在推理任务上，LLMs的学习和泛化效率普遍低于人类。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLMs在某些任务上表现优异，但其信息处理方式与人类存在本质差异，尤其在推理和泛化能力上仍有不足。

title: AutoACSL: Synthesizing ACSL Specifications by Integrating LLMs with CPG-Based Static Analysis
summary: Generating formal specifications for C programs remains a challenge in formal verification due to the manual effort, expertise, and semantic precision required. While recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) offer promise in automating specification synthesis, current approaches often lack semantic depth and produce unverifiable or incomplete contracts. To address these limitations, we introduce AutoACSL, a novel framework that integrates LLM prompting with semantic features extracted from Code Property Graphs (CPGs). AutoACSL performs static analyses to extract key semantic elements, including arithmetic operations, loop and recursion structures, and return value propagation, which are encoded into structured prompts. These prompts enable the LLM not only to generate normal behavioral specifications but also to include constraints that prevent inputs leading to runtime errors. AutoACSL employs a feedback-driven synthesis loop, where candidate specifications are verified using Frama-C/WP and refined iteratively until verification succeeds or a termination condition is met. Evaluated on 604 programs drawn from diverse datasets, AutoACSL achieves a 98% specification generation success ratio and a 96% full proof ratio when paired with Gemini-3. Compared to a code-only baseline, AutoACSL improves the full proof ratio by 24.7% to 51.7% across four LLMs (GPT-o4 Mini, GPT-5.2, Grok-4.1, and Gemini-3), demonstrating that integrating large language models with CPG-based static analysis substantially enhances both generation robustness and verification effectiveness for automated ACSL specification synthesis.

AI.tldr: AutoACSL是一个结合大语言模型与代码属性图语义特征的框架，用于自动生成可验证的C程序形式化规约（ACSL），在604个程序上达到98%生成成功率和96%完全证明率。
AI.motivation: C程序形式化规约的手动编写费时费力且需要专业知识，现有LLM方法缺乏语义深度，生成的规约往往不可验证或不完整。
AI.method: 框架通过静态分析提取代码属性图中的语义要素（算术运算、循环递归结构、返回值传播），编码为结构化提示输入LLM，再通过Frama-C/WP验证并迭代精化，直至验证通过或终止。
AI.result: 在604个程序上，AutoACSL结合Gemini-3达到98%规约生成成功率和96%完全证明率；相比纯代码基线，在四个LLM上将完全证明率提升24.7%至51.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将大语言模型与基于代码属性图的静态分析相结合，能显著提升自动化ACSL规约合成的生成鲁棒性和验证有效性。

title: An Empirical Study of OpenPangu Quantization on Ascend NPUs
summary: OpenPangu models are attractive targets for private and domestic large-language-model deployment, yet their robustness under aggressive post-training quantization on Ascend NPUs has not been systematically characterized. This paper conducts a controlled empirical study of OpenPangu 1B and 7B models on Huawei Ascend 910B1 NPUs. We evaluate representative weight-only and weight-activation post-training quantization methods, including RTN, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, GPTAQ, BiLLM, and SliM-LLM, under a unified calibration and evaluation protocol. Across 18 evaluation tasks, we find that 8-bit weight-only quantization is effectively lossless for both models, while 4-bit quantization remains practical for the 7B model but is visibly more harmful for the 1B model on reasoning, math, and code tasks. Ultra-low precision remains challenging: most 2-bit and binary settings collapse to near-random behavior, and W4A4 SmoothQuant produces non-finite perplexity in our evaluation. These results provide an NPU-oriented accuracy map for selecting OpenPangu quantization settings and highlight the persistent difficulty of extreme low-bit compression.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了OpenPangu 1B和7B模型在华为昇腾910B1 NPU上经过多种后训练量化方法（RTN, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, GPTAQ, BiLLM, SliM-LLM）后的鲁棒性。实验发现：8-bit权重量化近乎无损，4-bit量化对7B模型可用但对1B模型损害明显，超低精度（2-bit/二值/W4A4）表现接近随机，为NPU场景下的量化选择提供了精度参考。
AI.motivation: OpenPangu模型在私有化大模型部署中备受关注，但其在昇腾NPU上经过激进的后训练量化后的鲁棒性尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 在华为Ascend 910B1 NPU上，对OpenPangu 1B和7B模型施加8种代表性后训练量化方法（仅权重量化与权重-激活量化），采用统一的校准与评估协议，在18项任务上进行对比实验。
AI.result: 8-bit权重量化对两个模型均几乎无损；4-bit量化对7B模型仍实用，但显著损害1B模型的推理、数学和代码任务；2-bit及二值量化接近随机表现；W4A4 SmoothQuant产生非有限困惑度。
AI.conclusion: 提供了面向NPU的OpenPangu量化精度图谱，指出极端低位压缩仍是持续存在的困难挑战。

title: CulMind: Benchmarking Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning in Chinese Cultural Heritage
summary: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in Chinese Cultural Heritage (CCH) requires fine-grained reasoning over visual, textual, stylistic, and historical clues. However, existing CCH benchmarks mainly emphasize final-answer accuracy, while the accuracy and completeness of reasoning processes remain underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce CulMind and CulMind-R: a high-quality benchmark for multimodal CCH covering 50 tasks from collections of more than 100 museums, and a 24-task reasoning subset that adaptively defines task-specific dimensions for reasoning process evaluation. To evaluate reasoning quality, we propose ReaScore, a task-adaptive metric that evaluates reasoning by automatically weighting task-relevant dimensions. Experiments on 14 leading MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between answers and reasoning, especially on challenging tasks. Further analysis shows that task-adaptive dimension selection and weighting better align evaluation results with expert judgments. Overall, our benchmark and metric support a more expert-aligned assessment of CCH understanding and offer a transferable reference for broader evaluations of cultural heritage. We publicly release the data, code, and evaluation scripts at https://github.com/ZevTsao/CulMind to facilitate reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CulMind和CulMind-R基准，涵盖50项中国文化遗产任务及24项推理子集，并设计ReaScore指标评估推理过程质量，实验发现主流多模态大模型在推理质量上与答案准确性存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有中国文化遗产基准主要关注最终答案准确性，忽略了对推理过程准确性和完整性的评估，缺乏细粒度推理评估方法。
AI.method: 构建CulMind（50任务，来自100+博物馆）和CulMind-R（24推理子集，自适应定义任务特定推理维度）；提出ReaScore指标，通过自动加权任务相关维度评估推理质量。
AI.result: 在14个主流多模态大模型上实验，发现答案与推理之间存在显著差距，尤其在挑战性任务上；任务自适应维度选择与加权更符合专家判断。
AI.conclusion: CulMind和ReaScore为文化遗产理解提供更符合专家标准的评估方法，并可迁移至更广泛的文化遗产评估场景。

title: How Should Agents Read Demonstrations? Hierarchical Structure Beats Flat Action Logs
comment: Accepted at the 5th Deep Learning for Code (DL4C) Workshop, ICML 2026. 8 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Programming by Demonstration (PbD) offers a human-centered way to author procedural knowledge for LLM agents: users communicate what they want by showing rather than by writing prompts or code, making agent authoring accessible to non-programmers. The natural output of a PbD recording is a flat action log, but how this log is organized before being passed to the agent is an open design question with significant consequences for plan quality. We propose grouping recorded actions into labeled, hierarchical subgoals and evaluate the effect of this organizational structure in a controlled experiment. Across 85 web automation tasks, we compare a zero-shot baseline against four demonstration formats that share identical action sequences but differ in structure. On 43 natural-language tasks with vague descriptions, hierarchically grouped demonstrations improve pass rates from 76.7\% to 90.7\% (paired permutation test $p{=}0.034$; win-loss 6:0), while flat demonstrations show a smaller, non-significant improvement. On 42 tasks with precise descriptions, no format provides any benefit, confirming that the hierarchical advantage arises specifically when descriptions leave procedural details ambiguous. Ablation shows that subgoal grouping alone drives the effect: preconditions, postconditions, and parameter annotations add no measurable benefit. These results offer a concrete design recommendation for PbD pipelines and, more broadly, for any system that feeds procedural context to an LLM agent: segment action sequences into named subgoal groups rather than presenting flat step lists.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在编程通过演示（PbD）中，将录制的动作日志组织成带标签的层次化子目标结构对LLM智能体任务执行质量的影响。实验表明，在描述模糊的自然语言任务中，层次化结构将通过率从76.7%提升至90.7%，而扁平结构改进不显著；在精确描述的任务中则无差异。
AI.motivation: PbD生成的自然输出是扁平的动作日志，但如何组织这些日志再传递给智能体是个开放的设计问题，对任务执行质量有重要影响。作者希望探索不同组织结构对智能体表现的影响。
AI.method: 在85个网页自动化任务上进行控制实验，比较零样本基线与四种共享相同动作序列但结构不同的演示格式。将任务分为43个模糊描述的自然语言任务和42个精确描述任务，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 层次化子目标分组在模糊描述任务中通过率从76.7%显著提升到90.7%（p=0.034，胜负比6:0）；扁平演示改进不显著。精确描述任务中所有格式均无提升。消融实验表明仅子目标分组起作用，前置条件、后置条件和参数注释无额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 对于PbD流水线及任何向LLM智能体提供过程上下文的系统，推荐将动作序列分割成名命名的子目标组，而非呈现扁平的步骤列表。

title: Reward-free Pretraining for Reinforcement Learning via Occupancy Coverage Maximization
summary: Sparse rewards pose a central challenge in reinforcement learning, since agents receive no informative signal until they reach their goal. Intrinsic-reward methods address this issue by optimizing non-stationary objectives such as novelty, prediction error, or skill diversity, thereby injecting a supervision signal into the problem. While effective, these methods often require that the extrinsic (sparse) reward can be evaluated -- either online or during offline relabeling of the stored transitions. This limitation is particularly vexing for multi-task, meta-, and continual reinforcement learning, where agents' interactions with the environment are usually reward-free. In this work, we present a method to pre-train transferable exploration policies that rapidly adapt to sparse rewards at downstream task time. Our objective maximizes state-space covering for the occupancy measure, and can be framed in terms of entropy maximization. Its algorithmic implementation, ROVER, leverages recent advances on the operatorial formulation of RL to estimate occupancy with a learned resolvent world model, bypassing common hurdles associated with density and entropy estimation. ROVER further introduces a virtual "sink" state for unexplored regions, balancing coverage of known states with expansion into unseen ones and preventing cyclic expansion-collapse behavior during learning. In tabular and pixel-based sparse navigation tasks, ROVER produces more uniform aggregate coverage and stronger initializations for downstream tasks than standard reward-free baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROVER方法，通过预训练可迁移的探索策略，在无奖励环境下最大化状态空间覆盖，从而快速适应下游任务的稀疏奖励。
AI.motivation: 稀疏奖励下，传统内在奖励方法需要在线或离线评估外部奖励，无法应用于无奖励的多任务、元学习和持续强化学习场景。
AI.method: 基于占用度量的状态空间覆盖最大化（等价于熵最大化），利用算子化强化学习的可解世界模型估计占用度，并引入虚拟"sink"状态平衡已知区域覆盖与未知区域探索。
AI.result: 在表格型和像素型稀疏导航任务中，ROVER比标准无奖励基线方法产生更均匀的聚合覆盖和更强的下游任务初始化性能。
AI.conclusion: ROVER通过无奖励预训练实现探索策略的可迁移性，有效解决了稀疏奖励下多任务场景的初始化难题。

title: Evaluating Document-Tuned Transformer Representations for Person-level Mental Health Assessment
summary: Person-level psychological assessment requires aggregating meaning across many messages from the same individual, a task that document-level training objectives were not explicitly designed for. We present a systematic, empirical comparison between architecturally matched traditional (a) base-transformers and (b) document-tuned-transformers (further contrastively fine-tuned at the document-level, sometimes referred to as "sentence transformers") under otherwise identical conditions. Comparing layer-wise and overall performance across two longitudinal mental health and psychological datasets, we find document-tuned models demonstrated a consistent improvement over base representations (increase in Pearson r of 13.4%, p=.015). Robustness analyses revealed document-tuned models remained more accurate under perturbations to word deletion, synonym replacement, typo injection, and back translation. Further, hedged language (e.g., `usually') was more characteristic of outcomes in document-tuned embeddings while abundance (e.g., `lot') was more characteristic of base-transformers, suggesting document-tuned models may better capture uncertainty. These results suggest representation choice impacts mental health prediction, document-tuned models often being more adept.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了传统基础Transformer和文档级微调Transformer（如句子Transformer）在心理健康预测中的表现，发现文档级微调模型在多个指标上优于基础模型，包括Pearson r提升13.4%，在扰动下更鲁棒，并能更好捕捉不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档级训练目标并非为聚合同一人的多条消息进行心理评估而设计，需要验证文档级微调模型是否更适合这一任务。
AI.method: 在架构匹配的基础上，系统比较基础Transformer与文档级对比微调Transformer，在纵向心理健康数据集上进行逐层和整体性能对比，并进行了多种鲁棒性测试和特征分析。
AI.result: 文档级微调模型在Pearson r上提升13.4%（p=.015），在词删除、同义词替换、拼写错误插入和回译等扰动下表现更鲁棒，且更善于捕捉不确定性（如"通常"等 hedging 语言）。
AI.conclusion: 表示学习的选择对心理健康预测有显著影响，文档级微调模型通常更适用于该任务。

title: BioInsight: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Interactive Biomedical Knowledge Discovery
summary: Biomedical researchers increasingly use AI-generated analyses and reports to interpret protein-level signals, but static outputs are often insufficient for research decision-making, where users need to inspect evidence, assess uncertainty, compare mechanisms, and refine hypotheses. We present \textsc{BioInsight}, a multi-agent system that moves from static biomedical report generation to interactive evidence-centered interactive interface generation. Given a disease name, a protein association table, and optional cohort metadata, BioInsight organizes disease-specific evidence through typed intermediate artifacts, including ranked pathways, literature evidence packets, protein-level reasoning notes, citation-grounded reports, dashboard schemas, and rendered interactive interfaces. The system decomposes evidence retrieval from mechanistic reasoning, normalizes citations through deterministic components, and converts the same structured evidence used in the report into an interactive interface. We evaluate BioInsight on standardized biomedical QA, challenging protein-function reasoning, and end-to-end biomedical evidence synthesis. Results show that BioInsight achieves best, and suggest that biomedical AI systems should move beyond text-only and static reports toward provenance-preserving, interactive evidence artifacts.

AI.tldr: BioInsight是一个多智能体系统，能将静态的生物医学报告转变为交互式、以证据为中心的界面，支持研究者检查证据、评估不确定性、比较机制和优化假设。
AI.motivation: 生物医学研究者越来越多地使用AI生成的分析和报告，但静态输出不足以支持研究决策，用户需要检查证据、评估不确定性、比较机制和优化假设。
AI.method: 给定疾病名称、蛋白质关联表和可选的队列元数据，BioInsight通过类型化的中间工件（排序通路、文献证据包、蛋白质推理笔记、引用依据报告、仪表盘模式和交互界面）组织疾病特异性证据。系统将证据检索与机制推理分离，通过确定性组件规范化引用，并将相同证据转换为交互式界面。
AI.result: 在标准化生物医学问答、蛋白质功能推理和端到端生物医学证据合成任务上，BioInsight取得了最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学AI系统应超越纯文本和静态报告，转向保留溯源的交互式证据工件。

title: Reconstructing Randomly Masked Spectra Helps DNNs Identify Discriminant Wavenumbers
summary: Nondestructive detection methods, based on vibrational spectroscopy, are vitally important in a wide range of applications including industrial chemistry, pharmacy and national defense. Recently, deep learning has been introduced into vibrational spectroscopy showing great potential. Different from images, text, etc. that offer large labeled data sets, vibrational spectroscopic data is very limited, which requires novel concepts beyond transfer and meta learning. To tackle this, we propose a task-enhanced augmentation network (TeaNet). The key component of TeaNet is a reconstruction module that inputs randomly masked spectra and outputs reconstructed samples that are similar to the original ones, but include additional variations learned from the domain. These augmented samples are used to train the classification model. The reconstruction and prediction parts are trained simultaneously, end-to-end with back-propagation. Results on both synthetic and real-world datasets verified the superiority of the proposed method. In the most difficult synthetic scenarios TeaNet outperformed CNN by 17%. We visualized and analysed the neuron responses of TeaNet and CNN, and found that TeaNet's ability to identify discriminant wavenumbers was excellent compared to CNN. Our approach is general and can be easily adapted to other domains, offering a solution to more accurate and interpretable few-shot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于任务增强的数据扩充网络（TeaNet），通过重建模块对随机掩码光谱进行重构生成增强样本，解决了振动光谱数据有限场景下的深度学习分类问题，在合成和真实数据集上相比CNN提升了17%的性能。
AI.motivation: 振动光谱数据样本量有限，不同于图像、文本等拥有大规模标注数据集，现有的迁移学习和元学习概念难以有效应用于该领域，需要新的方法来解决小样本学习问题。
AI.method: 提出TeaNet，核心是一个重建模块：对输入光谱进行随机掩码，然后重建出与原始样本相似但包含额外域内变化的样本，用于训练分类模型。重建和预测部分通过反向传播进行端到端联合训练。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上验证了方法的优越性，在最困难的合成场景中TeaNet比CNN高出17%；神经元响应分析表明TeaNet识别判别性波数的能力优于CNN。
AI.conclusion: 该方法具有通用性，可轻松适应其他领域，为更准确且可解释的小样本学习提供了解决方案。

title: CuratorKIT : Data Curation and Synthetic Data Generation for LLM Post-Training
summary: Data curation is a critical part of post-training pipelines for large language models, yet existing tools often treat ingestion, deduplication, synthetic generation, and quality filtering as separate stages. This fragmentation makes it difficult to audit pipeline decisions or understand why individual samples are rejected. CuratorKIT is an open-source Python library that covers this full lifecycle in a single configurable pipeline. The framework is composed of six source format readers and automatic schema detection, a pre-generation data hygiene layer for credentials, PII, and toxic content, eight LLM-powered generation tasks, three complementary quality gates with provenance-exact hallucination verification, structured adaptive recovery, and five training-ready export formats compatible with TRL, Unsloth, and AlignTune. Every pipeline decision is recorded in an append-only per-sample provenance chain, and rejected samples carry structured failure reasons rather than being silently discarded. CuratorKIT supports 100+ LLM providers through LiteLLM, exposes both a Python API and a YAML-driven CLI, and is designed for practitioners who need reproducible, auditable data pipelines at scale .

AI.tldr: CuratorKIT是一个开源Python库，提供从数据读取、清洗、生成到质量过滤的完整数据策展流程，支持可审计的溯源链和结构化失败原因记录。
AI.motivation: 现有数据策展工具将数据摄入、去重、合成生成和质量过滤作为独立阶段处理，导致难以审计管道决策或理解单个样本为何被拒，缺乏统一的可追溯框架。
AI.method: CuratorKIT采用单一可配置管道，包含6种源格式读取器与自动模式检测、预处理清洗层、8种LLM驱动的生成任务、3种互补质量门控（含来源精确的幻觉验证）、结构化自适应恢复，以及5种训练就绪的导出格式。所有决策记录在仅追加的逐样本溯源链中。
AI.result: 支持100+LLM提供商，提供Python API和YAML驱动的CLI，拒绝的样本携带结构化失败原因而非静默丢弃，支持与TRL、Unsloth、AlignTune等框架兼容的导出格式。
AI.conclusion: CuratorKIT专为需要可复现、可审计的大规模数据管道的实践者设计，解决了数据策展流程碎片化和缺乏可追溯性的关键问题。

title: Building Agent Harnesses for Scientific Curation from Multimodal Sources
summary: Scientific discovery workflows often depend on structured curation from the literature. This is difficult for current agents because the key evidence is scattered across long text, dense tables, and figures, and the final records often require reasoning across multiple evidence fragments rather than copying a single span. We study scientific curation from multimodal sources and introduce Beaver, an agent harness that extracts structured information from scientific papers while preserving provenance to the supporting evidence. Beaver combines a frontier agent with multimodal evidence tooling, task scaffolding, and artifact-grounded autoresearch. These components turn curation into a staged, auditable workflow and enable an iterative evaluate--diagnose--revise loop, where persistent run artifacts expose stage-localized failures and guide harness updates. Experiments show that Beaver reaches 81.0 on Gold-Referenced Attribute Score (GRAS), an attribute-level measure of agreement with gold curated records, outperforming frontier agents by over 23 absolute points. Ablations show that task scaffolding, multimodal evidence tooling, and provenance traces each contribute meaningfully to performance, while attribute-level analysis shows the largest gains on high-value attributes that require cross-modal reasoning and normalization. These results show that, for scientific curation from papers with multimodal evidence, harness design is a central determinant of agent performance.

AI.tldr: Beaver是一个从科学论文中提取结构化信息的智能体框架，通过多模态证据工具、任务分阶和可追溯机制，在GRAS指标上达到81.0分，比前沿智能体高出23个绝对百分点。
AI.motivation: 科学发现工作流依赖从文献中结构化整理信息，但当前智能体难以处理分散在长文本、密集表格和图表中的关键证据，且最终记录往往需要跨多个证据片段进行推理，而非简单复制单一文本片段。
AI.method: Beaver结合了前沿智能体、多模态证据工具、任务分阶（task scaffolding）和基于工件的人工自研（artifact-grounded autoresearch），将科学整理转化为分阶段、可审计的工作流，并支持迭代的"评估-诊断-修正"循环，通过持久化运行工件暴露阶段局部故障并指导框架更新。
AI.result: Beaver在GRAS指标上达到81.0分，比前沿智能体高出23个绝对百分点。消融实验表明，任务分阶、多模态证据工具和溯源追踪各自对性能有显著贡献；属性级分析显示，最大的提升出现在需要跨模态推理和归一化的高价值属性上。
AI.conclusion: 对于需要从包含多模态证据的科学论文中进行信息整理的任务，智能体框架设计（harness design）是决定智能体性能的核心因素。

title: Topological Neural Dynamics: A Neuron-wise Framework for Sequence Modeling
summary: Existing sequence models, including RNNs, LSTMs, continuous-time networks, and Transformers, share a common structural principle: layer-wise dynamics, where all neurons in the same layer co-evolve through a shared parameterized operator, leaving individual neurons no freedom to evolve independently. Yet in many complex dynamical systems, rich global behavior emerges precisely from locally evolving units interacting through structured connectivity. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Topological Neural Dynamics (TND), a sequence modeling framework that shifts computation from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics. TND represents a neural system as a directed neuron graph, an interaction operator, and a local dynamics function, where each neuron evolves independently and collective computation emerges from interactions through the explicit graph topology. We instantiate TND as a discrete-time graph-coupled dynamical system and evaluate it as a case study on a behavior cloning task in single-player Pong. Compared with Vanilla RNN, Sparse RNN, LSTM, Closed-form continuous-time neural network (CfC), and Transformer baselines, TND achieves the best catch rate and a mean of 17.47 consecutive catches per round, more than three times that of the strongest baseline. These results suggest that shifting from layer-wise to neuron-wise dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑神经动力学（TND），将序列建模从层状动力学转向神经元级动力学，通过有向神经元图、交互算子和局部动力学函数实现全局涌现行为，在Pong任务中显著超越RNN、LSTM、Transformer等基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有序列模型（RNN、LSTM、连续时间网络、Transformer）均采用层状动力学结构，同一层神经元通过共享参数化算子共同演化，缺乏独立演化自由度。然而复杂动力系统的全局行为恰恰源于局部单元通过结构化连接独立演化并涌现。受此启发，作者希望设计一种神经元级动力学的序列建模框架。
AI.method: TND将神经表示为有向神经元图、交互算子和局部动力学函数三要素。每个神经元独立演化，通过显式图拓扑结构进行交互，实现群体计算。具体实例化为离散时间图耦合动力系统。
AI.result: 在单玩家Pong行为克隆任务中，TND实现了最佳接球率，平均每轮连续接球17.47次，是最强基线模型的三倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 从层状动力学转向神经元级动力学为序列建模提供了有效的归纳偏置，在需要局部交互涌现全局行为的任务中具有显著优势。

title: Behavioral and Representational Evidence of Binomial Ordering Preferences in Large Language Models
comment: Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Zhi-qing-Yang/Linguistic-Binomials-in-Large-Language-Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can readily reproduce conventional expressions, yet their ability to model gradient frequency distributions remains underexplored. We investigate this using linguistic binomials, such as men and women, where both word permutations are grammatically valid but exhibit distinct, cross-linguistic variations in conventionality. We formalize binomial ordering as a distributional alignment problem, and construct a multilingual dataset of 600 binomial pairs across 8 languages. With categorical and distributional metrics, we measure and compare the corpus-derived preferences with model-induced ordering probabilities of 6 open-weight LLMs. While models often behaviorally recover the dominant corpus-preferred order, particularly for strongly conventionalized pairs, they align less well with the exact corpus preference distributions. This suggests that apparent directional order overstates how faithfully LLMs capture the statistical nuances of language use. Sparse probing verifies that the concept of preference strength is partially encoded among middle-to-late layers, and steering along probe-derived directions alters model-induced ordering distributions, demonstrating that the statistical behavioral preference of LLMs can be mechanistically measured and manipulated via internal representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在建模语言中梯度频率分布（以语言二项式为案例）方面的能力，发现模型虽能恢复主导语序偏好，但难以精确匹配语料库中的偏好分布，并通过内部表示探测和操控验证了这一统计偏好可被测量和干预。
AI.motivation: LLMs能复现常规表达，但其对语言中梯度频率分布（如二项式中非绝对但具有偏好性的语序）的建模能力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 将二项式语序形式化为分布对齐问题；构建涵盖8种语言600个二项式对的多语言数据集；使用分类和分布度量指标，比较6个开源LLMs的语序概率与语料库偏好分布；进行稀疏探测和表征引导实验。
AI.result: 模型能恢复主导语序，尤其对强惯例化二项式表现良好，但与语料库偏好分布的精确对齐度较低；偏好强度概念部分编码在中间到后层；通过探针方向引导可改变模型输出的语序分布。
AI.conclusion: LLMs表观的方向性语序偏好高估了其对语言统计细微差别的建模忠实度；模型的统计行为偏好可通过内部表征进行机制性测量和操控。

title: Closure of Self-Determining System Based on Causal and Constitutive Relations
summary: A self-determining system is defined as one in which causes originating within the system influence the system itself. This definition raises the question of how to specify system boundaries. Although the concept of "closure" is commonly used for this purpose, defining boundaries solely in terms of causal relations introduce challenges, such as how to handle external causes and circular causality. To address this issue, we introduce two types of asymmetric relations: causal and constitutive. We propose that system boundaries can be defined as closures of loops formed by these relations, referred to as causal-constitutive loops. By constraining constitutive relations, the resulting system necessarily includes internal causes and thereby satisfies self-determination. Furthermore, to prevent reduction to supervenience, constitutive relations must involve at least two independent variables. This minimal requirement leads to two interdependent loops, which implies a dual-process organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过因果-构成循环闭合来定义自决定系统的边界，并指出构成关系需至少两个独立变量以避免还原为随附性，从而形成双过程组织。
AI.motivation: 现有基于“闭合”概念定义系统边界的方法在处理外部因果和循环因果时存在困难，需要更精确的边界定义方式来支持自决定系统的理论构建。
AI.method: 引入两种非对称关系（因果关系和构成关系），提出系统边界可通过这些关系形成的循环闭合来定义，即“因果-构成循环”。
AI.result: 构成关系的约束使系统必然包含内部原因，满足自决定性；同时构成关系至少需要两个独立变量，这导致两个相互依赖的循环，形成双过程组织。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果-构成循环闭合定义系统边界，能够有效解决自决定系统的边界界定问题，并揭示了双过程组织作为自决定系统的必要结构特征。

title: NASDAQ: Normalized Observation Space Dynamics-Augmented Q-Learning
summary: Augmenting model-free reinforcement learning (RL) with representations learned through observation dynamics prediction (observation-predictive RL) can improve sample efficiency and performance, with minor modifications and limited additional computation. However, this approach still struggles in challenging tasks with low-dimensional observations. In this paper, we identify a key factor behind this problem: unbalanced reconstruction losses across observation dimensions, where dimensions with larger value ranges dominate the loss. This encourages the agent to neglect dimensions with relatively small ranges, leading to degraded performance. To address this issue, we propose a novel normalization method tailored to online RL, which normalizes low-dimensional observations and balances the resulting losses and gradients. Beyond balancing reconstruction losses, observation normalization enables dynamics prediction to be performed in a normalized observation space, thereby providing a unified treatment of low- and high-dimensional inputs (e.g., physical states and images). Building on this idea, we further introduce Normalized Observation Space Dynamics-Augmented Q-learning (NASDAQ), a framework for observation-predictive RL applicable across diverse domains. NASDAQ learns state-action representations by coupling value learning with two auxiliary tasks: short-term value prediction and next normalized observation prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NASDAQ achieves competitive or superior performance compared with state-of-the-art model-based and self-predictive RL methods, while requiring significantly less training wall-time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对低维观测的归一化方法，平衡观测预测中的重构损失，并在此基础上构建了NASDAQ框架，在多种RL任务上取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 观测预测增强的模型无关RL在低维观测任务中表现不佳，原因是不同观测维度的重构损失不平衡，大范围维度主导损失，导致小范围维度被忽略。
AI.method: 提出针对在线RL的观测归一化方法，平衡各维度的损失和梯度；在此基础上构建NASDAQ框架，通过值学习、短期值预测和下一归一化观测预测三个任务联合学习。
AI.result: NASDAQ在多种任务上达到或超越SOTA的基于模型和自预测RL方法，且训练时间显著更短。
AI.conclusion: 观测归一化有效解决了低维观测下的重构不平衡问题，NASDAQ作为一个统一框架适用于多种RL场景。

title: EvoEmbedding: Evolvable Representations for Long-Context Retrieval and Agentic Memory
summary: Existing embedding models are inherently static: they encode text segments in isolation, ignoring their surrounding context and temporal order. This paper introduces EvoEmbedding, a novel embedding model that generates evolvable representations for retrieval. It is tailored for long-context scenarios, where information is dynamic, sequential, and requires continuous state tracking. Our design is simple: EvoEmbedding maintains a continuously updated latent memory as it sequentially processes inputs, and uses it alongside the raw content to jointly generate evolvable embeddings. Consequently, for the same query, our model adapts its representation to retrieve distinct targets based on the evolving context, going beyond static semantic search. To equip the model with this capability, we construct EvoTrain-180K, a diverse dataset for the joint optimization of latent memory and retrieval.
