Furthermore, we introduce a memory queue to prevent representation collapse during recurrent encoding, alongside segment-batching techniques that tackle significant length variance and accelerate training by 3.8$\times$. Extensive experiments show that our model not only outperforms larger-scale specialists (e.g., Qwen3-Embedding-8B and KaLM-Embedding-Gemma3-12B) across a range of long-context retrieval benchmarks, but also generalizes well to downstream tasks (e.g., personalization) with contexts 10$\times$ longer than its training window. Notably, EvoEmbedding seamlessly integrates into agentic workflows to boost performance. For instance, a naive RAG pipeline equipped with our model surpasses dedicated agentic memory systems. Project Page: https://clare-nie.github.io/EvoEmbedding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoEmbedding，一种能根据上下文动态演化表示的检索嵌入模型，通过持续更新的潜在记忆和联合优化，在长上下文、动态信息场景中显著优于现有大型模型，并适用于下游任务和Agent工作流。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型是静态的，孤立编码文本片段，忽略上下文和时间顺序，无法处理动态、序列化的长上下文信息。
AI.method: EvoEmbedding维护持续更新的潜在记忆，顺序处理输入时结合原始内容联合生成可演化嵌入；构建EvoTrain-180K数据集进行联合优化；引入记忆队列防止表示坍塌，以及分段批处理技术加速训练3.8倍。
AI.result: 在长上下文检索基准上超越更大规模专家模型（如Qwen3-Embedding-8B和KaLM-Embedding-Gemma3-12B）；在训练窗口10倍长的下游任务中也能泛化；集成到简单RAG中即超越专用Agent记忆系统。
AI.conclusion: EvoEmbedding有效解决了静态嵌入的局限性，为动态、长上下文场景提供了可演化检索的新范式，并展示了在Agent工作流中的实用价值。

title: Agentic Time Machine as an Infrastructure for Future-Event Forecasting
summary: Forecasting future events is a critical challenge for large language model (LLM) agents, spanning domains from elections and monetary policy to financial markets. However, evaluating progress on this task presents a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and environment fidelity. While live evaluation benchmarks suffer from an inherently slow feedback loop, existing retrospective replays typically restrict agents to static, pre-frozen databases that sacrifice the environmental realism of actual deployments. To tackle this issue, we introduce Agentic Time Machine (TM), an infrastructure that approximately reconstructs the web state at any chosen past time by filtering post-cutoff content. Leveraging this evaluation infrastructure, we further propose a planner-solver-aggregator multi-agent framework that breaks each question into diverse analytical angles, gathers evidence in parallel, and combines the results into a single forecast. Experiments show that offline scores under TM correlate strongly with live FutureX scores, validating that TM offers a fast and reliable sandbox for forecasting-agent evaluation. On FutureX-Past and Polymarket evaluated under TM, our framework achieves the highest score among strong closed-book, tool-augmented, and self-consistency baselines. On the official FutureX live leaderboard, our system achieves the best average rank over four consecutive weeks, including 1st place in May Week 1. As of June 17, it also ranks 1st on FutureX's official eight-week overall leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agentic Time Machine (TM)评估基础设施，通过过滤过时内容重建任意过去时间点的网络状态，并在此基础上设计了一个"规划器-求解器-聚合器"多智能体框架，在保持环境真实性的同时实现高效评估，在FutureX等多个榜单上取得了最高排名。
AI.motivation: 现有的事件预测评估存在效率与环境保真度之间的根本权衡：实时评估反馈慢，而回顾性回放通常使用静态冻结数据库，牺牲了真实部署的环境真实性。
AI.method: 构建Agentic Time Machine (TM)评估基础设施，通过过滤过时内容近似重建任意过去时间的网络状态；在此基础上提出规划器-求解器-聚合器多智能体框架，将每个问题分解为多个分析角度，并行收集证据并整合结果。
AI.result: TM下的离线分数与实时FutureX分数高度相关；在FutureX-Past和Polymarket评估中，该框架在所有基线中得分最高；在FutureX实时榜单上，连续四周平均排名最佳，包括5月第一周第1名，截至6月17日8周总榜第1名。
AI.conclusion: Agentic Time Machine为预测型智能体评估提供了快速且可靠的沙盒环境，验证了离线评估与实时评估之间的强相关性，所提出的多智能体框架在预测任务上达到了领先性能。

title: Task-Differentiated Atomic Skill Expansion and Routing for Continual Learning Across Highly Heterogeneous Tasks
summary: Continual learning (CL) is commonly studied under the assumption that sequential tasks are semantically related or structurally similar. However, in highly heterogeneous settings, where tasks differ substantially in reasoning patterns and input-output formats, existing methods often suffer from catastrophic forgetting and inefficient capacity allocation. To address this challenge, we propose Task-differentiated Atomic Skill Expansion and Routing (\texttt{TASER}), a CL framework that jointly determines how many new atomic skills to introduce for each task and which skills to activate. The framework first uses atomic skill incremental learning to dynamically expand capacity based on task divergence and model uncertainty. It then applies orthogonality-enhanced skill detection to ensure these skills remain semantically distinct and independently reusable. Finally, a skill dynamic routing mechanism composes task-relevant skills through lightweight task-conditioned gating. We further introduce \texttt{HeteroCLBench}, a highly heterogeneous benchmark for CL, comprising 19 diverse tasks across 9 cognitive dimensions under a standardized sequential protocol. Experiments on \texttt{HeteroCLBench} show that \texttt{TASER} consistently outperforms strong baselines by improving plasticity and reducing catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TASER框架，通过动态扩展原子技能和正交化路由机制，解决高度异构持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，并构建了包含19个任务的HeteroCLBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法假设任务间语义相关或结构相似，但在高度异构场景（任务推理模式和输入输出格式差异大）下，存在灾难性遗忘和容量分配效率低的问题。
AI.method: TASER框架包含三个核心模块：(1) 原子技能增量学习，基于任务差异和模型不确定性动态扩展容量；(2) 正交增强技能检测，确保技能语义独立且可复用；(3) 技能动态路由机制，通过轻量级任务条件门控组合任务相关技能。
AI.result: 在包含19个任务、9个认知维度的HeteroCLBench基准上，TASER在可塑性和抗遗忘性上持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: TASER通过动态技能扩展与正交路由有效应对高度异构持续学习，HeteroCLBench为异构CL研究提供了标准化评估平台。

title: TACO: Task-Aware Column Description Generation Using LLMs
summary: Generating accurate and informative column descriptions (e.g. "membership status of customers" for the column name "cust_mem") is essential for a wide range of downstream NLP tasks on tabular data, including NL2SQL, table question answering, and entity linking. This problem arises in enterprises, domain sciences, government data portals, and so on. Despite its importance, most real-world datasets suffer from missing or cryptic documentation, often due to abbreviated column names or domain-specific jargon. Existing approaches largely rely on single-prompt large language models (LLMs), which struggle with three key issues: (i) inconsistent or incorrect handling of abbreviations, (ii) hallucinated or incomplete descriptions, and (iii) redundancy or vagueness that hinders downstream performance. We present TACO, a task-aware framework for automatic column description generation using LLMs. TACO introduces a three-step pipeline: (1) abbreviation expansion, which standardizes column names; (2) description generation, which produces initial semantic descriptions enriched with synonyms and search-oriented keywords; and (3) description revision, which refines these outputs using simulated downstream tasks. In addition, we investigate human-in-the-loop extensions and release new evaluation datasets for entity linking and schema enrichment. Extensive experiments across public and proprietary datasets show that TACO consistently outperforms existing methods, improving downstream task performance by up to 32%.

AI.tldr: TACO是一个任务感知的列描述自动生成框架，通过三步流水线（缩写扩展、描述生成、描述修订）有效解决表格数据中列名缺失或晦涩的问题，在下游任务中性能提升高达32%。
AI.motivation: 现实世界数据集中的列名常因缩写或领域术语而难以理解，现有方法（单一提示LLM）存在处理不一致、幻觉、冗余模糊等问题，亟需更可靠的自动列描述生成方法。
AI.method: TACO采用三步流水线：(1) 缩写扩展，标准化列名；(2) 描述生成，产生富含同义词和搜索关键词的语义描述；(3) 描述修订，通过模拟下游任务来优化输出。此外还研究了人在回路扩展并发布了新的评估数据集。
AI.result: 在公共和专有数据集上的实验表明，TACO持续优于现有方法，下游任务性能提升高达32%。
AI.conclusion: TACO框架通过任务感知的多步流水线显著提升了列描述生成的质量，对NL2SQL、表格问答和实体链接等下游任务具有实用价值。

title: The AI Evaluability Gap: The Missing Layer for Managing Risk and Sustaining Value
comment: 24 pages, 9 figures. Conceptual framework paper introducing the AI Evaluability Gap, Evaluability as evidence sufficiency for governance decisions, Operational Certification, Investment Certification, and a six-property evidence lifecycle for AI governance
summary:
Organizations deploying AI face two fundamental governance challenges: managing AI risk and sustaining AI value. Both depend on evidence whose sufficiency cannot be taken for granted. We call the shared underlying challenge the AI Evaluability Gap: the condition in which organizations lack sufficient evidence to support high-confidence governance decisions regarding either risk or value.
  We argue that this gap reflects a category error in current practice. Existing governance approaches focus primarily on properties of systems, such as safety, fairness, reliability, compliance, and value, while paying comparatively little attention to the evidentiary foundations required to justify decisions about those properties. We further argue that AI governance encompasses both operational decisions regarding whether a system may operate and investment decisions regarding whether it merits continued organizational resources.
  To address this problem, we introduce Evaluability, defined as the capability of a system to generate, maintain, and renew evidence sufficient to support high-confidence governance decisions over time. We formalize governance decisions as functions of calibrated confidence Conf(D|E) and identify six properties of evaluable evidence: observability, attributability, intervenability, verifiability, calibration, and temporal validity.
  The framework distinguishes Operational Certification, which relies primarily on structural evidence to justify deployment decisions, from Investment Certification, which relies primarily on causal evidence to justify continued resource allocation. We argue that evidence sufficiency is a missing layer of AI governance and that closing the AI Evaluability Gap is a prerequisite for both managing risk and sustaining value in AI-enabled organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI治理中的"可评估性鸿沟"问题，即组织缺乏足够证据来支持有关AI系统风险和价值的治理决策。作者认为现有治理过度关注系统属性而忽视证据基础，并引入"可评估性"概念，定义了可评估证据的六大属性，区分了运营认证与投资认证两种类型。
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理实践存在一个根本性缺陷：组织在决策时缺乏充分证据支撑，无法同时有效管理AI风险与维持AI价值。这一问题的根源在于人们犯了一个"范畴错误"——过分关注系统本身的属性（安全性、公平性等），而忽视了支撑这些判断所需的证据基础。
AI.method: 提出"可评估性"概念框架，形式化治理决策为校准置信度函数Conf(D|E)，识别可评估证据的六大属性（可观察性、可归因性、可干预性、可验证性、校准性和时间有效性），并区分运营认证（依赖结构证据）与投资认证（依赖因果证据）两种决策类型。
AI.result: 建立了AI可评估性理论框架，明确定义了证据充分性作为AI治理缺失的一层，并提出了弥合可评估性鸿沟的具体路径。
AI.conclusion: 证据充分性是AI治理中被忽视的关键层面，弥合可评估性鸿沟是组织在部署AI时同时实现风险管理和价值维持的必要前提。

title: Objective-Behavior Alignment: Diagnostics for MORL Policy Selection
summary: Real-world decision-making often requires optimizing multiple competing objectives simultaneously. In reinforcement learning (RL), this is typically addressed by combining reward signals into a single scalar objective via a scalarization function, which can be fragile: small changes in the weights can induce drastically different policies. Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) instead produces sets of policies that explicitly represent trade-offs between objectives. However, these policies are typically presented to the decision maker only through their value vectors, which can obscure substantial behavioral variation: policies that induce distinct trajectories may appear indistinguishable when evaluated solely by expected returns. We propose an exploratory diagnostic workflow that automatically highlights behavioral variation along the Pareto front that objective values alone do not reveal, providing both quantitative and visual tools to support policy inspection. We validate our approach on simple grid examples and scale it to continuous control benchmarks, demonstrating that it remains effective as problem complexity increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种探索性诊断工作流，自动揭示多目标强化学习中Pareto前沿上被目标值掩盖的行为差异，提供定量和可视化工具支持策略检查。
AI.motivation: 现有MORL方法仅通过值向量呈现策略，不同行为轨迹的策略可能因期望回报相近而无法区分，需更细粒度的行为差异分析工具。
AI.method: 设计探索性诊断工作流，自动识别Pareto前沿上目标值无法反映的行为变化，结合定量指标与可视化工具进行策略检查。
AI.result: 在简单网格环境和连续控制基准上验证，该方法随问题复杂度增加仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: MORL中除值向量外，需关注策略的行为多样性，所提诊断工作流能有效补充现有评估体系。

title: Clinical Term Extraction using Open-Source Small Language Models
summary: Clinical information for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) care documented in unstructured clinical notes limits downstream analysis without extraction into structured formats. Open-source small language models with few-shot prompting for detecting the presence of ALS-relevant clinical terms in patient documentation were evaluated without task-specific training data. The detection task targeted 17 categories spanning functional scores, respiratory measures, medications, and related clinical and non-clinical attributes. Clinical note content was normalized from JSON-encoded discharge summaries and processed with a prompt template having structured JSON outputs. We compared 26 open-source models using aggregate, label-level, and manual-validation multilabel classification metrics. Manual validation showed that a regex rule baseline had higher overall micro-F1 and lower Hamming loss than any single SLM or TF-IDF baseline, while Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 was the highest-performing SLM by micro-F1. Model rankings varied by metric and label category, with the TF-IDF baseline showing high recall but low precision, some SLMs showing higher precision but lower recall, and Hammer2.1-7b showing strong performance for ALSFRS-R subscore detection. These findings support targeted hybrid extraction workflows rather than replacement of existing rule-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了26个开源小语言模型在少量样本提示下，从ALS非结构化临床笔记中检测17类临床术语的能力。手动验证显示，正则表达式基线在整体micro-F1和Hamming损失上优于所有SLM和TF-IDF基线，但Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507是表现最佳的SLM。研究支持混合抽取工作流，而非完全替代现有基于规则的方法。
AI.motivation: ALS临床护理信息通常记录在非结构化临床笔记中，难以进行下游分析。现有方法需要将非结构化数据提取为结构化格式，但缺乏任务特定训练数据，因此需要探索无需训练数据的开源小语言模型在ALS相关术语检测中的潜力。
AI.method: 使用26个开源小语言模型，通过少量样本提示（few-shot prompting）进行ALS相关临床术语检测，无需任务特定训练数据。临床笔记内容从JSON编码的出院小结中标准化处理，使用具有结构化JSON输出的提示模板。对比了正则表达式基线、TF-IDF基线和SLM，使用聚合、标签级别和手动验证的多标签分类指标进行评估。
AI.result: 手动验证表明，正则表达式基线在整体micro-F1和Hamming损失上优于所有单个SLM或TF-IDF基线。Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507是表现最佳的SLM。模型排名因指标和标签类别而异：TF-IDF基线召回率高但精确率低，部分SLM精确率高但召回率低，Hammer2.1-7b在ALSFRS-R子评分检测中表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持采用目标导向的混合抽取工作流，而非完全用SLM替代现有的基于规则的方法。不同模型在不同指标和标签类别上各有优势，混合方法能够综合利用规则的高可靠性和SLM的灵活性。

title: Negative Knowledge as Failure-aware Shared Memory for AutoResearch
summary: AI-assisted research systems generate many failed attempts, but those failures rarely become a durable, shared knowledge asset. We propose a negative knowledge memory layer: a curator agent converts each failed attempt into a bounded, typed record in a shared bank, and a downstream research agent explicitly adopts or rejects those records before proposing its next experiment. We evaluate this layer in two settings: same-task retry on ScienceAgentBench and cross-task scientific research on two nonlinear math-physics PDE problems. The negative knowledge layer outperforms vanilla AutoResearch baselines while using fewer tokens; agents with the negative knowledge bank solve new tasks that all baselines fail to solve in PDE systems research. We also show that the previous negative knowledge bank can transfer and enhance AutoResearch on different PDE problems. These results suggest that structured negative knowledge is a knowledge asset that should be explicitly maintained in broader AI-engaged scientific research beyond a memory-compression or debugging aid, alongside positive findings, as a collective infrastructure for scientific memory. Code is available at https://github.com/hch-wang/Negative_Knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种负知识记忆层（Negative Knowledge Memory Layer），将AI研究系统中的失败尝试转化为结构化、可共享的记录，帮助后续研究代理避免重复错误，并在科学任务中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: AI辅助研究系统会产生大量失败尝试，但这些失败很少成为持久、可共享的知识资产，导致研究资源浪费，缺乏系统性积累。
AI.method: 设计一个策展代理（curator agent）将每次失败尝试转化为有界、有类型的记录存入共享负知识库；下游研究代理在提出新实验前明确采纳或拒绝这些记录。
AI.result: 在ScienceAgentBench的同任务重试和两个非线性数学物理PDE问题的跨任务科学研究中，负知识层优于vanilla AutoResearch基线，且使用更少token；负知识库可迁移至不同PDE问题，增强研究效果。
AI.conclusion: 结构化负知识应作为一种知识资产，与正向发现并列，作为AI参与科学研究中的集体基础设施，而不仅仅是内存压缩或调试辅助工具。

title: Distinguishing indistinguishable attractors: Unsupervised anomaly detection with reservoir computers
summary: Detecting when a nonlinear dynamical system departs from its normal regime is a recurring problem across the sciences, from cardiology to climate and energy systems. We show that a very simple Kolmogorov--Smirnov test on the output weights of a reservoir computer is highly sensitive to regime changes in nonlinear dynamical systems, including those invisible to both classical nonlinear measures and modern deep-learning detectors. The core idea of our algorithm is to treat the readout layer of a reservoir computer as a representation of the input dynamics. Since the input mapping and the reservoir itself are random and fixed, the trained output weights are the only object encoding the system at hand. We summarize this fingerprint by the empirical cumulative distribution function of the readout weights and compare it to a reference band built from the training data. This unsupervised, online detector distinguishes two visually indistinguishable butterfly-shaped attractors, resolves parameter drifts seven times smaller than the strongest deep-learning baseline, flags noise four orders of magnitude below the signal, and identifies ventricular flutter in a clinical ECG recording. More broadly, we aim to establish a perspective on reservoir computers in which the trained output weights are treated as a representation of the learned system in their own right, rather than merely as a means to forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于储层计算输出权重的Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验方法，用于检测非线性动力系统的状态变化，该方法对肉眼不可见的系统变化具有高灵敏度，在多个基准测试中优于深度学习基线。
AI.motivation: 非线性动力系统偏离正常状态（如心脏疾病、气候异常、能源系统故障）的检测是一个跨学科难题，现有方法（经典非线性指标和深度学习检测器）对某些"不可见"的状态变化不够敏感。
AI.method: 利用储层计算中固定随机输入映射和储层，仅训练输出层权重；将训练后的输出权重视为系统"指纹"，通过其经验累积分布函数与参考带进行Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验，实现无监督在线检测。
AI.result: 成功区分两个视觉上无法区分的蝴蝶形吸引子；参数漂移检测灵敏度比最强深度学习基线高7倍；可检测到低于信号4个数量级的噪声；在临床心电图中识别出心室扑动。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种新视角：储层计算的输出权重本身可被视为学习系统的表征，而不仅仅是用于预测的工具；该方法在非线性动力系统异常检测中展现出优越性能。

title: When Compression Helps and When It Hurts: Condition-Aware Analysis of Chain-of-Thought Distillation
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation transfers multi-step reasoning from large reasoning models to smaller students, but verbose teacher traces inflate both training and inference cost. Existing CoT compression methods fall into two families, selective pruning and generative rewriting, yet prior studies have left key factors entangled: granularity is confounded with importance criteria in pruning, restructuring level is rarely isolated in rewriting, and compression budgets are not systematically evaluated across domains or regimes. We recast CoT compression along three dimensions: importance criterion, restructuring level, and compression budget. Sweeping these across two model families, Math and General domains, and Long-/Short-CoT regimes, we find that (i) importance criterion utility is strictly governed by granularity: step-level criteria converge on a shared reasoning backbone, while token-level pruning requires symbol-aware signals to preserve the logical core; (ii) restructuring level inverts across domains: Math degrades monotonically with structural disruption, while aggressive rewriting acts as a denoiser on General tasks; (iii) training-time compression does not necessarily translate to inference-time savings: Long-CoT students retain verbose habits despite concise supervision, making the training ratio an optimistic lower bound on deployment cost. These findings yield condition-aware guidelines for matching compression to deployment context.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地研究了思维链（CoT）压缩的三个关键维度：重要性标准、重组层级和压缩预算。实验发现：(1)重要性标准的有效性由粒度严格决定；(2)重组层级在不同领域效果相反；(3)训练时压缩不必然带来推理时节省。最终给出了条件感知的压缩指南。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT压缩方法将多个关键因素（如粒度与重要性标准、重组层级等）混淆在一起，缺乏系统性的解耦研究。同时，压缩预算在不同领域和场景下的影响也未被充分评估。
AI.method: 作者将CoT压缩重新梳理为三个正交维度：重要性标准（importance criterion）、重组层级（restructuring level）和压缩预算（compression budget）。在两个模型家族、Math和General两大领域、以及Long-CoT和Short-CoT两种模式下进行全面的消融实验。
AI.result: (1) 步骤级重要性标准趋于收敛，而token级剪枝需要符号感知信号；(2) Math领域随结构破坏性能单调下降，General领域激进改写反而起到降噪作用；(3) Long-CoT学生模型即使接受简洁监督，仍保留冗长推理习惯，训练时压缩比仅是推理成本的下限。
AI.conclusion: CoT压缩没有通用最优方案，需要根据部署场景（领域、预算、模型规模等）匹配相应的压缩策略。训练时压缩不等于推理时节省，需关注实际部署成本。

title: Coherence Under Commitment: Probing Generalization and Vacuous Memorization in LLM Logical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) deployed for logical reasoning in knowledge-intensive domains exhibit a subtle but critical failure: coherence can be vacuously achieved through systematic abstention. A model that withholds commitment to either entailment or refutation satisfies negation consistency while providing no utility. We introduce Coherence Under Commitment (CUC), a dual-query evaluation paradigm that jointly measures consistency and decisiveness. CUC contributes three innovations: (1) a commitment score $c(\varphi) = p(\varphi) + p(\lnot\varphi)$ quantifying probability mass allocated to decisive outcomes; (2) a \textbf{deterministic elicitation protocol} via normalized YES/NO log probabilities, eliminating sampling variance; and (3) a 3-way decision framework (True/False/Uncertain) operationalizing the coherence-commitment trade-off into metrics. Experiments on four open-weight LLMs (1B-3B) across 204 FOLIO examples expose a sharp frontier. Qwen2.5-3B achieves near-zero contradiction ($\mathbb{E}[v_{\mathrm{neg}}]{=}0.025$) but only $7.4\%$ coverage, while TinyLlama-1.1B reaches $79.4\%$ coverage with violations on every example. Coherence-only evaluation would rank the abstaining model first; CUC exposes this as vacuous, and the frontier generalizes to LogiQA~v2 ($ρ{=}0.97$). We argue that evaluation must report both coherence and non-vacuous commitment and release a toolkit for standardized assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Coherence Under Commitment (CUC)评估范式，揭示了大语言模型在逻辑推理中通过系统性弃权（abstention）实现虚假一致性的问题。CUC同时测量一致性和决策性，包含承诺分数、确定性诱导协议和三向决策框架。实验表明，仅评估一致性会奖励弃权模型，而CUC能暴露这种空洞性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM逻辑推理评估仅关注一致性（coherence），但模型可以通过系统性弃权（不对蕴含或反驳做出承诺）来空洞地满足一致性，导致评估结果具有误导性。需要一种能同时衡量模型一致性和决策意愿的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出CUC评估范式，包含三个创新：(1) 承诺分数 c(φ) = p(φ) + p(¬φ) 量化分配给决定性结果的概率质量；(2) 通过归一化的YES/NO对数概率实现确定性诱导协议，消除采样方差；(3) 三向决策框架（True/False/Uncertain）将一致性-承诺权衡转化为可度量指标。
AI.result: 在204个FOLIO样本上对四个开源LLM（1B-3B）进行实验，揭示了清晰的前沿：Qwen2.5-3B实现了接近零的矛盾（0.025），但覆盖率仅7.4%；TinyLlama-1.1B达到79.4%覆盖率，但每个样本都有违规。一致性评估会奖励弃权模型，而CUC暴露了这种空洞性。该前沿在LogiQA v2上得到验证（ρ=0.97）。
AI.conclusion: 评估必须同时报告一致性和非空洞的承诺。发布了用于标准化评估的工具包。

title: MedTS-TTT: Test-Time Training for Medical Time Series Classification
summary: Medical time series (MedTS) signals such as electroencephalography (EEG) and electrocardiography (ECG) support many clinical applications. However, substantial subject-level heterogeneity often induces subject-level distribution shift, causing a fixed parameter set to generalize poorly to unseen individuals. Compared with domain adaptation methods that often depend on extra adaptation components or target-batch statistics, Test-Time Training (TTT) provides a more practical solution for sequential clinical data by enabling online adaptation from unlabeled test samples. However, many representative TTT methods require iterative inner-loop optimization, increasing test-time overhead. In this paper, we propose MedTS-TTT, a test-time training framework for medical time series modeling. MedTS-TTT is built upon Closed-Loop Self-Alignment Test-Time Training (CLSA-TTT) and a Gated Convolutional Backbone (GCB). CLSA-TTT constructs a token-level self-supervised target and performs a single-step fast-weight update for intra-layer closed-loop alignment, enabling rapid sample-wise adaptation without iterative inner-loop optimization. GCB combines CLSA-TTT-based fast adaptation and token-level fusion with a gated convolutional branch to balance local dynamic modeling and information-flow control. On 4 public datasets (2 EEG and 2 ECG) with subject-independent splits, MedTS-TTT achieves 11 top-1 rankings out of 12 evaluations across 9 baselines and 3 metrics. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/mingzhi-c/MedTS-TTT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedTS-TTT框架，通过闭路自对齐测试时训练（CLSA-TTT）和门控卷积主干（GCB）实现了无需迭代内循环优化的高效测试时自适应，在4个公开数据集上取得了11/12的top-1排名。
AI.motivation: 医疗时间序列存在严重的个体异质性导致分布偏移，传统领域自适应方法依赖额外组件或目标批次统计，而现有TTT方法需要迭代内循环优化增加测试时开销，亟需一种高效、实用的在线自适应方法。
AI.method: 提出MedTS-TTT框架，包含两个关键组件：1) CLSA-TTT：构建token级自监督目标，通过单步快速权重更新实现层内闭环对齐；2) GCB：结合CLSA-TTT快速适应和token级融合的门控卷积分支，平衡局部动态建模和信息流控制。
AI.result: 在4个公开数据集（2个EEG、2个ECG）上，基于9个基线方法和3个评估指标，MedTS-TTT在12项评估中取得11项top-1排名。
AI.conclusion: MedTS-TTT通过避免迭代内循环优化实现了高效的测试时自适应，在医疗时间序列建模中展现了优越的泛化性能。

title: PrivacyAlign: Contextual Privacy Alignment for LLM Agents
summary: AI agents acting on behalf of users are constantly making decisions, and for users to trust their agents, those decisions must align with what they actually want. Privacy is an important alignment problem for agents: every message, post, or tool call an agent makes is a contextual judgment about what is appropriate to share, with whom, and under which conditions. Because such judgments depend on social expectations and norms, human judgment does not merely label privacy violations but also helps define them. While existing work relies on unreliable proxies for both training and evaluation, we place human judgment at the center of agentic privacy alignment. We introduce PrivacyAlign, a dataset of 1,350 samples with 3,516 detailed annotations from 599 unique annotators across diverse scenarios where current LLMs actually leak, and use it to ground both alignment training and automated evaluation in human privacy norms. Building on these annotations, we first show that conditioning LLM judges on human annotations and explanations for reference responses to the same prompt makes their judgments more reliable. We then introduce annotation-conditioned reward modeling, which uses these annotations to score new responses during RL, and show that small open-weight agents trained with this reward better align with human privacy norms, with strong gains on PrivacyAlign and existing privacy benchmarks for agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrivacyAlign数据集（1350个样本，3516条人工标注），将人类判断置于AI代理隐私对齐的核心，并基于此训练出更符合人类隐私规范的奖励模型和代理系统。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理在代表用户决策时缺乏隐私对齐能力，现有工作依赖不可靠的代理指标进行训练和评估，未能将人类对隐私规范的判断置于核心地位。
AI.method: 构建PrivacyAlign数据集（1350样本，599位标注者，3516条详细标注）；提出基于标注条件的大语言模型评判方法，使其判断更可靠；引入标注条件的奖励建模，在强化学习中用人类标注评分新回复。
AI.result: 标注条件的大语言模型评判更可靠；标注条件的奖励模型训练出的小型开源代理在PrivacyAlign和现有隐私基准上均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将人类隐私规范融入AI代理对齐训练是可行的，且能有效提升代理在隐私决策上与人类期望的一致性。

title: Repeated post-training is not Self-improving: Diagnosing Scientific Amnesia in Continual DPO Pipelines
summary: Industrial LLM teams often ship behavior updates by repeatedly DPO-training a base model on sequences of related preference-data campaigns. The dominant failure mode in this regime is not always classical catastrophic forgetting: a pipeline may preserve previously learned behaviors while still failing to accumulate reusable methodological knowledge about how to train the next campaign. We call this failure mode scientific amnesia. This paper turns that practitioner intuition into a measurable industrial problem. We contribute: (i) a diagnostic suite for amnesia, (ii) a Program-based pipeline that chains FSDP-sharded DPO checkpoints across Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct runs, (iii) a 30-campaign HumanEval subdomain benchmark, and (iv) a comparative diagnostic study of five strategy proposers: random memory, rule-based scheduling, retrieval-only memory, warm-start Bayesian optimization, and MSCL, a meta-scientific memory and reasoner candidate. Across a single-seed 5-condition * 3-step real-LM chain, 4 of 5 candidates degrade in step-level peak pass@1, including MSCL; only the deliberately conservative rule-based schedule improves. Follow-up pilots qualify rather than overturn this finding: in a heterogeneous chain, MSCL is the only completed candidate that improves, whereas in a small multi-seed homogeneous sweep, retrieval-only has the best mean Delta and no pairwise candidate gap is statistically distinguishable. The contribution is therefore diagnostic, not a claim that MSCL solves the problem: scientific amnesia is observable in a production-like continual-DPO pipeline, and conclusions about interventions depend sharply on chain regime, evaluator design, and seed coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了工业LLM团队在连续DPO训练中出现的“科学遗忘症”现象（即模型无法积累可复用的方法论知识），并提供了诊断工具、基准测试和比较研究，发现干预效果高度依赖训练链设计、评估方式和随机种子覆盖。
AI.motivation: 工业LLM团队在连续DPO训练中，除了经典的灾难性遗忘外，还存在一种更隐蔽的失败模式：模型未能积累关于如何训练下一轮campaign的可复用方法论知识，即“科学遗忘症”。本文旨在将这一实践经验转化为可测量的工业问题。
AI.method: (i) 开发了一套科学遗忘症诊断工具；(ii) 构建了基于FSDP分片的DPO检查点链接的程序化流水线；(iii) 设计了包含30个campaign的HumanEval子域基准；(iv) 对五种策略（随机记忆、基于规则的调度、仅检索记忆、热启动贝叶斯优化、MSCL元科学记忆与推理器）进行了比较诊断研究。
AI.result: 在单种子5条件×3步真实LM链中，除保守的基于规则调度外，其余4种策略（含MSCL）均出现step-level峰值pass@1退化。在异质链中MSCL是唯一改进的候选，而在同质小规模多种子扫描中，仅检索记忆平均Delta最优，但所有候选间差距统计上不显著。
AI.conclusion: 科学遗忘症在类生产环境的连续DPO流水线中是可观测的，且干预效果高度依赖训练链设计、评估器设计和种子覆盖范围。本文贡献在于诊断，而非声称MSCL解决了该问题。

title: Ramanujan Graph Rewiring with Non Negative Resistance Curvature
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning on graph-structured data by iteratively propagating and aggregating information across edges. However, conventional message passing schemes often suffer from over-squashing, whereby exponentially large neighborhoods are compressed into fixed-dimensional embeddings, impeding effective long-range dependency learning. In this work, we introduce Ramanujan Propagation, a graph rewiring strategy that leverages Ramanujan graphs to alleviate topological bottlenecks in GNNs. We first establish that suitably chosen Ramanujan graphs guarantee non-negative resistance curvature, which mitigates over-squashing and facilitates efficient information flow. We then propose an algorithmic framework to construct a Ramanujan rewired graph that preserves the local connectivity of the original graph. Our experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms nine state-of-the-art rewiring techniques. These results establish Ramanujan graphs as a rigorous structural prior for scalable, topology-aware message passing in GNNs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ramanujan Propagation，一种基于Ramanujan图的图重连策略，通过保证非负电阻曲率来缓解GNN中的过度挤压问题，在多项实验中优于九种现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统GNN的消息传递机制存在过度挤压问题，即指数级增长的邻域信息被压缩到固定维度的嵌入中，阻碍了有效长程依赖的学习。
AI.method: 利用Ramanujan图作为图重连策略，保证非负电阻曲率以缓解过度挤压；提出一个算法框架来构建保留原始图局部连接性的Ramanujan重连图。
AI.result: 该方法在实验中优于九种最先进的图重连技术。
AI.conclusion: Ramanujan图可作为可扩展、拓扑感知的GNN消息传递的严格结构先验。

title: Leveraging LaBSE with Progressive Curriculum Learning for Multicultural Polarization
summary: Detecting online polarization remains a critical challenge, particularly in multilingual and multicultural contexts where intergroup hostility is prevalent. The problem is particularly challenging due to the data scarcity for these tasks in the low-resource languages. Identifying such phenomena has become an active area of research and is addressed in SemEval-2026 Task 9: Multilingual, Multicultural Online Polarization Detection. To address this problem we propose an architecture that leverages LaBSE embeddings - an unconventional choice typically reserved for retrieval tasks, to obtain strong cross-lingual learning which enhances scores in low-resource language by a score up to 0.2 macro F1. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive ablation study evaluating the performance of diverse encoder models in the Qwen model family within a retrieval-based prompting framework. Our code will be soon available at https://github.com/carrycurious/PolarMind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于LaBSE嵌入的架构，在SemEval-2026 Task 9的多语言多文化在线极化检测任务中，有效提升低资源语言的宏F1分数达0.2，并系统评估了Qwen系列编码器在检索式提示框架中的表现。
AI.motivation: 多语言多文化环境下的在线极化检测面临数据稀缺挑战，尤其在低资源语言中表现不佳，亟需有效的跨语言学习方法。
AI.method: 采用LaBSE嵌入（通常用于检索任务）实现强跨语言学习，并在检索式提示框架中对Qwen模型家族的多种编码器进行消融研究。
AI.result: 低资源语言的宏F1分数提升高达0.2。
AI.conclusion: LaBSE嵌入作为跨语言特征提取器在极化检测任务中效果显著，为低资源语言场景提供了有效解决方案。

title: Self-Improvement Can Self-Regress: The Rise-and-Collapse Failure Mode of LLM Self-Training
summary:
Self-improvement can self-regress. In REINFORCE post-training for code, a model can quickly improve on its optimized metric and then collapse within the same training campaign. We study this in a controlled multi-seed testbed using Qwen-2.5-3B and Qwen-2.5-7B, trained on competitive-programming tasks with binary CodeGrader reward across 10 sequential 20-step campaigns. Across campaigns, pass@1 shows a robust rise-then-collapse pattern: it peaks within tens of gradient steps and then falls back, sometimes to near zero. This is not cross-task catastrophic forgetting, but within-task policy over-optimization on a fixed distribution; KL- and EWC-style constraints do not prevent it.
  We ask where the control loop should sit. We compare three levels: CARE, a between-campaign memory mechanism with a capability posterior, transfer gate, and regression-aware belief revision; ES, a within-campaign early-stop rule that rolls forward the peak checkpoint and sets the next budget to peak_step+3; and GRPO, which changes the RL update using group-relative reward normalization.
  The answer is regime-dependent. On Qwen-2.5-3B, where naive REINFORCE is fragile, CARE v2 nearly doubles end-of-chain pass@1 from 4.9% to 9.5%, with paired bootstrap 95% CI [+0.4,+8.9] and gains in 4/5 seeds. On Qwen-2.5-7B, CARE reaches parity with naive REINFORCE, 13.8% vs. 11.8%, while ES reaches 22.2% [14.1,28.0]. Out-of-the-box GRPO reaches 20.7% [15.7,25.1], nearly matching REINFORCE+ES.
  GRPO raises the floor but does not remove the cliff. Its 7B gain mainly comes from better between-campaign carryover, while the within-campaign peak-to-end gap remains about 17 points under both REINFORCE and GRPO. GRPO+ES gives mixed evidence: 2/3 seeds improve, but one final cliff lowers the mean to 17.0% [0.0,28.1]. A Gemma-3-4B pilot shows the same signature, suggesting the phenomenon is not limited to Qwen.

AI.tldr: 本文发现代码后训练中模型在优化指标上会先快速上升后急剧崩溃，并提出三种控制策略（CARE、ES、GRPO），效果因模型规模而异。
AI.motivation: REINFORCE后训练中模型在代码任务上表现出先提升后崩溃的现象（self-improvement can self-regress），需要探究其原因并寻求有效的控制策略。
AI.method: 在Qwen-2.5-3B/7B上使用CodeGrader二元奖励进行10轮×20步的REINFORCE训练；对比CARE（跨轮记忆机制）、ES（早停规则）和GRPO（组相对奖励归一化）三种控制策略。
AI.result: 3B上CARE v2将pass@1从4.9%提升至9.5%；7B上ES达到22.2%，GRPO达20.7%，均优于naive REINFORCE的11.8%。但GRPO未消除内部崩溃，Gemma-3-4B也观察到相同现象。
AI.conclusion: 最佳控制策略存在规模依赖性：小模型需跨轮记忆（CARE），大模型更受益于早停（ES）或GRPO；GRPO能提升下限但无法消除崩溃现象，崩溃具有跨模型通用性。

title: DataClaw0: Agentic Tailoring Multimodal Data from Raw Streams
summary: Massive unstructured multimodal streams suffer from high "data entropy," impeding both efficient human knowledge acquisition and high-quality AI post-training. Existing passive annotation paradigms, heavily reliant on heuristic rules or general VLMs, are costly, monotonous, and fail to unlock the deep procedural logic embedded in raw data. We elevate data processing to a learnable capability, proposing a paradigm shift towards Agentic Data Tailoring, which actively refining and structuring data to align with diverse user and downstream intents. To overcome the data scarcity bottleneck in training such high-order capabilities, we design a two-stage pipeline grounding generative semantic synthesis in deterministic Factual Anchors, yielding a large-scale dataset spanning five core physical and digital domains. Building upon this, $\text{DataClaw}_0$-9B model synergizes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), achieving robust alignment with complex refinement and tailoring intents. To systematically quantify this capability, we construct $\text{DataClaw}_0$-val, the first benchmark dedicated to data refinement. Crucially, we adopt downstream post-training as the ultimate validation touchstone. Evaluations on video generation, real-world VQA, and GUI navigation confirm that $\text{DataClaw}_0$ delivers high-information-density tailored data, facilitating efficient model adaptation to new tasks under limited training data regimes. Project page: https://czjdsg.github.io/MakeAnyData

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Agentic Data Tailoring的自适应数据处理范式，并构建了DataClaw₀-9B模型来实现高质量的多模态数据精炼。通过两阶段流水线生成大规模训练数据，结合SFT和GRPO训练策略，在视频生成、VQA和GUI导航等下游任务中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有被动式数据标注范式（依赖启发式规则或通用VLM）成本高、单调且无法挖掘原始数据中的深层过程逻辑，阻碍了高效知识获取和高质量AI后训练。
AI.method: 提出Agentic Data Tailoring范式，将数据处理提升为可学习能力；设计两阶段流水线，基于确定性事实锚点生成语义合成数据；构建DataClaw₀-9B模型，采用SFT+GRPO联合训练实现复杂精炼意图的对齐。
AI.result: 构建了DataClaw₀-val基准数据集；在视频生成、真实世界VQA和GUI导航任务中，DataClaw₀生成的高信息密度数据能够促进模型在有限训练数据下的高效适应。
AI.conclusion: 将数据处理转化为可学习能力是提升多模态数据质量的有效路径，DataClaw₀在多个下游任务中证明了其数据精炼能力的实用价值。

title: Denoising Iterative Self-Correction: Structured Verification Loops for Reliable LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models produce fluent but often incorrect multi-step reasoning, and naive correction methods risk degrading already-correct answers. We introduce Denoising Iterative Self-Correction (DISC), a test-time procedure that treats verification question outputs as noisy measurements of where a solution may be corrupted. Using these signals, DISC progressively reduces errors across multiple verify-judge-correct passes, analogous to traditional iterative denoising. A binary judgment gate controls correction precision by blocking rewrites that would damage already-correct answers while the verifier and corrector together repair errors. We evaluate this trade-off using two paired diagnostics: an improvement-to-degradation ratio (precision) and a repair rate (recall). Across three benchmarks (BIG-Bench Mistake, HotpotQA, GPQA Diamond) and four models, DISC dominates Chain-of-Verification and Self-Refine on the precision-recall trade-off, reaching 81.6% accuracy with 13x more improvements per degradation than Chain-of-Verification and 5x more than Self-Refine on BIG-Bench Mistake (Sonnet~4.5). On GPQA Diamond, we identify a capability floor below which judges acknowledge contradictions in evidence but cannot translate that recognition into a correction. We further show that cross-model role allocation -- assigning verification and judgment to a model different from the generator -- mitigates self-confirmation bias.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DISC的测试时自纠错方法，通过将验证问题的输出视为带噪声的测量信号，在多个验证-判断-纠正循环中逐步减少推理错误，并引入二值判断门控来保护已正确的答案，在三个基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多步推理中常出现流畅但错误的结果，而简单的纠错方法可能破坏已经正确的答案，因此需要一种既能修复错误又不损害正确答案的高精度纠错机制。
AI.method: 提出Denoising Iterative Self-Correction (DISC)，将验证问题输出视为带噪声的测量信号，通过多个验证-判断-纠正循环逐步减少错误。引入二值判断门控来控制纠正精度，阻止破坏正确答案的重写，同时验证器和纠正器协作修复错误。
AI.result: 在BIG-Bench Mistake、HotpotQA、GPQA Diamond三个基准测试和四个模型上，DISC在精度-召回率权衡上优于Chain-of-Verification和Self-Refine，在BIG-Bench Mistake上达到81.6%准确率，每次改进/退化比是Chain-of-Verification的13倍、Self-Refine的5倍。
AI.conclusion: DISC方法在保持高精度的同时有效修复推理错误，跨模型角色分配可以缓解自我确认偏差，但在GPQA Diamond上存在能力下限，即判断器虽能识别证据矛盾但无法将其转化为纠正。

title: Answer Engineering: Local Trajectory Editing for Protocol-Constrained Decision Making in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models can produce confident but protocol-invalid answers in domains where procedural compliance is critical. This paper presents Answer Engineering, a deterministic runtime and authoring layer that applies localized rule-guided interventions to the visible reasoning trajectory during standard autoregressive generation, without retraining, modifying model weights, or performing global search. The method is evaluated on a controlled clinical benchmark for sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL), where correct management depends on protocol-consistent interpretation of symptom timing, Weber/Rinne tuning-fork findings, and otoscopic findings. In the benchmark, step-by-step reasoning shifted rather than eliminated errors: compliant outcomes for SSNHL decreased from 54.5% under unguided generation to 25.1%, while acceptance on the conductive contrast condition increased from 1.6% to 58.9%. Local trajectory editing increased SSNHL compliance to 83.5% and conductive-case adherence to 77.9%, raising balanced accuracy from 42.0% under reasoning-only generation to 80.7%. The results support a systems-level view in which protocol adherence can be improved through auditable runtime control of reasoning trajectories, while also identifying limitations caused by rule coverage, trigger reliability, and persistent diagnosis-first generation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Answer Engineering方法，通过运行时对推理轨迹进行局部规则引导干预，在不重新训练或修改模型权重的情况下，显著提升了大型语言模型在临床诊断协议中的合规性（SSNHL合规性从54.5%提升至83.5%），平衡准确率从42.0%提升至80.7%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在需要严格遵循协议的临床领域常产生自信但不符合协议的答案，现有方法缺乏对推理轨迹的可控干预手段。
AI.method: Answer Engineering：一种确定性运行时和创作层，在标准自回归生成过程中对可见推理轨迹施加局部规则引导干预，无需重新训练、修改模型权重或进行全局搜索。
AI.result: SSNHL合规性从54.5%提升至83.5%，传导性病例依从性从1.6%提升至77.9%，平衡准确率从42.0%提升至80.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过可审计的推理轨迹运行时控制可提升协议依从性，但存在规则覆盖、触发可靠性和诊断优先生成动力学等局限性。

title: A Reward-Petri-Net Interpretation of Temporal Behavior Trees
summary: This paper introduces an interpretation of Temporal Behavior Trees (TBTs) as Reward-Petri-Nets (RPNs) for reinforcement learning (RL). Designing reward functions for complex, long-horizon robotic tasks is notoriously difficult, especially when tasks have hierarchical structure and temporal constraints. TBTs extend conventional behavior trees (BTs) used in robotic applications by incorporating temporal properties into their leaf nodes. This allows TBTs to represents not only the behavioral task structure defined by BT operators such as Sequence, Fallback, and Parallel, but also the task's temporal constraints. In this work, the constraints are specified in the leaf nodes using Linear Temporal Logic. In order to inform RL rewards using TBTs, we provide a translation from TBT into a Petri Net (PN) and show how rewards can be automatically assigned based on the TBT's structure, resulting in a RPN. In a series of increasingly challenging environments, we demonstrate how TBT-based rewards enable learning where vanilla RL fails, improve sample efficiency, and offer flexible, intuitive control over the learning progress. We showcase the learning impact by using different reward distribution schemes and TBT structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将时间行为树(TBT)解释为奖励Petri网(RPN)用于强化学习，通过自动分配奖励信号解决具有层次结构和时间约束的复杂机器人任务学习问题。
AI.motivation: 长程机器人任务的奖励函数设计极为困难，特别是当任务具有层次结构和时间约束时，传统方法难以有效处理。
AI.method: 将时间行为树(TBT)转换为Petri网(PN)，并基于TBT结构自动分配奖励，形成奖励Petri网(RPN)；TBT叶子节点使用线性时序逻辑(LTL)指定时间约束。
AI.result: 在多个难度递增的环境中，基于TBT的奖励方法使学习成为可能（而普通RL失败），提高了样本效率，并提供了灵活直观的学习进度控制。
AI.conclusion: TBT结构可有效指导RL奖励设计，不同奖励分配方案和TBT结构对学习效果有显著影响，为复杂机器人任务提供了一种可解释、可控的奖励塑造方法。

title: CalVerT: Augmenting Agents with Calibrated Verifier Telemetry Improves Action and Learning in Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
summary: LLM agents in knowledge intensive question answering take retrieval and reasoning actions with incomplete knowledge about whether their current answer is uncertain, unsupported, or already complete. This produces two failure modes: committing to confident but unsupported answers, which hurts accuracy, and over-retrieving when the evidence in hand already suffices, resulting in wasted compute. To give agents a more complete picture of the state space they are operating in, we introduce calibrated verifier telemetry (CalVerT), which augments the agent's state with additional telemetry: a calibrated self-confidence score and a grounding verifier score. We show that CalVerT can improve agents in both training-free and training-based settings. On four QA benchmarks, we find that CalVerT raises F1 by triggering retrieval in cases where agents over-rely on parametric knowledge, while cutting redundant retrieval in cases where agents have sufficient context to answer. We show that CalVerT can augment existing QA frameworks without training. Moreover, CalVerT also improves trained systems: by simply augmenting an agent's state with telemetry, we observe improvements after reinforcement learning, as compared to an agent with identical training but no CalVerT telemetry.

AI.tldr: 提出校准验证器遥测（CalVerT）方法，通过向LLM智能体状态添加校准自信分数和基础验证器分数，减少过度检索与过早承诺错误，提升知识密集型QA任务的准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在知识密集型问答中，因无法判断当前答案是否不确定、无支撑或已完整，导致两种失败模式：基于不充分证据做出自信但错误的回答（降低准确率），以及已拥有足够证据仍过度检索（浪费计算资源）。需要更完整的智能体状态感知来缓解这些问题。
AI.method: 提出CalVerT，在智能体状态中增加两种校准遥测信号：校准的自信分数（用于评估模型自身输出置信度）和基础验证器分数（用于评估答案与上下文之间的支持关系）。该方法可应用于无训练和基于训练两种场景，通过增强强化学习中的状态表示来提升性能。
AI.result: 在四个QA基准上，CalVerT在无训练设置下提升了F1分数：在智能体过度依赖参数知识时触发检索，在已有足够上下文时减少冗余检索。在有训练设置下，仅通过向智能体状态添加遥测信号，经过强化学习后相比无CalVerT的相同训练系统表现更好。
AI.conclusion: CalVerT提供了一种轻量级、即插即用的方法，通过为智能体提供更完整的决策状态信息，同时提升了QA系统的准确性和计算效率，且适用于训练-free和训练-based两种范式。

title: PulseCX: Breaking the Closed-World Assumption in Real-Time CX
summary: Conversational AI agents in Customer Experience (CX) typically suffer from a Closed-World Constraint, ignoring high-velocity external shifts like viral trends or outages. Ad-hoc web search attempts to bridge this gap but often introduce prohibitive latency and context poisoning. We introduce PulseCX, a framework that decouples knowledge acquisition from consumption. Adopting a structure-first paradigm, PulseCX employs an asynchronous agent to linearize signals into a Decay-Aware Temporal Knowledge Graph (DA-TKG) governed by reinforcement--decay dynamics to actively manage information lifecycles. By coupling this self-evolving memory with hierarchical intent gating, PulseCX removes synchronous search bottlenecks (<10ms overhead) and drives significant gains in Intent Resolution (IRR) and Customer Satisfaction (s-CSAT) in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: PulseCX提出了一种解耦知识获取与消费的框架，通过异步智能体构建衰减感知时序知识图谱（DA-TKG）并引入层次化意图门控，在动态环境中以<10ms的开销显著提升意图解析和客户满意度。
AI.motivation: 传统对话AI受限于封闭世界约束，无法应对病毒式传播、服务中断等高频外部变化；而临时网络搜索又带来了高延迟和上下文污染问题。
AI.method: 采用结构优先范式：①异步智能体将信号线性化为衰减感知时序知识图谱（DA-TKG），通过强化-衰减动力学管理信息生命周期；②耦合自进化记忆与层次化意图门控，消除同步搜索瓶颈。
AI.result: 系统开销低于10ms，在动态环境下意图解析率（IRR）和客户满意度（s-CSAT）均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 解耦知识获取与消费的架构能有效应对动态变化，兼顾低延迟与高质量对话体验。

title: Urban Power Grid Topology and Hierarchy Identification from Open Data
summary: Understanding the complex topology and hierarchy of urban power grid is crucial for energy prognosis, power flow management, and system resilience analysis. However, detailed grid information remains largely proprietary. This creates significant barriers for research and innovation, especially when analyzing the last-mile distribution networks connecting individual buildings. This paper addresses this challenge by developing an open-data-driven framework for the complete identification of urban power grid topology, from high-voltage transmission down to individual building connections. Particularly, we fuse public infrastructure data (power-lines, substations, transformers, poles) to map the high and medium-voltage skeleton using graph-based algorithms. We then leverage geospatial machine learning on OpenStreetMap building data to group power demand clusters, and infer the physical topology of the final distribution lines linking the clustered buildings. We apply the developed framework to the district of Alna in Oslo, Norway, and we reconstruct the complete grid topology that connects 7,330 buildings and all major electricity infrastructure assets. With the research in this work, we provide a critical tool that facilitates power system analysis, e.g., power flow optimization, cascading failure simulation, and grid resilience against the penetration of distributed renewable generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于开放数据驱动的框架，能够从高压输电到单个建筑连接，完整识别城市电网拓扑结构，并在挪威奥斯陆Alna区成功重建连接7,330栋建筑的完整电网拓扑。
AI.motivation: 详细的电网信息大部分属于专有数据，限制了能源预测、潮流管理和系统韧性分析等相关研究与创新，特别是涉及连接单个建筑的"最后一公里"配电网分析。
AI.method: 融合公共基础设施数据（电力线、变电站、变压器、电线杆），利用基于图的算法绘制高、中压骨架；然后利用OpenStreetMap建筑数据的空间地理机器学习对电力需求集群进行分组，推断连接集群建筑的最后配电线物理拓扑。
AI.result: 在挪威奥斯陆Alna区成功应用该框架，重建了连接7,330栋建筑及所有主要电力基础设施资产的完整电网拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为电力系统分析（如潮流优化、级联故障仿真、分布式可再生能源渗透下的电网韧性评估）提供了关键工具。

title: When to Plan, When to Polish: Noise Level as a Granularity Axis for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Standard tokenwise diffusion LMs keep training corruption and inference commitment at token granularity throughout denoising. At high noise, this leaves scattered local fragments rather than coherent evidence, making it hard to form early coarse structure, exactly what planning-sensitive generation requires. Hierarchical planning methods add coarse stages to separate planning from wording, but they need extra planners, block latents, or two stage designs. We propose Noise Dependent Granularity Control (NDGC), a single-level diffusion method that uses the noise level as a granularity cue. NDGC aligns training exposure and inference commitment with denoising progress. High noise steps use coherent token groups to support early meaning commitment, while low noise steps return to token level refinement. This creates planning like coarse to fine denoising without an explicit planner or hierarchical architecture. Across controlled tests, ablations, and WritingPrompts, NDGC shows earlier skeleton formation, better ordered recovery, and healthier outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出噪声依赖粒度控制(NDGC)方法，通过噪声水平动态调整去噪粒度，实现从粗到细的规划式生成，无需额外规划器或层级架构。
AI.motivation: 标准token级扩散LM在高噪声阶段产生零散局部片段，难以形成早期粗略结构，不利于需要规划感知的生成任务。
AI.method: 提出NDGC方法，将噪声水平作为粒度线索：高噪声步使用连贯token组支持早期语义承诺，低噪声步回到token级精炼。
AI.result: 在受控测试、消融实验和WritingPrompts上，NDGC展现出更早的骨架形成、更有序的恢复和更健康的输出。
AI.conclusion: NDGC实现了类似规划的粗到细去噪过程，无需显式规划器或层级架构，效果优于标准方法。

title: Learning Burst-Aware Early Warning Models for Capacity Stress under AI Workload Surges in Hyperscale Data Centers
summary: The rapid growth of large-scale AI workloads, particularly Large Language Model (LLM) training and inference, is fundamentally reshaping the operational dynamics of hyperscale data centers. Unlike traditional cloud workloads, AI-driven jobs exhibit bursty, high-intensity, and rapidly shifting resource demands, often leading to sudden capacity stress that cannot be effectively handled by reactive threshold-based mechanisms. In this paper, we propose a deployment-oriented, burst-aware early warning framework for proactive capacity stress prediction under AI workload surges. We formulate the problem as a high-recall forecasting task over multivariate telemetry windows, with the explicit goal of enabling operational intervention before system degradation occurs. The proposed framework integrates workload intensity, temporal variation, and system pressure signals, and employs a lightweight tree-based learning model to capture nonlinear interactions in highly imbalanced environments. To evaluate the system under realistic conditions, we introduce an AI workload surge injection methodology that simulates burst-driven demand patterns observed in large-scale AI systems. Our XGBoost-based model achieves an ROC AUC of 0.697 and an AP of 0.670, significantly outperforming baseline methods. Under deployment-oriented threshold selection, the framework achieves a Recall of 0.914, enabling the detection of the majority of stress-prone periods with acceptable false-alarm cost. Beyond predictive performance, we show how the proposed framework can be integrated into operational control loops to support proactive actions such as workload throttling and resource scaling. Our results highlight the practical value of high-recall, learning-based early warning systems in enabling resilient and adaptive data center operations in the era of AI-driven workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向部署的、突发感知的早期预警框架，用于在AI工作负载激增下主动预测数据中心容量压力。该框架基于XGBoost模型，在高度不平衡的环境中实现了0.914的召回率，显著优于基线方法，并支持工作负载节流和资源扩展等主动干预操作。
AI.motivation: 大规模AI工作负载（尤其是LLM训练与推理）呈现出突发性、高强度和快速变化的资源需求，传统基于阈值的反应式机制无法有效应对这种突发的容量压力，迫切需要一种能够提前预警的主动式框架。
AI.method: 将问题建模为多变量遥测窗口上的高召回率预测任务，集成工作负载强度、时间变化和系统压力信号，采用轻量级树模型（XGBoost）捕获高度不平衡环境中的非线性交互，并引入AI工作负载激增注入方法模拟突发驱动需求模式。
AI.result: XGBoost模型在ROC AUC上达到0.697，AP达到0.670，在面向部署的阈值选择下召回率达到0.914，显著优于基线方法，能够检测大多数压力易发时段且误报成本可接受。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可集成到运营控制回路中支持工作负载节流和资源扩展等主动操作，展示了高召回率、基于学习的早期预警系统在AI驱动工作负载时代实现弹性自适应数据中心运营的实用价值。

title: SOHET: Sequence Of Heterogeneous Events Transformer with Self-Supervised Pre-Training
summary: Many machine learning applications rely on heterogeneous event streams to make predictions, either causally as events arrive or bidirectionally over complete sequences. We propose SOHET (Sequence Of Heterogeneous Events Transformer), a hierarchical architecture combining event-type-specific tabular encoders with temporal and type embeddings, processed by a causal or bidirectional transformer. We introduce three self-supervised pre-training objectives for the causal setting. On a proprietary large-scale real-world Booking.com fraud detection task with 17 event types, SOHET outperforms FlexTPP, NAPPT, and CIPPT by 5.8%. Pre-training yields an additional 2.6% gain and 2.4% faster convergence. On the EBES benchmark, bidirectional SOHET matches or exceeds the published best on 6 out of 8 tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SOHET分层架构，通过事件类型专用表格编码器与时间/类型嵌入结合，在欺诈检测任务上超越基线模型5.8%，预训练带来额外2.6%性能提升和2.4%更快收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理异构事件流时无法有效捕捉事件类型特异性特征与时间动态关系，需要一种既能处理因果关系又能处理双向关系的统一架构。
AI.method: 提出SOHET分层架构，结合事件类型专用表格编码器与时间和类型嵌入，采用因果或双向Transformer处理，并引入三种自监督预训练目标。
AI.result: 在Booking.com欺诈检测任务上SOHET超越FlexTPP、NAPPT和CIPPT达5.8%；预训练带来额外2.6%提升和2.4%更快收敛；在EBES基准上8个任务中6个达到或超过最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: SOHET架构能有效处理异构事件流预测，结合预训练策略可进一步提升性能与收敛速度，具有良好的通用性。

title: Test-Time Training with Next-Token Prediction
summary: Next-token prediction is the self-supervised signal that trains language models, and every observed prompt token provides the same signal at test time. We study whether this signal can define the inner-loop objective for test-time training (TTT) in pretrained long-context language models. Many TTT architectures require models to be trained with test-time adaptation in mind, limiting their direct applicability to released LLM checkpoints. While recent in-place TTT methods make fast-weight adaptation possible for pretrained LLMs without redesigning the backbone, they leave a central question unresolved: what should each test-time write store? Existing recipes train the fast weight to match a learned local value proxy but they are not directly tied to the self-supervised next-token prediction signal. We introduce Test-Time Training with Next-Token Prediction (TTT-NTP), a drop-in fast-weight adaptation method for pretrained LLMs that instead supervises updates using the model's own next contextual hidden state. This makes each local write follow the same causal computation that supports next-token prediction: the value target is a pointwise linear projection of a single next-position contextual state. On RULER Full-13 (averaged over 4k, 8k, 16k, and 32k context lengths), TTT-NTP is the only method that consistently improves the released backbone across four models spanning three families and a 0.6--8B size range: Llama-3.1-8B (+3.9), Mistral-7B-v0.3 (+3.0), and the Qwen3 series (Qwen3-4B +4.1, Qwen3-0.6B +2.9). On the real-world LongBench-v2 long-document QA benchmark, TTT-NTP improves over the base model on both Llama-3.1-8B (+5.6) and Mistral-7B-v0.3 (+3.7), while preserving commonsense and knowledge performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTT-NTP方法，利用模型自身的下一个位置隐藏状态作为监督信号，对预训练大语言模型进行测试时快速权重自适应。该方法无需重新设计骨干网络，在RULER和LongBench-v2等多个长上下文基准上，对Llama-3.1、Mistral和Qwen3系列模型均有一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时训练（TTT）方法要么需要重新设计模型架构，不适用于已发布的预训练检查点；要么虽然支持原地快速权重适配，但使用的监督信号与预训练阶段的自监督下一token预测信号脱节，缺乏理论上的一致性。
AI.method: TTT-NTP将测试时局部写入的监督信号设定为模型自身下一个位置的上下文隐藏状态，通过逐点线性投影得到值目标，使得每次局部更新都遵循与预训练相同的因果计算范式。
AI.result: 在RULER Full-13（4k/8k/16k/32k平均）上，TTT-NTP是唯一在四个模型（Llama-3.1-8B +3.9、Mistral-7B-v0.3 +3.0、Qwen3-4B +4.1、Qwen3-0.6B +2.9）上均一致提升的方法；在LongBench-v2上，Llama-3.1-8B提升+5.6，Mistral-7B-v0.3提升+3.7，且不影响常识和知识任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于下一token预测信号的测试时训练方法既能在理论上与预训练目标对齐，又能在实践上作为即插即用的适配方案，有效提升预训练长上下文语言模型的表现。

title: Trip+: Benchmarking Agents in Personalized Interactive Travel Planning
summary: Interactive travel planning has become a popular use case for language models. Agents are deployed to manage evolving preferences and unexpected disruptions over multiple turns. Such settings require models to make complex, profile-conditioned planning decisions. However, existing benchmarks often evaluate feasibility, personalization, or interaction in relatively isolated settings. We therefore introduce Trip+ to measure the ability of agents to plan travel holistically. In Trip+, given traveler profiles and dynamic interactions, agents must generate and revise minute-level itineraries. End-to-end traveler experiences are evaluated via an LLM-based simulator, enabling the assessment of subjective metrics like fatigue. Our scenarios range from simple request resolutions to complex environment-driven replanning. We evaluate 18 LMs and find a consistent gap in experiential quality. Models favor technically feasible but exhausting itineraries that diverge sharply from profiled traveler preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trip+基准测试，用于评估语言模型在交互式旅行规划中生成和修订分钟级行程的能力。通过基于LLM的模拟器评估主观体验质量，发现现有模型倾向于生成技术上可行但忽略用户偏好的疲劳行程。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试往往在相对孤立的设置中评估可行性、个性化或交互性，缺乏对旅行规划整体能力的综合评估。
AI.method: 构建Trip+基准，要求模型根据旅行者档案和动态交互生成并修订分钟级行程，使用基于LLM的模拟器评估疲劳等主观指标。
AI.result: 评估18个语言模型，发现模型在体验质量上存在一致差距，倾向于生成技术上可行但令人疲惫的行程，与旅行者偏好严重偏离。
AI.conclusion: 现有语言模型在旅行规划中缺乏对用户体验质量的关注，需要改进以更好地平衡可行性与个性化偏好。

title: Predictive Repair Management Using a Multi-Head Attention Transformer and Online Learning
summary: Accurate prediction of repair duration is an important challenge in product maintenance due to its implications for resource allocation, customer satisfaction, and operational performance. This study aims to develop a deep learning framework to help fleet repair shops accurately categorize repair time given product historical data. The study uses an automobile repair and maintenance dataset and creates an end-to-end predictive framework by employing a multi-head attention network designed for tabular data. The developed framework combines categorical information, transformed through embeddings and attention mechanisms, with numerical historical data to facilitate integration and learning from diverse data features. A weighted loss function is introduced to overcome class imbalance issues in large datasets. Moreover, an online learning strategy is used for continuous incremental model updates to maintain predictive accuracy in evolving operational environments. Our empirical findings demonstrate that the multi-head attention mechanism extracts meaningful interactions between vehicle identifiers and repair types compared to a feed-forward neural network and a random forest model. Also, combining historical maintenance data with an online learning strategy facilitates real-time adjustments to changing patterns and increases the model's predictive performance on new data. The model is tested on real-world repair data spanning 2013 to 2020 and achieves an accuracy of 78%, with attention weight analyses illustrating feature interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于多头注意力网络的深度学习框架，利用汽车维修历史数据预测维修时长，结合嵌入表示、加权损失函数和在线学习策略，在实际数据集上达到78%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 在产品维护中，准确预测维修时长对资源分配、客户满意度和运营绩效至关重要，但现有方法在处理大规模、类别不平衡的表格数据时存在局限。
AI.method: 使用多头注意力网络处理表格数据，通过嵌入层和注意力机制融合类别特征与数值历史数据；引入加权损失函数解决类别不平衡问题；采用在线学习策略实现模型的持续增量更新。
AI.result: 在2013-2020年的真实汽车维修数据集上达到78%的预测准确率，相比前馈神经网络和随机森林模型，多头注意力机制能更好地提取车辆标识与维修类型之间的交互特征。
AI.conclusion: 结合历史维护数据与在线学习策略能够实现实时模式调整，提升模型在新数据上的预测性能；注意力权重分析有效揭示了特征间的交互关系。

title: Fixed RAG Compression Collapses Measured Reader Scaling
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) compression papers often evaluate a compressor on one to three readers and treat the compressed evidence layer as evaluation-neutral. We show this assumption is false: fixed compression can raise average accuracy while hiding reader upgrades and reversing model rankings. Across 20 readers and ten domain-method settings over four QA benchmarks and one summarization benchmark, compression gain decreases with reader baseline (nine of ten settings significant, p < 0.05). Generic summarization flips 31% of pairwise model rankings on LongMemEval-S, and a fixed HotpotQA compressor hides 80% of the raw upgrade from Qwen 7B to GPT-4.1-mini. Two opposing forces explain this paradox: compression rescues weak readers by removing noise they cannot filter, and harms strong readers by dropping details they would have used. The pattern appears across structured compilation, generic summarization, three trained compressor families, query-focused summarization, and an external audit of nine published compression papers. We release ragscale, a toolkit built on 177,000 row-level compression transitions, so any compression paper can audit reader scaling with three readers in one day.

AI.tldr: RAG压缩效果并非评价中性：固定压缩会掩盖读者能力差异并颠倒模型排名，原因在于压缩对弱读者去噪有利、对强读者删细节有害。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG压缩论文通常只用1-3个读者进行评测，并默认压缩后的证据层对评价是中性的，这一假设可能不成立。
AI.method: 在4个QA基准和1个摘要基准上，使用20个读者、10个领域-方法设置，分析固定压缩对不同读者能力的影响；同时审计了9篇已发表压缩论文。
AI.result: 压缩收益随读者基线能力提升而下降（9/10设置显著）；通用摘要导致LongMemEval-S上31%的模型排名翻转；固定压缩掩盖了Qwen 7B到GPT-4.1-mini的80%原始提升。
AI.conclusion: 压缩并非评价中性，存在“弱读者受益、强读者受损”的悖论，未来压缩论文应审计读者扩展效应。团队发布ragscale工具包以支持快速审计。

title: Whistleblowing and the machine -- towards a considered position
comment: Presented at AAMAS-26 Workshop on Rebellion and Disobedience in AI, see https://sites.google.com/view/rad-ai/rad-ai/cfp?authuser=0
summary: Artificial intelligent agents and autonomous systems are embedded in our environments. They are both a commercial product and a personal tool that generates a lot of data and can draw conclusions from it: machines generate and keep secrets. But should machines protect all secrets? It has been shown that artificial agents are able to whistleblow and it has been argued that digital multi-agent environments should allow for agents in them to whistleblow. We argue that machine whistleblowing must be normative and principled and routed in the existing understanding of whistleblowing as an important rule-breaking mechanism in society. We also argue that there is a need for government regulators to formulate an informed stance on both what machines should be allowed to whistleblow on and how to legally protect those who develop whistleblowing machines

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能代理的“机器告密”问题，主张机器告密应基于现有社会告密理论，具备规范性和原则性，并呼吁政府监管机构制定相关政策，明确机器可告密的内容及对开发者的法律保护。
AI.motivation: 人工智能代理和自主系统已深度嵌入环境，既能生成大量数据也能从中得出结论，即机器可以“拥有秘密”。已有研究显示AI代理能够进行告密行为，数字多智能体环境也应允许告密。因此需要探讨如何规范机器告密行为。
AI.method: 基于现有社会告密理论进行规范性论证，分析机器告密应遵循的原则，并提出政策建议。
AI.result: 提出机器告密必须是有原则的、规范性的，并植根于社会对告密作为重要规则突破机制的理解；同时指出需要政府监管机构制定明确立场。
AI.conclusion: 机器告密应被规范化，政府需要明确机器可告密的内容范围以及对告密机器开发者的法律保护措施。

title: Enhancing Creativity in 3D Generative Design via a TRIZ-Inspired Text-to-CAD Framework
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in supporting engineering design tasks, including computer-aided design (CAD) automation. However, most existing LLM-based 3D CAD generation approaches primarily focus on geometric precision and instruction-following performance, often overlooking the fundamental aspect of creative design exploration. This study presents a TRIZ-inspired text-to-CAD framework that leverages LLMs to generate high-quality, editable CAD models while systematically exploring creative design alternatives. The framework integrates the Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ)-embedding deep human insights from extensive patent records-into LLM prompting strategies, enabling autonomous generation of innovative CAD variants that address technical contradictions. Through a comprehensive three-stage pipeline of design generation, enhancement, and optimization, the framework produces structurally diverse CAD models from well-crafted prompts. The present study implements and evaluates the first two stages, while positioning the design optimization stage as future work. A product design case study (chair) demonstrates that the TRIZ-inspired text-to-CAD framework generates multiple creative design alternatives by systematically applying TRIZ inventive principles such as segmentation, anti-weight, dynamics, and composite materials, achieving 4.0-14.7% mass reduction across all enhanced designs while maintaining structural integrity. The key findings suggest that integrating systematic innovation methodologies with LLM-based 3D CAD generation bridges the gap between precision-focused synthesis and creativity-focused exploration, advancing toward autonomous design systems where AI makes design decisions independently, supporting human decision-making in human-AI collaborative design for engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受TRIZ启发的文本到CAD框架，利用大语言模型生成可编辑的3D CAD模型，在保证几何精度的同时系统性地探索创新设计方案。以椅子设计为例，该方法通过应用TRIZ发明原理，实现了4.0-14.7%的质量减轻，同时保持结构完整性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的3D CAD生成方法主要关注几何精度和指令遵循能力，忽略了创造性设计探索这一基本方面。
AI.method: 将TRIZ（发明问题解决理论）嵌入LLM提示策略，通过设计生成、增强和优化三阶段管道，自主生成解决技术矛盾的创新CAD变体。
AI.result: 椅子设计案例显示，通过应用分割、反重量、动力学和复合材料等TRIZ原理，所有增强设计实现了4.0-14.7%的质量减轻，同时保持结构完整性。
AI.conclusion: 将系统性创新方法与基于LLM的3D CAD生成相结合，弥合了精确性合成与创意性探索之间的差距，推动AI自主设计系统的发展。

title: Inverse Turing Bench: Evaluating Language Models as Judges of Human vs. AI Dialogue
summary: As AI systems integrate into online spaces, differentiating them from humans in conversations is increasingly important. We present Inverse Turing Bench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs and other models on their ability to differentiate humans and AI in multi-turn text. The benchmark provides a collection of paired dialogue transcripts, wherein one dialogue is between two humans and the other is between a human and an AI. The task is to correctly identify which dialogue is human-only vs. human-AI. We evaluated a preliminary set of models against this benchmark, and found that GPTZero, Claude Opus-4.6, and GPT-5.5 achieve the highest accuracy: 89.41%, 77.92%, and 75.94% respectively. Our results suggest that statistical approaches to detection have semantic blind spots, but semantic approaches are susceptible to persona-prompting. Our work speaks to the Inverse Turing Test as a probe of LLM theory of mind, and motivates human-AI differentiation as a critical capability for AI systems. Our live benchmark can be found at https://huggingface.co/spaces/roc-hci/Inverse-Turing-Bench-Leaderboard (anonymity preserved).

AI.tldr: 提出了Inverse Turing Bench评估基准，用于测试模型区分人类与AI对话的能力。实验发现GPTZero、Claude Opus-4.6和GPT-5.5准确率最高，但统计方法和语义方法各有盲点。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统融入在线空间，区分人类与AI的对话变得越来越重要，但目前缺乏针对多轮对话中人类-AI区分能力的标准化评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含成对对话转录的基准测试集（人类-人类对话 vs 人类-AI对话），要求模型正确识别哪段对话是纯人类对话、哪段是人机混合对话。
AI.result: GPTZero（89.41%）、Claude Opus-4.6（77.92%）和GPT-5.5（75.94%）取得了最高准确率；统计方法存在语义盲点，语义方法则易受角色提示攻击。
AI.conclusion: 该工作可作为逆图灵测试探测LLM心智理论的工具，并推动人类-AI区分能力作为AI系统的一项关键能力。

title: ARCO: Adaptive Rubric with Co-Evolution for Multi-Step LLM-Based Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning for multi-step LLM agents often relies on scalar rewards that indicate success but cannot explain why a trajectory is good or bad. Rubric-based rewards improve interpretability through natural-language criteria, but existing methods score at the trajectory level and freeze the scorer behind a closed-source judge, leaving step-level credit assignment unresolved and the judge itself static. We propose ARCO (Adaptive Rubric CO-evolution), a rubric framework in which a same-scale model $μ$ shares a backbone with two heads: a generation head that produces per-step criteria, and a score head that predicts rubric-conditioned step-level rewards. A trajectory decomposition constraint ties the sum of step rewards to the terminal outcome, enabling credit assignment without step-level labels, while $μ$ and the policy $π$ are jointly updated on on-policy data so that the rubric content and the scoring function co-evolve at the parameter level. Across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue with two open-source backbones, ARCO improves the best EM in every setting over strong outcome-, rubric-, and process-reward baselines, and analyses show that its rubrics are step-specific, robust to design choices, and useful for diagnosing agent behavior. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/zihangtian/ARCO.

AI.tldr: ARCO提出了一种自适应评分规则协同进化框架，让同规模模型同时生成步骤级标准和预测步骤级奖励，并通过轨迹分解约束实现无需步骤标签的信用分配，显著提升了多步LLM智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法对多步LLM智能体使用标量奖励，无法解释轨迹好坏的原因。基于评分规则的奖励虽引入可解释性，但现有方法仅在轨迹级别评分且使用固定闭源裁判，无法解决步骤级信用分配问题，裁判本身也缺乏适应性。
AI.method: ARCO框架中，同一尺度模型μ共享一个骨干网络与两个头部：生成头产生每步标准，评分头预测基于规则的步骤级奖励。通过轨迹分解约束（步骤奖励之和等于终端结果）实现无需步骤标签的信用分配，同时μ与策略π在策略数据上联合更新，使评分规则内容和评分函数在参数层面协同进化。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue三个数据集上使用两个开源骨干模型，ARCO在所有设置下均优于强基线（结果级、评分规则级和过程奖励基线），取得了最佳EM分数。分析表明其评分规则具有步骤特异性、对设计选择鲁棒，并能用于诊断智能体行为。
AI.conclusion: ARCO通过自适应协同进化的评分规则框架，有效解决了多步LLM智能体的步骤级信用分配问题，提升了性能与可解释性，且开源了代码和数据。

title: Unsupervised Disentanglement Without Compromises : How Functional Orthogonality Enforces Identifiability
summary: This paper explores unsupervised disentangled representation learning from a functional perspective. We define latent concepts as factors that influence observations through locally orthogonal directions, formalized as an orthogonality constraint on the Jacobian of the generative mapping. We prove that this condition yields identifiability of general nonlinear generative models, without requiring statistical independence or causal assumptions, provided the latent domain admits all combinations of factor values. Experiments with orthogonality-regularized normalizing flows empirically confirm the theory, demonstrate reliable recovery of ground-truth factors, and shed light on the success of VAEs. These findings challenge the prevailing impossibility claims for unsupervised disentanglement and provide a principled alternative foundation.

AI.tldr: 本文从函数视角探索无监督解耦表示学习，提出通过生成映射的雅可比矩阵正交约束实现潜在概念的可识别性，实验验证了该方法在归一化流中的有效性，挑战了无监督解耦不可能性的主流观点。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督解耦学习被认为存在理论上的不可能性（如Locatello等人的结论），作者希望从函数视角出发，通过施加局部正交性约束来打破这一限制，为无监督解耦提供新的理论依据。
AI.method: 将潜在概念定义为通过局部正交方向影响观测的因素，形式化为生成映射雅可比矩阵的正交性约束；在不需要统计独立性或因果假设的条件下，证明该约束能使一般非线性生成模型达到可识别性；在归一化流中引入正交性正则化进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论证明了正交性约束下的非线性生成模型是可识别的；实验上，正交正则化的归一化流能够可靠恢复真实潜在因子；该框架还能解释VAE在解耦学习中的部分成功机制。
AI.conclusion: 挑战了无监督解耦不可能性的流行论断，提供了一个有原则的替代理论框架，为后续无监督解耦表示学习提供了新的方向。

title: Keyless Attention: Value-Space Routing and Value-Only Caching for Efficient Transformers
summary: We propose Keyless Attention, an attention mechanism that eliminates the key projection entirely, operating over queries and values only. This yields a Value-Only Cache that reduces KV cache memory and access overhead by exactly 50% over standard attention, while matching or exceeding standard attention's decode throughput. Beyond efficiency, we introduce Depth-$m$ Attention Factorization: standard attention computes a depth-2 factorization of the attention bilinear form, while Keyless Attention realizes a depth-$m$ instance of this family. At m=3, Keyless Attention matches the projection matrix count of standard attention via a value-space routing matrix that replaces the key projection and introduces a coupling between routing and retrieval. Experiments across five models and four architectures (GPT-2 280M, GPT-2 557M, Pythia 410M, Qwen2 1.5B, and Llama 3.2 1B) show that Keyless Attention matches or outperforms standard QKV attention on perplexity in 4 out of 5 models. On downstream zero-shot evaluation (GPT-2 557M), Keyless Attention outperforms on 4 out of 5 commonsense reasoning benchmarks, while achieving 50% KV cache reduction throughout.

AI.tldr: 提出Keyless Attention，去除Key投影，仅保留Query和Value，将KV缓存减少50%，同时性能匹配或超越标准注意力机制。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力机制中的KV缓存占用大量内存和带宽，成为大模型推理的瓶颈。本文旨在通过消除Key投影来减少KV缓存开销，同时保持模型性能。
AI.method: 提出Keyless Attention，仅使用Query和Value进行计算，消除Key投影。引入Depth-m注意力因子分解框架，标准注意力是depth-2特例，Keyless Attention实现了depth-m实例（m=3），通过值空间路由矩阵替代Key投影，耦合路由与检索。
AI.result: 在5个模型（GPT-2 280M/557M、Pythia 410M、Qwen2 1.5B、Llama 3.2 1B）上，4/5的模型困惑度匹配或超越标准注意力。GPT-2 557M在5个常识推理基准中4个超越标准注意力。KV缓存减少50%。
AI.conclusion: Keyless Attention能有效消除Key投影，在减少50% KV缓存的同时保持甚至提升模型性能，为高效注意力机制设计提供了新方向。

title: Towards Dys-XAI: Influence-Based Explanations for Dysarthria Severity Assessment
summary: Dysarthria severity assessment is essential for therapy planning and longitudinal monitoring, yet manual perceptual rating is time-consuming and variable across clinicians. Although deep learning models achieve strong performance, their black-box nature limits clinical adoption. Existing speech explainability methods typically provide acoustic feature importance scores that are difficult for end-users to interpret. We propose an influence-based, instance-level explainability framework that explains each decision through supportive and competing training samples. Using gradient-based influence approximations, we compute per-utterance influence scores to identify supportive and competing training samples for each prediction. Controlled deletion experiments from 5 to 20 percent validate the explanations, showing that removing highly influential samples systematically shifts predictions. This approach provides auditable explanations by linking decisions to perceptible reference cases.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于影响力的实例级可解释性框架，通过支持性和竞争性训练样本来解释构音障碍严重程度评估模型的决策，并验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 构音障碍严重程度评估对治疗规划和长期监测至关重要，但人工评估耗时且存在评分者间差异；现有深度模型虽性能优异但缺乏可解释性，限制了临床采用。
AI.method: 利用基于梯度的影响力近似方法，计算每个语音片段的贡献分数，识别对预测起支持性和竞争性的训练样本；通过从5%到20%的受控删除实验验证解释质量。
AI.result: 受控删除实验表明，移除高影响力样本会系统性地改变预测结果，验证了所提解释方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将模型决策链接到可感知的参考病例，提供了可审计的解释，有望推动深度学习在临床构音障碍评估中的应用。

title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs. However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. The second, action chunk consistency (ACC), exploits the temporal overlap induced by receding-horizon control and detects failures when consecutive action chunks become inconsistent. To capture the trade-off between detection accuracy and detection latency, we introduce AUCPDT, a threshold-independent metric that jointly evaluates precision, recall, and detection time. Through extensive real-world and simulation experiments, we demonstrate that LLMD and ACC capture complementary failure modes whose combination enables reliable and early failure detection across diverse tasks, frequently outperforming significantly more expensive baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 提出VLA-FAIL框架，结合两种轻量级故障检测器（LLMD和ACC），无需故障数据即可高效检测VLA模型在机器人操作中的运行时故障。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在分布外场景中行为不可预测，现有故障检测方法计算开销大、依赖架构假设或需要故障数据，缺乏轻量且广泛适用的方案。
AI.method: 提出两种检测器：1) 最后一层马氏距离(LLMD)，通过测量最后一层特征与训练数据的token级偏差检测分布外状态；2) 动作块一致性(ACC)，利用退步水平控制的时间重叠检测动作块间不一致。并引入AUCPDT指标联合评估精度、召回率和检测时间。
AI.result: 在真实世界和仿真实验中，LLMD和ACC能捕获互补的故障模式，组合后实现可靠且早期的故障检测，在多任务上优于更昂贵的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VLA-FAIL是一种轻量、无需故障数据、广泛适用的VLA运行时故障检测框架，能有效提升VLA的安全部署能力。

title: TALAS: Teacher-Anchored Layer Alignment with Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Embedding Distillation
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) has established itself as a pivotal technique for compressing large pre-trained language models. However, existing methods that force a student to strictly mimic the teacher's sentence embeddings or internal features often incur prohibitive computational costs and yield suboptimal performance due to the inherent capacity gap. To address these challenges, we propose TALAS (Teacher-Anchored Layer Alignment with Sharpness-aware minimization), a unified framework that synergizes hierarchical (multi-layer) alignment with robust optimization. First, we introduce a Teacher-Anchored mechanism that selectively distills final sentence embeddings only into the student's upper layers, thereby reducing overhead while respecting capacity constraints. Second, we bridge the semantic gap in lower layers via Layer-Aligned Self-Distillation, which propagates knowledge top-down using internal geometric relational constraints in the embedding space. Finally, to prevent the student from memorizing point-wise teacher noise, we integrate Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization (ASAM) into the training objective, guiding the model towards flat minima for enhanced generalization. Empirical results on standard sentence embedding benchmarks demonstrate that TALAS consistently outperforms strong distillation baselines while achieving superior training efficiency in terms of computational cost and memory footprint.

AI.tldr: TALAS提出了一种结合层次化对齐和锐度感知最小化的知识蒸馏框架，通过教师锚定机制、层对齐自蒸馏和自适应锐度感知优化，在降低计算成本的同时提升句子嵌入性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法强制学生模型严格模仿教师模型的句子嵌入或内部特征，存在计算成本高、性能次优的问题，主要原因在于师生模型之间存在固有的能力差距。
AI.method: 1) 教师锚定机制：仅将教师的最终句子嵌入选择性蒸馏到学生的上层，减少开销；2) 层对齐自蒸馏：在下层通过内部几何关系约束实现自上而下的知识传播；3) 自适应锐度感知最小化：引导模型收敛到平坦极小值，防止记忆教师噪声，提升泛化能力。
AI.result: 在标准句子嵌入基准测试上，TALAS持续优于强蒸馏基线方法，同时在计算成本和内存占用方面实现了更高的训练效率。
AI.conclusion: TALAS通过层级对齐与鲁棒优化的统一框架，有效解决了师生能力差距带来的性能瓶颈，是一种高效且性能优越的知识蒸馏方案。

title: Social World Model for Lifelong Social Intelligence
summary:
Social intelligence is a core competency for language agents, yet current research primarily focuses on static capability evaluation rather than how these skills are continuously shaped and accumulated. This gap calls for a shift toward sustainable learning paradigms. Currently, two methodological pain points exist: social interaction trajectories lack unified structured representations to form iterable learning signals, and capability improvement and retention are typically studied in isolation, hindering the assessment of continuous evolution.
  To bridge this gap, we propose the Social World Model. We decompose social interaction into five dimensions (scene setting, observation, mental state, action, and dialogue) to build a closed-loop learning framework. In this setup, agents collect interaction experiences, convert them into preference signals for model updating, and redeploy the updated policy for continued learning. Additionally, we provide a reusable data synthesis mechanism and a lifelong learning benchmark, transforming social capabilities from an "object of evaluation" into an "object of sustainable training".
  Validating our framework on the ASCENT-Bench, the interactively trained Qwen2.5-7B model outperforms its baseline across all five core metrics. Notably, it matches the closed-source Gemini 3 Flash in completion rate, exceeds it in pass rate, and achieves zero forgetting across three difficulty levels. Unlike prior works that merely report static comparisons or capability decay, this end-to-end approach provides a trainable, verifiable, and retainable pathway, demonstrating that small open-source models can sustainably acquire competitive social coordination capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Social World Model，将社交互动分解为五个维度构建闭环学习框架，使小规模开源模型通过可持续训练获得竞争力的社交协调能力，并在ASCENT-Bench上超越了基线模型，实现了零遗忘。
AI.motivation: 当前研究聚焦静态能力评估，缺乏可持续学习范式；社交交互轨迹缺乏统一结构化表示，能力提升与保留被孤立研究。
AI.method: Social World Model将社交互动分解为场景设置、观察、心理状态、行动和对话五个维度，构建闭环学习框架；提供可复用的数据合成机制和终身学习基准。
AI.result: 在ASCENT-Bench上，交互训练的Qwen2.5-7B在五个核心指标上均超越基线，完成率匹配Gemini 3 Flash，通过率超越该闭源模型，且在所有难度级别上实现零遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了可训练、可验证、可保留的路径，证明小规模开源模型可以通过可持续训练获得有竞争力的社交协调能力。

title: Atomistic Language Models Understand and Generate Materials
summary: Atomistic structure and natural language have long been modeled separately, with language models either calling atomistic models as tools or being fine-tuned on lossy textual encodings that discard atomistic information. We introduce Atomistic Language Models (ALMs) to pursue native multimodality, in which a single language backbone understands atomistic structures, generates materials from natural language, and optimizes crystal structures as instructed by text. By unifying a pretrained atomistic encoder, large language model, and denoising diffusion model through purely continuous projectors and staged training, ALMs achieve state-of-the-art results on crystal structure prediction and de novo generation.
