We evaluate VADAOrchestra on real-world financial use cases, demonstrating faithfulness, scalability, and explainability compared to standard agentic architectures.

AI.tldr: VADAOrchestra是一个神经符号框架，结合LLM的灵活性与Datalog+/-的严谨推理，通过混合编排实现复杂工作流的可审计、可扩展和可解释决策。
AI.motivation: 传统BPM系统缺乏运行时适应性，而纯LLM代理系统不透明、不可靠且可扩展性差，两者互补但未有效结合。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：LLM编排器增量式规划工作流，将其编码为Datalog+/-逻辑程序，由符号引擎执行推理，实现高层编排与符号推理的解耦。
AI.result: 在真实金融用例上验证了该方法在忠实度、可扩展性和可解释性方面优于标准代理架构。
AI.conclusion: VADAOrchestra有效融合了符号系统的严谨性与LLM的灵活性，提供了可验证的推理轨迹，解决了可审计性和大规模数据推理的挑战。

title: UniRank: Unified Rank Allocation for Low-Rank LLM Compression
summary: Low-rank decomposition serves as a promising compression paradigm for large language models, however, rank allocation remains challenging: manual rules lack generalizability, and learning-based approaches incur heavy computational overhead. To address these issues, we formulate global low-rank allocation as a sorting-and-truncation pipeline, and score each singular component via dual criteria: \textbf{Local} singular energy ratio that quantifies the intrinsic importance within the decomposed parameter matrix and \textbf{Global} functional importance (measured by input-output cosine similarity) that evaluates the functional significance of decomposed modules. We verify the strong correlation between high input-output cosine similarity and low effective rank through geometric interpretation and experimental validation. Furthermore, we propose rank-preserving fine-tuning, which performs direct LoRA tuning on decomposed weights and avoids extra information loss caused by re-truncation in conventional merging pipelines. Empirical results confirm that our method delivers sustained performance enhancements when combined with models featuring distinct decomposition schemes, model sizes and architectural designs, e.g. in one-shot compression without further fine-tuning, our method reduces perplexity by up to 50\% compared with uniform and heuristic allocation baselines. Code will be available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于排序-截断的全局低秩分配方法，通过局部奇异能量比和全局功能重要性（输入-输出余弦相似度）双重标准对奇异组件评分，并引入保秩微调以避免信息损失，在多种模型上取得显著压缩效果。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩分解方法中，秩的分配要么依赖缺乏泛化能力的手工规则，要么采用计算开销大的学习方法，缺乏高效且通用的全局低秩分配方案。
AI.method: 提出排序-截断流水线，利用局部奇异能量比（衡量参数矩阵内部重要性）和全局功能重要性（输入-输出余弦相似度，衡量分解模块功能重要性）双重标准评分；同时提出保秩微调，在分解权重上直接进行LoRA调优，避免传统合并流程中重新截断导致的信息损失。
AI.result: 在无需微调的一次性压缩中，相比均匀分配和启发式分配基线，困惑度降低高达50%；结合不同分解方案、模型规模和架构均能带来持续性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证了高输入-输出余弦相似度与低有效秩之间的强相关性，所提方法为LLM低秩压缩提供了一种高效、通用且性能优越的解决方案。

title: Sub-Billion, Super-Frontier: Small Language Models Rival Zero-Shot Frontier LLMs on General and Literary Relation Extraction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong relation extraction (RE), but their computational demands and reliance on proprietary APIs limit deployment in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive settings. We investigate how far small language models (SLMs) can close this gap across general-domain and literary text. We evaluate five models from 360M to 3B parameters under three domain-composition regimes and two prompt-conditioned tuning styles (30 configurations), comparing them with zero-shot frontier LLMs and a discriminative RoBERTa baseline. Across nine benchmarks, the best sub-billion model, Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned on pooled general-domain data, achieves a general-domain positive-class micro-F1 of 0.83, versus 0.69 for GPT-5.4 and 0.66 for Claude Sonnet 4.6 evaluated zero-shot. This does not imply that SLMs are intrinsically stronger; rather, targeted task adaptation enables 4-bit models deployable on a single consumer GPU to outperform general-purpose frontier systems under this protocol. An in-domain RoBERTa baseline also exceeds both frontier models, indicating that the gain stems from task adaptation rather than generative decoding. On literary RE, tuned SLMs reach 0.92 on the human-annotated Biographical benchmark versus 0.83 for GPT-5.4, and 0.833 versus 0.578 on the two-benchmark literary average. A targeted domain-adaptive pretraining case study yields no practically meaningful gain over supervised fine-tuning, while the cleanest within-family scale comparison shows only marginal improvement. These results show that, when task-specific data are available, compact task-adapted models can provide accurate, private, and hardware-efficient RE.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究小语言模型（SLMs）在关系抽取任务上的表现，发现经过微调的小模型（如Qwen2.5-0.5B）在通用领域和文学领域上均可超越零样本的GPT-5.4等大模型，强调了任务适配比模型规模更重要。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在关系抽取上性能优异，但其高昂的计算成本和依赖商业API限制了在资源受限或隐私敏感场景下的部署。本文旨在探索小语言模型能否通过任务适配缩小与大模型的性能差距。
AI.method: 选取5个参数量从360M到3B的小模型，在3种领域组合和2种提示调优风格下（共30种配置）进行实验；对比零样本前沿LLM（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6）和判别式RoBERTa基线；涵盖9个基准数据集，并进行了领域自适应预训练案例研究。
AI.result: 最佳子十亿模型Qwen2.5-0.5B在通用领域上微F1达0.83，超过GPT-5.4（0.69）和Claude（0.66）；文学领域微调小模型达0.92（GPT-5.4为0.83）。领域自适应预训练相比监督微调无实际增益，同族模型规模对比仅有边际提升。
AI.conclusion: 在有任务特定数据的情况下，紧凑的任务适配小模型能够提供准确、隐私保护且硬件高效的关系抽取方案，无需依赖大规模模型或商业API。

title: SCOPE: Evolving Symbolic World for Planning in Open-Ended Environments
summary: Recent works have explored integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with classical planners that rely on symbolic representations of planning problems to generate long-horizon plans for complex embodied tasks. However, in open-ended environments, these symbolic representations obtained from perception are often incomplete, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, a self-adaptive symbolic planning framework that supports refining action plans and evolving the symbolic world, i.e., the symbolic representations of open-ended environments. SCOPE comprises two synergistic modules: a Symbolic Execution Simulator (SESim) that conducts symbolic validation and real execution of action plans, leveraging the feedback to refine the plans and evolve the symbolic world; and a Self-Adaptive Symbolic Memory (SASMem) that further distills feedback into evolving symbolic knowledge to enhance long-horizon planning and modeling of the symbolic world. Experiments in open-ended environments show that SCOPE significantly improves the completeness of the symbolic world, the success rate of plans under environment perturbations, and cross-task grounding and adaptability across diverse embodied scenarios.

AI.tldr: SCOPE是一个自适应符号规划框架，通过符号执行模拟器和自适应符号记忆模块，在开放环境中不断优化行动计划和演化符号世界表征，显著提升了符号世界的完整性和规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有将视觉-语言模型与经典规划器结合的方法中，从感知获得的符号表征在开放环境中往往不完整，导致规划性能次优。
AI.method: 提出SCOPE框架，包含两个协同模块：1) 符号执行模拟器(SESim)，进行符号验证和真实执行，利用反馈优化计划和演化符号世界；2) 自适应符号记忆(SASMem)，蒸馏反馈为演化符号知识，增强长程规划能力。
AI.result: 在开放环境实验中，SCOPE显著提升了符号世界的完整性、环境扰动下的规划成功率，以及跨任务泛化能力和适应性。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE通过自我适应的符号世界演化机制，有效解决了开放环境中符号表征不完整的问题，为复杂具身任务的长程规划提供了新思路。

title: WiSP: A Working-Set View of Mixture-of-Experts Serving on Extremely Low-Resource Hardware
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Preprint, work in progress
summary: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models place most of their parameters in expert layers, yet only a small fraction of those experts are used for any token. The unused weights must still be stored where the GPU can reach them. On commodity GPUs the common fix is layer-level CPU offloading, which keeps memory low but streams all of a layer's experts across PCIe on every forward pass, losing much of MoE's sparsity benefit. We cast low-resource MoE serving as a working-set management problem on the GPU: routed expert weights and the key-value (KV) cache are two streams of memory demand competing for limited VRAM. We realize this in WiSP (Working-Set Paging), a routing-aware expert pager that plugs into an unmodified serving engine with byte-identical outputs. Keeping resident only the experts a workload reuses, WiSP reaches up to 1.95x the decode throughput of static offload at the same memory budget when the model does not fit. We also find that prefetching experts from predicted routing helps little in single-stream decode: the bottleneck is PCIe bandwidth, not prediction accuracy. This shifts the question from prefetching to allocation: how should VRAM be split between experts and the KV cache? We answer with MV-WSA (Marginal-Value Working-Set Allocation), which equalizes marginal latency benefit per byte subject to a KV admission floor. MV-WSA runs either as an offline configurator or as an online controller that resizes both pools while serving. In real serving the offline configurator is the only policy we test that does well on both prefill and decode; in trace-driven simulation it stays within a few percent of a per-workflow oracle while fixed splits are about 20% worse. The online controller adds a further 1.20x without changing model outputs.

AI.tldr: WiSP是一种路由感知的专家分页系统，通过将MoE模型中的专家权重和KV缓存视为GPU上的内存工作集进行管理，在低资源环境下实现高效服务。它结合MV-WSA分配策略，在固定内存预算下提升解码吞吐量达1.95倍，并通过边际延迟收益均衡分配VRAM资源。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE模型在低资源GPU上采用层级CPU卸载，虽然降低内存但每层所有专家都要通过PCIe传输，无法利用MoE的稀疏性优势。作者将问题重新定义为GPU上专家权重与KV缓存两个工作集的内存竞争问题。
AI.method: 提出WiSP（工作集分页）系统：路由感知的专家分页器，可无缝接入未修改的服务引擎，保持字节级输出一致性。仅保留工作负载重复使用的专家权重。并提出MV-WSA（边际价值工作集分配）：通过均衡每字节的边际延迟收益来决定VRAM如何在专家和KV缓存之间分配，并设有KV准入下限。
AI.result: WiSP在相同内存预算下达到静态卸载1.95倍的解码吞吐量。MV-WSA离线配置器在预填充和解码阶段均表现优异，跟踪驱动模拟中比固定分割方案好约20%，接近每工作流最优解。在线控制器额外提升1.2倍且不改变模型输出。
AI.conclusion: 低资源MoE服务的关键瓶颈是PCIe带宽而非路由预测精度，因此问题应从专家预取转向VRAM分配策略。MV-WSA通过边际收益分析实现了更优的显存资源划分。

title: Orthogonal Representation Editing: Decoupling Semantic Entanglement in Batch Knowledge Editing of LLMs
summary: Knowledge editing aims to efficiently update factual information in Large Language Models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, existing methods still suffer from performance degradation in batch knowledge editing. We identify that semantic representation entanglement, such as overlapping concepts and shared syntactic patterns, accumulates interference in the representation space and reduces editing precision. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we propose Orthogonal Representation Editing (ORE), which performs edits in the hidden representation space of LLMs by constructing a general semantic subspace and enforcing orthogonal constraints on edit vectors, effectively decoupling semantic entanglement. Furthermore, we introduce a gated non-linear representation head to enable adaptive learning of editing locations and precise control over knowledge injection. Extensive experiments show that ORE outperforms existing methods and achieves superior performance in cross-lingual knowledge editing scenarios. We release our code at https://github.com/YVVH/ORE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正交表示编辑（ORE）方法，通过在LLM的隐藏表示空间中构建通用语义子空间并对编辑向量施加正交约束，有效解耦语义纠缠，解决批量知识编辑中的性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑方法在批量编辑时存在性能下降问题，原因是语义表示纠缠（如概念重叠、共享句法模式）在表示空间中积累干扰，降低了编辑精度。
AI.method: 提出正交表示编辑（ORE）：1）在LLM隐藏表示空间中构建通用语义子空间；2）对编辑向量施加正交约束以解耦语义纠缠；3）引入门控非线性表示头，自适应学习编辑位置并精确控制知识注入。
AI.result: 实验表明ORE在批量知识编辑和跨语言知识编辑场景中均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ORE通过正交约束有效解耦语义纠缠，显著提升了批量知识编辑的性能，并在跨语言场景下也表现出色。

title: Deep Learning-Based Sign Language Recognition from Videos and Cross-Lingual Translation to Indian Vernaculars
summary: Sign language is a primary mode of communication for the global deaf and hard-of-hearing community, yet automated tools that recognize sign gestures from video and translate them into natural language text remain limited, particularly for low-resource Indian languages. We present a two-stage deep learning pipeline that (i) classifies short sign language video clips into English word labels using a fine-tuned VideoMAE video transformer, and (ii) translates the predicted English label into Hindi, Telugu, and Bengali using Meta AI's No Language Left Behind (NLLB-200) multilingual translation model. The classification model is fine-tuned on a 13-class subset of the AI4Bharat Indian Sign Language video corpus from IIT Madras, processing 16-frame clips sampled uniformly from each video at 224 x 224 resolution. Under a small-scale academic setting (13 classes, 197 clips, 80-20 split), the fine-tuned model reaches 99% training accuracy and 78% validation accuracy after 15 epochs. We provide a per-class breakdown via a confusion matrix and classification report, identify the dominant failure modes (confusable adjective pairs such as ugly, deaf, blind, hat, and dress), and describe a Streamlit-based inference demo that takes a user-uploaded video and returns the predicted English label alongside its Hindi, Telugu, and Bengali translations. We discuss the scope, limitations (small label set, isolated-word rather than continuous signing, single-signer style sensitivity, ambiguity of single-word machine translation), and directions for future work, including expanding to sentence-level generation and a larger vocabulary. Code is released to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段深度学习流水线，先使用VideoMAE视频Transformer对印度手语视频片段进行分类（13类），再使用NLLB-200多语言翻译模型将预测的英文标签翻译成印地语、泰卢固语和孟加拉语，在小型学术数据集上达到78%的验证准确率。
AI.motivation: 为低资源印度语言（印地语、泰卢固语、孟加拉语）的手语识别与翻译提供自动化工具，弥补当前对印度手语支持不足的空白。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：阶段一，使用微调的VideoMAE视频Transformer对13类印度手语视频片段进行分类；阶段二，使用Meta AI的NLLB-200多语言翻译模型将预测的英文标签翻译为三种印度语言。
AI.result: 在13类、197个视频片段、80-20划分的小规模设置下，微调模型在15个epoch后达到99%训练准确率和78%验证准确率，并提供了混淆矩阵和分类报告。
AI.conclusion: 当前方法在小规模孤立词识别上有效，但存在标签集小、非连续手势、单人手语风格敏感、机器翻译歧义等局限，未来将向句子级生成和更大词汇量扩展。

title: Protein contacts are already in the attention: a single-forward-pass alternative to the Categorical Jacobian
summary: The Categorical Jacobian (CJ) of Zhang et al. (2024) reads protein contacts from a language model by perturbing every residue with every alternative amino acid, about 19L forward passes. We show the signal it reconstructs is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads: averaging the top-K contact-relevant heads, selected on as few as 10 labeled proteins, recovers contacts in one forward pass and beats CJ on leakage-clean data for every bidirectional model where CJ is defined, and matches or beats it in-distribution (the exceptions being the smallest 8M model and a statistical tie on ESM Cambrian). Ablations localize the gain to labeled head selection, not averaging: at a matched label budget the unweighted mean ties a supervised L1 logistic regression on the same heads, so the parameter-free mean is selection's minimal form, not the source of the advantage. Our primary test is leakage-clean: on a CAMEO split where neither selection nor evaluation touches data the models have plausibly memorized, the head readout beats CJ on ESM-2-650M by +9 pp (N=29, p<0.001), with the within-model margin reproducing across architectures on a wider pretraining-aware set. Both methods fall 30-36 percentage points from their in-distribution Zhang numbers to the leakage-clean numbers, consistent with substantial pretraining overlap inflating prior numbers (a CAMEO-vs-Zhang difficulty shift contributes too, so we read it as an upper bound on the leakage component). We additionally introduce representation-CJ, a hidden-state generalization of the Jacobian for architectures without a masked-LM head; show that the optimal K tracks how diffusely a model spreads its contact heads; and find that both methods lose the contact signal on both causal LMs we test (ProGen2), suggesting attention-encoded pair structure may depend on bidirectional pretraining.

AI.tldr: 通过仅选择少量注意力头（在10个标注蛋白上筛选），即可在单次前向传播中恢复蛋白质接触图，性能优于需要19L次前向传播的分类Jacobian方法，且更抗数据泄露。
AI.motivation: 分类Jacobian方法需要大量前向传播，效率低且可能存在数据泄露问题。作者希望找到更高效、更干净的蛋白质接触图读取方法。
AI.method: 在少量标注蛋白上筛选与接触预测最相关的Top-K注意力头，对它们的输出取平均；提出representation-CJ作为无掩码语言模型头架构的推广。
AI.result: 头读取方法在泄露干净数据上超越CJ（ESM-2-650M上+9pp，p<0.001）；两种方法在泄露干净数据上比原始分布内结果低30-36pp，说明先前结果被预训练数据泄露高估。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头选择是性能提升的关键，而非平均操作本身；接触信号依赖于双向预训练，因果语言模型（如ProGen2）中两种方法均失效。

title: Only Ask What You Don't Know: Grounded Delta Planning for Efficient Multi-step RAG
summary: Multi-hop question answering remains challenging for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) because existing approaches either propagate errors across iterative retrieval rounds or over-generate reasoning steps, increasing cost without improving accuracy. We propose Grounded Delta Planning RAG (GDP-RAG), a plan-based framework that targets only the information delta based on three simple design choices: (1) preliminary retrieval to ground planning before execution, (2) a gap-conditioned planning prompt that asks only for missing information, and (3) a skeletal trajectory that pairs each subquery with a Thought capturing evidence from preliminary retrieval and carrying it through to the final answer. GDP-RAG focuses computation on unresolved gaps, yielding concise, reliable reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue show that GDP-RAG achieves the highest accuracy (60.63%) among all compared systems while maintaining a cost-of-pass of 0.51, 22% lower than PAR-RAG (0.65) and 68% lower than KnowTrace (1.57), with no method achieving both higher accuracy and lower cost.

AI.tldr: GDP-RAG通过三种设计（预检索接地、缺口条件规划提示、骨架轨迹）实现了多跳问答中准确率最高（60.63%）且成本最低（0.51）的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在多跳问答中要么在迭代检索中传播错误，要么过度生成推理步骤导致成本增加但准确率不提升。
AI.method: 提出GDP-RAG框架，包含三个设计：初步检索接地规划、只询问缺失信息的缺口条件规划提示、以及将子查询与初步检索证据配对传递到最终答案的骨架轨迹。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue上达到最高准确率60.63%，成本指标0.51，比PAR-RAG低22%，比KnowTrace低68%。
AI.conclusion: GDP-RAG通过聚焦未解决的信息缺口，实现了简洁可靠的推理轨迹，在准确率和成本方面均优于现有方法。

title: Grounded Scaling: Why Agentic AI Needs Deterministic Environments
summary: Long-chain agent execution fails exponentially in environments designed for human tolerance: with per-step determinism $δ< 1$, $k$-step chain success degrades as $δ^k$. The AGI-to-ASI scaling debate (Genewein et al., 2026) has so far framed progress as a race between compute growth and a list of frictions (data wall, abstraction barrier, embodied bottleneck, multi-agent trust); we argue that environment determinism is a complementary binding axis cutting across all four, for the broad class of agentic AI tasks whose outcomes are verifiable economically, physically, or through multi-party settlement. Three formal results pin down the regime: a Determinism-Efficiency Bound on chain-task success, a Verifier-Goodharting Floor on flywheel ceilings under imperfect rewards, and a convergence condition for environment-side skill evolution. We operationalise the framework as a Supply Certainty Index (SCI) over five measurable properties, a five-level Determinism Maturity Model (DMM) as adoption ladder, and a falsifiable open-question programme (OQ1-OQ5) with explicit null results that would force retraction. The position is platform-agnostic. We engage three competing positions: sim-to-real sufficiency, alignment sufficiency, and AI-as-normal-technology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出环境确定性是影响长链Agent任务成功的关键约束轴，建立了确定性-效率边界、验证器古德哈特定理和环境技能演化收敛条件三个形式化结果，并开发了供应确定性指数（SCI）和确定性成熟度模型（DMM）作为实用框架。
AI.motivation: 现有AGI到ASI的争论聚焦于计算增长与摩擦（数据墙、抽象障碍、具身瓶颈、多智能体信任）的赛跑，但忽视了环境确定性这一横跨所有摩擦的关键约束轴，尤其是在经济、物理或多方结算可验证的代理AI任务中。
AI.method: 通过三个形式化理论结果（确定性-效率边界、验证器古德哈特定理、环境技能演化收敛条件）构建理论框架，并操作化为供应确定性指数（SCI）和五级确定性成熟度模型（DMM），同时提出五个可证伪的开放问题（OQ1-OQ5）及对应的零结果撤回条件。
AI.result: 长链Agent执行的失败率随步数指数级增长（δ^k），环境确定性是制约长链任务成功率的根本因素，而非单纯依赖计算规模扩大。
AI.conclusion: 环境确定性是AGI-ASI辩论中独立且核心的约束轴，平台无关的框架可用于指导实际系统设计，并与模拟到现实充分性、对齐充分性、AI作为普通技术三种竞争立场进行对比讨论。

title: A Verifiable Search Is Not a Learnable Chain-of-Thought
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables; Interactive walkthrough: https://nemotron.harshpatel.live ; Code, solvers, and per-row eval data: https://github.com/harshpatel1692/search-not-learnable
summary: It is tempting to assume any task solvable by a short program can be taught to a model as its chain-of-thought: write the steps out, fine-tune, and the model follows. This paper shows the assumption fails for an identifiable class of procedures. The testbed is nine reasoning tasks, each from a deterministic generator; public and hidden splits share generators, so held-out data proxies test accuracy. I reverse-engineer the generators into Python solvers, render them as chain-of-thought, and distill into a rank-<= 32 LoRA over a 30B (3.5B-active) Nemotron model. Forward-computable tasks install readily: lookup/arithmetic and an 8-bit boolean task transfer (>= 0.99 and 0.68). Cryptarithm does not: distilling its backtracking search holds at 0.01-0.07 across eleven chain-of-thought designs, RL from verifiable rewards, and self-training, even though a search solver answers 71% of instances. This is not a capability gap. The model does the arithmetic on 97-100% of lines and ranks the correct cipher in its top eight on 71%; it cannot carry the search forward as a left-to-right derivation. Fine-tuning learns the shape of a verifiable elimination step while its verdicts become unconditional templates, correct only 16-57% of the time ("verdict-as-token"). The ceiling holds across backbones from 3B to 671B and across fine-tuning and prompting; a controlled intervention isolates the cause: revealing the cipher key, which turns the derivation forward, lifts the same instances from 0.03 to 0.57. When a procedure's only solution is search over information-free structure, no faithful forward chain-of-thought exists to imitate. The task becomes learnable only by removing the search, precomputing its combinatorial core into a catalog and reducing the trace to recall plus verification; the 1st-place solution reaches Private LB 0.92 this way. What distills is memorization and verification, not search.

AI.tldr: 本文证明并非所有能用短程序解决的任务都可以通过链式思维蒸馏给模型。对于需要回溯搜索的密码算术任务，即使模型能完成各步骤的计算，也无法将搜索过程作为前向推导来模仿。通过预计算搜索核心为目录、将轨迹简化为记忆加验证，才能取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 挑战"任何短程序可解的任务都能通过链式思维蒸馏给模型"这一普遍假设。
AI.method: 在9个确定性生成器产生的推理任务上，将生成器逆向工程为Python求解器，渲染为链式思维，通过LoRA微调Nemotron模型进行蒸馏。对密码算术任务尝试了11种链式思维设计、强化学习和自训练。
AI.result: 前向可计算任务（查找、算术、8位布尔运算）转移良好（>=0.99和0.68）；密码算术的搜索蒸馏最高仅0.01-0.07，尽管搜索求解器能解答71%的实例。揭示密钥可使准确率从0.03提升到0.57。通过预计算搜索核心为目录，将轨迹简化为记忆加验证，取得了0.92的分数。
AI.conclusion: 当过程的唯一解法是对无信息结构进行搜索时，不存在可忠诚模仿的前向链式思维。能蒸馏的是记忆和验证，而非搜索本身。

title: moBERTo: A Modern Encoder for Portuguese via Continued Pretraining of ModernBERT
summary: Encoder-only transformer models remain essential for production NLP pipelines. We introduce moBERTo, a Portuguese adaptation of ModernBERT obtained through continued pretraining of the ModernBERT-base checkpoint on 60 billion tokens (5 epochs over a 12-billion-token corpus curated from FineWeb2 and filtered with educational and STEM classifiers). We preserve the original architecture, including rotary positional embeddings, alternating local-global attention, flash attention, and unpadding. We evaluate moBERTo across information retrieval (including long-context retrieval at up to 8,192 tokens), document classification, named entity recognition, and natural language understanding. Our best variant, which combines a Portuguese tokenizer with subword-matching embedding transfer and long-context post-training, achieves the highest average reranking nDCG@10 across three Portuguese retrieval benchmarks and the best results on PLUE-PT. Through ablation studies, we show that (i) continued pretraining is strongly preferable to training from scratch, particularly for preserving long-context capabilities; (ii) tokenizer adaptation improves token-level tasks but degrades long-context retrieval; (iii) a dedicated long-context post-training phase at 8,192 tokens further improves reranking and NER; and (iv) encoder-only architectures remain competitive with larger decoder-only alternatives for discriminative tasks. We publicly release the model weights at https://huggingface.co/Tropic-AI/moBERTo and training data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tropic-AI/moberto-pretraining-dataset-c4-compatible on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: moBERTo 是 ModernBERT 的葡萄牙语适配版本，通过在 120 亿 token 语料上继续预训练 5 个 epoch（共 60B token）得到。最佳变体结合了葡萄牙语分词器、子词匹配嵌入迁移和长上下文后训练，在多项葡萄牙语 NLP 任务上取得了最优结果。
AI.motivation: 编码器-only Transformer 模型在生产 NLP 管道中仍然至关重要，但缺乏针对葡萄牙语的优质适配模型。作者旨在将 ModernBERT 适配到葡萄牙语，同时保持其架构优势。
AI.method: 基于 ModernBERT-base 检查点进行继续预训练，使用 FineWeb2 筛选的 120 亿 token 葡萄牙语语料，训练 5 个 epoch（共 60B token）。保留原始架构（RoPE、交替局部-全局注意力、flash attention、unpadding）。探索了葡萄牙语分词器、子词匹配嵌入迁移和长上下文后训练（8192 token）等变体。
AI.result: 最佳变体在三个葡萄牙语检索基准上取得最高 reranking nDCG@10，在 PLUE-PT 上取得最优结果。消融实验表明：继续预训练优于从头训练；分词器适配提升 token 级任务但损害长上下文检索；长上下文后训练进一步改善 reranking 和 NER；编码器-only 架构在判别任务上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: moBERTo 展示了继续预训练和架构适配在低资源语言场景下的有效性，证明编码器-only 模型在判别任务上仍可与更大规模的 decoder-only 模型竞争。模型和训练数据已公开发布。

title: Imagine to Ensure Safety in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: This work investigates the safe exploration problem in reinforcement learning, where an agent must maximize cumulative performance while simultaneously satisfying safety constraints. This challenge becomes even more pronounced in long-horizon tasks, where existing safe methods face fundamental limitations due to compounding estimation errors and restricted exploration capabilities. To address this problem, we propose a method that combines a learnable world model with two complementary policies a high-level policy and a low-level policy to promote safety at both hierarchical levels. The high-level policy generates intermediate subgoals that bias exploration toward safe regions, while the low-level policy uses imagined rollouts in the learned world model to reduce unsafe behaviors when reaching these subgoals. The proposed method was evaluated on challenging long-horizon navigation and manipulation tasks with high-dimensional action spaces, where it significantly outperforms existing Safe RL baselines in both success rate and strong empirical constraint satisfaction, consistently meeting the prescribed safety budget across seeds, while prior approaches fail to effectively solve these complex long-horizon scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合可学习世界模型与两层策略（高层生成安全子目标，低层通过想象推演减少不安全行为）的方法，有效解决了强化学习中长时域任务的安全探索问题，在导航和操作任务上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 长时域任务中，现有安全强化学习方法因累积估计误差和探索能力受限而面临根本性局限，亟需一种能在最大化累积性能的同时满足安全约束的探索方法。
AI.method: 结合可学习世界模型与两层互补策略：高层策略生成中间子目标，将探索偏向安全区域；低层策略利用在世界模型中的想象推演，减少到达子目标过程中的不安全行为。
AI.result: 在具有高维动作空间的长时域导航和操作任务上，该方法在成功率和约束满足率上显著优于现有安全强化学习基线，一致地满足预设的安全预算。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分层安全探索方法能够有效解决复杂长时域场景下的安全强化学习问题，克服了现有方法在该场景下的根本性局限。

title: Cohort-Anchored Foundation Models for Electronic Health Records: From Risk Scores to Auditable Peer Cohorts
summary: Foundation models have achieved remarkable performance across medical question answering, imaging, and electronic health record (EHR) tasks, yet reliable clinical deployment remains challenging due to limited interpretability, vulnerability to distribution shift, and weak alignment with clinician reasoning. We argue that these limitations arise because existing approaches prioritize representation learning while treating patient comparison as an emergent property rather than a primary source of clinical evidence. To address this gap, we propose CAFM, a Cohort-Anchored Foundation Model framework that elevates patient cohorts to a first-class object throughout the learning pipeline. The framework consists of four stages: deviation-aware data curation, cohort-conditioned pretraining, multimodal cohort alignment, and clinician-in-the-loop refinement. Together, these stages improve data quality, organize representations around clinically meaningful cohort structure, preserve modality-specific relationships, and support auditable clinical decision-making. The framework is compositional and can augment existing EHR foundation models without modifying their underlying encoders. We illustrate CAFM through four clinical case studies spanning acute kidney injury prediction, cardiovascular risk stratification from electrocardiograms, optic neuropathy triage from orbital imaging, and electroretinogram-grounded report generation. We further present five empirically testable hypotheses and identify open challenges in data quality, irregular temporality, multimodal learning, distribution shift, and evaluation beyond predictive accuracy. We argue that explicitly anchoring foundation models to patient cohorts provides a principled path toward trustworthy clinical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAFM框架，通过将患者队列作为核心对象融入基础模型训练全流程（数据筛选、预训练、多模态对齐、临床反馈），以提升可解释性、分布外泛化能力和临床可信度，并通过四个临床案例验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗基础模型在可解释性、分布偏移鲁棒性和与临床推理的对齐方面存在不足，根本原因在于它们将患者比较视为表征学习的附带产物而非主要证据来源。
AI.method: 提出CAFM框架，包含四个阶段：偏差感知数据筛选、队列条件预训练、多模态队列对齐、临床专家参与优化。该框架可组合式地增强现有EHR基础模型，无需修改底层编码器。
AI.result: 通过急性肾损伤预测、心血管风险分层、视神经病变分诊、视网膜电图报告生成四个临床案例进行验证，并提出了五个可实验检验的假设。
AI.conclusion: 将基础模型显式锚定于患者队列是通往可信临床AI的原则性路径。

title: BLUEX v2: Benchmarking LLMs on Open-Ended Questions from Brazilian University Entrance Exams
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in many tasks, their assessment in Portuguese has received less attention, particularly for open-ended, discursive tasks that demand deeper reasoning and generation capabilities. While the original BLUEX benchmark addressed the scarcity of Portuguese evaluation datasets through multiple-choice questions from Brazilian university entrance exams, it did not cover the more challenging second-phase examinations, which require free-form written responses. In this work, we introduce BLUEX v2, a benchmark derived from the second-phase entrance exams of Brazil's two leading universities: UNICAMP (Comvest) and USP (Fuvest), spanning exam years 2022-2025. Our dataset comprises 395 questions unfolding into 919 graded subquestions, with 55.7% of questions containing associated images. Each question is annotated with subject area, official reference answers, LLM-generated rubric criteria, and six cognitive capability tags. We evaluate 21 state-of-the-art LLMs using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol. Results reveal a 4.92-point performance spread across models (4.18-9.10 on a 0-10 scale), with Mathematical Reasoning and Image Understanding emerging as the hardest capability dimensions. The dataset, evaluation code, and model outputs are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BLUEXv2.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BLUEX v2，一个基于巴西顶尖大学第二阶段入学考试的多模态葡萄牙语基准数据集，包含395道题（919个子问题），评估了21个LLM的表现，发现数学推理和图像理解是最困难的能力维度。
AI.motivation: 现有葡萄牙语评估数据集（如BLUEX）仅涵盖选择题形式，缺乏对开放式、论述性任务（特别是需要深度推理和生成能力的第二阶段的考试）的评估。
AI.method: 从UNICAMP和USP两所巴西顶尖大学2022-2025年的第二阶段入学考试中构建数据集，包含395道题（919个子问题），55.7%的题目附带图片，每道题标注了学科领域、官方参考答案、LLM生成的评分标准和六项认知能力标签，采用LLM-as-a-judge协议评估21个前沿LLM。
AI.result: 模型性能跨度4.92分（4.18-9.10，满分10分），数学推理和图像理解是最困难的能力维度。
AI.conclusion: BLUEX v2填补了葡萄牙语开放式评估的空白，数据集、评估代码和模型输出已公开。

title: Governance Decay: How Context Compaction Silently Erases Safety Constraints in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on context compaction, summarization, or eviction to keep long-running sessions within a token budget. We show that this context-management layer is a safety-critical failure surface: in-context governance constraints that agents reliably obey while visible can be silently removed by compaction, causing the same agent to perform prohibited tool actions later in the session. We call this failure mode Governance Decay. We introduce ConstraintRot, a benchmark of long-horizon agent scenarios with deterministic tool-call grading, and measure compaction-induced violations across seven model families. Across 1,323 episodes, violation rises from 0% with the policy in full context to 30% after compaction, reaching 59% for some models; when the constraint survives the summary, violation remains 0%, but when it is dropped, violation reaches 38%. We further study a Compaction-Eviction Attack, in which adversarial in-context content biases the summarizer to omit a legitimate policy, and show that optimized injections defeat every evaluated model. Finally, we propose Constraint Pinning, a simple training-free mitigation that quarantines governance constraints from lossy compaction and restores violation to 0% in our benchmark. These results identify context management as a first-class governance surface for deployed LLM agents.

AI.tldr: LLM代理的上下文管理（压缩/摘要/驱逐）会意外移除安全约束，导致代理在长会话中执行被禁止的操作。本文提出Governance Decay问题，构建ConstraintRot基准，发现压缩后违规率从0%升至30%（最高59%），并提出Constraint Pinning方法可恢复至0%违规率。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM代理依赖上下文压缩来维持长会话的token预算，但现有研究忽视了这一层可能移除安全约束，导致代理在后续会话中执行原本被禁止的操作。
AI.method: 构建ConstraintRot基准（长时域代理场景+确定性工具调用评分），在7个模型家族共1,323个episode中测量压缩导致的违规行为。并设计了Compaction-Eviction Attack（利用对抗性上下文内容诱导摘要器遗漏合法策略），以及Constraint Pinning（将治理约束与有损压缩隔离的无训练缓解方法）。
AI.result: 完整策略下违规率0%，压缩后升至30%，部分模型达59%。策略被保留时违规率仍为0%，但被丢弃时达38%。对抗攻击可击败所有测试模型。Constraint Pinning将违规率恢复至0%。
AI.conclusion: 上下文管理是LLM代理的一级治理面（first-class governance surface），需要被严肃对待。Constraint Pinning提供了一种简单有效的训练无关缓解方案。

title: Ranking-and-Selection with Multiple Correct Answers and Non-Answerable Estimates
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 Winter Simulation Conference
summary: We study fixed-precision ranking-and-selection in structured settings where the answer may be non-unique and where noisy estimates may temporarily admit no valid answer at all. This phenomenon arises naturally in problems such as multi-fidelity ranking-and-selection and identifying a Condorcet winner from pairwise comparisons. To address this, we propose a unified framework based on answer-wise acceptance sets, restricted generalized likelihood ratio stopping, and an answer-pitfall decomposition that yields a max-max-min characteristic value and a common sampling principle. We introduce ENDS, a general procedure that combines estimation, nomination, pitfall detection, and cost-aware information-directed selection. We instantiate ENDS for various problems by deriving explicit formulas. Extensive numerical experiments show that this unified recipe performs well across a broad range of pure-exploration problems and offers a practical framework and proof-of-concept algorithmic recipe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的固定精度排序与选择框架ENDS，通过答案可接受集、受限广义似然比停止和答案陷阱分解，解决了非唯一答案和暂时无有效答案的结构化问题，并在多种纯探索问题上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 在多重保真度排序与选择、Condorcet胜者识别等结构化问题中，答案可能不唯一，且噪声估计可能导致暂时无有效答案，现有方法缺乏统一处理框架。
AI.method: 提出基于答案可接受集的统一框架，包括受限广义似然比停止规则、答案陷阱分解方法，以及ENDS算法（结合估计、提名、陷阱检测和成本感知信息导向选择）。
AI.result: 为多种问题推导了显式公式，大量数值实验表明该统一方法在广泛的纯探索问题中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种实用的方法论和概念验证算法方案，可推广至多种结构化纯探索问题。

title: When Confidence Takes the Wrong Path: Diagnosing Retrieval-State Lock-In in RAG
summary: The trustworthiness of a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system depends on more than the answer it returns, yet many black-box uncertainty methods still read agreement among sampled answers as confidence. That inference fails when repeated samples condition on the same defective retrieval state. The state may be empty, with the model falling back on parametric memory, or populated by a coherent but wrong neighbourhood. In either case, the answers agree because the error is stable. The problem is recognised in deployed RAG, but it has lacked a name, a measurable signature, and a prevalence bound. We supply all three. We name the failure retrieval-state lock-in and diagnose it by separating the three objects a single confidence score conflates: the answer surface, the retrieved evidence, and the retrieval state itself. In an inspectable, ontology-guided knowledge-graph RAG (KG-RAG) system across six question-answering snapshots, we measure the agreement blind spot directly: at five samples per question, 42% of KG-RAG errors and 59% of dense-retrieval errors carry zero answer dispersion, so agreement has nothing to rank, while evidence- and retrieval-state checks still flag most of them. The decomposition supports an auditable decision rule: accepting an answer only when answer, evidence, and retrieval checks all agree that it is low-risk reaches 91.9% pooled precision against a 69.7% accept-all rate. The cost is coverage: it certifies only 7.7% of answers as low-risk. On the clinical calibration domain it reaches 100% precision under an automated judge; this is an in-domain automated-label upper bound, not a clinical safety claim, and still needs human validation. Confidence in RAG is object-specific: when answers agree, the useful question is which part of the pipeline to distrust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAG系统中的"检索状态锁定"问题：当检索状态有缺陷时，多次采样生成的一致答案实际上不可信。通过将置信度分解为答案表面、检索证据和检索状态三个对象，在KG-RAG系统中测量发现42%-59%的错误存在"一致性盲区"，并提出了可审计的决策规则。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒不确定性方法错误地将采样答案间的一致性当作置信度，忽略了当检索状态存在缺陷（如检索为空或检索到错误但一致的上下文）时，多次采样仍会生成一致但错误的答案。该问题在部署的RAG系统中已被认识到，但缺乏命名、可测量特征和流行度边界。
AI.method: 将单个置信度分数混淆的三个对象解耦：答案表面、检索证据和检索状态。在可检查的、本体引导的知识图谱RAG系统上，对六个问答快照进行测量，比较答案一致性、证据检查和检索状态检查的效果。
AI.result: 五次采样下，42%的KG-RAG错误和59%的密集检索错误携带零答案分散度；提出的决策规则（答案、证据、检索检查三者一致才接受）达到91.9%的合并精确率（对比69.7%的全接受率），但覆盖率仅为7.7%；在临床校准领域达到100%精确率。
AI.conclusion: RAG中的置信度是对象特定的：当答案一致时，有用的问题是怀疑pipeline中的哪个部分不可信。对置信度的分解支持更可信的决策，但覆盖率仍有待提升。

title: MacAgentBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Real-World macOS Desktop
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) have advanced rapidly in desktop automation, and a growing number of users deploy CUAs such as OpenClaw on Mac Mini for always-on automation. However, existing benchmarks, including those for macOS, evaluate agents without framework augmentation and rely on binary evaluation. As a result, they fail to capture both the framework capabilities leveraged by modern CUAs and the partial progress on long-horizon, multi-application tasks. We present MacAgentBench, a comprehensive macOS agent benchmark comprising 676 tasks across 25 applications, with nearly 60% involving both GUI and CLI interaction. The benchmark adopts deterministic rule-based evaluation and introduces fine-grained multi-checkpoint scoring with capability annotations for multi-application tasks. Experiments across three frameworks and 16 models show that the best configuration, Claude Opus 4.6 on OpenClaw, attains 73.7% Pass@1, while this advantage is primarily driven by the skill library rather than by framework design. Fine-grained metrics further reveal that models with similar Pass@1 can differ substantially in sub-goal completion. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/JetAstra/MacAgentBench.

AI.tldr: MacAgentBench是一个包含676个任务、覆盖25个应用的macOS智能体基准测试，采用精细的多检查点评分机制。最佳配置（Claude Opus 4.6 + OpenClaw）达到73.7% Pass@1，优势主要来自技能库而非框架设计。
AI.motivation: 现有macOS基准测试缺乏框架增强评估，且依赖二元评价，无法捕捉现代CUA使用的框架能力以及长周期、多应用任务中的部分进展。
AI.method: 构建了676个任务、25个应用的基准测试，其中近60%涉及GUI和CLI混合交互。采用确定性规则评估和带能力标注的精细多检查点评分。
AI.result: 最佳配置（Claude Opus 4.6 + OpenClaw）达73.7% Pass@1；优势主要来自技能库而非框架设计；相同Pass@1的模型在子目标完成度上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: MacAgentBench提供了更全面的macOS智能体评估，揭示了技能库对性能的关键作用以及精细评估指标的必要性。

title: AgroSense 2.0: Cross-Modal Transformer Fusion with Geospatial Raster Integration and Interpretable Multi-Task Learning for Precision Crop Recommendation
summary: Crop recommendation systems in precision agriculture have long suffered from a fundamental modality gap: visual soil characterization and chemical nutrient profiling are typically treated as independent inference problems, with fusion often reduced to late-stage feature concatenation. AgroSense~2.0 addresses this limitation through three architectural advances. First, we introduce continental-scale geospatial integration via a seven-band soil raster (\texttt{india\_soil\_7bands.tif}) spanning India, encoding Nitrogen, pH, SOC, Clay, Sand, Silt, and Bulk Density as $32\times32$ spatial patches, a modality entirely absent from prior work. Second, we replace naive feature concatenation with a cross-modal Transformer fusion module, where tabular nutrient features attend over image representations via multi-head attention, enabling richer inter-modal dependency modeling than shallow fusion. Third, we adopt a multi-task objective jointly optimizing soil classification and crop recommendation through a shared backbone, improving generalization via complementary cross-task signal. To enhance interpretability, we apply TreeSHAP to the tabular branch, revealing crop-conditioned nutrient sensitivity: humidity and rainfall emerge as the most influential features globally, while crop-specific profiles diverge meaningfully rainfall dominates rice, nitrogen and potassium dominate maize, and humidity and nitrogen dominate coffee. These explanations provide transparency into model decisions and surface both agronomically consistent patterns and dataset-specific divergences worth further study. Together, these contributions establish AgroSense~2.0 as a more principled, interpretable, and geospatially grounded framework for precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: AgroSense 2.0 提出了一种跨模态Transformer融合框架，通过七波段土壤栅格数据、交叉注意力机制和多任务学习，解决了精准农业中土壤视觉特征与化学养分特征之间的模态鸿沟，并利用TreeSHAP增强了模型可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统作物推荐系统中，土壤视觉表征与化学养分分析被视为独立问题，特征融合往往停留在简单的后期拼接，缺乏深层次的跨模态交互。
AI.method: 1) 引入覆盖印度的七波段土壤栅格数据；2) 使用跨模态Transformer融合模块，让表格养分特征通过多头注意力机制与图像表示进行交互；3) 采用多任务学习同时优化土壤分类和作物推荐。
AI.result: TreeSHAP分析显示湿度、降雨量等特征的全局重要性，以及不同作物对养分的差异化敏感性（如水稻依赖降雨，玉米依赖氮和钾等）。
AI.conclusion: AgroSense 2.0 提供了一个更原则性、可解释且地理空间基础坚实的精准农业框架。

title: Language-Specific Sentiment Polarity Biases in Encoder and Large Language Model Classification of Product Reviews
summary: This study investigates sentiment polarity biases, specifically, differences in how accurately AI models classify positive versus negative reviews across languages and model architectures. Large language models show a negative bias in French and are more accurate on negative reviews, while encoder models exhibit positive bias in Japanese, missing negative reviews that use indirect criticism. These language-specific polarity biases have implications in both social and business domains deploying multilingual sentiment analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了AI模型在不同语言和架构下对情感极性（正面/负面）的分类准确性差异，发现大语言模型在法语中存在负面偏见（对负面评论更准确），而编码器模型在日语中存在正面偏见（漏判间接批评的负面评论）。这些语言特定的极性偏见对部署多语言情感分析系统的社会和商业领域有重要影响。
AI.motivation: 现有情感分析系统在多语言场景下可能存在系统性偏见，但不同语言和模型架构中情感极性偏见的差异尚未被充分研究，因此需要系统性地探究这些偏见及其影响。
AI.method: 通过比较大型语言模型和编码器模型在法语和日语等多语言环境下的情感分类准确性，分析正面和负面评论的分类差异。
AI.result: 大语言模型在法语中表现出负面偏见，对负面评论分类更准确；编码器模型在日语中表现出正面偏见，容易漏判使用间接批评方式的负面评论。
AI.conclusion: 语言特定的情感极性偏见存在于不同模型架构中，对多语言情感分析系统的实际部署（社会和商业领域）具有重要影响。

title: Text2DSL: LLM-Based Code Generation for Domain-Specific Languages
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at KES 2026 (Knowledge-Based Intelligent Information and Engineering Systems), Procedia Computer Science, Elsevier
summary: Domain-specific languages (DSLs) are widely used for managing operating system security policies, yet manually authoring rules in such languages demands high expertise and is error-prone. This paper formalises the task of automatic DSL code generation from natural language descriptions - Text2DSL - as a distinct problem class, separate from Text-to-SQL and general-purpose code generation. We introduce the PolkitBench dataset comprising 4,204 verified natural-language-to-Polkit-rule pairs, each validated through a three-level AST-based pipeline. Controlled prompt experiments on two MoE models of different scale and provenance - GigaChat-10B-A1.8B (1.8B active parameters) and Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B (3B active) - demonstrate the critical role of structured context (BNF grammar, API specification, permitted identifier vocabulary) for LLM-based DSL code generation. Across both models, supplying context raises syntactic validity to 98.6-99.4%, structural validity by +9.7 to +35.5 pp, and the CodeBLEU score by +60% to +95%. The consistency of the effect across models of different scale and provenance indicates that, for the Text2DSL class of problems, injecting a formal target-language specification into the prompt context is a robust enabling factor for high-quality generation without model fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Text2DSL任务——从自然语言自动生成领域特定语言（DSL）代码，并构建了PolkitBench数据集（4204条验证过的自然语言-Polkit规则对）。通过在两个MoE模型（GigaChat-10B-A1.8B和Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B）上的实验表明，提供结构化上下文（BNF语法、API规范、标识符词汇表）可将语法有效性提升至98.6-99.4%，结构有效性提升9.7-35.5个百分点，CodeBLEU提升60-95%。该效应在不同规模模型上具有一致性，说明注入形式化语言规范是无需微调即可实现高质量DSL生成的有效方法。
AI.motivation: DSL在操作系统安全策略管理中广泛使用，但人工编写规则需要高专业知识且容易出错。现有研究缺乏将自然语言自动转换为DSL代码这一独立问题类的系统研究。
AI.method: 将Text2DSL定义为独立问题类；构建包含4204条验证对的PolkitBench数据集（基于三级AST管道的验证流程）；在两种不同规模和来源的MoE模型上进行带结构化上下文（BNF语法、API规范、标识符词汇表）的对比实验。
AI.result: 提供结构化上下文后，语法有效性达98.6-99.4%，结构有效性提升9.7-35.5个百分点，CodeBLEU提升60-95%。
AI.conclusion: 对于Text2DSL类问题，向提示上下文注入形式化的目标语言规范是无需模型微调即可实现高质量生成的关键因素，该效果在不同规模和来源的模型上具有一致性。

title: Data Pruning: Redundant, Problematic, and Interdependent Samples
comment: This work is a preprint of a published paper by the same name
summary: The performance of deep learning models is affected by not only data quantity but also data quality. Data pruning is a process by which practitioners can reduce the size of a dataset by only keeping the most important training data points, thereby achieving similar test set performance. We empirically investigate two popular data pruning methods under noisy and noiseless conditions and show that these methods fail in the presence of significant label noise. We highlight that the success of data pruning is distinctly affected by three factors: redundancy in the dataset, the presence of problematic samples, and interdependence between samples. We perform a detailed investigation on commonly used benchmark classification datasets and neural network architectures. We find that our observations are consistent across data distributions and training protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数据剪枝方法在标签噪声下的表现，发现现有方法在显著标签噪声下会失效，并揭示了影响数据剪枝成功的三个关键因素：数据冗余、问题样本的存在以及样本间的相互依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型的性能不仅受数据量影响，也受数据质量影响。数据剪枝旨在通过保留最重要的训练数据点来减小数据集规模，同时保持相似的测试性能。然而，现有方法在标签噪声环境下的表现尚不清楚，本文旨在探究这一问题。
AI.method: 作者对两种流行的数据剪枝方法在有无噪声条件下进行了实证研究，在常用基准分类数据集和神经网络架构上进行了详细调查，分析了数据冗余、问题样本和样本间相互依赖这三个因素对剪枝效果的影响。
AI.result: 发现现有数据剪枝方法在显著标签噪声下会失效。数据剪枝的成功受到数据冗余、问题样本的存在以及样本间相互依赖关系这三个因素的显著影响。这些观察结果在不同数据分布和训练协议下是一致的。
AI.conclusion: 数据剪枝方法在标签噪声条件下表现不佳，需要考虑数据冗余、问题样本和样本间依赖关系等因素来改进方法。

title: AI Fiction in the Wild
comment: Presented at the MFS Cultural AI Conference, Purdue University, September 19, 2025. This essay is provisionally forthcoming in MFS: Modern Fiction Studies
summary: Some professional authors are beginning to use AI tools to help produce their fiction writing. Are readers using AI to generate fiction, too? This paper examines how large language models are reshaping the production and consumption of fiction by enabling new forms of participation in narrative generation. Drawing on over 500,000 anonymized, English-language ChatGPT-user conversations (arXiv:2405.01470), we find that more than one third of the conversations involve some form of fiction generation -- including original stories, roleplay, fanfiction, and erotica. This AI-generated fiction is notably dominated by power users. We identify common fiction generation patterns and profiles among these users, including what we call "infinite story demanders," who repeatedly request and revise variations of the same or similar narratives over extended periods of time. We show that users especially gravitate toward fanfiction and erotica, and that they are broadly drawn to generic forms, repetition, immediacy, and niche combinations of story elements. Our findings motivate two theoretical provocations. First, we argue that AI technologies may lead to a shift in the conventional relationship between the author and reader, potentially producing what we call a "solipsistic reader-writer," who both generates and consumes fiction within a closed conversational loop, interacting with a machine rather than a human other. Second, we note that LLMs enable interactivity, play, and permutation in ways that are seemingly pleasurable for users, raising questions about where AI will fit into contemporary storytelling and entertainment ecosystems. We situate these developments within broader transformations in literature and media, including self-publishing, fanfiction, and pornography, and suggest that AI-generated fiction shares structural affinities with on-demand, personalized, and repetitive cultural forms.

AI.tldr: 基于50万条ChatGPT对话数据，研究发现超过三分之一的对话涉及小说生成（包括原创故事、角色扮演、同人和色情文学），用户表现出对重复性、即时性和小众组合的偏好，并提出了"唯我论读者-作者"的理论概念。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型如何改变小说的生产与消费方式，特别是普通用户（而非职业作者）如何使用AI进行小说创作，以及这种行为对传统作者-读者关系的影响。
AI.method: 对超过50万条匿名化的ChatGPT用户对话数据（英文）进行分析，识别小说生成模式，并对用户行为进行分类和画像分析。
AI.result: 超过三分之一对话涉及小说生成；重度用户主导AI小说创作；识别出"无限故事索取者"等典型用户类型；用户偏好同人、色情文学、重复叙事和即时满足。
AI.conclusion: AI技术可能导致"唯我论读者-作者"的出现——用户在封闭的对话循环中既是创作者也是消费者；AI生成小说与按需、个性化、重复性的文化形式具有结构上的相似性，对当代叙事和娱乐生态提出了新的问题。

title: PaperClaw: Harnessing Agents for Autonomous Research and Human-in-the-Loop Refinement
summary: Large language models have become capable reasoners and tool users that write and run code and search the literature, which makes automating the research process itself a realistic goal. We present PAPERCLAW, a harnessed multi-agent system that carries a project autonomously, from a field of study to a finished paper. PAPERCLAW curates a domain from a field's live literature, datasets, and code; brainstorms it into an idea with a pre-registered main-result contract; and drives a stoppable hypothesis map through an iterative propose, test, reflect loop that grows only from measured verdicts and halts once the evidence supports the idea, at which point it writes a venue-compliant paper. A full-lifecycle memory keeps each stage in a single living record, so a long run can be paused, inspected, and resumed without losing context. At the centre is an in-cycle research assistant with research tools and skills: it can drive the whole pipeline on its own, while the same interface lets a person step in at any stage, turning a first autonomous draft into a stronger paper through human-in-the-loop refinement. Throughout, PAPERCLAW keeps its output grounded and checkable, citing only references validated against open scholarly indexes and reporting results that genuinely ran. An evaluation with an LLM judge finds that PAPERCLAW produces strong papers both fully autonomously and with human-in-the-loop refinement.

AI.tldr: PAPERCLAW是一个多智能体系统，能够从研究领域选择到论文撰写全流程自主完成科研项目，支持人机协作迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已具备推理和工具使用能力，使自动化研究流程成为现实目标，但缺乏从零到完整论文的端到端自主系统。
AI.method: 采用多智能体架构，包含全生命周期记忆模块、可停靠假设地图、迭代式"提出-验证-反思"循环，以及经校验的引用和结果验证机制。
AI.result: 通过LLM评审评估，PAPERCLAW在完全自主模式和人机协同精炼模式下均能产出高质量论文。
AI.conclusion: PAPERCLAW证明了端到端自动化科研的可行性，其模块化设计允许人类在任意阶段介入，兼顾自主性与可控性。

title: Selective Ensemble Based on Preference-Directed Multi-Objective Bandits
summary: Selective ensemble for modern machine learning systems requires choosing promising model candidates under limited evaluation budgets, while downstream tasks often specify only partial preferences over capabilities such as accuracy, robustness, and reasoning. This setting naturally gives rise to a sequential decision problem under partially specified linear preferences. We formalize it as preference-directed multi-objective bandits (PDMOB), where admissible trade-offs are represented by a polyhedral preference cone. Based on this formulation, we introduce Pareto $C$-optimality, which recovers standard Pareto optimality and single-weight scalarization as special cases. We then propose the preference-directed upper confidence bound (PrefUCB) algorithm, which maintains directional confidence intervals to guide exploration. We analyze both indicator-based and gap-weighted regret, and establish instance-dependent logarithmic bounds for both criteria, recovering the optimal logarithmic dependence on the horizon $T$ in classical special cases. Experiments on large pre-trained model selective ensemble tasks and online asset allocation under institutional mandates validate the efficacy of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出偏好导向多目标老虎机（PDMOB）框架，用于解决现代机器学习系统在部分偏好约束下的选择性集成问题，并设计了PrefUCB算法，在理论上实现了对数级遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习系统（如大模型集成）需要在有限评估预算下选择有潜力的模型，而下游任务通常只指定部分能力偏好（如准确率、鲁棒性、推理能力），这构成了部分指定线性偏好下的序贯决策问题，现有方法未能很好地解决。
AI.method: 提出了偏好导向多目标老虎机（PDMOB）框架，用多面体偏好锥表示可接受的权衡；引入帕累托C-最优性（统一了标准帕累托最优和单权重标量化）；设计了PrefUCB算法，维护方向性置信区间引导探索；分析了基于指标和间隙加权的遗憾，并建立了实例相关的对数界。
AI.result: 在理论上，PrefUCB算法在经典特例下恢复了与时间T的最优对数依赖关系；在大规模预训练模型选择性集成和在线资产配置任务上验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: PDMOB框架和PrefUCB算法能够有效处理部分偏好约束下的多目标序贯决策问题，为现代机器学习系统的选择性集成提供了理论基础和实用方法。

title: Learning Moral Diversity: Modelling Individual Perspectives in Moral Classification of Texts
comment: Accepted at the Seventh Workshop on NLP and Computational Social Science. 12 pages, 7 figures
summary: Understanding moral values in social media text offers insight into moral judgement formation, and supervised NLP models trained on crowdsourced data have achieved strong classification performance. However, most approaches simplify the problem by aggregating multiple annotators' labels into a single "ground truth", overlooking the inherent subjectivity of the task. In practice, there are disagreements between annotators caused by personal viewpoint or inherent ambiguities, particularly for short tweets. Here, we extend a pretrained language model with a layer that learns annotator-specific features. Our model improves predictions of individual annotations and yields representations that reveal meaningful insights into annotators' moral perspectives. We show that models trained on aggregated labels may hide variation and give a misleading impression of performance. Overall, we demonstrate that disagreement reflects the inherent subjectivity of the task and that modelling individual perspectives creates benefits for moral classification of texts.

AI.tldr: 针对社交媒体文本中道德价值观标注的主观性问题，本文提出在预训练语言模型中加入标注者特定特征层，以建模个体标注差异，避免聚合标签带来的偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有道德分类方法通常将多个标注者的标签聚合成单一“真实标签”，忽略了标注主观性和个体差异，导致模型性能评估产生误导。
AI.method: 在预训练语言模型基础上扩展一个学习标注者特定特征的网络层，从而建模不同标注者的个性化视角。
AI.result: 所提模型能够更准确地预测个体标注，并生成反映标注者道德观点的有意义的表示；基于聚合标签训练的模型会隐藏标注差异并产生误导性性能评估。
AI.conclusion: 标注分歧反映了道德分类任务固有的主观性，建模个体视角对文本道德分类具有积极意义。

title: SkillAudit: From Fixed-Suite Benchmarking to Skill-Centered Assessment
comment: Preprint. Project page: https://skillaudit.github.io/. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/SkillAudit/skillaudit
summary: Agent skills have become a practical way to extend large language model agents, but the growing skill ecosystem still lacks a reliable way to judge whether a skill is worth deploying. Existing evaluation methods remain largely anchored to fixed task suites, assessing skills through performance on predefined tasks and environments. As skill marketplaces expand, this paradigm becomes inadequate: fixed suites can conflate a skill's marginal contribution with backbone strength and miss its value when tasks fall outside the skill's intended scope. We introduce SkillAudit, an end-to-end framework for skill-centered assessment that takes an arbitrary agent skill as input and automatically generates a comprehensive, multi-dimensional evaluation report spanning utility, efficiency/cost, and safety. SkillAudit focuses on the skill artifact itself and constructs capability-aligned evaluation tasks directly from the skill package. The generated tasks are conducted in isolated sandbox environments to collect execution evidence, followed by automated checks with LLM-based judging to produce auditable results. To dissect the agent skills, we propose the baseline comparison principle to measure utility and efficiency/cost, and introduce a two-stage detection paradigm combining static semantic analysis with dynamic runtime verification to assess safety risks. After scanning top-ranked real-world skill packages spanning 23 occupational categories, we found that over 7% of skills are at risky status.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillAudit框架，通过自动生成多维度评估报告（效用、效率/成本、安全性）来评估任意智能体技能的可部署性，发现超7%的真实世界技能存在风险。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法依赖固定任务套件，无法区分技能的边际贡献与骨干模型能力，且无法评估技能在预期范围外的价值，随着技能生态扩张需要更可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: SkillAudit框架：从技能包直接构建能力对齐的评估任务，在隔离沙箱环境中执行并收集证据，结合LLM判断自动检查；采用基线对比原则衡量效用和效率/成本；提出静态语义分析+动态运行时验证的两阶段检测范式评估安全风险。
AI.result: 扫描涵盖23个职业类别的前沿真实世界技能包后，发现超过7%的技能处于风险状态。
AI.conclusion: SkillAudit为技能中心化评估提供了可靠的端到端方案，能够有效识别风险技能，对技能市场生态的健康发展具有重要价值。

title: DevoTG: Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Modeling C. elegans Developmental Connectomics
summary: Understanding how a nervous system wires itself from birth to adulthood is a fundamental challenge in developmental neuroscience. We present DevoTG, a temporal graph framework that applies Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNs) to two complementary representations of C. elegans neural development: a Continuous-Time Dynamic Graph (CTDG) of cell division events derived from cell lineage data, and a Discrete-Time Dynamic Graph (DTDG) of the developing synaptic connectome spanning eight reconstructed electron-microscopy datasets. On the lineage prediction task, our TGN achieves a mean test AUC of 0.839 +/- 0.007 (5 seeds; validation AUC 0.937 +/- 0.001), outperforming a static GNN with the identical architecture by 26 AUC points (0.577 +/- 0.080), demonstrating that temporal memory is the decisive factor. Applied to the connectome DTDG, DevoTG identifies three connection stability classes (stable, developmental, and variable) across 225 neurons and 858 to 2,496 connections over development (L1 birth to adult), providing a temporal-graph-theoretic complement to the individual-variability classification of Witvliet et al. Analysis of hub command interneurons AVA, AVB, and AVE reveals their persistent centrality and how their integration roles are progressively reinforced across larval stages. Accompanying interactive visualizations (3D animated networks, centrality heatmaps, and a spatiotemporal lineage graph) make developmental dynamics accessible for biological hypothesis generation. DevoTG is open-source and designed for extension to other developing nervous systems. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/DevoLearn/DevoGraph/tree/main/DevoTG.

AI.tldr: 提出了DevoTG，一个使用时序图神经网络（TGN）分析秀丽隐杆线虫神经系统发育的时间图框架，在线虫谱系预测任务中AUC达到0.839，并在连接组分析中识别出三类连接稳定性。
AI.motivation: 理解神经系统从出生到成年的布线机制是发育神经科学的基本挑战，现有方法缺乏对发育过程中时间动态信息的有效建模。
AI.method: 构建了两种图表示：细胞分裂事件的连续时间动态图（CTDG）和突触连接组的离散时间动态图（DTDG），并应用TGN进行建模分析。
AI.result: 谱系预测任务测试AUC 0.839，比静态GNN高26个点；识别出三类连接稳定性（稳定、发育、可变）；发现命令中间神经元AVA、AVB、AVE的持续中心性及其在幼虫阶段的渐进增强。
AI.conclusion: DevoTG证明了时间记忆是发育预测的关键因素，为个体变异性分类提供了时序图理论补充，且开源可扩展至其他神经系统。

title: Does the Same Token Mean the Same State? MoE Routing as Signal for Reasoning Control
summary: In sparse Mixture-of-Experts language models, does the same token id imply the same router state and the same experts producing it? Holding the emitted token id fixed at repeated anchors, we find it does not: the experts that produce it still separate task context, trajectory history, and reasoning-effort mode. This residual structure supports test-time control: near \emph{boundary} anchors (the final-response transition) and \emph{delimiter} anchors (which open the answer, e.g.\ \texttt{\textbackslash boxed\{} or code fences), routing neighborhoods already align with final-answer basins at a marker-only readout and strongest when the routing is read at the answer opening. We operationalize this as \textbf{RAD} (Routing Agreement Decoding), an answer-string-free multi-rollout selector: it locates a fixed anchor, represents each rollout by its anchor-window MoE routing states, and returns the densest Weighted-Jaccard $K$-NN route-basin center, without parsing, normalizing, executing, or voting over answer strings. Across 10 sparse-MoE configurations (gpt-oss, Qwen3-MoE) and 6 datasets spanning math, GPQA, and code, RAD is on par with Majority where string voting is well-posed, with small positive paired deltas (RAD $73.9$ / RAD+DC $74.2$ vs.\ Majority $73.6$). Like majority voting, RAD is not a verifier: a dense \emph{wrong} basin can still win. Its value is the interface: the same selector gives direct pass@1 on code, where exact-string voting is ill-defined, and the same routing-density principle, re-anchored to the agentic boundary, improves best-of-16 patch selection on SWE-bench Verified over random, where patches have no answer string to vote on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAD方法，利用稀疏MoE语言模型中路由状态（而非输出文本）的一致性来挑选答案，无需解析文本，在数学、代码等任务上达到与多数投票相当的效果，并适用于无明确答案字符串的场景。
AI.motivation: 在稀疏MoE语言模型中，相同的输出token可能由不同的专家路由产生，这意味着路由状态蕴含了任务上下文、推理轨迹和努力模式等额外信息。作者希望利用这一结构特性，实现无需解析答案字符串的测试时控制。
AI.method: 提出RAD (Routing Agreement Decoding)：固定一个锚点（如边界锚点或分隔符锚点），对多次生成中各rollout在锚点窗口内的MoE路由状态进行表示，通过加权Jaccard K近邻找到最稠密的路由盆地中心作为最终输出，无需解析或投票答案字符串。
AI.result: 在10种稀疏MoE配置（gpt-oss、Qwen3-MoE）和6个数据集（数学、GPQA、代码）上，RAD (73.9%) 和 RAD+DC (74.2%) 与多数投票 (73.6%) 相当；在代码任务上可直接作为pass@1选择器；在SWE-bench上可提升补丁选择效果。
AI.conclusion: RAD提供了一种与文本无关的接口，在多数投票不适用的场景（如代码生成、无答案字符串的补丁选择）中依然有效。但其局限性在于不是验证器，稠密的错误盆地仍可能胜出。

title: Confident but Conflicted: Internal Uncertainty and Cognitive Dissonance Resolution in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently encounter inputs that disagree with their prior outputs, through user pushback, retrieved documents, or web search results. While the way they resolve such conflicts -- a process we frame as cognitive dissonance resolution -- has been characterized behaviorally, its connection to internal model uncertainty is not well understood. To study this systematically, we vary persuasion attempts along two dimensions, source authority and evidence quality, across 12 health-science claims of stratified epistemic status. Dissonance can be resolved through persuasion, backfire, or immunity. We introduce Trust Elasticity (TE), an econometrics-inspired measure of how readily a model is persuaded toward conflicting evidence. Across four LLMs, TE varies substantially, while clearly false claims elicit near-zero TE across all models. On two open-weight models, we further find that this variation is associated with two complementary internal uncertainty indicators, Confidence Miscalibration in Qwen and Internal Uncertainty Change in Llama. These results link cross-model behavioral variation to a measurable internal property and point to interventions targeting internal uncertainty as future work.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM如何解决认知失调（用户反驳、检索文档等导致的输入与先前输出的冲突），提出信任弹性（TE）指标衡量模型被说服的难易程度，并发现TE变化与内部不确定性指标（Qwen的置信度校准、Llama的内部不确定性变化）相关。
AI.motivation: LLM常遇到与自身输出矛盾的输入，但其解决此类冲突的内部不确定性机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 沿来源权威性和证据质量两个维度操纵说服尝试，在12个健康科学主张上测试，引入经济学启发的信任弹性（TE）指标，并在4个LLM上分析，对2个开源模型进一步关联内部不确定性指标。
AI.result: 不同LLM的TE差异显著；明显虚假的主张在所有模型上TE接近零；Qwen中TE与置信度误校准相关，Llama中与内部不确定性变化相关。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型行为差异与可测量的内部属性相关，未来工作可针对内部不确定性进行干预。

title: Modularized Reinforcement Learning on LLMs: From MDP Creation to Exploration and Learning
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to LLM post-training, yet the methods that dominate current pipelines, PPO and GRPO, represent only a narrow slice of what RL offers. Understanding why these methods prevail, and what alternatives exist, requires a principled examination of the design decisions that underlie any RL algorithm.
  This survey organizes that examination around three stages of algorithm construction. We begin with MDP creation: how the reward function, state space, action space, termination condition, and discount factor are, or could be, defined for LLM training. We then turn to exploration, covering temperature sampling, entropy regularization, intrinsic motivation, tree search, and curriculum learning. Finally, we address learning along four classical RL dimensions: model-free versus model-based, value-based versus policy-based versus actor-critic, on-policy versus off-policy, and credit assignment, including both Monte Carlo methods, which rely on full return estimates, and bootstrapping methods, which update estimates using other learned predictions.
  Mapping the LLM literature onto this taxonomy reveals a strikingly non-uniform distribution of research effort. Critic-free policy gradients and Monte Carlo credit assignment are densely populated, while value-based methods, off-policy actor-critic training, and bootstrapping-based credit assignment remain largely unexplored despite well-established counterparts in classical RL. These gaps represent concrete opportunities for transferring proven RL techniques to LLM training.
  By making these gaps explicit alongside the methods that have proven effective, this survey offers researchers in both RL and LLMs a shared framework for understanding current practice and identifying promising directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了强化学习（RL）在LLM后训练中的应用，指出当前主流方法（PPO、GRPO）只代表了RL的一小部分。作者从MDP构建、探索策略、学习范式三个维度构建分析框架，揭示了LLM领域在RL方法选择上的严重不均衡：无评论家策略梯度与蒙特卡洛信用分配研究密集，而基于值的方法、离策略AC训练和自举法信用分配则几乎空白，为未来研究指明了方向。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM后训练中RL方法选择过于狭窄（仅PPO和GRPO），缺乏对更广泛RL技术空间的系统性审视。作者希望构建一个统一框架，帮助研究者理解现有方法的优劣并发现尚未被充分探索但具有潜力的RL技术。
AI.method: 提出三阶段分析框架：1) MDP构建（奖励函数、状态空间、动作空间、终止条件、折扣因子）；2) 探索策略（温度采样、熵正则化、内在动机、树搜索、课程学习）；3) 学习范式（无模型vs有模型、基于值vs基于策略vsAC、在策略vs离策略、信用分配中的蒙特卡洛vs自举法）。基于此框架对现有LLM+RL文献进行映射分类。
AI.result: 发现LLM领域的RL研究分布极不均匀：无评论家策略梯度和蒙特卡洛信用分配方法研究密集；而基于值的方法、离策略AC训练、自举法信用分配等在经典RL中成熟的技术在LLM后训练中几乎未被探索。
AI.conclusion: 这些研究空白是直接将经典RL技术迁移到LLM训练中的具体机会，论文为RL和LLM研究者提供了理解当前实践和识别未来方向的共享框架。

title: KaLM-Reranker-V1: Fast but Not Late Interaction for Compressed Document Reranking
summary: As retrieval systems scale, high-quality reranking becomes increasingly important. However, most existing rerankers, whether encoder-based or decoder-based, jointly encode the query and passage, tightly coupling their computation and limiting deployment efficiency as well as flexibility. We present KaLM-Reranker-V1, a fast but not late-interaction (FBNL) reranker that decouples query and passage computation while retaining expressive relevance modeling. Built on an encoder-decoder architecture, KaLM-Reranker-V1 uses the encoder to pre-encode passages with Matryoshka embedding pooling, while the decoder models the system instruction, user instruction, and query intent; cross-attention then captures relevance between the query context and passage representations. This design makes KaLM-Reranker-V1 efficient through decoupled passage encoding, yet not late interaction, by preserving rich relevance modeling through cross-attention. We instantiate KaLM-Reranker-V1 in three sizes, Nano, Small, and Large, with 0.27B, 1B, and 4B activated parameters, respectively. Extensive experiments on BEIR, MIRACL, and LMEB demonstrate that KaLM-Reranker-V1 achieves strong reranking performance with superior efficiency. On BEIR, KaLM-Reranker-V1 achieves state-of-the-art performance, on par with strong industrial models such as the Qwen3-Reranker series; on MIRACL, despite not being extensively trained on multilingual data, KaLM-Reranker-V1 still shows excellent reranking performance. Moreover, on LMEB, reranking models demonstrate a clear advantage, with even the 0.27B Nano model remaining competitive with 7-12B embedding models.

AI.tldr: KaRM-Reranker-V1 是一种基于编码器-解码器架构的重排序模型，通过解耦查询和段落计算提升效率，同时利用交叉注意力机制保持丰富的相关性建模能力，在 BEIR、MIRACL 和 LMEB 基准上取得了优异的性能和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有重排序模型（无论是基于编码器还是解码器）通常将查询和段落联合编码，导致计算紧密耦合，限制了部署效率和灵活性。为了解耦查询和段落计算同时保持表达能力，作者提出了 KaLM-Reranker-V1。
AI.method: 采用编码器-解码器架构：编码器通过 Matryoshka 嵌入池化预编码段落，解码器建模系统指令、用户指令和查询意图，交叉注意力机制捕获查询上下文与段落表示之间的相关性。这种方法被称为“快速但非后期交互”（FBNL）。
AI.result: 在 BEIR 上达到与 Qwen3-Reranker 系列等强工业模型相当的最优性能；在 MIRACL 上展现了优异的跨语言重排序能力；在 LMEB 上即使 0.27B 的 Nano 模型也能与 7-12B 的嵌入模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: KaRM-Reranker-V1 通过解耦段落编码提升了效率，同时通过交叉注意力保留了丰富的相关性建模，证明了该设计在重排序任务上兼具高性能和高效率的优势。

title: AgentLens: Interpretable Safety Steering via Mechanistic Subspaces for Multi-Turn Coding Agent
summary: Coding agents based on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable autonomous capabilities, but they also introduce significant safety and misuse risks during multi-turn interactions with external environments. Existing safety mechanisms mainly rely on external guardrails, which have a limited ability to perform fine-grained behavioral control during execution. Meanwhile, recent mechanistic interpretability methods for LLM safety are mostly confined to single-turn or jailbreak-style QA settings, limiting their ability to capture the evolving risk dynamics of multi-turn agent execution. In this paper, we investigate the safety of multi-turn coding agents from an internal perspective. We propose AgentLens (Mechanistic Subspace Intervention and Steering), a white-box defense framework that performs runtime safety detection and representation-level mitigation for coding agents. Unlike conventional agent guardrails, AgentLens detect harmful execution states from step-level hidden representations and mitigate unsafe behavior by intervening in a 10-dimensional subspace within a single layer. To support this research, we introduce the Mechanistic Agent Safety (MAS) benchmark, comprising comprehensively annotated multi-turn execution trajectories across 194 tasks using LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, and Gemma-2-9B. Extensive experiments show that AgentLens achieves strong safety detection performance, provides preliminary evidence for lookahead risk anticipation, and substantially reduces harmful actions of the coding agent, establishing a foundation for applying mechanistic interpretability to dynamic LLM agent safety. The code is available at: https://github.com/EddyLuo1232/AgentLens

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentLens，一个基于机械可解释性的白盒防御框架，通过在单层10维子空间中进行表示级干预，实现对多轮编码代理在运行时阶段的安全检测和行为缓解。实验表明该方法能有效检测有害状态并减少有害行为。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM编码代理在多轮交互中存在安全与滥用风险，而外部防护栏难以进行细粒度行为控制，现有机械可解释性方法多局限于单轮或越狱式QA场景，无法捕捉多轮代理执行中动态演变的风险。
AI.method: 提出AgentLens框架，从隐藏表示中检测有害执行状态，并通过在单层内10维子空间进行干预来缓解不安全行为；同时构建MAS基准，包含194个任务的多轮执行轨迹及详细标注。
AI.result: AgentLens在安全检测上表现优异，具有前向风险预判能力，并显著减少了编码代理的有害行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为将机械可解释性应用于动态LLM代理安全建立了基础。

title: On the Curse of Dimensionality in Private Sparse Covariance Estimation and PCA
summary:
We study high-dimensional differentially private (DP) covariance estimation in the operator norm, and principal component analysis (PCA), under $k$-row-column sparsity ($k$-RCS) of the covariance matrix. In the non-private setting, it is known that $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ samples suffice to solve both of these problems. However, the only comparable result known under DP (Wang et al. 2021) requires $Ω(d)$ samples under standard parameterizations of the problem. We investigate when this curse of dimensionality is inherent for sparse covariance estimation tasks under DP.
  On the upper bound front, we show that a $\mathsf{poly}(k, \log d)$ sample complexity for PCA is possible under DP, if we also posit sparsity of the leading eigenvector. We complement this result with $\mathsf{poly}(d)$ lower bounds under DP for both sparse covariance estimation and PCA, establishing an exponential gap between the private and non-private variants of these problems when $k = \mathsf{polylog}(d)$. To our knowledge, no such separation has previously been demonstrated for any sparse estimation problems in private high-dimensional statistics. Our techniques are flexible enough that they imply stronger lower bounds even for the well-studied problem of standard DP PCA, without sparsity assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高维差分隐私协方差估计与主成分分析在k行-列稀疏条件下的样本复杂度，发现差分隐私下存在维度灾难，首次证明了稀疏估计问题中隐私与非隐私版本之间的指数级差距。
AI.motivation: 探究在差分隐私约束下，稀疏协方差估计任务中维度灾难何时是固有的，以及隐私与非隐私版本之间是否存在样本复杂度的本质差距。
AI.method: 上界方面，假设主特征向量稀疏时，证明了多项式级别样本复杂度；下界方面，利用灵活的证明技术，对稀疏协方差估计和PCA均给出多项式下界，并推广到标准差分隐私PCA问题。
AI.result: 当k=polylog(d)时，差分隐私与非隐私版本的样本复杂度存在指数级差距；主特征向量稀疏时，差分隐私PCA可实现多项式样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 高维差分隐私下的稀疏协方差估计存在固有的维度灾难，即使利用稀疏性也难以消除隐私带来的样本复杂度代价。

title: Bagpiper-TTS: Natural Language Guided Universal Speech Synthesis
summary: Classical TTS systems typically rely on rigid input formats and predefined metadata slots, limiting their ability to fulfill flexible user requirements. This paper introduces Bagpiper-TTS, a universal speech synthesis system that deals with diverse natural language user requests. Given a natural language prompt, Bagpiper-TTS first reasons over the users' intent to derive a rich caption, i.e., a comprehensive textual blueprint encompassing both transcription and nuanced metadata. Subsequently, this caption guides the synthesis of the target speech. Our model inherently supports a broad spectrum of tasks besides classical TTS applications, including multi-talker, intent-to-speech, role-play synthesis, singing voice synthesis, and more. Experimental results demonstrate that Bagpiper-TTS achieves an 1.7% Word Error Rate (WER) on the Seed-TTS-Eval benchmark and match the performance of dedicated models in both LLM-as-a-judge and human subjective evaluations across multiple applications.

AI.tldr: Bagpiper-TTS是一个通用语音合成系统，通过自然语言提示理解用户意图，生成包含转录和元数据的详细文本蓝图，然后合成目标语音，支持多说话人、意图到语音、角色扮演、歌声合成等多种任务，在Seed-TTS-Eval基准上达到1.7%的词错误率。
AI.motivation: 传统的TTS系统依赖刚性输入格式和预定义元数据槽，无法满足灵活的用户需求，因此需要一种能够处理多样化自然语言用户请求的通用语音合成系统。
AI.method: 给定自然语言提示，Bagpiper-TTS首先推理用户意图，生成包含转录和元数据的丰富文本蓝图，然后根据该蓝图合成目标语音。
AI.result: 在Seed-TTS-Eval基准上达到1.7%的词错误率，在LLM作为评判者和人类主观评估中，多项应用均达到专用模型的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: Bagpiper-TTS是一种通用的语音合成系统，能够处理多样化的自然语言用户请求，支持经典TTS之外的多种任务，性能优异。

title: Skin-Deep: A Geometric Diagnostic for Alignment Fragility in Large Language Model Representations
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. The first two authors contributed equally. Code (pre-attack GFS diagnostic): https://github.com/js-lee-AI/skin-deep
summary: Alignment tuning is meant to make harmful-request refusal robust, yet this safety behavior can be erased by a small set of benign fine-tuning examples. This is a deployment risk for open-weight models because a checkpoint can pass refusal tests at release time and later lose refusal under low-cost downstream fine-tuning. Prior work has established these refusal failures, but existing studies do not show how to detect this fragility in the aligned model itself before an attack or fine-tuning intervention is run. We introduce Skin-Deep, a geometric diagnostic that detects alignment fragility directly from the aligned model's hidden-state activations before such an intervention is run and compresses the layer-wise safety geometry into a single scalar, the Geometric Fragility Score (GFS). Applied to twenty-one instruction-tuned models spanning six alignment recipes and 3B--32B parameters, Skin-Deep reveals a recurring low-rank safety subspace across model families. Direction ablations show that removing directions in this subspace weakens harmful-request refusal, providing causal evidence that the recovered geometry underlies refusal behavior. Crucially, GFS identifies, before any fine-tuning, the initially safe model that retains the most refusal after small-scale LoRA fine-tuning. These results establish GFS as a practical pre-deployment diagnostic for flagging fragile refusal behavior without running an attack.

AI.tldr: 提出Skin-Deep几何诊断方法，通过几何脆弱性分数(GFS)在微调攻击前检测对齐模型的安全脆弱性，揭示低秩安全子空间的存在，并证明GFS能预判模型在LoRA微调后拒答能力的保持程度。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐模型在发布时可通过拒绝测试，但低成本的微调（如少量良性示例）可能消除其安全行为，而当前缺乏在攻击或微调前检测这种脆弱性的方法。
AI.method: 从对齐模型的隐藏状态激活中提取层间安全几何结构，将其压缩为单个标量GFS；通过方向消融实验验证低秩安全子空间对拒答行为的关键作用。
AI.result: 覆盖6种对齐方法、21个指令微调模型（3B-32B参数），发现跨模型家族的通用低秩安全子空间；GFS能在微调前准确识别出保留拒答能力最强的初始安全模型。
AI.conclusion: GFS可作为实用的部署前诊断工具，无需运行攻击即可标记脆弱的拒绝行为，为开放权重模型的安全部署提供预警机制。

title: Learning by Shifting: Temporal View Construction for Time Series Contrastive Learning
comment: Published in the European Conference on Machine Learning and Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECMLPKDD)
summary: Supervised learning demands large quantities of labeled data, a bottleneck that is expensive and reliant on domain-specific expertise. Self-supervised learning, particularly contrastive learning, has emerged as a compelling alternative, enabling rich representation learning directly from unlabeled data. Yet its success hinges critically on the design of positive and negative sample pairs. Existing approaches for time series rely on hand-crafted augmentations and masking heuristics that embed strong domain assumptions, often limiting generalization across diverse temporal patterns and potentially introducing spurious correlations. In this work, we challenge this paradigm by demonstrating that explicitly encoding temporal shift invariance through a simple, deterministic view construction is sufficient to learn strong representations for time series classification. By exploiting temporal structure, our method, Shift Invariant Feature Training (ShiFT), achieves state-of-the-art performance on six diverse real-world time series benchmark datasets, as well as the UCR and UEA archives, while reducing training time. Beyond empirical performance, we present a systematic analysis of contrastive learning dynamics in time series settings, examining the effects of batch size and the number of negatives on downstream performance. Our findings provide practical insights for designing efficient contrastive learning frameworks for time series representation learning. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sfi-norwai/ShiFT.

AI.tldr: ShiFT方法通过显式编码时间平移不变性，利用简单确定的视图构建在时间序列自监督学习中取得SOTA性能，并系统分析了对比学习动态。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列对比学习方法依赖手工数据增强和掩码启发式，嵌入强领域假设，限制泛化能力并可能引入虚假相关性。
AI.method: 提出Shift Invariant Feature Training (ShiFT)，通过简单确定的视图构建显式编码时间平移不变性，利用时间结构学习表征。
AI.result: 在6个真实世界时间序列基准数据集及UCR、UEA档案上达到SOTA性能，同时减少训练时间。
AI.conclusion: 时间平移不变性本身足以学习强时间序列表征，为设计高效对比学习框架提供了实用见解。

title: IndicGuard: A Multilingual Safety Guard Model and Dataset for Indic Languages
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve widespread integration across diverse linguistic landscapes, ensuring their safety and alignment with regional normative values remains a critical challenge. Current safety mechanisms are predominantly optimized for English-centric frameworks, often failing to capture the unique socio-cultural sensitivities and localized categories of harm inherent to the Indic region. To address this gap, we introduce IndicGuard, a multilingual safety guard model and dataset for Indic languages. We construct a high-volume, culturally nuanced safety dataset encompassing ten major Indic languages, systematically curated to capture regional harms, sensitive socio-political contexts, and adversarial jailbreaks. Leveraging this corpus, we fine-tune a 4B-parameter instruction-tuned model based on Gemma-3-4B-IT to serve as a multilingual safety guardrail for real-time content moderation and policy compliance checking. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate that IndicGuard significantly enhances LLM robustness against localized vulnerabilities, achieving high moderation consistency across different conversational turns. Crucially, IndicGuard consistently outperforms the existing baseline model, CultureGuard, across evaluated languages. Finally, we demonstrate that our model effectively generalizes to low-resource Indic languages excluded from training, substantiating the structural robustness and cross-lingual transfer capabilities of the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了IndicGuard，一个面向10种印度语言的 multilingual 安全护栏模型和数据集，通过微调Gemma-3-4B-IT实现跨语言内容审核，显著优于现有基线CultureGuard，并能泛化到未见过的低资源语言。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全机制主要针对英语优化，缺乏对印度地区独特社会文化和敏感性伤害类别的覆盖，亟需一个面向印度语言的多语言安全模型。
AI.method: 构建涵盖10种主要印度语言的高量、文化敏感的安全数据集，包含区域性伤害、敏感社会政治背景和对抗性越狱攻击；基于Gemma-3-4B-IT模型进行微调，得到IndicGuard作为多语言安全护栏。
AI.result: IndicGuard在多个评估中显著增强了LLM对本地化漏洞的鲁棒性，在对话轮次间保持高一致性，并在所有评估语言上一致优于CultureGuard；同时有效泛化到训练中未包含的低资源印度语言。
AI.conclusion: IndicGuard证明了面向印度语言的多语言安全框架的有效性，具备良好的跨语言迁移能力和结构鲁棒性，为低资源语言的安全对齐提供了可行方案。

title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; includes Supplementary Information. Code: https://github.com/VISTA-Stanford/vista-architect (tag v0.1.0-preprint, commit 8837d44)
summary:
We introduce VISTA Architect, a database-oriented AI architecture for integrating large language models (LLMs) with longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). At ingestion, it transforms complex clinical documentation into a persistent, provenance-linked knowledge graph, eliminating repeated reprocessing of raw records at query time. The architecture has two layers: a source-faithful MEDS Graph preserving granular EHR structure with full provenance, and a clinically abstracted Timeline Object Architecture (TOA) that uses graph-guided LLM extraction to synthesize a concise timeline of deduplicated, temporally coherent clinical events. This addresses key limitations of direct long-context prompting and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which often miss temporal relationships and incur high cost and latency from repeated raw-text processing. By precomputing clinical synthesis once, downstream queries access an organized patient state and traverse to source documentation only when detailed verification is needed.
