  We demonstrate the system in multidisciplinary thoracic oncology tumor boards at Stanford Medicine, where precise reconstruction of patient histories is critical. Across 1,180 patients, VISTA Architect achieved 96.4% accuracy (mean 9.75/10) on 15 tumor board-salient variables (17,700 evaluations; 95% CI 96.1-96.7%), surpassing a matched BM25 RAG baseline and recent benchmarks for LLM-based clinical extraction. An agentic interface reduced preparation for a 30-patient held-out cohort to about 2.2 minutes without sacrificing accuracy. While configured here for thoracic oncology, the modular design adapts to other specialties through customizable event definitions, episode structures, and agentic tools; validation beyond thoracic oncology remains future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VISTA Architect，一种面向数据库的AI架构，将大语言模型与纵向电子健康记录结合。通过预构建持久化的知识图谱和临床时间线，解决了长上下文提示和RAG在时序关系捕捉、成本与延迟方面的局限。在斯坦福医学中心1180名胸外科肿瘤患者中，取得了96.4%的高准确率，并将30名患者的准备时间缩短至约2.2分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型与电子健康记录集成的方法（如长上下文提示和RAG）存在三大问题：难以捕捉事件间的时序关系、对原始文本重复处理导致高成本和高延迟、缺乏结构化的患者状态组织。
AI.method: 提出两层架构：底层为保留完整溯源和细粒度EHR结构的MEDS图；上层为临床抽象时间线对象架构（TOA），通过图引导的LLM提取生成去重、时序连贯的临床事件摘要。预计算一次后，下游查询可直接访问组织好的患者状态。
AI.result: 在斯坦福医学中心胸外科肿瘤多学科委员会中，对1180名患者的15个变量进行17700次评估，准确率96.4%（平均9.75/10），超越BM25 RAG基线。智能体界面将30名患者的准备时间降至约2.2分钟，且不牺牲准确性。
AI.conclusion: VISTA Architect通过预计算结构化临床摘要有效解决了时序关系捕捉和成本延迟问题，在胸外科肿瘤领域表现优异。模块化设计可扩展至其他专科，但跨专科验证尚待未来研究。

title: A Standard Processing Pipeline for High-accuracy Measurement of Few-shot Regression on Laser Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy
summary: Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) faces challenges in high-accuracy quantitative measurement under few-shot scenarios due to spectral noise and data scarcity. Traditional preprocessing methods often fail to preserve subtle spectral features or capture nonlinear correlations. This work proposes a standardized processing pipeline integrating diffusion-based denoising, attention-based autoencoder for dimensionality reduction, group shuffling data augmentation, and ordinary least squares regression. The diffusion module employs a 3D UNet architecture to remove spectral noise while preserving essential emission features. The attention-autoencoder captures nonlinear spectral correlations, effectively reducing high-dimensional spectral data to compact latent representations. Group shuffling data augmentation enhances model robustness by creating synthetic samples through feature group permutation. Experimental results on multiple elemental concentrations demonstrate that our Diffusion-DA-AE pipeline achieves superior performance with a mean RMAE of 0.2847, representing 37.7\% and 37.6\% improvements over baseline autoencoder and traditional PCA-PLS regression, respectively. The framework's effectiveness validates its generalizability and establishes a new benchmark for few-shot LIBS regression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合扩散去噪、注意力自编码器、组洗牌数据增强和普通最小二乘回归的标准化处理流程（Diffusion-DA-AE），用于解决激光诱导击穿光谱（LIBS）在少样本场景下的高精度定量测量难题，实验表明该方法在平均RMAE上达到0.2847，比基线方法提升约37.7%。
AI.motivation: LIBS技术在少样本场景下存在光谱噪声和数据稀缺问题，传统预处理方法难以保留细微光谱特征或捕捉非线性相关性，迫切需要一种更有效的标准化处理流程。
AI.method: 提出Diffusion-DA-AE流程：1）基于3D UNet架构的扩散去噪模块去除光谱噪声；2）注意力自编码器捕捉非线性光谱相关性，实现高维光谱数据的降维；3）组洗牌数据增强通过特征组置换生成合成样本提升模型鲁棒性；4）采用普通最小二乘回归进行定量分析。
AI.result: 在多种元素浓度实验中，该方法平均RMAE为0.2847，相比基线自编码器和传统PCA-PLS回归分别提升37.7%和37.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架的有效性验证了其泛化能力，为少样本LIBS回归任务建立了新的基准。

title: DynamicMem: A Long-Horizon Memory Benchmark in Real-World Settings
summary: LLM agents increasingly act as personal assistants that must remember a user's profile over months: who they are (attributes), what they routinely do (habits), and what they prefer (preferences), and keep it updated as jobs, routines, and tastes drift. Existing benchmarks evaluate this "memory" ability through short, simplified interactions, missing three core properties of real behavior: the profile is heterogeneous, with attributes, habits, and preferences evolving on different timelines; changes are driven by external context such as seasons and life events; and evidence is rarely stated explicitly, instead scattered across many small actions in different apps that a memory system must infer from. We introduce DynamicMem, a synthetic benchmark that constructs 15 months of activity per user, providing long-term multi-app data that real users' privacy keeps out of reach. It provides user-consistent trajectories averaging 2.2M tokens and 1,772 grounded events per user across 16 applications such as e-commerce, fitness, and social platforms. The profile evolves over this period and is never given explicitly: each attribute, habit, or preference must be inferred from small signals scattered across apps. We evaluate at five quarterly checkpoints to track how systems scale as history grows. Benchmarking five representative systems exposes problems a single accuracy score hides: (i) profile reconstruction degrades with history length while service-task accuracy stays flat, despite both drawing on the same memory; (ii) no system both keeps facts that stay true and replaces facts that change, with errors clustering on preferences and on naming the exact referent; and (iii) over 93% of failures trace to what the memory retrieves, not to the model writing the answer, so the largest room for improvement lies in memory itself. Code: https://wenyaxie023.github.io/DynamicMem/

AI.tldr: DynamicMem是一个合成基准，通过构建15个月的多APP用户活动数据（平均220万token/用户），评估LLM代理在异质性用户画像（属性、习惯、偏好）随时间演变下的长期记忆能力。实验发现：记忆检索是93%以上失败的原因，且现有系统无法同时保持稳定事实和更新变化事实。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准仅通过短期简化交互评估LLM代理的记忆能力，忽略了真实行为的三个核心特性：用户画像的异质性（属性、习惯、偏好以不同时间尺度演化）、变化由外部环境驱动（季节、生活事件等）、证据分散在多APP的小动作中需系统推断。隐私限制使得真实长期多APP数据不可获取，因此需要合成基准来填补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 构建DynamicMem合成基准，为每个用户生成15个月的活动轨迹，覆盖16个应用（电商、健身、社交等），平均220万token和1772个基于事件的行为。用户画像随时间演化且从不显式给出，需从跨APP的微小信号中推断。在5个季度检查点评估系统随历史增长的扩展能力。
AI.result: 评估5个代表性系统发现三个关键问题：1）画像重构准确率随历史长度下降，但服务任务准确率保持不变（尽管都依赖同一记忆）；2）没有系统能同时保持正确事实和替换变化事实，错误集中在偏好和指代准确命名上；3）超过93%的失败根源在于记忆检索环节，而非模型生成答案的能力。
AI.conclusion: 提升LLM代理长期记忆性能的最大改进空间在于记忆系统本身（检索机制），而非下游推理模型。现有系统在处理用户画像的动态更新上存在根本性缺陷，需要设计能同时兼顾事实保持与事实替换的记忆机制。

title: Safety-Aware Evaluation of LLM-Generated Driver Intervention Messages through Multi-Task Risk Fusion
summary: Existing driver intervention systems rely on auditory alerts and fixed templates, failing to leverage multi-task recognition outputs. General-purpose metrics such as BLEU and BERTScore cannot capture intervention-specific quality dimensions including risk-urgency alignment, cognitive load, and driver acceptability. In this paper, we propose the Driver Safety-Aware Intervention Score (DSAIS), a domain-specific metric evaluating five dimensions through a hybrid architecture combining lightweight rule-based computation with LLM Judge evaluation, together with an end-to-end framework integrating four-task recognition outputs into an LLM through risk fusion, state history management, and dynamic prompt construction. Experiments on the AIDE dataset with five models and seven conditions demonstrate that DSAIS achieves ICC 0.798-0.840 across three architecturally distinct judges and Cohen's d > 1.5 across all control conditions. Multi-dimensional sub-score analysis quantifies the contextual adaptability gap between rule-based and LLM-based systems, revealing that multi-task integration improves contextual relevance by 9.1% over rule-based baselines. Ablation experiments demonstrate that each framework component contributes to contextual relevance, with sub-score decomposition revealing gains that aggregate scoring masks. Driver emotion recognition is identified as the most critical upstream factor, and compact local LLMs (7B--9B parameters) achieve quality superior to API-based models, providing practical design guidelines for in-vehicle deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向驾驶员安全干预的专用评估指标DSAIS及端到端框架，融合多任务识别输出与大语言模型，实验证明其有效性优于传统通用指标。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶员干预系统依赖固定模板和通用指标（如BLEU、BERTScore），无法捕捉干预质量的关键维度（风险-紧迫性对齐、认知负荷、驾驶员接受度），缺乏针对干预场景的专用评估方法。
AI.method: 提出DSAIS指标（五维度混合架构：轻量规则计算+LLM Judge评估），以及端到端框架（四任务识别输出融合、风险融合、状态历史管理、动态提示构建）。在AIDE数据集上用5个模型、7种条件进行实验。
AI.result: DSAIS在三个不同架构评判者间ICC达0.798-0.840，所有控制条件下Cohen's d > 1.5；多任务集成使上下文相关性比基于规则的基线提高9.1%；消融实验验证各组件贡献；驾驶员情绪识别是最关键的上游因素；7B-9B参数本地LLM效果优于API模型。
AI.conclusion: DSAIS是有效的领域专用评估指标，多任务融合框架能显著提升干预质量，为车载部署提供实用设计指导（推荐紧凑本地LLM方案）。

title: VegSim: A Geospatial World Model for Scenario-Conditioned Vegetation Simulation
summary: Vegetation monitoring under climate stress requires answering not only how it will evolve given the expected weather, but how it would respond to alternative meteorological conditions. Forecasting models return the expected vegetation state for the observed weather and cannot answer these scenario-conditioned questions, because future weather is fixed to the recorded trajectory. We present VegSim, a geospatial world model for scenario-conditioned vegetation simulation. VegSim infers a latent vegetation state from sparse satellite-derived NDVI histories, past meteorological covariates, and static spatial context, propagates it forward under future weather forcing through recurrent latent dynamics, and decodes predictive NDVI quantiles at each lead time. Because future forcing enters as a controllable input, the same trained model supports probabilistic forecasting under observed weather and conditional simulation under user-defined meteorological forcing, without supervision on scenario responses. We evaluate VegSim on GreenEarthNet across in-distribution data and spatial, temporal, and joint spatial-temporal shift, where it achieves strong point and probabilistic accuracy against time series and Earth observation forecasting baselines while using a compact architecture. We then simulate vegetation responses across Europe under four meteorological scenarios, and in a France summer 2022 case study, obtaining spatially coherent patterns consistent with known sensitivity to temperature and precipitation. The code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/vegsim.

AI.tldr: VegSim是一个地理空间世界模型，能够基于用户定义的气象条件进行情景驱动式植被模拟，支持概率预测和条件仿真，在多种分布偏移场景下表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有植被监测模型只能基于观测到的实际天气进行预测，无法回答"如果气象条件不同，植被会如何变化"这类情景驱动问题。本文旨在开发一个能够接受未来气象强迫作为可控输入的地理空间世界模型。
AI.method: VegSim从稀疏的卫星NDVI历史、过去气象协变量和静态空间上下文中推断潜在植被状态，通过循环潜在动力学在未来气象强迫下向前传播，并在每个预测步长解码预测性NDVI分位数。未来强迫作为可控输入，同一模型同时支持观测天气下的概率预测和用户定义气象强迫下的条件模拟。
AI.result: 在GreenEarthNet数据集上，VegSim在分布内数据以及空间、时间、时空联合偏移下，相比时间序列和地球观测预测基线，取得了更强的点预测和概率预测精度，同时架构更紧凑。在欧洲四种气象情景模拟和法国2022年夏季案例研究中，获得了与温度和降水敏感性一致的空间连贯模式。
AI.conclusion: VegSim成功实现了情景条件驱动的地理空间植被模拟，能够在不依赖情景响应监督的条件下，灵活回答"what-if"植被变化问题，具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Explanation-Guided Medical Named Entity Recognition with Stability and Boundary Awareness for Atopic Dermatitis
comment: Corresponding author: Xue Jiang, E-mail: xuejiang1025@126.com
summary: Objective: This study aims to improve the reliability and robustness of medical named entity recognition (NER) in Chinese atopic dermatitis (AD) clinical texts through explanation-guided learning. Methods: We propose a stability and boundary-aware explanation-guided NER framework. Perturbation-based analysis is used to evaluate explanation stability and entity boundary sensitivity. An adaptive fusion strategy dynamically combines local and global explanation to generate more reliable token-level explanations. The fused explanation signals are further incorporated into model training through stability, boundary-aware, and consistency constraints. Results: Experiments on Chinese AD NER datasets show that the proposed framework improves explanation robustness and achieves consistent performance gains across multiple NER models. The adaptive fusion strategy also provides more stable explanations and stronger boundary perception than individual explanation methods. Conclusion: The proposed method effectively integrates reliable explanation signals into medical NER training, improving both recognition performance and explanation reliability. The framework provides a practical and generalizable solution for explainable medical NER and offers reliable support for downstream clinical decision-making and medical knowledge applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种稳定性和边界感知的解释引导框架，通过自适应融合局部与全局解释信号来提升中文特应性皮炎临床文本中医学命名实体识别的可靠性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 提升中文特应性皮炎临床文本中医学命名实体识别的可靠性和鲁棒性，使模型不仅表现更好，还能提供可信的解释支持下游临床决策。
AI.method: 提出稳定性与边界感知的解释引导NER框架：利用扰动分析评估解释稳定性与实体边界敏感性；采用自适应融合策略动态结合局部与全局解释生成更可靠的词级解释；通过稳定性约束、边界感知约束和一致性约束将融合的解释信号融入模型训练。
AI.result: 在中文AD NER数据集上，该框架提升了解释鲁棒性，并在多个NER模型上取得一致性能提升；自适应融合策略相比单一解释方法提供了更稳定的解释和更强的边界感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效将可靠解释信号融入医学NER训练，同时提升了识别性能与解释可靠性，为可解释医学NER提供了实用且泛化的解决方案，并为下游临床决策和医学知识应用提供了可靠支持。

title: Beyond Penalizing Mistakes: Stabilizing Efficiency Training in Large Reasoning Models via Adaptive Correct-Only Rewards
summary: Training large language models to reason efficiently is a critical challenge. While integrating length-penalizing rewards into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) aims to reduce verbosity, it frequently triggers reward collapse, severely degrading reasoning capabilities. Through a systematic evaluation of various reward configurations, we identify the root mechanism: GRPO's group normalization creates divergent advantages when incorrect answers receive continuous length penalties. Consequently, methods penalizing the length of incorrect answers are structurally prone to collapse under sustained optimization. Furthermore, restricting penalties exclusively to correct answers avoids this primary failure, but leaves the model susceptible to a stochastic collapse driven by response over-compression. To robustly prevent both failure modes, we propose ACOER (Adaptive Correct-Only Efficiency Reward). ACOER eliminates the structural penalty loop by isolating brevity bonuses to correct completions and prevents stochastic compression via dynamic budget normalization and control-loop penalty adjustments. Evaluated across diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ACOER improves overall accuracy compared to the base model while reducing token generation by over 60%, establishing a fundamentally stable approach for efficiency-aware optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACOER方法，通过仅对正确回答给予简洁奖励、动态预算归一化和控制环惩罚调整，在提升数学推理准确率的同时减少60%以上的token生成，从根本上解决了GRPO在优化推理效率时引发的奖励崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 训练大语言模型高效推理是一个关键挑战。在GRPO中加入长度惩罚奖励虽旨在减少冗长输出，但常常触发奖励崩溃，严重损害推理能力。
AI.method: ACOER (Adaptive Correct-Only Efficiency Reward)：1) 将简洁奖励仅限制在正确回答上，消除结构性惩罚循环；2) 通过动态预算归一化防止随机压缩崩溃；3) 控制环惩罚调整实现稳定优化。
AI.result: 在多个数学推理基准上，ACOER相比基础模型提升了整体准确率，同时减少了60%以上的token生成量。
AI.conclusion: ACOER建立了一种本质上稳定的效率感知优化方法，同时避免了因惩罚错误回答导致的奖励崩溃和因过度压缩导致的随机崩溃两种失败模式。

title: SPOTR: Spatio-temporal Pooling One-Token Reconstruction for Universal Physiological Signal Self-supervised Learning
comment: The paper has been accepted by IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: Physiological signals such as EEG, ECG, and PPG are widely used in clinical monitoring. Recent self-supervised learning (SSL) methods offer an attractive way to leverage unlabeled recordings, yet they still fall short in practice. In particular, current SSL methods struggle across heterogeneous datasets, often distorting clinically meaningful structures or learning shortcuts from temporal and cross-channel redundancy. Consequently, existing SSL methods often deliver limited performance under linear probing, a lightweight adaptation setting that better matches real-world medical scenarios. Moreover, most Transformer-based SSL models encode a flattened spatiotemporal token sequence, incurring high computation and memory cost, and are typically developed within a single modality. To address these limitations, we present SPOTR (Spatio-temporal Pooling One-Token Reconstruction), a compress-reconstruct pretraining framework that introduces a single-token global bottleneck for physiological signals. SPOTR compresses each waveform into a single-token representation and reconstructs the signal conditioned only on this representation. Meanwhile, SPOTR introduces an efficient spatio-temporal compaction module to reduce computation and memory cost. Pretrained on 20 datasets spanning EEG, iEEG, ECG, and PPG, SPOTR consistently outperforms the strongest baseline under linear probing, improving average AUC by 18.49%, 21.71%, 17.86%, and 4.64%, respectively. Compared with a representative general-purpose time-series foundation model, SPOTR achieves around 78% lower latency and 52% lower peak GPU memory on average. The code can be found at https://github.com/5GYYYYY/SPOTR.

AI.tldr: SPOTR是一个针对生理信号（EEG、ECG、PPG等）的压缩-重构自监督预训练框架，通过单token全局瓶颈和时空压缩模块，在跨数据集线性探测中显著优于现有方法，并大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督学习方法在处理异质生理信号数据集时表现不佳，常扭曲临床有意义的结构或学习冗余捷径，且Transformer模型计算成本高、多模态适应性差。
AI.method: 提出SPOTR框架，采用压缩-重构范式：将每个波形压缩为单token表示，仅依赖该表示重构信号；同时引入高效的时空压缩模块降低计算和内存开销。
AI.result: 在EEG、iEEG、ECG、PPG共20个数据集上预训练，线性探测下平均AUC分别提升18.49%、21.71%、17.86%和4.64%；相比通用时间序列基础模型，延迟降低约78%，峰值GPU内存降低约52%。
AI.conclusion: SPOTR通过单token全局瓶颈和时空压缩，有效解决了跨数据集学习中的结构和冗余问题，在降低计算成本的同时实现了更优的线性探测性能，更适用于实际医疗场景。

title: Understanding Knowledge Distillation in Post-Training: When It Helps and When It Fails
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks, but their high computational cost limits deployment in resource-constrained environments. Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a teacher model of a larger size to a smaller student model. While prior work has mainly examined task-specific or small-scale settings, the post-training stage for building general instruction-following models has received limited attention. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study of KD in post-training using the large-scale Tulu 3 dataset. We find that KD outperforms supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in low-data regimes, but its advantage diminishes as more training data is added. Distilling from a stronger instruction-tuned teacher restores substantial gains even with abundant data, indicating that KD remains effective when the teacher provides knowledge that the student cannot easily acquire from the training data alone. We further study domain-specific, low-resource scenarios and propose a two-stage KD strategy that leverages synthetic teacher-labeled data followed by refinement on human annotations. This method consistently improves student performance, providing practical guidance for building compact models in data-scarce environments.

AI.tldr: 系统研究了知识蒸馏在后训练阶段的效果，发现数据少时KD优于SFT，但数据多时优势减弱；从更强指令微调教师蒸馏能恢复增益；提出两阶段KD策略在低资源场景有效。
AI.motivation: LLM计算成本高，知识蒸馏（KD）是低资源环境下的解决方案，但此前研究多限于任务特定或小规模场景，缺乏后训练阶段的大规模系统性研究。
AI.method: 在Tulu 3数据集上系统比较KD与SFT；研究不同数据规模、教师强度的影响；提出两阶段KD策略（先合成教师标签数据，再用人工标注精炼）。
AI.result: 低数据量时KD优于SFT，数据充足时优势消失；更强教师蒸馏可恢复增益；两阶段KD策略在低资源领域持续提升学生模型性能。
AI.conclusion: KD在数据稀缺场景下是构建紧凑LLM的有效策略；教师质量是关键因素；两阶段KD为低资源环境提供了实用指导。

title: Text Dictates, Music Decorates: Energy-based Attention for Editable Dance Motion Generation
summary: Choreographic motion generation poses unique challenges for AI, demanding precise semantic control over complex, temporally structured, and expressive full-body dynamics. While existing models can synthesize motion from music, they remain largely black boxes. Conversely, attempting to condition generation on both text and music frequently leads to modality collapse, where dense acoustic rhythms overwhelm sparse semantic text prompts, destroying user controllability. To resolve this spatial-temporal conflict, we propose STREAM (Structural-Temporal Rhythmic Energy-based Attention for Motion), a modality-decoupled diffusion transformer. STREAM strictly separates conditioning pathways: global text semantics dictate the kinematic structure via Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN), while a novel Bimodal Energy-Based Attention Module (BEAM) routes these features to the musical beat without overwriting the semantics. We further introduce Motorica++, a newly curated dataset enriched with domain-specific dance vocabulary and frame-level semantic annotations from existing Motorica dataset. Additionally, to rigorously quantify zero-shot editability, we propose the Exchange Evaluation Protocol and Editable Dance Score (EDS). Through extensive experiments, STREAM achieves state-of-the-art alignment between motion and music while perfectly preserving choreographic semantics, positioning AI not merely as a reactive synthesizer, but as a controllable, collaborative partner for artistic direction. The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/SeongJong-Yoo/STREAM.

AI.tldr: STREAM提出一种模态解耦的扩散Transformer，通过分离文本语义（AdaLN）和音乐节奏（BEAM模块）的生成路径，解决了文本-音乐共驱动舞蹈生成中的模态崩溃问题，在Motorica++数据集上实现了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有舞蹈生成模型多为黑盒，无法精细控制；同时用文本和音乐控制时，密集的声学节奏会淹没稀疏的语义提示，导致模态崩溃，用户可控性差。
AI.method: 提出STREAM框架：1）文本全局语义通过Adaptive Layer Normalization控制运动学结构；2）新颖的双模态能量注意力模块BEAM将特征路由到音乐节拍而不覆盖语义；3）构建Motorica++数据集，补充领域特定舞蹈词汇和帧级语义标注；4）提出Exchange Evaluation Protocol和Editable Dance Score用于量化零样本可编辑性。
AI.result: STREAM在运动-音乐对齐方面达到SOTA，同时完美保留舞蹈编排语义，实现了可控的、可协作的艺术生成。
AI.conclusion: STREAM将AI从被动的反应式合成器转变为可控的、协作式的艺术创作伙伴。

title: Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation: Mining Golden Trajectories from Rollouts
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by applying dense teacher supervision on student-sampled trajectories. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon mathematical reasoning exposes a reliability and efficiency problem: standard OPD assigns every sampled candidate the same long rollout budget, even though some trajectories may quickly become weakly aligned with the teacher and provide less useful supervision. Prior analyses suggest that successful OPD depends on local teacher-student compatibility, which can be measured by top-k overlap on student-visited prefixes. When this overlap is low, continuing to generate or train on long suffixes may waste computation and introduce noisy learning signal. To address this, we introduce Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation (PG-OPD), a simple rollout-allocation framework that uses fixed-length prefixes to estimate trajectory value before expensive long-horizon generation. PG-OPD first decodes every sampled candidate to the same prefix length, computes teacher-student top-k overlap within an early probe window of that prefix, and selectively continues high-overlap candidates to a fixed long length. Low-overlap candidates stop at the fixed prefix, avoiding unnecessary suffix generation. Across diverse teacher-student combinations on AMC, AIME, and HMMT benchmarks, PG-OPD improves average accuracy by up to 4.80 points while reducing training time by up to 2.46x. These results suggest that prefix-level compatibility provides a practical signal for directing OPD computation toward trajectories that remain learnable from the teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出PG-OPD方法，通过前缀级教师-学生兼容性评估来动态分配推理轨迹的生成预算，在数学推理任务上提升准确率并显著减少训练时间。
AI.motivation: 标准同策略蒸馏（OPD）在长程数学推理中存在效率问题：对所有采样轨迹分配相同的长rollout预算，导致与教师模型对齐度低的轨迹浪费计算资源并引入噪声信号。
AI.method: PG-OPD先对所有候选轨迹解码固定长度前缀，在前缀内的早探窗口中计算教师-学生的top-k重叠度，仅对高重叠度的轨迹继续生成长序列，低重叠度轨迹在前缀处停止。
AI.result: 在AMC、AIME、HMMT基准上，相比标准OPD，准确率提升高达4.80点，训练时间减少多达2.46倍。
AI.conclusion: 前缀级兼容性可作为引导OPD计算资源分配的有效信号，将计算集中在对齐度高的可学习轨迹上。

title: StatABench: Dataset and Framework for Evaluating Statistical Analysis Capabilities of LLMs
summary: Statistical analysis is a broad, complex field requiring both domain knowledge and tool proficiency. While prior work has evaluated large language models (LLMs) in this domain, existing benchmarks remain limited in scope and format. To bridge this gap, we introduce StatABench (Statistical AnalysisBenchmark), a benchmark designed to systematically assess LLMs' statistical analysis capabilities. StatABench comprises two complementary components: Stat-Closed, containing 404 questions across 18 statistical topics in multiple formats (multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, decision-making, and practical application), and Stat-Open, featuring 30 complex open-ended modeling tasks adapted from professional competitions. We evaluate diverse LLMs using the LangChain MCP framework and multiple data science agents, and assess Stat-Open solutions via a validated LLM-as-Judge protocol. Experiments show that even GPT-5.1 achieves only 68.6% on Stat-Closed, while the best open-source model reaches 60.6%. On Stat-Open, the top agent framework scores 61.86 on average. These results reveal the gap between current LLMs and reliable statistical analysis, highlighting persistent challenges in tool-grounded reasoning, methodological decision-making, and end-to-end statistical modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了StatABench基准测试，包含Stat-Closed（404题，覆盖18个统计主题）和Stat-Open（30个复杂建模任务）两部分，用于系统评估大语言模型在统计分析方面的能力。实验表明，即使最强的GPT-5.1在封闭题上仅达68.6%，最佳开源模型为60.6%，最佳智能体框架在开放题上平均得分61.86，揭示了当前LLM与可靠统计分析之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在统计分析领域的评估基准在范围和格式上存在局限，缺乏系统性、全面的评估手段，因此需要构建更完善的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建StatABench基准，包含Stat-Closed（404道多种格式的封闭题）和Stat-Open（30个源自专业竞赛的开放建模任务）；采用LangChain MCP框架和数据科学智能体评估多种LLM，并通过LLM-as-Judge协议评估Stat-Open解决方案。
AI.result: GPT-5.1在Stat-Closed上仅68.6%，最佳开源模型60.6%；最佳智能体框架在Stat-Open上平均61.86分。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在工具推理、方法决策和端到端统计建模方面仍面临挑战，距离可靠的统计分析能力存在显著差距。

title: Closed-loop Auto Research for Molecular Property Prediction: Discovering and Certifying Generalizable Improvements
summary:
Closed-loop Auto Research extends automated machine learning from fixed-dataset fitting to changing the research workflow, with language-model agents editing representations and model code and acquiring external evidence. Molecular property prediction spans many small endpoints. We ask whether this action space yields improvements generalizing beyond the validation signal selecting them.
  We isolate three Auto Research axes, features, models, and external evidence, under a file-level ablation lock attributing each gain to one axis over a strong baseline. Across 36 endpoints in three benchmark suites we score each selected configuration once on a held-out test whose labels the search never read. A routed pipeline taking each endpoint's best validation axis reaches positive held-out gains of 0.013, 0.011, and 0.042, the transferable axis differing by suite, data on TDC, model on Polaris, feature and model on MoleculeNet. The largest model-search gain falls from 0.041 on validation to 0.003 on test, while curated data reaches 0.022 but negative 0.019 on test, two non-transfer signatures. Curated external data raises held-out CYP2C9-substrate performance by 0.17 and half-life by 0.08, admitted through a contamination filter rejecting same-source files overlapping 64 to 89 percent of test structures, necessary but not sufficient for transfer. A matched-trial automated machine learning control did not reproduce the agent's code-level model intervention, reaching 0.006 against 0.042, and the pipeline stays competitive with an 84M-parameter pretrained 3D model on the shared training split.
  The experiments stay within molecular property prediction, but separating discovery from held-out certification is a domain-agnostic lesson for any closed-loop system optimising a proxy for a held-out quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了闭环自动研究（Auto Research）在分子性质预测中的应用，通过分离特征、模型和外部证据三个轴，在36个端点上评估了每个轴对留出测试集的泛化能力。结果显示不同基准套件的最佳转移轴不同，且发现模型搜索和外部数据存在非转移特征。文章还通过污染过滤器和匹配试验验证了方法有效性，最终在共享训练集上与8400万参数预训练3D模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 探究闭环自动研究框架中，特征工程、模型选择和外部证据获取这三个动作空间所带来的改进，是否能从验证集上选择的信号泛化到未见过的新数据上，即验证自动化研究中的"代理优化"是否真的能提升留出性能。
AI.method: 将Auto Research分为三个轴（特征、模型、外部证据），在文件级消融锁定下隔离每个轴的贡献；在36个分子性质预测端点上，使用路由流水线为每个端点选择最佳验证轴，并在从未读取过标签的留出测试集上评估；设计污染过滤器排除重叠文件，并进行匹配试验对照自动化机器学习基线。
AI.result: 路由流水线在三个基准套件上分别获得0.013、0.011和0.042的留出正向增益；不同套件最佳转移轴不同；模型搜索验证增益0.041降至测试0.003，外部数据验证0.022降至测试-0.019，呈现非转移特征；CYP2C9底物和半衰期任务分别提升0.17和0.08；匹配试验中基线仅达0.006而本文达0.042。
AI.conclusion: 分离发现过程与留出认证是闭环优化系统的通用经验法则；不同任务需要不同的自动化研究策略；外部数据需要严格污染过滤才能实现有效转移；代码级模型干预比传统自动化机器学习更有效。

title: Load Testing for Machine Learning Model Serving Systems at Scale
comment: The paper is accepted at ECSA 2026
summary: Machine learning (ML) model serving has become a dominant consumer of GPU infrastructure, yet capacity planning in these systems remains largely ad hoc. Under-provisioning leads to service-level objective (SLO) violations and production incidents, while over-provisioning results in substantial resource waste. This paper presents \sys, an industrial load testing framework for ML serving systems that systematically estimates serving capacity through an adaptive, feedback-driven search strategy. The approach leverages real-time performance signals, incorporating dampening, spike tolerance, and convergence detection to efficiently identify maximum sustainable throughput under SLO constraints. We evaluate \sys through a longitudinal analysis of 14 industrial case studies spanning four ML architecture classes: recommendation, ranking, vision, and NLP. This study demonstrates that systematic load testing leads to substantial improvements in GPU resource efficiency and operational reliability. Prior to adopting \sys, a significant fraction of model launches were under-provisioned, resulting in recurring incidents; these issues were substantially reduced after deployment. Our results show that ML-specific design decisions are critical to accurate capacity estimation: workload calibration using recorded traffic reduces estimation error from approximately 30\% to 2--6\%, while proper warmup handling yields a 22.2\% improvement in accuracy. Further analysis reveals key factors influencing prediction error, including model size and co-location effects. This paper distills six lessons and derive architectural guidelines for ML load testing, offering actionable insights for building reliable and efficient ML serving systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向机器学习推理服务的工业级负载测试框架\sys，通过自适应反馈驱动搜索策略，系统性地估算服务容量，在满足SLO约束的前提下最大化可持续吞吐量。基于14个工业案例的纵向研究表明，该方法能显著提升GPU资源效率并降低运营事故。
AI.motivation: ML模型服务的容量规划长期依赖经验做法，资源不足导致SLO违例和事故，资源过剩则造成大量GPU浪费，亟需系统化的容量估算方法。
AI.method: 采用自适应、反馈驱动的搜索策略，整合实时性能信号，结合阻尼、尖峰容忍和收敛检测等机制，在SLO约束下高效识别最大可持续吞吐量；并使用记录流量进行工作负载校准和合理的预热处理。
AI.result: 工作负载校准将估计误差从约30%降至2-6%；合理预热处理使精度提升22.2%；部署后显著减少了模型上线时的资源不足事故。
AI.conclusion: ML特有的设计决策（如工作负载校准、预热处理）对准确容量估计至关重要，并提炼出六条经验教训和架构设计指南，为构建可靠高效的ML推理系统提供可操作的见解。

title: Predicate Importance Estimation and Decoupled Rationale-Score Distillation for Entity Alignment
summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) are increasingly used as structured context for Large Language Models (LLMs), but industrial KG-RAG systems often need to integrate public and domain-specific KGs constructed from heterogeneous databases. This integration relies on Entity Alignment (EA), where lexical matching alone is insufficient under predicate-name variation and incomplete local neighborhoods. We address EA for KG integration by constructing a pairwise EA dataset and proposing two complementary modules: Predicate Importance Estimation (PIE) and Decoupled Rationale-Score Distillation (DRSD). PIE is a compact embedding-based approach that removes the subject information from each 1-hop triple, encodes the resulting subjectless triples, and aggregates them with learnable predicate-importance weights to build predicate-aware entity embeddings. DRSD trains a distilled small language model (SLM) with pseudo-answers produced by a teacher LLM through distinct prompts. By converting binary EA labels into text-based supervision and decoupling confidence-score estimation from label-consistent rationales, DRSD enables the SLM to learn task-specific reasoning while retaining a less label-biased confidence signal. Experiments show that PIE and DRSD improve EA classification. Moreover, because DRSD decouples confidence-score estimation from the decision, a discrepancy between the two flags an uncertain prediction for human review, thereby enabling a practical discrepancy between automatic acceptance and human-in-the-loop verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIE和DRSD两个互补模块，用于解决知识图谱集成中的实体对齐问题，通过谓词感知嵌入和蒸馏小语言模型提升对齐性能，并利用置信度与决策的解耦实现人机协同验证。
AI.motivation: 工业级KG-RAG系统常需集成来自异构数据库的公共和领域特定知识图谱，而现有实体对齐方法在谓词名称变化和不完整局部邻域条件下效果不足，需要更鲁棒的对齐方法。
AI.method: 1) PIE：去除三元组主语信息，编码无主语的1跳三元组，通过可学习的谓词重要性权重聚合，构建谓词感知实体嵌入。2) DRSD：利用教师LLM生成伪答案，通过不同提示蒸馏小语言模型，将二元EA标签转为文本监督，并解耦置信度评分与标签一致性推理。
AI.result: 实验表明PIE和DRSD均能提升实体对齐分类性能，且DRSD的置信度与决策解耦机制能有效识别不确定预测，供人工审核。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法不仅改进了实体对齐效果，还通过置信度-决策差异实现了自动接受与人在回路验证之间的实用平衡。

title: GroundEval: A Deterministic Replacement for LLM-as-Judge in Stateful Agent Evaluation
summary:
Before letting an agent operate over real context, can you prove it used the right evidence? GroundEval turns that question into a deterministic test of what the agent searched, fetched, cited, and was permitted to access. In one case study, two frontier LLM judges scored a plausible agent response above 0.85. But the trace told a different story: the agent had never retrieved the artifact its answer depended on, yielding a GroundEval score of 0.000.
  We introduce GroundEval, a judge-free framework for evaluating agents against grounded, time-bounded, and access-controlled evidence. GroundEval uses a domain configuration to generate questions, lets the agent choose how to answer, and then scores both the final answer and the recorded trajectory that produced it. The benchmark targets three failures that LLM-as-judge evaluation struggles to detect: whether an agent checked before claiming absence, reasoned only from evidence available to the actor at the relevant time, and used the correct causal mechanism rather than a plausible one. These correspond to three tracks: Silence, Perspective, and Counterfactual. GroundEval exposes when plausible answers rest on invalid evidence paths, and produces structured per-question diagnostics that pair tool activity with the agent's turn-level narration, making each score inspectable rather than merely reported. What our case studies turned up is that this gap isn't some rare corner case. It's exactly the blind spot that final-answer and judge-based scoring were never built to catch.

AI.tldr: GroundEval是一个无需裁判模型（judge-free）的评估框架，通过记录和验证智能体的搜索、获取、引用轨迹，检测其答案是否基于真实的证据路径，而非仅凭最终答案打分。实验表明，智能体可能给出高分参考答案，但证据路径完全错误（得分0.000），暴露了传统评估方法的盲区。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-judge评估方法仅关注最终答案质量，无法检测智能体是否使用了正确的证据路径（如是否真实检索过、是否使用时点可得的证据、是否使用正确的因果机制）。作者旨在构建一个可审计、可检验的证据级评估框架。
AI.method: GroundEval通过领域配置生成问题，让智能体自由作答，同时记录完整的操作轨迹（搜索、获取、引用、访问权限）。框架包含三个追踪（Tracks）：Silence（检查前是否确认过缺失）、Perspective（仅使用当时可得的证据）、Counterfactual（使用正确的因果机制而非貌似合理的机制）。评分同时考虑最终答案和轨迹。
AI.result: 案例研究中，两个前沿LLM裁判给智能体答案打分为>0.85，但GroundEval发现智能体从未检索过答案所依赖的工件，证据路径得分为0.000。这种差距不是个别案例，而是系统性的盲区。
AI.conclusion: 仅基于最终答案和裁判打分的评估方法无法捕捉证据路径的无效性，GroundEval通过结构化的每个问题诊断（工具活动+轮次叙述）让分数可审查，填补了这一关键空白。

title: Channel Location Constrains the Auditability of Subliminal Learning
summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's hidden trait from distillation data that never names it. We ask when such transfer can be audited before training. The answer is not model identity or scale alone, but channel location: the carrier through which the trait reaches the student. We find three regimes. In a controlled initialization-dependent body channel, a pre-training screen works. Coverage, the cosine between the student's initial distillation update and the teacher's fine-tuning displacement, predicts held-out transfer (Spearman $ρ\approx 0.95$; AUROC 0.997). In pretrained language models, masked single-token traits instead ride convergent vocabulary geometry. This channel is initialization-independent, so initialization-alignment screens, including coverage, are not mechanistic; the useful handles are post-hoc detection and targeted mitigation. Even when a single-token named entity is removed from the loss, the student's held-out probability for that entity rises to 0.40 on average ($\sim 2500\times$), and a related semantic class transfers. In an untied-head model, orthogonalizing the trait's output row against entangled neighbours collapses leakage, while equal-size random-subspace edits do not. Thus removing a target string from distillation labels does not remove the corresponding preference: neighbouring tokens can carry it. Finally, conditional behaviours can route through the network body. For sycophancy, with agreement and correction markers masked from the loss, transfer reaches about 0.63 of the teacher's effect, localizes to body computation, and evades four audits across two model families. We scope this as masked transfer of a condition-present policy. Channel location is necessary for deciding which audits can be sound. It is not a deployment-ready screen: an audit used outside its carrier regime can give false assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究潜意识学习（subliminal learning）中，学生模型如何从蒸馏数据中继承教师模型的隐藏特征。关键发现是：特征传递的**通道位置（channel location）**决定能否在训练前进行审计。存在三种通道：1）初始化依赖的body通道，可通过coverage指标有效审计；2）初始化无关的词汇几何通道，无法通过初始化对齐筛查；3）条件行为可通过网络body路由，绕过多种审计。结论是：通道位置决定审计有效性，错误使用审计可能带来虚假安全感。
AI.motivation: 探究潜意识学习中隐藏特征传递的机制，特别是能否在训练前审计这种传递。现有研究关注模型身份或规模，但作者发现关键在于特征传递的通道位置。
AI.method: 通过三种通道的实验分析：1）body通道：初始化依赖，使用coverage（学生初始蒸馏更新与教师微调位移的余弦相似度）预测迁移效果；2）词汇几何通道：初始化无关，通过后验检测和定向缓解；3）条件行为通道：sycophancy实验，掩码标记后测量迁移效果并定位计算位置。
AI.result: 1）body通道中coverage预测迁移效果Spearman ρ≈0.95，AUROC 0.997；2）词汇几何通道中单token实体即使从损失中移除，学生保留概率仍上升至0.40（约2500倍），相关语义类别也会迁移；3）条件行为中sycophancy迁移约0.63教师效果，能绕过四种审计；4）正交化特征行可阻止泄漏，随机子空间编辑无效。
AI.conclusion: 通道位置是决定哪些审计有效的必要条件。但并非可部署的筛查工具：在错误通道使用审计会带来虚假的安心感。

title: Machine Translation and Post-Editing: Comparative Evaluation of Different MT Systems and Post-Editor Groups in Specialised Translation
summary: This article aims to evaluate the quality of machine translation (MT) and post-editing (PE) in the context of specialised translation from English into French. Three MT systems (DeepL, eTranslation and Systran) were compared, and two groups of post-editors -linguists/translators and NLP experts -were asked to perform post-editing. Translation assessment is based on error annotation using an error typology adapted to MT and PE evaluation. The results reveal significant differences between the three MT systems and the two groups of post-editors, particularly in terms of terminological accuracy and fluency. This study highlights the importance of domain knowledge in specialised translation, as well as the limitations and variable performance of MT systems in language for specific purposes (LSP).

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种机器翻译系统（DeepL、eTranslation、Systran）在英译法专业翻译中的质量，并比较了语言学家/翻译人员与NLP专家两组后编辑者的表现。结果显示，不同MT系统和后编辑组在术语准确性和流畅性方面存在显著差异，强调了领域知识在专业翻译中的重要性以及MT系统在特定用途语言中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 旨在评估机器翻译和后编辑在专业翻译（英译法）中的质量，比较不同MT系统及不同背景后编辑者的表现差异。
AI.method: 比较三种MT系统（DeepL、eTranslation、Systran），让两组后编辑者（语言学/翻译专家和NLP专家）进行后编辑，采用基于错误标注的翻译评估方法，使用适用于MT和PE评估的错误类型学。
AI.result: 三种MT系统和两组后编辑者之间在术语准确性和流畅性方面存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 强调了领域知识在专业翻译中的重要性，以及MT系统在特定用途语言（LSP）中的局限性和性能可变性。

title: Learning Filters with Certainty
summary: Hash-based data structures such as Bloom filters are widely used in network systems for tasks including caching, anomaly detection, and machine learning pipelines. They typically provide binary indications of whether an element belongs to a set of interest, e.g., the contents of a cache. When uncertainty arises due to hash collisions, a positive indication is returned to avoid false negatives. We argue that the certainty associated with such indications can itself be useful information. This work focuses on Counting Bloom Filters (CBFs), a Bloom-filter variant that maintains counters rather than bits. Besides supporting insertions and deletions, these counters provide additional information that can be used to estimate the certainty of positive membership indications. We show how this certainty signal can be exploited in architectures that combine Bloom Filters with machine learning (ML) models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用Counting Bloom Filter (CBF)中的计数器信息来量化成员查询的确定性，并将其与机器学习模型结合，提升网络系统中哈希数据结构的实用性。
AI.motivation: 传统Bloom Filter仅返回二值结果（是/否），但哈希碰撞导致的不确定性信息被忽略。作者认为这种确定性信号本身是有价值的信息，应加以利用。
AI.method: 聚焦Counting Bloom Filter (CBF)，其维护计数器而非位，支持插入和删除操作。利用计数器的值来估计成员肯定指示的确定性，并将该确定性信号用于结合Bloom Filter与机器学习模型的架构中。
AI.result: 展示了如何利用确定性信号来增强Bloom Filter与ML模型结合的架构性能。
AI.conclusion: CBF中的计数器提供的确定性信息可以有效提升网络系统中缓存、异常检测和机器学习管道等任务的性能。

title: Cluster-Specific Localized Drift Detection for Efficient Batch Model Adaptation under Controlled Distribution Shift
summary: Machine learning systems deployed in dynamic environments frequently operate under nonstationary data distributions, where controlled distribution shift can progressively degrade predictive performance. However, many widely used tabular benchmark datasets lack explicit temporal structure, limiting reproducible evaluation of drift adaptation methods. This work proposes a cluster-induced distribution shift simulation framework that transforms static tabular datasets into controlled evolving data streams through structured perturbations across featurespace partitions. Using this framework, six adaptation strategies are systematically evaluated: static learning, sliding-window retraining, global ADWIN retraining, cluster-local ADWIN retraining, random subspace drift detection, and feature-partitioned drift detection. Experiments are conducted on five benchmark datasets covering both classification and regression tasks using diverse predictive model families, including linear models, k-Nearest Neighbours, tree ensembles, boosting methods, and adaptive online learners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于聚类的分布漂移模拟框架，将静态表格数据集转换为受控演化的数据流，系统评估了六种漂移适应策略在多种模型上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基准数据集缺乏显式时间结构，难以对漂移适应方法进行可重复评估，需要一种可控的漂移仿真框架。
AI.method: 提出聚类诱导的分布漂移模拟框架，通过特征空间分区的结构化扰动将静态数据转化为动态数据流，并评估六种适应策略。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上，涵盖分类与回归任务，使用多种模型家族（线性模型、KNN、树集成、 boosting、在线学习器）进行了系统评估。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效模拟受控漂移，为漂移适应方法的可重复评估提供了标准化工具。

title: Have You Ever Seen Them? Entity-level Membership Inference through Interrogating Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) raise growing concerns about privacy leakage and copyright compliance. Membership inference is a key tool for assessing such risks, but existing studies mainly focus on whether specific samples or sample-based data units are used for training. We argue that LLMs exhibit a human-memory-like behavior: an LLM may not memorize a specific sample verbatim, yet it can accumulate and reveal knowledge about a real-world entity from scattered mentions. This analogy motivates us to examine whether an LLM can be interrogated like a human interviewee to reveal its exposure to entity-related information. Motivated by this question, we propose entity-level membership inference, which determines whether information related to a target entity is used in LLM training. We study this task in the practical label-only black-box setting, where only generated texts are observable. We formalize the task under clue, input, and model constraints, establish the necessary and sufficient conditions for its feasibility, and instantiate five interrogation strategies based on this formalization. The strategies use limited entity clues to construct prompts, elicit entity-related responses, and infer membership from semantic features among the generated texts. We construct entity-level datasets and adapt state-of-the-art sample-level label-only methods to the entity-level setting as baselines. Experiments on person entities show that our methods achieve AUC up to 0.97 and bring gains of 6.0%--17.5% in Balanced Accuracy over the best adapted baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出实体级别的成员推断攻击，判断LLM是否在训练中使用了与目标实体相关的信息。在仅标签的黑盒设置下，设计了五种基于语义特征的询问策略，实验达到0.97 AUC，比最优基线提高6.0%-17.5%平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有成员推断研究主要关注样本级别的训练数据泄露，但LLM具有类似人类记忆的行为——即使没有逐字记忆某个样本，也能从分散提及中积累和揭示关于真实世界实体的知识。因此需要一种实体级别的成员推断方法来评估LLM对实体信息的暴露风险。
AI.method: 在标签-only黑盒设置下，形式化定义了实体级成员推断任务，建立了可行性充分必要条件。基于此形式化，设计了五种询问策略：利用有限实体线索构造提示，引导LLM生成与实体相关的回复，从生成文本的语义特征中推断成员关系。构建了实体级数据集，并将现有样本级方法适配为基线。
AI.result: 在人物实体实验中，该方法AUC最高达0.97，相比最优适配基线，平衡准确率提升6.0%-17.5%。
AI.conclusion: 实体级成员推断是可行的且效果显著，LLM确实会从训练数据中积累实体知识，这带来了隐私泄露和版权合规方面的风险。

title: The Origins of Stochasticity: Comprehensive Investigations on Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models
summary: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled sophisticated reasoning and content generation, yet their inherent stochasticity poses significant challenges for ensuring predictive credibility. While traditional uncertainty taxonomy paradigms, such as the dichotomy of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties, provide conceptual foundations, they often fail to capture the multi-component and multi-stage nature of LLM generation and struggle to evaluate the effectiveness of various Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) methods. In this paper, we propose a granular uncertainty taxonomy that systematically attributes LLM uncertainty into input-level, parameter-level, token-level, and decoding-process sources. Correspondingly, we categorize existing UQ methods into Bayesian, ensemble, consensus-based, and single-pass approaches. Furthermore, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation framework covering diverse generation settings and metrics. We empirically evaluate 21 typical UQ methods across three prominent LLM families, including Qwen3, Llama 3.2, and DeepSeek-V3, on benchmarks such as TriviaQA, GSM8K, and HumanEval. Our experimental results demonstrate that (i) the effectiveness of UQ methods is sensitive to task types and generation settings; (ii) consensus-based methods, typed Deg and EigV, consistently outperform other UQ approaches; and (iii) larger model scales correlate with lower uncertainty estimates, suggesting an empirical scaling law for LLM uncertainty. This work bridges the gap between theoretical origins and practical deployment, providing a versatile diagnostic tool for systematically quantifying uncertainty in LLM applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个细粒度的大语言模型不确定性归因框架，将不确定性来源分为输入级、参数级、词元级和解码过程四个层面，并对应分类了贝叶斯、集成、共识和单次前向四类UQ方法。通过对21种UQ方法在三个主流LLM家族上的系统评估，发现共识型方法（如Deg和Eig）效果最优，且模型规模越大不确定性越低。
AI.motivation: 传统的不确定性分类范式（如偶然不确定性与认知不确定性的二分法）无法捕捉LLM生成过程中多组件、多阶段的特性，也难以有效评估各种UQ方法的效果，因此需要更细粒度的归因框架。
AI.method: 提出了将LLM不确定性系统归因到输入级、参数级、词元级和解码过程四个来源的细粒度分类法，并将现有UQ方法对应分为贝叶斯、集成、共识和单次前向四类；构建了跨多种生成设置和指标的综合评估框架，在Qwen3、Llama 3.2和DeepSeek-V3三个LLM家族上对21种UQ方法进行了实证评估。
AI.result: (i) UQ方法的有效性对任务类型和生成设置高度敏感；(ii) 基于共识的方法（Deg和Eig）一致优于其他UQ方法；(iii) 模型规模越大，不确定性估计越低，表明LLM不确定性存在经验性的缩放定律。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了理论起源与实践部署之间的差距，为系统量化LLM应用中的不确定性提供了通用的诊断工具。

title: A Completion-Aware Framework for Impactful Counterfactual Explainability in Graph Neural Networks
summary: In this study, we propose a novel pipeline for generic, model-agnostic, local-level counterfactual explainability in graph neural networks (GNNs). Although counterfactual explainers capable of both adding and removing edges have emerged in recent years, the need for generic and efficient solutions remains unmet, particularly concerning qualitative explanation generation. Our approach couples progress in factual explainability with missing edge prediction models rooted in link prediction research, in order to enhance the quality, robustness and intuitiveness of explanations. A multi-faceted experimental analysis conducted on real-world and synthetic graph classification benchmarks, both binary and multi-label, demonstrates the advancements in comparison to state-of-the-art baselines across diverse metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于图神经网络（GNN）的通用、模型无关的局部级反事实可解释性方法，通过结合事实可解释性与链接预测中的缺失边预测模型，提升了反事实解释的质量、鲁棒性和直观性，并在真实与合成图分类基准上超越了现有基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管近年来出现了能够同时添加和删除边的反事实解释器，但通用且高效的解决方案仍然缺乏，特别是在定性解释生成方面存在不足。
AI.method: 将事实可解释性的进展与基于链接预测研究的缺失边预测模型相结合，构建了一个新的流水线（pipeline），用于生成局部级反事实解释。
AI.result: 在真实世界和合成的图分类基准（包括二分类和多标签任务）上进行多方面实验分析，在多种指标上超越了当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法有效提升了反事实解释的质量、鲁棒性和直观性，为GNN通用反事实可解释性提供了新的解决方案。

title: Training Open Models for Agentic Phone Use
summary: Phones are becoming an important execution surface for general-purpose agents, but training open models for reliable phone use remains difficult because the environment that matters at deployment, real devices running real apps, is slow, stateful, side-effectful, and hard to reset or verify, while scalable mock environments only approximate real behavior. We present PhoneBuddy, a training recipe and open-model line for agentic phone use that combines a real-app environment with a mock-app environment, PhoneWorld, which reconstructs runnable mock apps from real GUI usage structure. PhoneBuddy first builds a shared supervised fine-tuning stage from trajectories collected in both environments, then compares real-app RL against mixed RL across both environments. Across a 150-task human evaluation on real phones spanning apps, mini-apps, and cross-app workflows, task success rate improves from 36.67\% after supervised fine-tuning to 40.67\% after real-app RL and 45.33\% after mixed RL. On AndroidWorld, the same progression rises from 60.3\% to 77.2\% to 83.2\%. These results show that mock-app training is not a replacement for real-app RL, but a complementary source of scalable, resettable, and automatically checked interaction. The gains are strongest on app and mini-app tasks, while long-horizontal cross-app workflows remain an important open challenge.

AI.tldr: PhoneBuddy提出了一种结合真实应用环境和模拟应用环境的训练方案，用于构建手机通用智能体模型。通过在150项真实手机任务和AndroidWorld上的评估，混合RL训练（45.33%和83.2%成功率）优于纯真实RL（40.67%和77.2%）和监督微调（36.67%和60.3%），表明模拟环境是真实环境RL的互补而非替代。
AI.motivation: 真实手机设备环境在部署时至关重要，但它运行缓慢、有状态、有副作用、难以重置和验证；而可扩展的模拟环境只能近似真实行为。因此需要一种能结合两者优势的训练方法。
AI.method: 提出PhoneBuddy训练方案，包含：(1) 构建PhoneWorld模拟环境，从真实GUI使用结构中重建可运行的模拟应用；(2) 在真实和模拟环境中收集轨迹，进行共享监督微调；(3) 比较纯真实环境RL训练与混合环境（真实+模拟）RL训练的效果。
AI.result: 在150项真实手机任务上，任务成功率从监督微调的36.67%提升到真实RL的40.67%，再到混合RL的45.33%。在AndroidWorld上，从60.3%提升到77.2%再到83.2%。
AI.conclusion: 模拟应用训练不是真实应用RL的替代，而是可扩展、可重置、可自动检查交互的互补来源。增益在应用和迷你应用任务上最强，而长跨度的跨应用工作流仍是重要开放挑战。

title: A Formula-Driven Survey and Research Agenda for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains an LLM on states induced by the current or recent student policy: the student generates complete or partial rollouts, a teacher or self-teacher scores the resulting tokens under their generated contexts, and dense log-probability, logit, or distributional signals are converted into post-training updates. This survey studies OPD as a feedback-to-update problem rather than a single loss family. We develop a formula-driven taxonomy from two routes -- direct distributional losses and policy-gradient-style log-ratio updates -- and use it to organize core methods, verifier- or outcome-guided hybrids, industrial reports, framework implementations, failure modes, and stabilization recipes under explicit evidence boundaries. The taxonomy shows that OPD effectiveness depends not only on KL direction or teacher access, but also on state compatibility, support construction, temporal credit, vocabulary-level probability routing, gates and weights, and regularization. We further separate two mechanisms often conflated in sampled-token OPD stability discussions. Temporal credit asks how teacher-student log-ratio returns should weight sampled actions across a rollout; vocabulary routing asks where probability mass should move when negative feedback suppresses a sampled token. This distinction yields bias boundaries for immediate, return-to-go, discounted, and baseline-corrected estimators, motivates GAE-OPD as a value-based hypothesis for log-ratio returns, and motivates Counterfactual Routed OPD (CR-OPD) for routing probability mass toward teacher-supported, student-reachable alternatives. We close by mapping actionability diagnostics, failure mechanisms, case studies, open problems, and a reporting checklist onto the same feedback-to-update variables.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法，将其重新定义为从反馈到更新的问题，并提出了基于直接分布损失和策略梯度式对数比更新的分类体系，区分了时间信用分配和词汇级概率路由两个关键机制，并提出了GAE-OPD和CR-OPD等新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对在线策略蒸馏的研究多将其视为单一损失函数族，缺乏统一视角。本文旨在将OPD重新定义为从反馈到更新的问题，建立统一的分类体系，并澄清被混淆的两个关键机制。
AI.method: 提出基于两条路线（直接分布损失和策略梯度式对数比更新）的公式驱动分类法，并区分了时间信用分配（temporal credit）和词汇级概率路由（vocabulary routing）两个机制。
AI.result: 揭示了OPD有效性依赖于状态兼容性、支持构建、时间信用、词汇级概率路由、门控权重和正则化等多个因素；提出了GAE-OPD和CR-OPD两种新方法。
AI.conclusion: OPD研究应从反馈到更新的统一视角出发，关注时间信用分配和词汇路由两个核心机制，未来可基于该框架进行方法设计和故障诊断。

title: Gradient-Descent Steps to Success over Mean Accuracy: A Paradigm Shift for ML
summary: Traditional evaluation of machine learning (ML) models typically focuses on achieving the maximum possible accuracy irrespective of the computational cost. In this article, we propose a paradigm shift towards evaluating performance based on computational effort-explicitly defined here as the total number of gradient descent steps required to reach an acceptable level of accuracy with high probability. Building upon the concept of computational effort originally introduced by Koza for Genetic Programming, we extend this metric to any ML model trained via gradient descent. Furthermore, we demonstrate that minimising this effort acts as a novel form of Automatic Machine Learning (AutoML). By evaluating it across 11 diverse ML models and five standard classification datasets, we uncover significant insights into the dynamics of gradient-based learning. Our findings reveal that optimal hyper-parameters consistently favour unusually large learning rates. Crucially, we demonstrate that the rapid, aggressive landscape traversal enabled by these large rates not only promotes generalisation-as seen in phenomena like superconvergence-but also statistically minimises the expected computational effort for training. Furthermore, we identify distinct phase transitions in the optimal search strategy: while a single training run suffices for lower accuracy targets, reaching a model's performance limit requires a dramatic shift towards conducting numerous independent, short restarts. Finally, we illustrate how this effort-based paradigm provides a robust framework for model selection, allowing practitioners to choose optimal algorithms based on the difficulty of a problem as perceived by different models for a given target accuracy, or to maximise the achievable accuracy for a fixed budget of gradient descent steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将机器学习模型评估从“追求最高精度”转向“以计算代价（梯度下降步数）为核心”，发现最优超参数倾向于超大学习率，并揭示了训练策略的相变现象：低精度目标单次训练即可，高精度极限需多次短重启。该方法为模型选择提供了新框架。
AI.motivation: 传统ML评估只关注最终精度，忽视了计算成本。作者希望引入类似遗传编程中的“计算代价”概念，将训练所需的梯度下降步数作为核心评估指标，推动评估范式的转变。
AI.method: 将Koza的计算代价概念扩展到任何基于梯度下降的ML模型；在11种模型和5个标准分类数据集上评估该指标；通过最小化计算代价实现新型AutoML；分析超参数（尤其是学习率）与计算代价的关系。
AI.result: 1）最优超参数一致偏好异常大的学习率；2）大学习率不仅促进泛化（超收敛现象），还能从统计上最小化期望计算代价；3）达到模型性能极限需要从单次训练转向大量独立短重启的相变策略。
AI.conclusion: 基于计算代价的评估范式为模型选择提供了鲁棒框架：允许根据目标精度选择最优算法，或在固定计算预算下最大化可达精度。

title: PIVOTSBench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Interpersonal Relationship Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Humans possess an innate ability to understand fine-grained interpersonal relationships, which is central to everyday social interactions. Although such reasoning is inherently multimodal, it remains largely unexplored by existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To address this gap, we introduce PIVOTS, the first benchmark built from Social-IQ 2.0 and YouTube data to evaluate MLLMs' ability to predict bidirectional interpersonal relationship dimensions grounded in established psychology research. In addition, PIVOTS includes auxiliary tasks that assess models' ability to identify and leverage the critical visual cues underlying such predictions. We evaluate both proprietary and open-source MLLMs and conduct detailed ablation studies to analyze the effects of visual modalities and explicit social role information in conversational utterances. We further examine how joint and pairwise prediction settings benefit MLLMs in scoring bidirectional PIVOTS dimensions. Project page and resources: https://flynnzhangsx.github.io/PIVOTSBench/ .

AI.tldr: 提出了PIVOTS基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型理解细粒度人际关系的双向维度预测能力，基于Social-IQ 2.0和YouTube数据构建。
AI.motivation: 人类天生具备理解细粒度人际关系的能力，但现有MLLMs在这方面尚未被充分探索，缺乏相应的评估基准。
AI.method: 从Social-IQ 2.0和YouTube数据构建PIVOTS基准，包含双向人际关系维度预测及辅助任务（识别关键视觉线索），并评估多种开源和闭源MLLMs。
AI.result: 通过消融实验分析了视觉模态、社会角色信息的影响，并发现联合预测和成对预测设置有助于提升双向维度评分性能。
AI.conclusion: PIVOTS填补了MLLMs在细粒度人际关系理解评估方面的空白，揭示了视觉模态和社会角色的重要性。

title: Measuring Behavior Portability in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous decision makers, yet the behavioral mapping they exhibit can vary substantially across decision environments that are payoff-equivalent by construction-environments that share identical payoff-relevant structure but differ in surface presentation. This sensitivity renders suite-based evaluation fragile and raises a fundamental question of behavioral portability: how well does a behavioral mapping learned in one decision environment informative on another that preserves the same underlying incentive structure? We introduce a formal framework to measure this property. Our protocol fits an interpretable behavioral model on data pooled from a set of source environments and evaluates its out-of-sample predictive performance in a held-out target environment, benchmarking against an oracle trained directly on target data. Portability is quantified via a loss-agnostic measure that delivers worst-case bounds on the performance of the induced prediction-action mapping in the target environment. In controlled experiments spanning seven canonical economic decision problems, we document substantial and systematic portability losses, suggesting that behavioral characterizations of LLMs obtained in one decision environment cannot be assumed to transfer reliably to structurally equivalent alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型在不同决策环境中的行为迁移性，发现即使环境在收益结构上等价，LLMs的行为映射也会因表面呈现差异而显著变化，表明从一个环境获得的行为特征无法可靠迁移到结构等价的替代环境。
AI.motivation: LLMs作为自主决策者部署日益增多，但其行为映射在不同决策环境中表现出显著差异，导致基于套件的评估脆弱，因此需要量化行为迁移性这一基本问题。
AI.method: 提出一个形式化框架：在源环境数据集上拟合可解释的行为模型，评估其在目标环境中的样本外预测性能，并与直接基于目标数据训练的基准模型对比，通过损失无关的度量给出最坏情况下的性能界限。
AI.result: 在覆盖7个经典经济决策问题的对照实验中，观察到显著且系统的迁移性损失，表明LLMs的行为特征无法可靠地跨结构等价环境迁移。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的行为表征在收益等价但表面不同的决策环境中缺乏鲁棒迁移性，这对当前基于特定套件的行为评估方法提出了严峻挑战。

title: Provably Efficient Policy-Reward Co-Pretraining for Adversarial Imitation Learning
summary: Adversarial imitation learning (AIL) achieves high-quality imitation compared to behavioral cloning (BC), but demands substantial online environment interaction. Recent empirical work has explored initializing AIL algorithms with BC pretrained policies to address this limitation, yet a rigorous theoretical understanding of pretraining's role in AIL remains elusive. This paper provides a systematic theoretical analysis and introduces principled pretraining algorithms for accelerating AIL. We begin by analyzing AIL with policy pretraining alone, identifying reward error as the dominant source of suboptimality. This reveals a critical and previously overlooked gap: the absence of reward pretraining. Motivated by this finding, we develop a principled policy-reward co-pretraining approach grounded in a reward shaping analysis. Our analysis uncovers a fundamental connection between expert policies and shaping rewards, which naturally gives rise to CoPT-AIL, an approach that jointly pretrains both policy and reward through a single BC procedure. We prove that CoPT-AIL achieves an improved imitation gap bound over standard AIL, establishing the first theoretical guarantee for the benefits of pretraining in AIL. Experimental results confirm CoPT-AIL's superior performance over existing AIL methods.

AI.tldr: 本文对对抗模仿学习中的预训练作用进行了系统理论分析，发现仅策略预训练存在奖励误差问题，提出策略-奖励联合预训练方法CoPT-AIL，首次从理论上证明了预训练对AIL的益处，实验验证了其优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有AIL方法虽性能优于行为克隆，但需要大量环境交互。虽然已有工作尝试用BC预训练初始化AIL，但缺乏对预训练作用的严格理论理解。
AI.method: 首先分析仅策略预训练的AIL，发现奖励误差是主要次优性来源；然后基于奖励塑形分析，提出策略-奖励联合预训练方法CoPT-AIL，通过单次BC过程同时预训练策略和奖励。
AI.result: CoPT-AIL相比标准AIL取得了更优的模仿差距界限，这是首次从理论上保证预训练对AIL的益处；实验也验证了其优于现有AIL方法。
AI.conclusion: 策略-奖励联合预训练能有效加速AIL，填补了之前被忽视的奖励预训练空白，为AIL预训练提供了理论基础和实践指导。

title: A Dual-Track Framework for Template-Constrained LaTeX Conversion
summary: With the increasing demands for advanced document conversion, mapping structured Markdown drafts into template-compliant formats like LaTeX remains a challenge. Existing approaches largely depend on either deterministic rule-based converters or pure end-to-end Large Language Model (LLM) generation. The former fails to correctly handle asset insertions and template-specific constraints, while the latter tends to induce semantic drift, leading to hallucinations that are difficult to debug. To address these limitations, we introduce a robust Dual-Track Framework that systematically decouples template formatting from document processing: an offline track extracts template constraints into a reusable manifest, while an online track implements a hybrid execution pipeline. This pipeline confines LLM usage exclusively to reasoning-intensive components (e.g., semantic metadata, bibliographic references, and complex visual/tabular layouts) while delegating rule-based engines for deterministic processing. Empirical evaluation across 7 LaTeX templates and 56 published research papers demonstrates that our method preserves better structural fidelity, satisfies diverse layout constraints, and achieves a higher compilation success rate compared to the previous baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出双轨框架，将模板格式与文档处理解耦，结合规则引擎与LLM，提升LaTeX文档转换的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，规则转换器难以处理资产插入和模板约束，纯LLM生成容易产生语义漂移和幻觉，且难以调试。
AI.method: 双轨框架：离线轨提取模板约束为可复用清单，在线轨采用混合执行管道，LLM仅用于推理密集型任务（语义元数据、参考文献、复杂图表），规则引擎处理确定性任务。
AI.result: 在7个LaTeX模板和56篇已发表论文上，该方法在结构保真度、布局约束满足度和编译成功率方面均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 双轨框架有效克服了纯规则方法和纯LLM方法的局限，实现了高质量的结构化Markdown到LaTeX的转换。

title: AI-Assisted Help-Seeking Trajectories in Programming Education from an SRL-Informed Perspective
summary: Generative AI tools provide novice programmers with instant, personalized support, but also raise concerns about whether AI use supports or bypasses students' regulation of problem-solving. Existing work has largely focused on correctness, usability, or overall usage frequency, with less attention to how student--AI help-seeking unfolds. This study addresses this gap by analyzing AI-assisted help-seeking trajectories in university-level programming. Using an SRL-informed analytical framework that links prompt-level help-seeking codes to conceptual, implementation, debugging, and reflective forms of support, we analyzed 1,290 task-specific student prompts linked to 17,190 code submissions from 71 students in introductory Python programming courses. Specifically, we examined how help-seeking interactions were structured across turns and attempts, and how trajectory patterns related to task scores and the number of code submissions. Results indicate that many students primarily used AI for reactive troubleshooting rather than for planned, self-regulated problem-solving. Although trajectory patterns were not associated with significant differences in task scores, they differed substantially in the number of code submissions required. These findings suggest that the educational significance of AI support lies not only in whether students use AI, but in how their help-seeking trajectories develop during programming problem-solving.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了71名学生在编程任务中与AI助手的1,290条求助轨迹，发现学生主要将AI用于反应性故障排除而非计划性自我调节学习，不同轨迹模式与任务得分无显著关联，但影响代码提交次数。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI工具的正确性、可用性或使用频率，忽视了学生与AI交互中的求助行为如何展开，尤其是从自我调节学习（SRL）视角理解学生如何利用AI支持问题解决过程。
AI.method: 基于SRL分析框架，对提示层面的求助行为进行编码（概念、实现、调试、反思四类），分析了71名学生的1,290条任务相关提示及对应的17,190次代码提交，考察求助交互在轮次和尝试中的结构模式及其与任务得分、提交次数的关系。
AI.result: 多数学生将AI用于被动调试而非主动规划问题解决；不同轨迹模式与任务得分无显著差异，但在代码提交次数上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助编程教育的意义不仅在于学生是否使用AI，更在于其求助轨迹如何发展；需要引导学生从被动求助转向自我调节的主动学习。

title: New Smooth Loss functions for Robust Regression that Closely Approximate Absolute Error and Provide Improved Performance on Datasets With Significant Outliers
summary: The performance of supervised machine learning models is directly related to the quality of the training dataset. In particular, the presence of significantly many outliers in the training data can lead to low accuracy because popular loss function like the Mean Squared Error (MSE) assign very high importance to large errors. The Mean Absolute Error (MAE) loss assigns equal importance to all errors and is most robust to outliers, but suffers from being non-differentiable at the origin. MAE also has large derivative values close to its minimum leading to instability and oscillations during training. Thus differentiable approximations to MAE namely Huber and Log-Cosh losses were introduced for robust regression tasks. This paper introduces two new infinitely differentiable loss functions that more closely approximate the MAE loss and provide improved performance on regression tasks with significantly many outliers in the training dataset. A comparison of the performance of regression models with different loss functions on a wide variety of benchmarks and datasets is presented to demonstrate the superior performance of the Square Root Loss (SRL) and Smooth Mean Absolute Error (SMAE) losses proposed in this paper. The SRL loss is shown to be strictly convex and the SMAE loss is shown to be strictly quasi-convex. Given the fundamental importance of linear regression, two new robust linear regression models are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种新的无限可微损失函数（平方根损失SRL和光滑平均绝对误差SMAE），它们更接近MAE损失，在训练数据包含大量异常值的回归任务中表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有损失函数如MSE对异常值敏感，MAE虽鲁棒但不可微且训练不稳定，Huber和Log-Cosh作为近似方案仍有局限，因此需要更优的鲁棒损失函数。
AI.method: 提出了两种新的无限可微损失函数：平方根损失（SRL）和光滑平均绝对误差（SMAE），分别证明了SRL的严格凸性和SMAE的严格拟凸性，并基于它们构建了鲁棒线性回归模型。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的SRL和SMAE损失函数在存在大量异常值的回归任务中，相比现有损失函数取得了更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: SRL和SMAE是更优的鲁棒损失函数，能有效应对训练数据中的大量异常值，为鲁棒回归提供了新的有效方法。

title: PRIDE: Privileged Information-enhanced Distillation for Empathetic Dialogue Generation
summary: Large language models have demonstrated significant capabilities in generating diverse and context-aware responses for empathetic dialogue. However, their computational demands severely limit their deployment in resource-constrained environments. While knowledge distillation offers a promising compression solution, it often fails to transfer the nuanced understanding essential for empathy, as it overlooks the implicit contextual cues that guide human connection. To bridge this gap, we propose a \textbf{pr}ivileged \textbf{i}nformation-enhanced knowledge \textbf{d}istillation method for \textbf{e}mpathetic dialogue generation (PRIDE). Our method leverages privileged information, such as expert psychological annotations or future event summaries, which is available exclusively during training but unavailable at inference time. This allows us to transfer the teacher model's empathetic reasoning to smaller models without relying on extra inputs during deployment. Specifically, PRIDE has three key components: (1) An empathy-reasoning prompt that guides the teacher to explicitly decompose the empathetic process into understanding feelings and analyzing situations step-by-step; (2) A multi-source attention mechanism that directs the student to effectively integrate privileged information; (3) A dual-alignment loss that combines reversed Kullback-Leibler divergence and maximum mean discrepancy to ensure robust knowledge transfer at both logit and feature levels. Experiments on multi-modal and text-only datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance, and in some cases matches or even surpasses larger teacher models in terms of accuracy and semantic relevance.

AI.tldr: 提出PRIDE方法，利用特权信息（训练时可用、推理时不可用）进行知识蒸馏，使小模型在共情对话生成中达到甚至超越大模型性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在共情对话中表现出色但计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限环境；现有知识蒸馏方法忽视了共情所需的隐含上下文线索，无法有效传递共情能力。
AI.method: PRIDE包含三个核心组件：(1) 共情推理提示，引导教师模型逐步分解共情过程；(2) 多源注意力机制，帮助学生模型有效整合特权信息；(3) 双对齐损失（反向KL散度+最大均值差异），在logit和特征层面实现鲁棒知识迁移。
AI.result: 在多模态和纯文本数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了有竞争力的性能，在某些指标上甚至匹配或超越了更大的教师模型，在准确性和语义相关性方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 提出的PRIDE方法通过特权信息增强的知识蒸馏，有效解决了小模型共情能力不足的问题，在不增加推理时输入的情况下实现了大模型级别的共情对话生成性能。

title: Active Inference as the Test-Time Scaling Law for Physical AI Agents
summary: In this paper, a novel test-time scaling law for physical artificial intelligence (AI) agents is introduced. This scaling law enables physical AI agents to reason with their world models to generalize in unforeseen scenarios at test time. The derived scaling law is grounded in the first principle of active inference, which equips agents with the general objective to survive in the real world, under which their specific task objectives are subsumed. Active inference achieves this by providing the reasoning to resolve prediction errors that arise when the agent encounters unforeseen situations outside its training distribution, enabling generalization in non-stationary environments. The proposed scaling law captures this by dynamically updating the agent's policy with this reasoning at test time. This policy update is modeled as a soft Bayesian inference process in which beliefs about the policy are updated using the reasoning that reduces expected prediction errors under allowable policies as a likelihood. The resulting posterior policy admits a biological interpretation, recovering the scaling mechanism that engages the brain's basal ganglia and prefrontal cortex at test time. To solve this analytically intractable problem, a variational inference solution minimizing free energy bounds is developed. This solution extends to enable learning beyond training by reinforcing new instances, resolved at test time, in both the policy and world model. Unlike existing scaling laws constrained by model size and training data, the derived solution scales with the continuous real-world experience of a physical AI agent. Simulation results on an autonomous driving task demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms model-free Q-learning and model-based Bayesian reinforcement learning, achieving robust generalization to unforeseen scenarios while improving inference efficiency by over 36%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向物理AI智能体的测试时缩放定律，基于主动推理原理，使智能体能在测试阶段通过世界模型推理来泛化到未见场景，并通过变分推断方法实现，在自动驾驶任务中优于传统方法，推理效率提升超36%。
AI.motivation: 现有缩放定律受限于模型大小和训练数据，物理AI智能体在真实世界中会遇到训练分布外的非平稳环境，需要一种能在测试时动态调整策略的通用缩放机制。
AI.method: 基于主动推理第一性原理推导测试时缩放定律，将策略更新建模为软贝叶斯推理过程，通过变分推断最小化自由能边界来求解，并支持在测试时强化新实例以超越训练进行学习。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶任务中，所提方法优于无模型Q学习和基于模型的贝叶斯强化学习，实现了对未见场景的鲁棒泛化，推理效率提升超过36%。
AI.conclusion: 该缩放定律突破了传统缩放定律对模型规模和训练数据的依赖，使物理AI智能体能够通过持续的真实世界经验进行缩放，具有生物学解释性（基底节和前额叶皮层机制）。

title: Frequency-Domain Neural ODEs for Modeling Non-Linear Dynamical Systems
comment: 11 pages. figures, tables, and results are at the bottom of the file
summary: Standard continuous-depth models, such as Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (NODEs), offer significant advantages in modeling physical systems by learning continuous vector fields rather than discrete temporal steps. However, when applied to complex dynamical systems, standard NODEs frequently struggle with highly nonlinear dynamics. This paper investigates the Frequency-domain Neural ODE (FNODE), an architecture that projects continuous temporal dynamics into the frequency domain using the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). By operating in the frequency domain, the model provides better generalization to the dynamical system. The architecture is empirically evaluated against discrete models, specifically Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTMs), and other continuous-depth variants, including Augmented Neural ODE (ANODE), across four distinct dynamical systems: the Lotka-Volterra model, the forced Duffing oscillator, the Van der Pol oscillator, and the Lorenz system. To rigorously assess generalization and robustness, curriculum and ensemble learning are used to evaluate the model's convergence by estimating confidence intervals across different ensemble models. The empirical results demonstrate that the FNODE architecture achieves better generalization while exhibiting remarkable convergence stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出频率域神经ODE（FNODE），利用FFT将时间动态映射到频率域，在多个复杂动力系统上相比标准NODE、ANODE及离散模型（GRU/LSTM）展现出更好的泛化性能和收敛稳定性。
AI.motivation: 标准神经ODE在处理高度非线性动力学系统时表现不佳，需要一种能更好泛化到复杂动力系统的新架构。
AI.method: 提出FNODE架构，利用快速傅里叶变换（FFT）将连续时间动态投影到频率域进行处理，并结合课程学习与集成学习进行鲁棒性评估。
AI.result: 在Lotka-Volterra模型、受迫Duffing振子、Van der Pol振子及Lorenz系统四个动力系统上，FNODE相比NODE、ANODE、GRU和LSTM取得了更好的泛化性能和收敛稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 频率域操作能有效提升神经ODE对复杂动力系统的建模能力，FNODE在泛化性和收敛性方面均优于现有方法。

title: Same question, different history: language, national identity, and credit in large language models
comment: 27 pages (main text and Supplementary Information combined), 5 figures, 9 tables
summary:
Who invented the radio, Russia's Alexander Popov or Italy's Guglielmo Marconi? Was the telephone the achievement of Bell in the United States or Meucci in Italy? Does printing belong to China's Bi Sheng or Germany's Gutenberg? The answer depends not only on historical record but also on language and perspective.
  We analyse eleven widely used large language models across 21 disputed inventions and discoveries, evaluated in twelve languages and 75,896 responses. While models generally acknowledge that credit is contested, query language systematically affects which claimant is surfaced. Lower-status claimants are more likely to appear when questions are asked in their associated language, whereas dominant Anglophone figures remain stable across languages.
  These patterns persist after controlling for response length, model differences, historical prominence, and levels of national commemoration. Language thus acts as a switch that activates different national versions of the same history, producing systematically different national memories from the same question.
  We interpret this as evidence that large language models function as distributed systems of cultural memory, where language conditions which histories become visible, contributing to a computational form of banal nationalism.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在不同语言下对争议性发明的归属描述存在系统性偏差，语言作为文化记忆的开关，导致不同国家版本的同一历史被激活。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型在不同语言环境下对历史和发明归属的呈现是否存在系统性差异，揭示语言在塑造文化记忆中的作用。
AI.method: 分析11种主流LLM，覆盖21项有争议的发明与发现，在12种语言中进行评估，共收集75,896条回复。
AI.result: 查询语言系统性影响被呈现的发明者；较低地位的发明者更可能在关联语言中出现，而占主导地位的英语人物跨语言稳定；控制多种变量后模式依然存在。
AI.conclusion: LLM充当分布式文化记忆系统，语言决定了哪些历史版本变得可见，形成计算形式的平庸民族主义。

title: MINCE: Shrinking LLM Evaluation Datasets via Few-Model Monte Carlo Calibration
summary: Evaluating LLMs across many model variants -- quantized, fine-tuned, or deployment-specific -- requires running large benchmarks repeatedly, a process that can take tens of hours per model on edge hardware such as NPUs. Existing subset selection methods reduce this cost but depend on large calibration pools or learned prediction layers. We introduce MINCE (Monte Carlo Informed N-sizing for Compact Evaluation), which uses Monte Carlo simulation over per-item logs from a small set of calibration models to find the minimum subset size that bounds accuracy drift and then fixes a randomly sampled subset at that size, with no prediction layer needed. MINCE reduces IFEVAL by 54\%, MMLU by 89\%, and GSM8K by 70\% with maximum drift $\leq$2.62\,pp on BF16 models and mean drift of 0.77--3.59\,pp on held-out NPU models, while delivering median GPU evaluation speedups of 2.7--8.1$\times$ and NPU evaluation speedups of 1.7--2.0$\times$. The method is robust to calibration pool size and achieves lower drift than tinyBenchmarks (12$\times$ lower on MMLU, 3.3$\times$ on GSM8K) while using 57$\times$ fewer calibration models.

AI.tldr: MINCE是一种基于蒙特卡洛模拟的评估子集选择方法，无需预测层，通过少量校准模型确定最小子集大小，在保持精度的同时显著加速LLM评估（GPU加速2.7-8.1倍，NPU加速1.7-2.0倍），并将IFEVAL、MMLU、GSM8K分别减少54%、89%、70%，漂移控制在2.62pp以内。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM评估需要在不同变体（量化、微调、部署专用）上重复运行大规模基准测试，在NPU等边缘硬件上每个模型耗时数十小时。现有子集选择方法依赖大规模校准池或学习型预测层，成本高昂。
AI.method: 使用蒙特卡洛模拟对少量校准模型的逐项日志进行分析，找到能约束精度漂移的最小子集大小，然后固定该大小的随机采样子集，无需预测层。
AI.result: IFEVAL减少54%，MMLU减少89%，GSM8K减少70%，最大漂移≤2.62pp（BF16模型），平均漂移0.77-3.59pp（NPU模型）；GPU加速2.7-8.1倍，NPU加速1.7-2.0倍；相比tinyBenchmarks，MMLU漂移低12倍，GSM8K低3.3倍，且仅用57倍更少的校准模型。
AI.conclusion: MINCE是一种高效、鲁棒的LLM评估压缩方法，对校准池大小不敏感，在精度保持和加速效果上显著优于现有方法。

title: OphthaDT: Generative Digital Twins for Forecasting Visual Acuity Trajectories in Ophthalmology
summary: Precision medicine in ophthalmology requires accurate longitudinal predictions, but the fragmented nature of multimodal clinical data remains a barrier to forecasting. We introduce OphthaDT, an LLM-based digital twin for ophthalmology that serializes longitudinal patient histories from 3,220 patients across four Phase III clinical trials into structured narratives to forecast best corrected visual acuity (BCVA). In benchmarks spanning up to 100 weeks, OphthaDT demonstrated the lowest prediction error in neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD), achieving an average mean absolute error (MAE) reduction of 6.0% compared to all baselines. In diabetic macular edema (DME), OphthaDT demonstrated competitive performance against all baselines while outperforming Random Forest and XGBoost by an average MAE reduction of 2.6% and 6.9%, respectively. Results reveal that OphthaDT's predictive advantage scales with trajectory complexity: whereas linear models remain effective for the more stable treatment responses of DME, OphthaDT's capacity is better suited for capturing the high longitudinal variability of nAMD. Finally, OphthaDT handles irregular sampling without imputation, positioning LLM-based clinical trajectory modeling as a methodology that could reduce patient burden and accelerate drug development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OphthaDT，一个基于大语言模型的数字孪生系统，通过将眼科临床试验中的纵向患者数据序列化为结构化叙事，预测最佳矫正视力（BCVA）。在3220名患者的四个III期临床试验数据上，OphthaDT在nAMD预测中平均MAE降低6.0%，在DME中优于随机森林和XGBoost分别降低2.6%和6.9%。
AI.motivation: 眼科精准医学需要准确的纵向预测，但多模态临床数据的碎片化特性阻碍了预测建模。现有方法难以有效处理非规则采样的临床序列数据。
AI.method: OphthaDT利用大语言模型将患者的纵向临床历史序列化为结构化叙事，无需数据插补即可处理非规则采样数据，通过LLM的序列建模能力预测BCVA。
AI.result: 在nAMD上MAE平均降低6.0%；在DME上优于随机森林（-2.6%）和XGBoost（-6.9%）；预测优势随轨迹复杂性增加而扩大；处理非规则采样无需插补。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的临床轨迹建模能有效处理复杂纵向眼科数据，有望减少患者负担并加速药物开发。

title: When Does Intrinsic Self-Correction Help? A Task-Sensitive Analysis
summary: Intrinsic self-correction (SC) aims to improve large language model outputs by prompting a model to revisit its own initial answer without external feedback. Recent studies have questioned the reliability of this approach, showing that models often struggle to judge whether their initial responses are correct. In this work, we take a task-sensitive view of SC. Rather than asking whether it works in general, we examine settings where SC may operate through different mechanisms: verifying explicit constraints, revisiting a complex reasoning process, or providing a second opinion over competing strategies in word-game tasks. Across multiple benchmarks and models, we find that SC can yield consistent performance gains when the underlying task structure facilitates these modes of revision. These results suggest that SC is best understood as a task-dependent inference-time strategy whose usefulness depends on the role the revision stage can play in a given task, rather than as a uniformly reliable method for improving initial model outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自校正（SC）的效果高度依赖于任务类型，在特定任务结构（如约束验证、复杂推理、策略二次判断）下能带来稳定提升，而非一种普遍可靠的方法。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明大模型的内在自校正能力不可靠，模型难以判断自身初始回答是否正确。作者希望从任务敏感的角度出发，探究在什么条件下自校正能发挥作用。
AI.method: 将自校正机制分为三类：验证显式约束、重新审视复杂推理过程、在文字游戏任务中对竞争策略提供二次意见。在多个基准和模型上进行实验评估。
AI.result: 当底层任务结构能够促进上述三种修正模式时，自校正可以带来一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 自校正应当被视为一种任务依赖的推理时策略，其有效性取决于修正阶段在特定任务中能扮演的角色，而非一种普遍可靠的方法。

title: Finding the Evidence: Discovering Decision-Supporting Tokens for On-Policy Reasoning Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation transfers reasoning ability through dense token-level supervision, yet the nature of the transferable signal remains unclear. We discover that reasoning chains contain two types of knowledge that require different discovery mechanisms: decisions (where to branch), which surface through student uncertainty, and evidence (intermediate steps that justify decisions), which hides in positions where the student is confident yet wrong. Current methods capture only decisions; the substantive knowledge in evidence tokens remains untransferred. We propose DEAR(Decision-Evidence Aware Reasoning Distillation), which first identifies decisions via student entropy, then discovers their supporting evidence through hidden-state cosine similarity to decision anchors, boosted by teacher-student divergence to prioritize the largest knowledge gaps.
