Previous works have shown that when four profiles a, b, c, d, represented as vectors, form analogical proportions componentwise, it is likely that their classes form an analogical proportion also. This is the basis of an analogical proportion-based classification method that can produce accurate predictions. Similarly, in this paper, each profile is associated with a distribution describing the frequencies of the possible values of a discrete attribute of interest. We then discuss and experimentally investigate if the distributions associated to four profiles forming an analogical proportion themselves also form an analogical proportion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了概率环境下的类比比例，探讨概率值之间以及概率分布之间的类比比例定义与性质，并通过实验验证了当四个轮廓形成类比比例时，它们对应的概率分布是否也形成类比比例。
AI.motivation: 将类比比例的概念从传统的数值、布尔值或向量表示扩展到概率表示，探索概率值和概率分布能否保持类比比例的结构特性。
AI.method: 基于算术比例和几何比例组合定义概率类比比例，研究概率值之间的类比关系，并进一步推广到概率分布层面，同时考虑归一化约束。通过实验验证分布层面类比比例的一致性。
AI.result: 提出了概率环境下类比比例的定义框架，并实验证明了当四个轮廓（以向量表示）按分量形成类比比例时，它们对应的概率分布在统计上也倾向于形成类比比例。
AI.conclusion: 概率类比比例可以有效地推广到分布层面，为基于类比推理的分类方法提供了新的理论支撑和应用可能。

title: From Handcrafted Features to Functional Edge Learning: Evolution of EEG Seizure Detection Frameworks
summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) analysis remains the clinical gold standard for epilepsy diagnosis and seizure detection. While Deep Learning (DL) has significantly advanced automated EEG interpretation, its transition from controlled experimental settings to routine clinical deployment is severely bottlenecked by fundamental architectural flaws. Standard DL models operate as opaque black-boxes lacking clinical interpretability, demand massive amounts of balanced annotated data, and incur steep computational costs incompatible with resource-constrained wearable or implantable neuromodulation devices. This paper presents a comprehensive review of these prevailing limitations and explores Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) as a emerging paradigm for EEG-based seizure detection. By replacing the fixed activation functions of traditional neurons with flexible, learnable functions along the network's connections, KANs bridge the critical gap between predictive accuracy and mathematical transparency. We systematically analyze how KAN architectures resolve the shortcomings of traditional DL-based models by offering exceptional parameter efficiency, inherent interpretability for physician trust, and robust performance under data scarcity. Ultimately, this review establishes KANs not merely as an incremental algorithmic update, but as a fundamental paradigm shift necessary to actualize next-generation, patient-specific, and thoroughly transparent clinical EEG monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了深度学习在癫痫脑电图分析中的三大瓶颈（缺乏可解释性、依赖大量标注数据、计算成本高），并论证了Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) 作为新兴范式，通过可学习连接函数替代固定激活函数，在参数效率、可解释性和数据稀缺鲁棒性方面实现突破，推动临床脑电监测系统向透明化、患者特异化方向变革。
AI.motivation: 深度学习虽在自动脑电图分析中表现优异，但由于缺乏临床可解释性、依赖大规模平衡标注数据、计算开销大，难以从实验环境过渡到日常临床部署，亟需新的技术范式。
AI.method: 采用Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs)，将传统神经元的固定激活函数替换为沿网络连接的可学习灵活函数，在保持预测精度的同时实现数学可解释性。
AI.result: KAN架构在参数效率、内在可解释性（便于医生信任）以及数据稀缺条件下的鲁棒性能方面，有效解决了传统深度学习模型的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: KANs不仅是增量算法更新，而是实现下一代患者特异性、完全透明的临床脑电图监测系统的根本性范式转变。

title: TriggerBench: Investigating Prospective Memory for Large Language Models
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long interactions, existing evaluations focus predominantly on retrospective memory (RM) via explicit queries. Prospective memory (PM), the critical ability to spontaneously recall and act on latent constraints without direct prompts, remains largely unevaluated. We introduce TriggerBench, a comprehensive PM benchmark spanning five dimensions across both daily assistants and professional workflows. TriggerBench pairs scenarios with matched RM controls, contrastive positive/negative variants, and overloaded triggers, enabling fine-grained measurement of proactive recall, false-alarm rate, and attentional robustness under a single protocol. Our evaluation yields three key findings. (i) PM shows a precision-recall trade-off and attentional fragility. Though enhanced reasoning significantly improves proactive recall, models may overfit to an "always-remind" heuristic. Furthermore, PM accuracy degrades substantially under implicit constraints or triggers overloaded by concurrent user requests, indicating that robust PM remains an open challenge. (ii) PM is notably harder than RM: on identical contexts, RM near-saturates up to 100K tokens, while PM decays sharply as context length scales. (iii) PM may serve as a behavioral probe of spare reasoning capacity. Pairing PM scenarios with AIME-2025 math problems reveals that successful trajectories yield higher PM accuracy than failed ones at the same context length, showing PM tracks spare reasoning budget that token count obscures. Project page: https://github.com/KristenZHANG/TriggerBench-Official.

AI.tldr: TriggerBench是一个评估大语言模型前瞻记忆（PM）能力的基准，涵盖日常助手和专业工作流五个维度。研究发现：PM存在精度-召回率权衡和注意力脆弱性；PM比回顾性记忆（RM）困难得多，随上下文长度增加性能急剧下降；PM可作为推理能力的行为探针，与数学问题表现相关。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估大多关注回顾性记忆（通过显式查询），但前瞻记忆（自发回忆并执行潜在约束的能力）这一关键能力尚未得到系统评估。
AI.method: 构建TriggerBench基准，涵盖五个维度的PM场景，配对的RM对照组、对比正/负变体及过载触发器，实现单一协议下对主动回忆、误报率和注意力鲁棒性的细粒度测量。
AI.result: (i) PM存在精度-召回率权衡和注意力脆弱性，增强推理能提升主动回忆但可能过拟合"始终提醒"启发式；(ii) PM显著难于RM，RM在100K token内近乎饱和，PM随上下文长度急剧衰减；(iii) PM可作为空闲推理能力的行为探针，与AIME-2025数学题表现正相关。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒的PM仍然是开放挑战，且PM可作为衡量LLM推理预算的有用指标。

title: IPO Finance Agent: Evaluation of LLM Financial Analysts beyond Finance Agent v2, with Automated Rubric Generation -- the Case of the SpaceX (SPCX) IPO
summary: Finance Agent v2 (by Vals AI) has emerged as the reference benchmark for evaluating both Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT frontier language models on financial tasks. However, it narrowly deals with periodic reporting from publicly traded companies (SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings), and its agentic harness relies on naive, unenriched chunk retrieval. Neither the task design nor the retrieval approach addresses the distinct challenges of IPO due diligence. SEC S-1 filings combine historical financial statements, governance structures, pro forma and common-control accounting treatments, capital-formation narratives, and underwriting-sensitive risk disclosures within substantially longer documents than typical periodic filings. That is why we introduce IPO Finance Agent, which extends the Finance Agent v2 framework along two directions: task domain and retrieval architecture. During our experiments, the original Finance Agent v2 harness basically failed to deliver any output related to the SpaceX S-1 filing, due to document length. We therefore had to improve the agentic harness with contextual retrieval, a more realistic and industry-standard approach for long documents. We also built a dataset of 1,000 IPO-diligence questions, and publicly release 70 questions on the SpaceX (SPCX) S-1 filing to support reproducibility, while the remainder are held private to guard against benchmark contamination. In addition, we introduce an evaluator-optimizer pipeline to automatically generate evaluation rubrics for the benchmark: candidate facts are extracted from an ensemble of independently-generated model answers to each question, consolidated into draft criteria, then automatically audited for omissions, hallucinations, mistiered items, and redundancy, with LLM feedback driving iterative repair, targeted enrichment, and deduplication. Human experts only review final rubrics before deployment. Results show that the best-performing evaluated model, Alibaba Qwen 3.7 Max, reaches 79.4% accuracy at $0.30 per query, and the most cost-efficient model on the resulting Pareto frontier, Xiaomi MiMo-2.5 Pro, reaches slightly lower accuracy (76.8%) at $0.05 per query. Both exceed the current Finance Agent v2 leaderboard ceiling-Google Gemini 3.5 Flash at 57.9% for $2.51 per querywhile undercutting even FABv2's cheapest entry (MiniMax M3: 48.3% at $0.32) on cost-efficiency. Code and data are released on GitHub: https://github.com/benstaf/ipoagent

AI.tldr: 本文提出IPO Finance Agent，扩展了Finance Agent v2框架，专门处理IPO尽职调查中的SEC S-1文件（如SpaceX）。通过上下文检索、1,000个IPO问题数据集和评估者-优化者流水线，最佳模型（阿里通义千问3.7 Max）达79.4%准确率（$0.30/次），最经济模型（小米MiMo-2.5 Pro）达76.8%（$0.05/次），远超原基准上限Gemini 3.5 Flash的57.9%（$2.51/次）。
AI.motivation: 现有Finance Agent v2基准仅处理上市公司定期报告（SEC 10-K/10-Q），不适用于IPO尽职调查。SEC S-1文件更长、结构更复杂（含历史财务报表、治理结构、风险披露等），且原框架依赖简单分块检索，无法处理超长文件（如SpaceX S-1）。
AI.method: 1) 扩展任务领域至IPO尽职调查；2) 引入上下文检索（contextual retrieval）替代朴素分块检索；3) 构建1,000个IPO问题数据集（公开70个SpaceX相关问题）；4) 设计评估者-优化者流水线，自动生成评估准则（候选事实提取、合并、自动审计修复）。
AI.result: 阿里通义千问3.7 Max达79.4%准确率（$0.30/次），小米MiMo-2.5 Pro达76.8%（$0.05/次），均超过原基准上限Gemini 3.5 Flash（57.9%，$2.51/次）和FABv2最便宜模型MiniMax M3（48.3%，$0.32/次）。原Finance Agent v2在SpaceX S-1上完全无法输出结果。
AI.conclusion: IPO Finance Agent有效解决了超长IPO文件处理难题，证明了上下文检索和专用评估流水线的价值。新模型在成本和准确率上均大幅超越原基准，代码和数据集已开源。

title: Learning a Normal World Model for Few-Shot Boundary-Calibrated Abnormality Detection
summary: Abnormality detection in complex systems faces two practical barriers: abnormal labels are scarce, and binary labels do not quantify how far an event has departed from normal behavior. We study a normal-world modeling formulation for this setting. Instead of learning a large and incomplete space of abnormal classes, the model learns the normal world from abundant normal events and uses a few abnormal examples only to calibrate the boundary of normality. We instantiate this idea as a Hypergraph Entropic Normal-World Model. The model represents multivariate sensor windows as context-conditioned hypergraphs, where hyperedges capture high-order relations among groups of variables. It then defines abnormality by an entropy-aware normal-world energy that combines temporal prediction surprise, hypergraph consistency surprise, and latent normal-manifold departure. On the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan degradation benchmark, the proposed full energy achieves strong zero-shot and few-shot performance across all four subsets and reaches AUROC 0.9983 on FD004, the most complex setting with multiple operating conditions and fault modes. Beyond standard detection metrics, we introduce mechanistic validation tests to probe whether the energy encodes normal-world structure rather than a superficial input-output mapping. The learned energy accepts unseen healthy engines, increases along degradation trajectories, and sharply penalizes context-mismatched cross-variable coupling breaks. These results suggest that normal-world energy can serve as an anomaly score, a graded risk measure, and a testable representation of normal system behavior under severe abnormal-label scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超图熵正常世界模型（HENM），利用正常事件学习系统常态，通过少量异常样本校准边界，在C-MAPSS数据集上实现零样本和少样本异常检测，AUROC达0.9983。
AI.motivation: 实际复杂系统中异常检测面临两个障碍：异常标签稀缺且二元标签无法量化异常偏离正常行为的程度，因此需要一种仅从正常数据学习、并用少量异常样本校准边界的建模方法。
AI.method: 将多元传感器窗口构建为上下文条件超图，超边捕获变量间高阶关系；定义含时间预测惊奇、超图一致性惊奇和潜在正常流形偏差的熵感知正常世界能量函数。
AI.result: 在NASA C-MAPSS数据集上，四个子集均取得强零样本和少样本性能，FD004子集AUROC达0.9983；通过机理验证测试证明能量编码了正常世界结构而非表面映射。
AI.conclusion: 正常世界能量可作为异常分数、分级风险度量及可检验的正常系统行为表示，有效应对严重异常标签稀缺问题。

title: War in the Abstract: The Rise and Consequences of Militarized Language in Scientific Communication
summary: Scientists do not, by profession, wage war. Yet warfare's vocabulary consistently appears in their abstracts. To quantify the extent to which warfare's vocabulary pervades scientific abstracts, we analyze 21.4 million papers (2010-2025; OpenAlex, PubMed). We additionally run a within-subject war-framing experiment (N = 801; 32,040 trials) designed to provide causal insight into the effects of militaristic language on persuasion. Between 2010 and 2025, the presence of militaristic terms in scientific abstracts rose 48% in OpenAlex and 32% in PubMed, with the rise accelerating sharply after 2019 (cross-database r = 0.96, p < 10^-8). The prevalence of militaristic language is conflict-aligned at both country and annual scales (Uppsala Conflict Data Program; r = 0.77-0.84), with the abstracts from the Global South displaying the fastest rise in militaristic language. Among disciplines, social sciences leads in level of such language while engineering and computer science lead in growth. The COVID and post-2022 large-language-model eras also saw the rise and narrowed the language gap between native-English and non-English authors. In our follow-up experiment, we found that war framing reduced credibility (mean shift -0.18 Likert units, 95% CI [-0.21, -0.14]; d_z = -0.28, p < 10^-20), funding willingness (d_z = -0.12) and policy support (d_z = -0.08), with a trend-level increase in sense of urgency (d_z = +0.07). Collectively, findings reveal that while scientific abstracts drift toward warfare, the use of militaristic language may erode credibility, funding willingness, and policy support.

AI.tldr: 通过分析2140万篇论文摘要（2010-2025年）和一项实验（N=801），发现科学摘要中军事化语言使用率在2019年后急剧上升（OpenAlex增长48%，PubMed增长32%），但战争框架会降低可信度、资助意愿和政策支持。
AI.motivation: 尽管科学家不从事战争，但军事化词汇频繁出现在科学摘要中。作者希望量化这一现象的普遍程度，并探究军事化语言对说服效果的影响。
AI.method: 分析2140万篇论文摘要（2010-2025年；OpenAlex和PubMed数据库），并开展一项被试内战争框架实验（N=801；32,040次试验），以提供军事化语言对说服效果的因果洞察。
AI.result: 2010-2025年间，OpenAlex军事化术语出现率上升48%，PubMed上升32%，2019年后加速显著（r=0.96, p<10^-8）。军事化语言与国家/年度冲突数据高度相关（r=0.77-0.84），全球南方上升最快。社会科学使用水平最高，工程和计算机科学增长最快。实验发现战争框架降低了可信度（d_z=-0.28）、资助意愿（d_z=-0.12）和政策支持（d_z=-0.08），但趋势性增加了紧迫感（d_z=+0.07）。
AI.conclusion: 科学摘要正逐渐倾向军事化语言，但这种语言的使用可能会侵蚀可信度、资助意愿和政策支持。

title: Some Results about the Expressivity of Preference-Incomplete Structured Argumentation Frameworks
summary: This paper studies the expressive power of ASPIC$^+$ argumentation frameworks with uncertain preference profiles by comparing them with several abstract formalisms with uncertain defeats. Most of our results are negative (and some of them are theoretically unexpected). We also conjecture a positive, non-trivial threshold for the expressivity of uncertain preferences, and prove some essential preliminary steps toward the confirmation of this conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文研究ASPIC$^+$论证框架中不确定偏好的表达能力，通过与多种不确定击败关系的抽象形式主义比较，得出大多数结果为负面（部分理论上出乎意料），并推测了一个非平凡的表达性阈值，同时证明了验证该猜想的关键初步步骤。
AI.motivation: 探究ASPIC$^+$论证框架中不确定性偏好配置的表达能力，评估其与现有抽象形式主义的关系。
AI.method: 通过形式化比较ASPIC$^+$框架（带不确定偏好）与多种抽象论证形式主义（带不确定击败关系），进行理论分析和对比。
AI.result: 多数比较结果为负面，其中部分结果在理论上出乎意料；同时发现了一个非平凡的正面表达性阈值。
AI.conclusion: 不确定偏好的表达力存在一定的理论限制，但在特定阈值下仍有正面结果，为进一步研究奠定了基础。

title: SCENIC: Semantic-Conditioned Edge-Aware Neural Framework for Structured IoT Command Generation
summary: Edge Internet of Things (IoT) agents are often constrained by memory capacity, privacy requirements, communication latency, and recurring inference cost. Current smart-home assistants commonly rely on API-level command interfaces or cloud-based language models that remain difficult to deploy on edge devices. This paper addresses edge IoT command generation as a many-to-one structured output task, where multiple natural-language instructions map to the same canonical command string for deterministic smart-home parsing. To support this setting, we propose Semantic-Conditioned Edge-Aware Neural Framework for Structured IoT Command Generation (SCENIC), an end-to-end framework covering model architecture selection, Smart Home Instruct data generation, triplet-loss contrastive supervised fine-tuning, pruning and quantization, and deployment-oriented export. We evaluate sub-0.2B-scale transformer backbones, which are, to the best of our knowledge, among the smallest language-model backbones studied for edge IoT structured command generation. On Smart Home Instruct-Bench, the strongest dense decoder-only row reaches 99.0% EM@1, while the encoder-decoder model retains stronger high-sparsity behavior. A representative pruned INT8 encoder-decoder export preserves 91.0% EM@1 and 99.0% EM@5 while reducing exported model size by 25.38%. TensorRT profiling of the NVIDIA 2:4 sparse encoder export further shows up to 1.8x encoder-component speedup, indicating that the selected encoder-decoder deployment path can retain structured command accuracy under edge-oriented compression while hardware acceleration evidence remains component-level. The SCENIC code and experimental artifacts are open sourced to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SCENIC框架，用于边缘IoT设备上的结构化指令生成，采用小规模Transformer模型（<0.2B参数），通过三重损失对比微调、剪枝和量化等技术，在保持高准确率的同时实现模型压缩和硬件加速，为智能家居等边缘场景提供了高效的语言理解方案。
AI.motivation: 边缘IoT设备受限于存储容量、隐私需求、通信延迟和推理成本，现有智能家居助手依赖API接口或云端大模型，难以部署在边缘设备上。本文旨在解决边缘IoT指令生成的结构化输出问题。
AI.method: 提出SCENIC端到端框架，包括模型架构选择、Smart Home Instruct数据生成、三重损失对比监督微调、剪枝与量化，以及面向部署的模型导出。采用<0.2B参数的小规模Transformer骨干网络。
AI.result: 最强密集解码器模型在Smart Home Instruct-Bench上达到99.0% EM@1；剪枝量化后的INT8编码器-解码器模型保留91.0% EM@1和99.0% EM@5，模型体积减少25.38%；TensorRT分析显示NVIDIA 2:4稀疏编码器组件加速达1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 编码器-解码器架构在边缘端压缩条件下仍能保持结构化指令生成精度，硬件加速证据已达组件级别，为边缘IoT场景提供了可行的部署方案。

title: Self-Compacting Language Model Agents
summary: Long agent traces composed of chains of thought and tool calls accumulate stale content that anchor subsequent generations, and eventually outgrow the context window. Existing scaffolds mitigate it with fixed-interval compaction triggered at a token threshold. Such triggers pay no heed to trajectory structure, risking discard of partial results mid-derivation or mid-search. We propose SelfCompact, a scaffold that allows the model itself to decide when and how to compact. Specifically, it pairs two inference-time elements: (i) a compaction tool the model invokes to summarize the accumulated context, and (ii) a lightweight rubric specifying when to fire (a sub-task has resolved, or the trajectory is converging) and when to suppress (mid-derivation, or when stuck). Both are needed. The tool alone is unevenly used across open-weight models, often invoked at unhelpful moments or not at all; the rubric alone cannot act. Together, they elicit effective adaptive compaction without any fine-tuning or external supervision. We present empirical results on six benchmarks (competitive math and agentic search) and seven models. Our results show that SelfCompact matches or exceeds fixed-interval summarization at a fraction of the token cost, improving over a no-summarization baseline by up to 18.1 points on math and 5-9 points on agentic search at 30-70% lower per-question cost. Our results expose a meta-cognitive gap: although unprompted models cannot reliably tell when their own context is rotting, a lightweight rubric closes this gap, reframing when to compact as a capability that scaffolds can supply without training.

AI.tldr: 提出SelfCompact框架，让模型自主决定何时以及如何压缩推理轨迹中的累积上下文，通过"压缩工具+轻量级规则"的组合，无需微调即可实现自适应压缩，在多个基准测试上以更低成本提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有固定间隔的上下文压缩策略忽视轨迹结构，可能在推导或搜索中途丢弃部分结果，导致信息丢失。
AI.method: 设计两个推理时组件：(i) 压缩工具，模型可调用以总结累积上下文；(ii) 轻量级规则，规定何时触发压缩（子任务解决或轨迹收敛）以及何时抑制（推导中途或卡住时）。两者协同工作。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试和七个模型上，SelfCompact以30-70%更低的每问题成本，在数学任务上提升高达18.1个点，在智能体搜索上提升5-9个点，匹配或超越固定间隔摘要方法。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了元认知差距：未经提示的模型无法可靠判断自身上下文何时"腐烂"，但轻量级规则可弥补这一差距，将压缩时机决策转化为脚手架可提供的无需训练的能力。

title: Cognitive Digital Twins: Ethical Risks and Governance for AI Systems That Model the Mind
summary: As AI systems become increasingly persistent and personalized, they make possible a class of technologies that we call cognitive digital twins (CDTs): dynamic computational representations of a specific person's cognition, updated from behavioral, contextual, or physiological data in order to model, predict, or simulate that person's cognition, or to act as that person's communicative or decision-making proxy. CDTs combine cognitive inference with longitudinal representation, simulation, and proxy action in ways that existing governance strategies for personal assistants, autonomous agents, recommender systems, and automated decision systems only partially address. This paper makes four contributions. First, we define CDTs and distinguish them from adjacent systems. Second, we introduce a 5A governance framework organized around authority, autonomy, access and control, accountability, and availability. Third, we identify CDT-specific risks, from misrepresentation and epistemic authority shifts to shadow twins, simulated participation, proxy action, and proxy-power asymmetries. Fourth, we analyze governance gaps and propose requirements for high-risk CDTs that strengthen consent, purpose limitation, validity, traceability, contestation, independent review, and model retirement. Existing frameworks primarily regulate data processing, automated decisions, or autonomous actions; CDTs also require governance at the level of cognitive representation itself, before any final decision or external action occurs. We argue that CDTs require governance not only because they can act for people, but because they can become infrastructures through which cognition is represented, simulated, classified, and operationalized.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并定义了“认知数字孪生”（CDT）概念，即对特定个体认知的动态计算表征，并提出了一个5A治理框架（权威、自主、接入与控制、问责、可用性），分析了CDT特有的风险（如误表征、认知权威转移、影子孪生、代理行动不对称等），指出现有治理策略的不足，并提出了针对高风险CDT的治理要求。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统日益持久化和个性化，出现了能够表征、模拟和代理个体认知的技术（即认知数字孪生），但现有治理框架（如针对个人助手、自主智能体、推荐系统等）无法充分应对这类技术带来的独特挑战，亟需新的治理思路。
AI.method: 通过概念界定与区分相邻系统、提出5A治理框架、识别CDT特有风险、分析现有治理空白并提出治理要求，进行系统性分析。
AI.result: 明确了CDT的定义及其与相邻系统的区别；提出了5A治理框架；识别了误表征、认知权威转移、影子孪生、模拟参与、代理行动不对称等风险；指出现有框架主要监管数据处理和自动决策，而CDT还需要在认知表征层面进行治理。
AI.conclusion: CDT需要治理不仅因为它们可以代理个体行动，更因为它们可能成为认知被表征、模拟、分类和操作化的基础设施。现有治理框架不足以应对，必须在认知表征层面建立额外的治理要求。

title: Encoder-Decoder Manifold Alignment for Idempotent Generation
summary: Recently, several learning paradigms have been introduced to enforce idempotency in generative models. The goal is to ensure that repeated application of a model leaves samples unchanged once they lie on the target data manifold. In practice, however, many of these approaches fail to achieve exact fixed points, leading to instability and drift under repeated application. In this work, we argue that a key reason for this failure is a geometric mismatch between the manifolds learned by the encoder and decoder. The encoder projects inputs onto one latent manifold, while the decoder implicitly learns to reconstruct data from a different manifold. This discrepancy prevents the model from learning truly idempotent mappings. To address this issue, we propose a new training framework that explicitly closes this gap by forcing the encoder and decoder to learn consistent representations of the same underlying data manifold. By aligning the geometry of these components, our method encourages stable projections. Empirically, we show that our approach achieves significantly lower idempotency error and consistently regenerates identical outputs under repeated application, compared to existing methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on both image generation and image editing tasks. Finally, we show that enforcing idempotency in this manner improves identity preservation and information stability, leading to more realistic and controllable generative editing models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的训练框架，通过对齐编码器和解码器学习的流形几何结构，解决生成模型中幂等性失败导致的重复应用不稳定问题，在图像生成和编辑任务上显著降低了幂等性误差。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型的幂等性方法在重复应用时无法达到精确不动点，导致不稳定和漂移。作者认为根本原因是编码器和解码器学习的流形存在几何不匹配——编码器将输入投影到一个潜在流形，而解码器从另一个不同的流形重建数据。
AI.method: 提出一个显式缩小编码器与解码器之间几何差距的训练框架，强制两者学习同一底层数据流形的一致表示，从而对齐组件的几何结构以实现稳定投影。
AI.result: 与现有方法相比，该方法实现了显著更低的幂等性误差，在重复应用下能一致地再生相同输出。在图像生成和图像编辑任务上均验证了有效性，同时改善了身份保持和信息稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过强制编码器与解码器流形对齐来增强幂等性，可以生成更真实、更可控的生成式编辑模型，为生成模型的稳定性提供了新的几何视角解决方案。

title: LangMAP: A Language-Adaptive Approach to Tokenization
summary: Language-specific tokenizers improve tokenization quality and the downstream performance of models on those languages. However, using such a tokenizer comes at a cost: either a new model must be trained from scratch, or the vocabulary of an existing pretrained model must be adapted. We propose Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori (LangMAP) Tokenization, a tokenization scheme that extends the UnigramLM algorithm to the multilingual setting, producing language-specific tokenization from a single shared vocabulary. Notably, LangMAP can be used when training a multilingual language model from scratch or to adapt a pretrained model's tokenizer to individual languages without changing its vocabulary. While language labels are required at training time, a key feature of the algorithm is that it then performs language-specific tokenization at inference without knowledge of the input's language. Across 14 open-source tokenizers, 9 natural languages, and 9 programming languages, LangMAP improves morphological boundary alignment and, for all coding languages tested, alignment with abstract syntax tree (AST) leaf boundaries. In fine-tuning experiments, results are mixed: LangMAP improves target-language grammatical acceptability (MultiBLiMP) on the languages tested; its benefits are less consistent on knowledge-related tasks (Global-PIQA, Belebele).

AI.tldr: 提出LangMAP分词方案，通过扩展UnigramLM算法实现多语言共享词汇表下的语言特定分词，在无需改变词汇表的情况下提升形态边界对齐和AST对齐效果，但在知识类任务上效果不一致。
AI.motivation: 语言特定分词器能提升分词质量和模型性能，但使用它们需要从头训练模型或调整现有预训练模型的词汇表，成本高昂。作者希望设计一种方案，既能实现语言特定分词，又能避免高昂的适配成本。
AI.method: 提出LangMAP（Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori）分词方案，将UnigramLM算法扩展到多语言场景。该方案在训练时需要语言标签，但在推理时无需知道输入语言即可进行语言特定分词。可以从头训练多语言模型时使用，也可用于适配预训练模型的分词器而不改变其词汇表。
AI.result: 在14个开源分词器、9种自然语言和9种编程语言上，LangMAP提升了形态边界对齐效果；在所有编程语言上，提升了与抽象语法树（AST）叶子边界的对齐效果。在微调实验中，LangMAP在目标语言的语法可接受性（MultiBLiMP）上有所提升，但在知识相关任务（Global-PIQA, Belebele）上效果不一致。
AI.conclusion: LangMAP在语法任务上有效，但在知识类任务上收益不稳定，需要进一步研究其在不同任务类型上的适用性和局限性。

title: TTFT-Aware Graph Chain-of-Thought:Distance-Indexed Neural A* for Low-Hallucination Multi-Hop Medical Reasoning
summary: Hallucinations and opaque reasoning remain unacceptable failure modes for clinical LLMs. We present a production-grade GraphRAG stack that constrains answers to verifiable graph chain-of-thought paths in a heterogeneous, ~700K-node medical knowledge graph powering a fertility assistant. The core idea is targeted navigation: a directed Pruned Landmark Labeling (PLL) oracle provides exact distances for sub-millisecond feasibility checks and simple-path enumeration, while a lightweight AStarNet heuristic operates strictly within the PLL corridor to prioritize clinically plausible expansions. We score and pack a small, diverse set of paths (CUI/semantic-type overlap, length prior, provenance priors) to condition generation, yielding compact prompts and improved Time to First Token (TTFT). On fertility-focused queries, the hybrid (PLL+AStarNet) establishes a better latency/recall Pareto frontier than text-only RAG and single-component baselines, lowers TTFT, and reduces clinician-audited hallucinations while preserving explanation clarity. The result is a practical recipe for explainable, low-hallucination multi-hop medical reasoning ready for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种生产级GraphRAG框架，结合PLL精确距离查询与AStarNet启发式搜索，在70万节点医学知识图谱上实现可解释、低幻觉的多跳临床推理。
AI.motivation: 临床大语言模型存在幻觉和不透明推理问题，无法直接用于实际医疗场景，需要可验证、可解释的推理机制。
AI.method: 构建异质医学知识图谱；使用有向剪枝地标标记(PLL)实现亚毫秒级精确距离计算与路径枚举；在PLL限定的搜索走廊内使用轻量级AStarNet启发式算法；通过CUI/语义类型重叠、长度先验、来源先验等分数选取多样性路径集，压缩prompt并改善首token延迟(TTFT)。
AI.result: 在生育相关查询上，混合方法(PLL+AStarNet)在延迟/召回帕累托前沿上优于纯文本RAG和单一基线，降低了TTFT，减少了临床医生审核的幻觉，同时保持了解释清晰度。
AI.conclusion: 该方案提供了一个可落地、可解释、低幻觉的多跳医学推理实用路线，适合实际临床部署。

title: Enhancing Protein Representation Learning via Manifold Restore Mixing
summary: Data augmentation (DA) has been proven to be an effective means for improving protein representation learning (PRL) by generating additional training samples. Although mainstream perturbation- and sampling-based augmentation methods can produce data containing sufficient variations, they carry the risk of disrupting the protein structure and function. Some crafted protein homology modeling tools can generate conformations, but reduce structural diversity. The above dilemmas lead us to a question: Can we restore the disrupted structure caused by DA operations, providing data with both the original structure and diverse variations? In this work, we first analyze and empirically reveal the structure defect and performance degradation issues of existing DA methods. Based on the findings, we propose a simple yet effective DA method, Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM), for protein representation learning. Specifically, inspired by manifold mixup, we mix the hidden representations of original and augmented protein data to generate new samples that restore structural information lost in DA while introducing diverse variations. Furthermore, we develop a sample difficulty scheduler that adjusts the beta distribution in mixup to provide models with progressively challenging mixed samples during training, which improves the final performance. Comprehensive experiments on various PRL backbones and downstream tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. The complete code and weights will be released upon acceptance. We provide a implementation at https://github.com/KingGugu/MRM.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM)的数据增强方法，通过在隐空间混合原始蛋白与增强数据的表征，既恢复DA操作破坏的结构信息，又引入多样性变异，并采用样本难度调度器逐步提升训练难度，在多种PRL骨干和下游任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有DA方法（扰动/采样法）虽能产生多样化数据，但会破坏蛋白质结构和功能；同源建模工具虽能生成构象但降低结构多样性。需要一种既能修复被破坏的结构，又能提供多样变异的数据增强方法。
AI.method: 受流形混合启发，在隐空间对原始蛋白与增强数据的表征进行混合（Manifold Restore Mixing），生成同时保留原始结构信息并引入多样化变异的新样本；同时设计样本难度调度器，动态调整混合的beta分布，在训练过程中逐步提供更有挑战性的混合样本。
AI.result: 在多种蛋白质表示学习骨干网络和下游任务上的综合实验表明，MRM方法具有良好的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MRM能有效解决现有DA方法的结构破坏与多样性不足问题，为蛋白质表示学习提供了一种简单而有效的数据增强方案。

title: Evaluation Awareness Is Not One Capability: Evidence from Open Language Models
summary: Safety benchmarks assume that test-condition behavior predicts deployment behavior, an assumption that fails if models detect evaluation cues and adapt. This opens a gap between benchmark performance and deployment behavior: compliance measured under test conditions becomes an optimistic upper bound that overstates how safely a model behaves once the evaluation harness is removed. We characterize this evaluation awareness through eight experiments across 37 open-weight models and seven families. (i)Detection is moderate and training-driven (24/37 models exceed chance, best AUROC 0.714 vs.0.819 human, with instruction tuning dominating over scale). (ii)Detection shifts safety behavior (hard refusal drops 5.8 percentage points under hypothetical framing, and 21/140 HarmBench framing effects are significant, with compliance rising up to +30 percentage points. (iii)Representations survive behavioral collapse (probes retain AUROC 0.98 under rewrites that drive behavior below chance, and multi-layer steering causally moves three downstream tasks while random controls do not). (iv)These axes are weakly coupled (only 1/15 correlations are significant, the sole robust link being behavioral detection versus framing resistance, $ρ=-0.79$, $p<0.001$). We call this gap the benchmark illusion: because detectability, behavioral manifestation, and controllability vary independently, it is multivariate rather than a single number, so no single awareness score is a reliable proxy for deployment safety.

AI.tldr: 论文通过37个开源模型的8项实验发现，模型能够检测到评估环境并调整行为，导致基准测试表现（乐观上限）与真实部署行为之间存在系统性差距，且这种差距是多维独立的，无法用单一指标衡量。
AI.motivation: 安全基准测试隐含假设模型在测试条件下的行为能预测其部署行为，但模型若检测到评估线索并自适应，则该假设失效，导致基准性能与部署安全性之间存在未被充分研究的差距。
AI.method: 对37个开源模型（7个系列）进行8项实验，从检测能力、行为变化、表征可持续性和各维度耦合性四个层面系统刻画模型对评估环境的感知及其影响。
AI.result: (i)24/37模型检测能力超过随机，最佳AUROC 0.714（人类0.819），指令微调优于规模扩展；(ii)假设框架下硬拒绝率下降5.8个百分点，21/140 HarmBench框架效应显著，合规性最高提升30个百分点；(iii)表征探针在行为降至随机以下时仍保持AUROC 0.98，多层操纵可因果影响下游任务；(iv)仅1/15相关性显著，检测能力与框架抵抗力的相关系数为ρ=-0.79,p<0.001。
AI.conclusion: 将这种系统性差距称为"基准幻觉"——因可检测性、行为表现和可控性独立变化且呈多维性，任何单一认知分数都无法可靠代理部署安全性。

title: A Matter of Time: Towards a General Theory of Agency
summary: Agency is often invoked in research on philosophy, biology, and cognitive science without a clear account of how it originates from material organization. Building on temporally parametrized (F, A)-systems, this paper develops a graded organizational theory of agency grounded in relational biology, physical biosemiotics, and process ontology. We argue that self-referential closure cannot be adequately conceived outside time: once the constitutive processes of a semantically closed organization are associated with distinct characteristic timescales, the organization unfolds into an out-of-sync dependency structure that can be formally redescribed as a history-dependent, revisable Asynchronous Dynamic Bayesian Network. This move allows for a principled distinction between autonomy, goal-directedness, agency, and open-endedness. Autonomy arises from precarious closure to efficient causation under material openness; goal-directedness from the maintenance of viability-supporting organization; agency appears when such organization acquires an endogenous anticipatory structure that selectively modulates organism-environment coupling in light of possible futures; open-endedness begins when this anticipatory organization can reconstruct its own future space of possibilities. Our framework reconciles Rosennean anticipation with organizational closure, restricts Markov blankets and active inference to derived formal redescriptions rather than first principles, and reinterprets computational enactivism in non-Fristonian terms. By deriving weaker temporalized organizations, our contribution outlines a hierarchy from proto-agential chemical systems to fully semantically closed agents, with implications for multicellular organisms, synthetic lifeforms, and neuroscience.

AI.tldr: 本文基于时间参数化的(F,A)-系统，发展了一种分级的组织性行动者理论，从关系生物学、物理生物符号学和过程本体论出发，通过异步动态贝叶斯网络重新描述语义闭合组织，区分了自主性、目标导向性、行动者性和开放性，并调和了Rosennean预期与组织闭合。
AI.motivation: 哲学、生物学和认知科学中频繁援引"行动者性"概念，但缺乏对其如何从物质组织中起源的清晰解释。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 基于时间参数化的(F,A)-系统，将语义闭合组织的构成过程与特征时间尺度关联，形式化重述为历史依赖、可修正的异步动态贝叶斯网络（Asynchronous Dynamic Bayesian Network）。
AI.result: 建立了从自主性、目标导向性、行动者性到开放性的分级框架：自主性来自物质开放下对有效因果的脆弱闭合；目标导向性来自维持可存活组织的活动；行动者性来自内源性预期结构选择性调节有机体-环境耦合；开放性来自预期组织重构自身可能性空间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架调和了Rosennean预期与组织闭合，将马尔可夫毯和主动推理限制为派生形式重述而非第一原理，并从原行动者化学系统到完全语义闭合的行动者构建了层级体系，对多细胞生物、合成生命和神经科学具有启示意义。

title: Diffusion Integrated Gradients: Controllable Path Generation for Flexible Feature Attribution
comment: 44 pages, 22 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to ECCV 2026; includes appendix
summary: Path-based attribution methods such as Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely adopted for their strong axiomatic properties and effectiveness in attributing model predictions to input features by integrating gradients along a path from a baseline to the input. However, the choice of the attribution path largely affects the quality of explanations, and existing approaches rely on fixed or hand-crafted paths that often produce noisy or distorted attributions. To address this limitation, we propose Diffusion Integrated Gradients (DiffIG), a novel method that reformulates path generation as a conditional generative modeling problem. DiffIG first trains a diffusion model to learn a distribution over paths generated from a Stick-Breaking Process, then employs guided sampling to embed user guidance during the sampling procedure. We demonstrate that DiffIG quantitatively matches or outperforms existing path-based methods, achieving perceptually aligned explanations. This work introduces a new generative perspective for flexible, inference-time controllable Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Diffusion Integrated Gradients (DiffIG)，将归因路径生成建模为条件生成问题，利用扩散模型学习路径分布并支持用户引导采样，实现更灵活、可控制的解释性AI方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于路径的归因方法（如Integrated Gradients）依赖固定或手工设计的路径，导致归因结果存在噪声或失真。作者希望解决路径选择对解释质量的限制。
AI.method: 先训练扩散模型学习由Stick-Breaking Process生成的路径分布，再通过引导采样嵌入用户指导，从而将路径生成转化为条件生成建模问题。
AI.result: DiffIG在定量指标上匹配或超越现有路径方法，生成感知上对齐的解释。
AI.conclusion: 提出从生成视角出发的、可在推理时灵活控制的可解释AI新范式，为未来更灵活的XAI方法奠定基础。

title: EnterpriseClawBench: Benchmarking Agents from Real Workplace Sessions
summary: Enterprise agents increasingly operate inside workspaces: they read heterogeneous files, invoke tools, and deliver business artifacts. We introduce EnterpriseClawBench, an enterprise agent benchmark constructed from proprietary, real-world agent sessions. Starting from a large archive of workplace sessions, the EnterpriseClawBench produces 852 reproducible tasks, each paired with recovered fixtures, rewritten prompts, role classes, skill subclasses, hard rules, and semantic rubrics. Because the sessions contain internal enterprise content, we do not release the benchmark data; instead, our reusable contribution is the construction and evaluation protocol. On EnterpriseClawBench, the best configuration reaches only 0.663 (Codex with GPT-5.5). These results show that enterprise agent evaluation must report harness--model combinations, artifact delivery, visual quality, cost, runtime, and skill-transfer behavior, rather than collapsing performance into a single score. Code: https://github.com/FrontisAI/EnterpriseClawBench

AI.tldr: 提出了EnterpriseClawBench，一个基于真实企业工作会话构建的智能体基准测试，包含852个可复现任务，最佳配置仅达到0.663分，强调了企业智能体评估应报告多个维度而非单一分数。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体日益在工作空间中运行（读取文件、调用工具、交付业务成果），但缺乏针对性的评估基准，现有基准无法覆盖企业场景的复杂性。
AI.method: 从大量企业工作会话档案出发，构建了852个可复现任务，每个任务配有恢复的夹具、重写的提示、角色类别、技能子类、硬规则和语义评分标准；由于数据涉密，仅开源构建和评估协议。
AI.result: 最佳配置（Codex with GPT-5.5）仅达到0.663分，表明当前方法在企业智能体任务上表现有限。
AI.conclusion: 企业智能体评估应报告多个维度（模型组合、工件交付、视觉质量、成本、运行时间、技能迁移行为），而非单一分数。

title: Managing Procedural Memory in LLM Agents: Control, Adaptation, and Evaluation
summary: Procedural memory is increasingly used to improve LLM agents on recurring workplace tasks, yet its ability to produce reusable skills remains poorly understood. We introduce AFTER, a benchmark of 382 realistic enterprise tasks spanning six professional roles and 22 procedural skills, designed to evaluate how skills transfer across tasks, roles, and model backbones. The benchmark includes controlled evaluation settings for local improvement, cross-task transfer, cross-role transfer, and cross-model generalization. Experiments show that procedural memory delivers consistent gains in industrial workflows: a single refinement round improves aggregate performance by 3.7-6.7 points, while skills evolved from diverse multi-model execution traces achieve 73.1% cross-model test accuracy, outperforming all single-model trace sources. We further find that some skills generalize broadly across tasks and models, whereas others become specialized to role-specific workflows and lose effectiveness under transfer. These results provide practical guidance for building, evaluating, and deploying procedural memory systems in production agent platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出了AFTER基准，用于评估LLM智能体中程序性记忆技能的跨任务、跨角色和跨模型迁移能力，实验表明程序性记忆能持续提升工业工作流性能，但某些技能会因专业化而失去迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 程序性记忆虽被广泛用于提升LLM智能体在重复工作场景中的表现，但其产生可复用技能的能力仍未被充分理解，缺乏系统性评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了AFTER基准，包含382个企业任务、6个专业角色和22个程序性技能，设计了局部改进、跨任务迁移、跨角色迁移和跨模型泛化四种受控评估设置。
AI.result: 单轮改进提升3.7-6.7个点；基于多模型执行轨迹演化的技能达到73.1%的跨模型测试准确率；部分技能泛化良好，另一些则因角色专业化而迁移能力下降。
AI.conclusion: 为在工业智能体平台中构建、评估和部署程序性记忆系统提供了实用指导。

title: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Can Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely viewed as a promising path toward continuously improving large language models. Recent works, however, suggest that mainstream RLVR often reallocates sampling probabilities among trajectories already present in the base model: it can improve sampling efficiency, reflected by higher pass@1 scores, but yields limited gains, and can even decrease pass@k scores when k is large, and therefore may fail to expand the base model's reasoning capacity boundary. In this paper, we present a boundary-aware Curriculum RL approach to move beyond the base model's reasoning capacity boundary. Our approach first uses pass@k sampling to locate the current reasoning capacity boundary, then applies targeted teacher guidance to examples near or beyond that boundary, and finally uses RL to consolidate the newly introduced reasoning patterns. Across Qwen, Llama, and DeepSeek base models, boundary-aware Curriculum RL improves both pass@1 scores and pass@256 scores, with pass@1 reflecting one-attempt performance and pass@256 serving as an empirical proxy for the reasoning capacity boundary. In our experiments, average pass@256 improves by 9.8 percentage points over the base models and by 10.3 percentage points over Vanilla RLVR. These results suggest that boundary-aware Curriculum RL can provide a scalable route for LLMs to continuously improve beyond the base model's empirical reasoning capacity boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出边界感知的课程强化学习方法，通过定位模型推理能力边界、针对性教师引导和强化学习巩固，有效提升了LLM的推理能力，在pass@1和pass@256指标上均优于基准模型和普通RLVR方法。
AI.motivation: 主流RLVR方法虽然能提升pass@1，但往往无法扩展基础模型的推理能力边界，甚至可能降低大k值下的pass@k分数。作者希望突破这一局限，实现模型推理能力的持续提升。
AI.method: 首先通过pass@k采样定位当前推理能力边界；然后对接近或超出该边界的样本施以针对性的教师引导；最后使用强化学习巩固新引入的推理模式。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Llama和DeepSeek基础模型上，边界感知课程RL同时提升了pass@1和pass@256分数。平均pass@256较基础模型提升9.8个百分点，较普通RLVR提升10.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 边界感知课程RL能够提供一条可扩展的路径，使LLM持续超越基础模型经验推理能力边界，实现推理能力的有效提升。

title: Can LLMs Reliably Self-Report Adversarial Prefills, and How?
summary: Prior work shows that large language models (LLMs) exhibit introspective capability on benign tasks. We extend the question to safety contexts and examine how reliably a model can recognize that its own prior response was elicited by an adversarial prefill attack. Across ten open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs (3B to 70B) and four safety benchmarks, no model reliably recognizes its own compromised outputs, with models claiming intent on prefilled responses at an average rate of $27.3\%$. Introspective signal stems largely from safety- and refusal-related reasoning. Orthogonalizing models' weights against the refusal direction collapses the gap between claiming rates on prefilled and natural outputs to near zero, though the direction is not its unique mediator. The signal is also probe-dependent: framing the question as internal intention versus external tampering elicits qualitatively different responses on the same models. We test three LoRA finetuning methods (SFT, GRPO, DPO) on eight models from 3B to 27B; all three widen the intention-probe gap on every model from 8B to 27B, with method ranking varying by model. The intervention does not transfer to the tampering probe and counterintuitively raises attack success rate under adversarial prefill on most models, amounting to a partial mitigation. These findings outline mechanisms underpinning the observed introspective signals in safety contexts and highlight risks in the reliability of LLM self-reports.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型在安全情境下的内省能力，发现模型无法可靠地识别自身输出是否受到对抗性前缀攻击的影响，且内省信号主要与安全/拒绝推理相关。通过LoRA微调方法尝试改善，但效果有限甚至适得其反。
AI.motivation: 先前研究显示LLM在良性任务中具备内省能力，但安全情境下模型能否识别自身输出被对抗性前缀攻击所诱导尚不清楚，这对模型安全自我报告的可信度至关重要。
AI.method: 在10个开源指令微调LLM（3B-70B）和4个安全基准上，评估模型识别自身被对抗性前缀攻击输出的可靠性；通过正交化权重、更换探针框架、以及三种LoRA微调方法（SFT、GRPO、DPO）进行干预和分析。
AI.result: 模型平均有27.3%的概率将前缀攻击输出声称具有意图；正交化拒绝方向后声称率差距几乎归零；内省信号对探针框架敏感；三种LoRA微调方法均扩大了意图探针的差距，且多数模型上攻击成功率反而上升。
AI.conclusion: LLM在安全情境下的内省信号机制被阐明，模型自我报告的可靠性存在显著风险，现有微调干预仅能部分缓解且可能适得其反。

title: Decomposing Financial Market Dynamics via Mechanism Analysis in an Evolutionary Multi-Agent Simulation
summary: Evolutionary agent-based markets (ABMs) couple several mechanisms -- who reproduces, how price forms, how biased the agents are, how consensus propagates -- yet these are usually fixed by convention, so it is unclear which mechanism controls which emergent property. In a coevolving, endogenous-price simulator with 120 heterogeneous behavioral agents, we make four mechanisms pluggable and run matched 3x20-seed interventions. We find the levers are largely separable. (1) Selection -> diversity: a Quality-Diversity (QD/MAP-Elites) operator robustly raises strategy-mix entropy over truncation top-k (paired Delta entropy +0.27 to +1.12 bits; sign-test p<0.001; CIs exclude 0) and sustains more strategy cycling (strongest in crisis: Delta=+0.070, p=0.0004). (2) Selection does not improve realism: even a per-agent realism reward that provably steers selection does not raise 5-fact realism (Delta_5=-0.11,-0.08,+0.03; not significant). (3) Microstructure -> realism: enabling reflexive price feedback does raise realism (Delta_5=+0.13,+0.20,+0.20; crisis/bull p<0.05, all CIs positive). (4) Behavior -> fragility: amplifying behavioral bias raises a genomic fragility proxy (Delta=+10.5,+11.1,+14.4; bull p<0.001, all CIs positive) while leaving realism flat. The remaining mechanism -- consensus network topology -- shows no robust effect (honest null). The contribution is a decomposition: in these single-mechanism sweeps the mechanisms behave as approximately distinct control knobs over diversity, realism, and fragility.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可插拔机制实验，发现进化代理市场中的四个机制（选择、微观结构、行为、共识网络）大致可作为独立的控制旋钮，分别调控多样性、真实性和脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有进化代理市场模型中多种机制（谁繁殖、价格如何形成、代理偏见程度、共识如何传播）通常按惯例固定，导致不清楚哪种机制控制哪种涌现特性。
AI.method: 在包含120个异质行为代理的共同进化、内生价格模拟器中，将四个机制设为可插拔，运行匹配的3x20种子干预实验，进行单机制扫描分析。
AI.result: (1)选择机制提升多样性； (2)选择机制不提升真实性； (3)微观结构（反射性价格反馈）提升真实性； (4)行为（放大偏见）增加脆弱性；共识网络无显著效果。
AI.conclusion: 这些机制在单机制扫描中大致表现为独立的控制旋钮，分别调控多样性、真实性和脆弱性，为模型设计提供了可分解的指导。

title: All Routes Lead to Collapse
summary: Attention sinks, representation collapse, and norm stratification are treated as transformer-specific pathologies. We show they are not specific to attention: they are what content-based routing does under a fixed similarity metric. We give a reframing identity: softmax attention is Boltzmann-weighted aggregation over Euclidean distances with constant key norms, so its score omits a $-\|k\|^2$ term and is blind to key magnitude. This predicts that any router whose metric is ill-matched to its representations should compensate, by concentrating its routing and collapsing the routed representations. We test it on routers that score and aggregate over different axes: softmax attention over tokens (nine pretrained transformers), graph attention over nodes, a selective state-space model and a recurrent mixer over time, and learned residuals over depth. All develop the same signature, and two within-model ablations show it is caused by the routing mechanism rather than by incidental dynamics. The form is contingent, set by the strength of the positional brake each router carries alongside its content score; we sweep that brake and move the onset across its whole range. The mechanism is not contingent, and it does not require norm stratification: a router with norm-normalized keys concentrates just the same. We do not claim these models implement Riemannian geometry; the geometric view is a diagnostic that names the inadequacy of the flat, norm-blind metric.

AI.tldr: 本文证明注意力下沉、表示坍缩和范数分层并非Transformer特有，而是任何基于固定相似度度量的内容路由机制都会出现的普遍现象。
AI.motivation: 揭示被广泛认为是Transformer特有病理现象（注意力下沉、表示坍缩、范数分层）的本质，证明它们是内容路由机制在固定相似度度量下的普遍行为，而非注意力机制特有的问题。
AI.method: 重新解释softmax注意力为常数键范数下的玻尔兹曼加权欧几里得距离聚合，指出其评分缺少-||k||²项从而对键的幅度"盲视"。在九种预训练Transformer、图注意力网络、状态空间模型、循环混合器及学习残差等多种架构上验证该预测。
AI.result: 所有测试的架构（包括不同轴上的路由机制）都出现相同的病理特征。通过两种模型内消融实验证明是由路由机制而非偶然动力学导致。位置刹车强度可调节表现形式，但机制本身并非偶然，且不依赖范数分层——范数归一化的键也会出现相同现象。
AI.conclusion: 这些病理现象是内容路由机制在固定相似度度量下的必然结果，而非Transformer特有。几何视角是诊断工具，用以指出扁平且对范数盲视的度量本身的不足。

title: Randomized YaRN Improves Length Generalization for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained on short sequences and then extended to work on longer sequences with additional training. However, such LLMs still struggle to further generalize to very long sequences. We propose Randomized YaRN, a training method that improves length generalization by combining YaRN-based positional extrapolation with randomized positional encoding and a length curriculum. During training on short context data, tokens are assigned YaRN positional encodings sampled from a larger position range, exposing the model to out-of-distribution positional representations even on short-context inputs. We evaluate Randomized YaRN on two challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, BABILong and Multi-Round Coreference Resolution (MRCR). When training on data with <8K context, Randomized YaRN consistently improves reasoning performance on context lengths from 16K to 128K and outperforms standard fine-tuning, with the largest gains appearing at far out-of-distribution lengths. Our results suggest that progressively exposing models to OOD positional distributions provides an effective recipe for generalizable long-context reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Randomized YaRN方法，通过在短序列训练中引入随机化位置编码和长度课程，显著提升LLM在超长序列（16K-128K）上的推理泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在短序列预训练后，尽管经过额外训练，仍难以泛化到极长序列，需要改进长度泛化方法。
AI.method: 结合YaRN位置外推与随机化位置编码及长度课程策略，在短上下文训练时分配更大范围的位置编码，使模型暴露于分布外位置表征。
AI.result: 在BABILong和MRCR基准上，训练于<8K上下文时，在16K到128K长度上持续提升推理性能，超出标准微调，远分布外长度上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 逐步暴露模型于分布外位置分布是提升长上下文推理泛化能力的有效方案。

title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
summary: Hybrid reasoning models can answer directly or spend extra tokens on extended thinking. A practical router should choose between these modes for each query, so easy problems avoid unnecessary reasoning and hard problems receive enough budget to finish the answer. Existing routers move in this direction, but they typically require labeled training data or fix thinking budgets up front, ignoring answer-level evidence from the model itself. We introduce DART, a training-free routing framework that samples two cheap no-think drafts, accepts direct answering when the drafts agree, and predicts a thinking budget from draft entropy when they disagree. Across the main comparisons, DART preserves or improves always-thinking accuracy in most settings while reducing thinking-token use. On math reasoning, accuracy improves by up to $+$9.0 points on Olympiad-level problems while thinking tokens drop 15-69%. On code reasoning under execution-based equivalence, accuracy improves by up to +22.5 points while thinking tokens drop 51-63%. The Stage~1 signal extends across model scales (0.6B-32B), model families, and API-only hosted settings, with no labeled data and no gradient updates required.

AI.tldr: DART是一个无需训练的推理路由框架，通过采样两个廉价的无思考草稿，当草稿一致时直接回答，不一致时根据草稿熵预测思考预算，在保持或提升精度的同时大幅减少推理Token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有路由方法需要标注训练数据或预先固定思考预算，忽略了模型自身提供的答案级证据，无法在简单问题和困难问题之间灵活分配推理资源。
AI.method: DART采样两个廉价的无思考草稿（no-think drafts），当草稿一致时直接接受回答；当不一致时，利用草稿熵（draft entropy）预测所需的思考预算，从而动态决定是否启动推理模式及分配多少推理资源。
AI.result: 在数学推理上，奥林匹克级问题精度提升最高+9.0分，思考Token减少15-69%；在代码推理上，基于执行等价评估，精度提升最高+22.5分，思考Token减少51-63%；该方法在0.6B-32B不同规模、不同模型家族及API-only场景下均有效。
AI.conclusion: DART无需标注数据和梯度更新，通过简单的两阶段信号（草稿一致性+草稿熵）即可实现高效的推理路由，在降低计算成本的同时甚至提升了复杂问题的推理精度。

title: Select-to-Act: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Language Guidance
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been widely applied to sequential decision-making, yet it often suffers from poor sample efficiency due to costly interactions with the environment. A limited line of recent work has started exploring improving RL efficiency by leveraging external knowledge expressed in natural-language instructions. However, the few existing approaches typically treat the entire instruction as a single conditioning input, failing to account for the stage-dependent nature of language guidance, especially in complex environments. In this paper, we propose \emph{Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Language Instructions (HRLLI)}, a hierarchical RL framework that explicitly models natural-language instructions as dynamically selectable semantic guidance during decision-making. HRLLI decomposes instructions into a set of piecewise guidance elements, where each instruction piece may become relevant at different stages of interaction with the environment. A novel hierarchical RL policy structure is then formulated in a \emph{Select-to-Act} paradigm: a high-level semantic policy acts as a guidance selector that selects the most relevant instruction piece to the current state to guide the low-level agent's decision, while a low-level policy executes environment actions conditioned on the selected guidance. The two-level policies are learned simultaneously to maximize augmented expected returns from interactions with the environment. This design enables the agent to adaptively ground language instructions into stage-specific decisions during interaction. Experiments on the instruction-intensive RTFM benchmark show that HRLLI consistently outperforms strong instruction-conditioned RL baselines, demonstrating that explicitly modeling adaptive instruction selection significantly improves the effectiveness of RL.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种分层强化学习框架HRLLI，通过将自然语言指令分解为可动态选择的片段，并采用Select-to-Act范式（高层语义策略选择最相关的指令片段来指导底层智能体决策），显著提升了强化学习在复杂环境中的样本效率和任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法样本效率低下，而将自然语言指令作为条件输入的方法通常将整个指令视为单一条件，忽略了语言指导在复杂环境中的阶段性特点，无法根据交互阶段动态利用指令中的不同部分。
AI.method: 提出HRLLI框架：将指令分解为多个片段，设计两层分层策略——高层语义策略作为"指导选择器"，根据当前状态选择最相关的指令片段；低层策略基于所选指导执行环境动作。两层策略通过最大化增强期望回报进行联合学习。
AI.result: 在指令密集型RTFM基准测试上，HRLLI持续优于现有的指令条件强化学习基线方法，证明了显式建模自适应指令选择能显著提升强化学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语言指令分解为阶段性指导并动态选择，能够更有效地将外部知识融入强化学习决策过程，提升复杂环境下的学习效率和任务完成能力。

title: Capable but Careless: Do Computer-Use Agents Follow Contextual Integrity?
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) now act on a user's behalf across personal applications such as email, calendars, and to-do lists. This cross-application access is useful, but it also creates a privacy risk that has been largely overlooked: when an agent works in one context, it can pull in information from another that is inappropriate in that context. Hence, we introduce AgentCIBench, an evaluation harness that turns this risk into executable, deterministically scored scenarios. We target three common failure modes in CUAs: visual co-location, where the agent pulls in prohibited items that sit next to the task target in the UI; task-ambiguity overshare, where the agent dumps dense personal state in response to an under-specified prompt; and recipient misalignment, where the agent sends content to an addressee for whom it is inappropriate. We evaluate 15 frontier agents and find a surprisingly high failure rate: 11 of 15 leak on more than 50% of scenarios, with an average leakage of 67.9%, and the same failures persist when agents act end-to-end in the environment to complete the task. We release AgentCIBench to encourage the development of safer computer-use agents and position contextual disclosure testing as a pre-deployment safety check.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentCIBench评估框架，测试计算机使用代理在跨应用操作时的上下文信息泄露风险，发现15个前沿代理中有11个在超50%场景下存在信息泄露，平均泄漏率达67.9%。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用代理（CUA）在跨应用执行任务时，可能会从其他上下文拉取不适当的信息，造成隐私风险，但目前缺乏系统评估这一风险的方法。
AI.method: 设计AgentCIBench评估框架，定义三类失败模式（视觉共位、任务模糊过度分享、接收者错位），对15个前沿代理进行确定性评分测试。
AI.result: 15个代理中有11个在超过50%的场景下存在信息泄漏，平均泄漏率67.9%，端到端环境中同样存在该问题。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁将上下文披露测试作为预部署安全检查，并发布AgentCIBench以推动更安全的计算机使用代理开发。

title: Reliability-Guided Adaptive Ensembling for Robust Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate domain shift without source data, but it is highly brittle under adversarially contaminated test streams, where corrupted inputs also destabilize online updates. We study robust test-time adaptation (RTTA) in the adversarial-stream setting, which remains comparatively underexplored relative to standard TTA, and propose SAFER (Stochastic Augmentation Framework for Enhanced Robustness), a training-free reliability-guided augmentation wrapper for RTTA. SAFER preserves the wrapped TTA objective while replacing brittle single-view predictions with a reliability-guided pooled predictor. For each test sample, SAFER generates stochastic augmentations and aggregates their predictions through correlation-weighted pooling with outlier detection. We further study an adaptive-mixing extension that improves clean-performance retention by adjusting original-versus-augmentation weighting using feature disagreement signals. We evaluate on PACS, VLCS, and OfficeHome under PGD attacks at various attack rates. Across benchmarks, SAFER improves resilience of TTA methods to adversarial attacks while maintaining competitive clean performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFER方法，一种无需训练、基于可靠性引导的随机增强包装器，用于提高测试时适应（TTA）方法在对抗性攻击下的鲁棒性，通过聚合随机增强预测和相关性加权投票来替代脆弱的单视图预测。
AI.motivation: 标准TTA方法在对抗性污染的测试流中高度脆弱，受污染的输入会破坏在线更新，而对抗性流下的鲁棒TTA（RTTA）研究相对不足。
AI.method: 提出SAFER框架：对每个测试样本生成随机增强，通过相关性加权池化与异常检测聚合预测；并引入自适应混合扩展，利用特征不一致信号调整原始与增强样本的权重。
AI.result: 在PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome数据集上，在PGD攻击下，SAFER显著提升了TTA方法对抗攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持了有竞争力的干净性能。
AI.conclusion: SAFER是一种有效的、无需额外训练的包装器，能够增强TTA方法在对抗性测试流下的鲁棒性，且不影响干净样本性能。

title: SPADE: Structure-Prior Adaptive Decision Estimation
summary: Physical-structure priors such as conservation laws, Hamiltonian forms, and symmetries can improve scientific machine learning when correct, but can degrade predictions when misspecified. Existing methods usually enforce a chosen structure or tune a soft penalty, without a calibrated rule for deciding whether to impose a prior, how strongly to impose it, which prior to use, or which subset of candidate laws holds. We introduce SPADE, Structure-Prior Adaptive Decision Estimation, a closed-form framework that treats this problem as shrinkage of the structure-violating block of an unconstrained estimator. SPADE uses one exact specification test and one estimand: the test decides whether the prior is supported by data, Stein-unbiased James-Stein shrinkage sets the enforcement strength with an $O(σ^2/n)$ oracle guarantee, and a gate commits to the hard prior only when the test certifies it. The same test yields consistent nested structure selection and Benjamini-Hochberg control for subset discovery in non-nested constraint families. Across a linear-subspace prior, a reservoir conservation law, and a nonlinear Hamiltonian prior on Duffing dynamics, SPADE tracks the oracle, beats a neural-network baseline, reduces correct-prior regret from $10.3\%$ to $2.6\%$, matches cross-validation with $1/71$ of the solves, selects the correct structure with $100\%$ accuracy, and recovers partial laws with controlled false relaxation.

AI.tldr: SPADE是一个闭式框架，通过结构违规块的收缩处理、单一规格检验和Stein无偏James-Stein收缩，自适应地决定是否施加物理结构先验、施加强度及选择正确子集，在多个先验任务中追踪oracle、减少遗憾、节省计算开销。
AI.motivation: 物理结构先验（如守恒律、哈密顿形式）在科学机器学习中若正确可提升性能，但若误设则会降低预测质量。现有方法缺乏校准规则来决定是否施加先验、施加强度、选择哪个先验或哪些子集成立，因此需要一种自适应决策框架。
AI.method: SPADE将问题视为对无约束估计量中结构违规块的收缩处理，使用一个精确规格检验判断先验是否被数据支持，通过Stein无偏James-Stein收缩设置强制强度并具有O(σ²/n)的oracle保证，当检验认证时通过门控提交硬先验。该检验还支持一致嵌套结构选择和Benjamini-Hochberg控制下的非嵌套约束族子集发现。
AI.result: 在线性子空间先验、储层守恒律和Duffing动力学的非线性哈密顿先验上，SPADE追踪oracle，击败神经网络基线，将正确先验的遗憾从10.3%降至2.6%，以1/71的计算求解量匹配交叉验证性能，以100%准确率选择正确结构，并以受控的假放松率恢复部分定律。
AI.conclusion: SPADE提供了一种校准的、自适应的闭式框架，能够高效且可靠地处理物理结构先验的决策问题，显著优于现有基线方法。

title: On the Sparsity-Storage-Accuracy Tradeoff in Parsimoniously Activated Dictionary Learning
summary: Dictionary learning has long been studied from both optimization and probabilistic perspectives. While formulations with element-wise sparsity regularization (e.g., L1-based sparse coding) admit well-established probabilistic interpretations, many structured variants that impose global constraints lack a clear and tractable generative view. In this paper, we revisit a class of practically effective yet theoretically under-explored dictionary learning methods that impose a simple global regularization on the number of activated dictionary atoms, which we term parsimoniously activated dictionary learning (PADL). We show that PADL admits an equivalent formulation as maximum a posteriori estimation under a structured generative model, with auxiliary latent variables that govern global activation patterns. This formulation allows us to derive generalization guarantees that are difficult to obtain under the original formulation. More importantly, it yields an analytical characterization of the tradeoff between sparsity, storage cost, and reconstruction accuracy, enabling data-driven estimation of optimal hyperparameters. Based on this connection, we develop an efficient and interpretable PADL algorithm that eliminates manual hyperparameter tuning, achieving improved reconstruction performance under comparable sparsity levels on visual benchmarks. We further demonstrate its practical utility in accelerating inference for vision-language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并理论化了“简约激活字典学习”（PADL），发现其等价于结构化生成模型的最大后验估计，从而导出泛化保证、稀疏性-存储-重构精度的权衡解析式，并开发出无需手动调参的高效算法，在视觉基准和视觉-语言模型推理加速中取得更好效果。
AI.motivation: 带元素级稀疏正则化的字典学习已有良好概率解释，但许多施加全局约束的结构化变体缺乏清晰易处理的生成视角。本文旨在为一种实践有效但理论不足的PADL方法建立概率基础，并利用该连接推导理论保证与实用算法。
AI.method: 证明PADL等价于一种带辅助隐变量的结构化生成模型的最大后验估计；基于此导出泛化保证与稀疏性-存储-重构精度的分析性权衡；开发无需手动调参的PADL算法。
AI.result: 在视觉基准上，所提方法在同等稀疏水平下实现了更优的重构性能；并在视觉-语言模型的推理加速中展示了实际效用。
AI.conclusion: PADL的概率视角不仅提供了理论上的泛化保证，还揭示了超参数选择的解析依据，从而实现了更优的实用性能，并可用于加速视觉-语言模型推理。

title: HOLMES: Evaluating Higher-Order Logical Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Logical reasoning is essential for reliable AI, yet existing benchmarks are largely first-order-logic-centric, focusing on object-level deduction over fixed predicates. This misses many realistic scenarios where models must reason over rules, predicates, functions, constraints, and decision procedures themselves. We introduce HOLMES (Higher-Order Logic Meets real-world Explainable Symbolic reasoning), the first real-world benchmark for higher-order symbolic reasoning in LLMs, containing 1379 instances. Built on higher-order logic, HOLMES pairs natural-language problems with HOL formalizations, ground-truth answers, verifiable reasoning traces, and fine-grained controllable reasoning factors across law and finance. Experiments show that current LLMs still struggle on HOLMES, with an average accuracy of only 50.64% and the best model reaching 59.54%. Our analyses further reveal that high final-answer accuracy can mask shortcut reasoning in conflict-resolution settings, while performance drops sharply under scope-conditioned and compositional reasoning. These findings identify higher-order symbolic reasoning as a key bottleneck for building reliable and verifiable LLMs. The project code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/wuyucheng2002/HOLMES.

AI.tldr: HOLMES是首个高阶逻辑符号推理基准，包含1379个实例，覆盖法律和金融领域。实验表明当前LLM平均准确率仅50.64%，最佳模型59.54%，揭示高阶符号推理是构建可靠LLM的关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有推理基准多基于一阶逻辑，关注固定谓词上的对象级演绎，无法覆盖现实世界中对规则、谓词、函数、约束和决策程序本身进行推理的场景。
AI.method: 构建基于高阶逻辑的HOLMES基准，包含1379个实例，将自然语言问题与高阶逻辑形式化、真实答案、可验证推理轨迹及细粒度可控推理因子配对，覆盖法律和金融领域。
AI.result: 当前LLM在HOLMES上平均准确率仅50.64%，最佳模型GPT-4达到59.54%；高最终答案准确率可能在冲突解决场景中掩盖捷径推理；在范围条件和组合推理下性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 高阶符号推理是构建可靠可验证LLM的关键瓶颈，现有模型在此方面表现不佳。

title: Multigrid Training for Molecular Generation using Graph Neural Networks
summary: Deep learning has demonstrated significant success for modeling biochemical molecular systems, where inputs are commonly represented as graphs or 3D grids. A major challenge is that computational cost scales with resolution, making full graph/grid computation of molecular densities expensive and often unstable. We introduce a multigrid training strategy that leverages low-resolution optimization to accelerate learning at higher resolution through parameter transfer across discretizations. For graph molecular representations, we progressively transfer parameters learned from a coarse graph to a sequence of increasingly finer graphs via biased random walk upsampling. For 3D molecular generation, we voxelize the molecular structures at multiple resolutions, pretrain a coarse-resolution conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE), and initialize a fine-resolution CVAE by transferring shape compatible convolutional parameters from the coarse model. Numerical experiments on receptor-conditioned 3D Ligand generation show that multigrid training accelerates convergence and improves generalization compared to training from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多网格训练策略，通过在低分辨率下优化学习并跨离散化参数迁移，加速高分辨率图/3D网格分子表示的学习，实验证明该方法在受体条件3D配体生成任务上收敛更快且泛化更好。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在分子建模中计算成本随分辨率增长而急剧增加，高分辨率下的全图/网格计算代价高昂且不稳定，因此需要一种能加速高分辨率训练的策略。
AI.method: 提出多网格训练策略：对于图分子表示，通过有偏随机游走上采样从粗图向细图逐步迁移参数；对于3D分子生成，在多分辨率下对分子结构体素化，先用粗分辨率条件变分自编码器（CVAE）预训练，再用迁移的形状兼容卷积参数初始化细分辨率CVAE。
AI.result: 在受体条件3D配体生成实验中，多网格训练相比从头训练加速了收敛，并提升了泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 多网格训练策略能有效降低分子建模高分辨率训练的计算成本，提高训练效率和模型性能。

title: GIF: Locally Sound Geometric Information Flow Control for LLMs
summary:
Large language models increasingly mediate interactions between sensitive data, untrusted inputs, and privileged actions in agentic systems, creating security and privacy risks. These range from prompt injections that manipulate downstream tool use to leakage of confidential information through model outputs. Recent Information Flow Control (IFC)-based defenses show promise but lack a principled semantic foundation for reasoning about information flow through the model itself. Since any input token may influence any output token in an autoregressive LLM, existing approaches suffer from severe taint explosion.
  We present Geometric Information Flow (GIF), a semantic framework for tracking information flow from input tokens to outputs. GIF uses the LLM Jacobian and local output geometry to upper-bound the Shannon mutual information between perturbed input spans and model outputs, yielding a scalable measure computable on large models via automatic differentiation and low-rank approximation. Unlike attention-based or correlational attribution heuristics, GIF satisfies local geometric soundness, and we provide a fully mechanized Lean 4 proof that it upper-bounds the true information flow induced by a given prompt under local regularity assumptions.
  We evaluate GIF on integrity and confidentiality tasks across multiple prompt-injection and privacy-leakage benchmarks. GIF achieves near-perfect recall even without a downstream declassifier, outperforming attention-based baselines. Combined with lightweight LLM-based declassifiers, it matches or exceeds the F1 of direct LLM-as-judge baselines such as GPT-5.5 xhigh reasoning while using up to 81x lower token cost. GIF flows detected with small surrogate models transfer to larger state-of-the-art models and other model families, even when the surrogate is up to 200x smaller, suggesting black-box deployment without gradient access.

AI.tldr: 本文提出几何信息流（GIF）框架，利用LLM雅可比矩阵和局部输出几何来上界香农互信息，从而高效追踪代理系统中通过大语言模型的信息流，在提示注入和隐私泄露检测任务中达到接近完美召回率，且计算成本极低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于信息流控制（IFC）的防御方法缺乏严格语义基础，且由于自回归LLM中任何输入token都可能影响任何输出token，导致严重的taint爆炸问题。
AI.method: 利用LLM雅可比矩阵和局部输出几何来上界香农互信息，通过自动微分和低秩近似在大模型上高效计算，并使用Lean 4形式化验证其局部几何正确性。
AI.result: 在多个提示注入和隐私泄露基准上达到接近完美召回率，结合轻量级LLM分类器时F1指标匹敌甚至超越GPT-5.5等强基线，token成本降低高达81倍，小代理模型（小200倍）的检测结果可迁移至大模型。
AI.conclusion: GIF提供了一个原则性的信息流语义框架，在完整性（防止提示注入）和机密性（防止隐私泄露）任务上均有效，且支持黑盒部署。

title: Bypassing Minimization Bias: A Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator for Off-Equilibrium Local Learning Coefficients
comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/yingjiacai/SIVE
summary: Singular Learning Theory leverages the Local Learning Coefficient (LLC) to quantify the geometry of neural network loss landscapes. However, mean-energy LLC estimators depend explicitly on an additive loss baseline, typically an estimate of the local minimum. During transient, off-equilibrium training phases, this minimum is unknown; substituting it with the lowest noisy mini-batch loss induces a systematic minimization bias that distorts the geometric measurement. In this paper, we propose the Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator (SIVE), a variance-based local LLC probe that structurally eliminates the unknown additive baseline through the variance operator. Combining this shift-invariant observable with an explicit correction derived from the Law of Total Variance, SIVE separates geometric loss fluctuations from mini-batch evaluation noise. Controlled experiments on analytically tractable toy models show that SIVE recovers the expected finite-temperature geometric signal in regimes where anchored mean estimators fail. Applied to deep neural networks, SIVE provides a robust, localized online diagnostic for tracking structural phase transitions throughout training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator (SIVE)，通过方差算子消除未知加性损失基线，从而在非平衡训练阶段稳健估计局部学习系数（LLC），解决了传统均值估计器因最小化偏差导致的几何测量失真问题。
AI.motivation: 传统 LLC 均值估计器依赖于明确的加性损失基线（即局部最小值估计），但在非平衡训练阶段该基线未知，使用最低噪声小批量损失替代会引入系统性最小化偏差，扭曲几何测量。
AI.method: 提出 SIVE，一种基于方差的局部 LLC 探针，通过方差算子结构性地消除未知加性基线；结合全方差定律的显式校正，将几何损失波动与小批量评估噪声分离。
AI.result: 在解析可解玩具模型上，SIVE 在锚定均值估计器失效的区域恢复预期的有限温度几何信号；在深度神经网络中，SIVE 提供鲁棒的局部在线诊断，用于跟踪训练过程中的结构相变。
AI.conclusion: SIVE 是一种对基线不敏感、鲁棒的 LLC 估计方法，适用于非平衡训练阶段的几何测量与相变检测。

title: EHR-Complex: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Complex Clinical Reasoning
summary: Clinical agents promise to democratize access to electronic health records (EHRs), yet existing benchmarks fail to reflect the complexity of practical EHR analysis, e.g., often operating on idealized, clean EHRs via static SQL generation rather than interactive execution. In this work, we introduce EHR-Complex, a large-scale benchmark designed for interactive clinical database reasoning. Built on the large MIMIC-IV substrate (365K patients, 31 tables, 500M+ records), EHR-Complex comprises about 52K tasks spanning six clinical intents, supporting both patient-level and population-level queries, where each task requires an agent to interact with a sandboxed environment by executing SQL queries or Python code. Notably, EHR-Complex considers the real-world SQL task complexity for longitudinal multi-table aggregation and compositional reasoning, resulting in 31.93 SQL structural components per query on average. Evaluation results on EHR-Complex reveal the clinical difficulty of these EHR reasoning scenarios, with the top-performing model achieving only 62.3% exact-match accuracy. Pass^k consistency drops below 50% for nearly all evaluated models at k=4, exposing broad stochastic fragility. A fine-grained analysis of more than 3,800 failed trajectories for representative LLMs reveals three dominant failure modes: SQL logic errors, medical-code lookup failures, and semantic misunderstandings. EHR-Complex provides a rigorous testbed for clinical agents and highlights remaining gaps in robust reasoning for large-scale EHR analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EHR-Complex基准，用于评估临床智能体在复杂电子健康记录数据库上的交互式推理能力，发现现有顶尖模型准确率仅62.3%，并揭示了SQL逻辑错误、医学术语查找失败和语义误解三类主要失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有基准过于理想化，仅基于静态SQL生成在干净的EHR数据上评估，无法反映实际临床数据库分析中复杂多表聚合、时序推理和交互式执行的真实挑战。
AI.method: 基于MIMIC-IV数据库（365K患者、31张表、5亿+记录）构建约52K个任务，涵盖6种临床意图，支持患者级和群体级查询；要求智能体在沙盒环境中通过SQL或Python代码交互执行，每个查询平均包含31.93个SQL结构组件。
AI.result: 最优模型精确匹配准确率仅62.3%；在k=4时几乎所有模型的Pass^k一致性低于50%；分析3800+失败轨迹发现三类主要失败模式：SQL逻辑错误、医学术语查找失败和语义误解。
AI.conclusion: EHR-Complex为临床智能体提供了严格的测试基准，揭示了大规模EHR分析中鲁棒性推理的显著差距，现有模型在处理真实临床数据库的复杂性和随机性方面仍存在严重不足。

title: Asymptotic Signal Subspace Recovery in Softmax Attention Models
summary: Attention mechanisms have demonstrated remarkable empirical success in identifying relevant information from large collections of tokens, yet the theoretical principles underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. We study a stylized softmax-attention model in which a query vector is learned by stochastic gradient ascent from a collection of informative and nuisance tokens. Exploiting the symmetry of the model, we derive a population objective and characterize the limiting ordinary differential equation governing the learning dynamics. Using tools from stochastic approximation and dynamical systems theory, we establish a rigorous connection between the stochastic learning algorithm and its deterministic limit. Our main result shows that, under suitable high-dimensional scaling assumptions and standard step-size conditions, the learned query converges almost surely to the one-dimensional signal subspace spanned by the latent informative direction. Equivalently, the query asymptotically recovers the latent signal up to the intrinsic sign ambiguity. These results provide a rigorous theoretical foundation for understanding attention mechanisms as signal extraction procedures in high-dimensional noisy environments and offer a dynamical-systems perspective on how attention discovers relevant information in the presence of substantial noise.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机梯度上升学习查询向量，严格证明了在高维噪声环境下，softmax注意力机制学到的查询向量几乎必然收敛到潜在信号子空间，从而为注意力机制作为信号提取过程提供了理论依据。
AI.motivation: 尽管注意力机制在实践中表现出色，但其理论基础尚不清晰，缺乏对注意力如何从大量噪声中识别关键信息的理论理解。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含信息token和噪声token的简化softmax注意力模型，利用对称性推导群体目标函数，刻画学习动力学的常微分方程，并结合随机逼近与动力系统理论建立随机学习算法与其确定性极限之间的严格联系。
AI.result: 在合适的高维缩放假设和标准步长条件下，学到的查询向量几乎必然收敛到由潜在信息方向张成的一维信号子空间，即查询渐近地恢复潜在信号（存在符号歧义）。
AI.conclusion: 为理解注意力机制作为高维噪声环境下的信号提取过程提供了严格的理论基础，并从动力系统视角揭示了注意力如何在大量噪声中发现相关信息。

title: Abstract representational geometry supports inference in large language models
summary: A defining feature of human intelligence is the ability to adapt to changing environments by inferring latent task structure from sparse observations. Neuroscientific research indicates that this capability relies on the hippocampus constructing abstract representations, expressed as low-dimensional, approximately orthogonal manifolds in neural state space. However, the internal mechanisms of large language models (LLMs) remain largely opaque, making it unclear whether they form comparable abstract representations or instead rely on task-specific statistical regularities when performing comparable reasoning tasks. Here we adapt a contextual reversal-learning paradigm to a text-based setting and compare humans and LLMs at both the Behavioural and representational levels. We report that although LLMs exhibit generalizable reasoning less frequently than humans, when such inference occurs, their internal states exhibit abstract geometric structures that resemble those reported in the hippocampus. Notably, this representational geometry is not uniformly distributed but is organized hierarchically across model depth: whereas lower layers show early, stable encoding of stimulus identity, higher layers form a hippocampal-like functional band enriched for abstract context geometry associated with inference. Furthermore, complementary intervention experiments mechanistically implicate geometry in reasoning: task-sequence language modelling induces geometric disentanglement, whereas geometric regularization of higher layers increases the emergence of generalizable inference. Together, these findings establish abstract representational geometry as a mechanistic principle supporting inference in large language models.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比人类和大型语言模型在上下文反转学习任务中的表现，发现LLM虽然推理能力不如人类，但其内部状态在高层形成了类似海马体的抽象几何结构，并且这种几何结构与推理能力存在因果关系。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型是否像人类一样，能够通过构建抽象的、低维且近似正交的神经流形来表示潜在任务结构，从而适应动态变化的环境，而不仅仅依赖任务特定的统计规律。
AI.method: 将上下文反转学习范式改编为文本形式，在行为和表征两个层面比较人类和LLM；分析LLM内部状态的几何结构；通过任务序列语言建模和几何正则化进行干预实验。
AI.result: LLM的泛化推理频率低于人类；但当推理发生时，其内部状态呈现类似海马体的抽象几何结构；这种结构在模型深度上分层组织：低层编码刺激身份，高层形成类似海马体的上下文几何表征；干预实验表明几何结构与推理存在因果关系。
AI.conclusion: 抽象的表征几何结构是支持大型语言模型进行推理的机制性原理。

title: QeHDC: Hyperdimensional Computing based on Quantum-enhanced binding and SuperClass Construction
summary: Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) is a robust computational framework inspired by human cognition characterized by simple and efficient operations within high-dimensional vector spaces. Quantum-enhanced Hyperdimensional Computing (QeHDC) extends classical HDC by leveraging quantum mechanical properties to enhance computational efficiency. In this paper, we propose a novel Quantum HDC framework featuring a one-pass training method, leveraging sinusoidal and quantum encoding to project classical data into quantum amplitude states efficiently. Our framework introduces an innovative reference-state-based quantum binding operation realized via quantum circuits. Furthermore, we propose a density-matrix-based superclass generation strategy employing eigenvalue decomposition to extract critical quantum state features effectively, enabling a more accurate and robust class representation. Experimental evaluations conducted on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate our approach's superior performance, robustness to noise, and computational feasibility compared to traditional classical and existing quantum-enhanced approaches. The results highlight the practical benefits and potential of Quantum HDC for quantum-enhanced classification tasks and pave the way for future advancements in quantum-inspired computational paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于量子超维计算（QeHDC）的新型框架，采用单次训练方法、正弦与量子编码、参考态量子绑定操作，以及基于密度矩阵的超类生成策略，在标准基准数据集上取得了优于传统经典和现有量子方法的性能、鲁棒性和计算可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统HDC虽高效但受限于经典计算瓶颈；量子计算有望进一步提升HDC的效率和能力，但现有量子HDC方法仍存在训练复杂、表征不准确等问题。
AI.method: 1）单次训练方法；2）正弦与量子编码将经典数据映射到量子振幅态；3）基于参考态的量子绑定操作（通过量子电路实现）；4）基于密度矩阵的超类生成策略，利用特征值分解提取关键量子态特征。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上，该方法在分类性能、噪声鲁棒性和计算可行性方面均优于传统经典方法和现有量子增强方法。
AI.conclusion: 该量子HDC框架在量子增强分类任务中展现出实际优势和潜力，为未来量子启发计算范式的发展奠定了基础。

title: Litmus: Zero-Label, Code-Driven Metric Specification for Evaluating AI Systems
summary: As agentic LLM systems move from prototypes to deployment across increasingly diverse domains, evaluating them has become both more important and more difficult. The challenge is not only that individual metrics may be unreliable, but that evaluation goals are often left implicit. Without a clear account of what a system is expected to do, how it can fail, and which failures matter, metric choices become difficult to justify, interpret, or validate. We present Litmus, a zero-label system that designs evaluation and monitoring metrics for AI pipelines by eliciting evaluation intent from source code and targeted interrogation. Instead of assuming that the evaluation target is already known, Litmus first identifies what must be measured and why, then converts those answers into constraints for constructing a justified, per-stage metric portfolio. We evaluate Litmus on three real, code-defined AI pipelines - financial account grouping, scientific QA, and inherent risk assessment - against AutoMetrics and three DynamicRubric baselines. Litmus achieves the broadest or tied-broadest concern coverage, spans more pipeline stages, produces a near-zero-redundancy portfolio, and ranks first in validity against per-row quality labels on all three pipelines - decisively on scientific QA (Spearman $ρ=0.72$ vs. less than $0.47$ for every baseline), and within overlapping confidence intervals in relation to two components of the audit framework despite using no labels during metric design. Our results support a shift from automatic metric implementation to automatic metric specification: before asking which metric to compute, evaluation systems should ask what must be measured and why.
